upcoming_games.name: Drift: Beyond Grip
upcoming_games.description: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.

upcoming_games.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up
upcoming_games.description: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!

upcoming_games.name: The Silence the Woods Keep
upcoming_games.description: 2D action with incremental progression and horror elements. Freely explore the forest, chop trees, and upgrade gear by day. By night, choose to risk it all for valuable resources while facing dangerous monsters with unique behaviors.

upcoming_games.name: Crossing Space Zen
upcoming_games.description: A relaxing 2D space-flight game with real gravity. Carry a whole people asleep on board through eighteen exoduses to a world to land on, or explore the open universe of the Drift. Beautiful suns best admired from afar, and not a single weapon: when trouble comes, you fly.

upcoming_games.name: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Video Game Store!
upcoming_games.description: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Game Store! — Sort games, consoles, and accessories in a retro game store. Restore messy shelves, unlock useful upgrades, and enjoy turning chaos into perfect order.

upcoming_games.name: Ghost Express
upcoming_games.description: Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Fit each shop's goods into boxes piece by piece, then deliver them to the apartment next door. As the orders pile up and space runs out, can Spooky get the job done?

upcoming_games.name: Armory Keeper
upcoming_games.description: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Find and sort over 3,000 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the armory. Place every item on its correct rack and unlock abilities to organize faster and more efficiently.

upcoming_games.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer
upcoming_games.description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

upcoming_games.name: Futa Paradise Resort
upcoming_games.description: Inherit a crumbling island resort — and the five gorgeous staff who refuse to let it die. Rebuild the business, outplay a corporate shark, and fall for one of them in this fully voiced adult visual novel with animated scenes. One resort. Five hearts. You can only choose one.

upcoming_games.name: AXIS FALL
upcoming_games.description: Fallock is a very relaxing top-down puzzle game where knowledge and discovery are key. Explore a minimalist maze, fall to reach new areas, and collect every number.

upcoming_games.name: Ice Cream Truck Simulator
upcoming_games.description: Start your engine and cool down the city! Hop into your fully interactive ice cream truck, drive through the neighborhood, and build your own ice cream empire. Take orders, scoop the perfect flavors, operate the card terminal, and manage your inventory on your in game laptop.

upcoming_games.name: The Rouge Casino
upcoming_games.description: Eight crooked casino tables, one roguelite spine. Rig the wheel, load the dice, mark the cards — stack charms, omens and gilded editions until the house edge is yours. Eight antes, eight stakes, eighty challenges, Endless beyond. No real gambling — just a casino you finally get to cheat.

upcoming_games.name: Tankii
upcoming_games.description: A multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.

upcoming_games.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR
upcoming_games.description: A happy North American neighborhood awaits you! Play solo or with up to 9 friends. Build your crew, take on jobs around the neighborhood, earn money and buy houses. Create your own cash flow and happily build your real estate empire!

upcoming_games.name: Smashboom
upcoming_games.description: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

upcoming_games.name: Mining Away!
upcoming_games.description: Mining Away! is a short incremental game in which you mine ores, collect resources, progress through the vast skill tree, find rare relics, and unlock powerful pickaxes!

upcoming_games.name: Working95
upcoming_games.description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

upcoming_games.name: Near Mint
upcoming_games.description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

upcoming_games.name: Rapid Escalation
upcoming_games.description: A fast-paced incremental space shooter where short battles fuel permanent upgrades and exponential growth.

upcoming_games.name: Space Numbers Go Up
upcoming_games.description: A short incremental game about space mining. Walk around your ship, physically interact with it's systems, blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your gear and watch numbers go up.

upcoming_games.name: The Great 48
upcoming_games.description: A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games. Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!

upcoming_games.name: Castlebound
upcoming_games.description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

upcoming_games.name: The Vast White
upcoming_games.description: A snowy mountain, the stillness, and you. With the help of your snowboard, rediscover the memories buried in the snow. Meet the locals, explore every path, and bring the ski resort back to life.

upcoming_games.name: Animal Zone
upcoming_games.description: Animal zone is a fast and furious one-shot one-kill 2D shooter game. Make headshots, tear your opponents to pieces, and stay alive to take your place in the food chain! Face off against your friends and other players in this brutal animal world.

upcoming_games.name: The Hidden Index
upcoming_games.description: Investigue os recantos mais profundos da dark web neste jogo de terror psicológico e mistério. Analise arquivos, decifre terminais e desvenda segredos perturbadores numa atmosfera tensa e imersiva. Cada clique aproxima-o do desconhecido.

upcoming_games.name: Cubetoria: Build. Think. Solve.
upcoming_games.description: Fill the cube with no gaps. 100 hand-made 3D polycube challenges from the Cubetoria Series 1 puzzle book, from your first 2×2×2 to expert Pro builds. Turn, tilt and snap colourful pieces into place, find every answer, keep a daily streak and build your own puzzles.

upcoming_games.name: Mini Battleships
upcoming_games.description: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.

upcoming_games.name: MARK IT
upcoming_games.description: Draw marks on a blank white jigsaw. Your own clues are the only way to put it back together! But as the levels go on, your marks may be erased, copied, flipped, rotated and more, so plan ahead and make sure they still give you the clues you need.

upcoming_games.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer
upcoming_games.description: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.

upcoming_games.name: WhoKilledKK
upcoming_games.description: This is a first-person horror adventure game where you enter the mansion of Kun Kun, the richest man in Aikun City. Everything inside has been eerily controlled. Kun Kun has set up a series of puzzles to stop intruders. Can you solve these puzzles and escape Kun Kun's mansion?

upcoming_games.name: Project Hole
upcoming_games.description: A cosy digging game set in a British back garden. Shovel, pick and drill through turf, clay and rock, sell every load, upgrade your tools and build ladders, belts and lifts as you dig hundreds of metres down to unearth treasures, crystal caves, lava and a buried secrets. Dig alone or with friends.

upcoming_games.name: Demon Castle Guard
upcoming_games.description: You are the Demon Lord, and every woman in the land wants to move into your castle. The rejected ones show up with armies for a "hostile job interview." Merge slimes, hold the gate, and pass them all. A cheeky pixel-art tower defense comedy with adult content.

upcoming_games.name: Military Base Tidy Up
upcoming_games.description: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.

upcoming_games.name: Shai & Shatta
upcoming_games.description: Run a lively Egyptian street kitchen solo or with friends. Brew shai, build ful sandwiches, and master koshary as orders pile up and the neighborhood causes chaos. Cook with up to 4 players locally or 8 online.

upcoming_games.name: Heart of the Deep
upcoming_games.description: A pixel-art incremental game about a dwarf clan digging 200 levels down to rekindle the World's Heart. Break rocks, defeat guardians, hire and upgrade dwarves, grow the Rune Tree and set out on new expeditions.

upcoming_games.name: Heroinu
upcoming_games.description: Simple is the Beast.

upcoming_games.name: SPACE BUMPS: A Bad Space Day
upcoming_games.description: A sci-fi point-and-click comedy about a stranded mechanic, strange machines, and a rescue operation that doesn't add up. Explore StationVille, solve inventory puzzles, talk to eccentric locals, and repair your way through Wil's very bad space day.

upcoming_games.name: Haste Makes Waste
upcoming_games.description: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.

upcoming_games.name: Terrified Gorillas
upcoming_games.description: A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

upcoming_games.name: Veltarum
upcoming_games.description: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

upcoming_games.name: 모야이게임
upcoming_games.description: Dodge enemy fire and challenge the bosses in this quirky arcade shoot 'em up. Collect Power, hold Shift for precise movement, and use Spell and Lightning to escape danger. Tackle four stages and a final boss, then chase your best local score.

upcoming_games.name: Fishwake
upcoming_games.description: Eat, grow and survive in a fast-paced underwater arcade adventure. Hunt smaller fish, evade predators, master currents and bosses, and fight your way through 50 handcrafted levels to the top of the food chain.

upcoming_games.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡
upcoming_games.description: A tower defense game with team building and online co-op. Recruit heroes, combine synergies, forge equipment and choose Heavenly Gifts. Manage resources between waves, counter invisible and flying enemies, and defend the crossing between two realms, solo or with friends.

upcoming_games.name: Horde Highway: Zombie Survivors on Wheels
upcoming_games.description: A bullet heaven roguelite on wheels: plow through thousands of zombies, evolve your car into a rolling arsenal, and survive the drive. 10 cars, evolving weapons, 40 stages across 4 worlds, a boss at the end of every stage.

upcoming_games.name: Mediotorum
upcoming_games.description: Enter Mediotorum, a fantasy world torn by rival factions. Collect cards, forge your deck, and face other players in turn-based duels where every decision can tip the balance of the war.

upcoming_games.name: Dear Gravity
upcoming_games.description: Fold a little hope. Let it fly. Read the wind, refine your paper plane and feel the quiet triumph of a difficult delivery landing just right. From your first window launch to a letter at the lighthouse, go a little further with every throw.

upcoming_games.name: Clay Galaxy
upcoming_games.description: Clay Galaxy is a cozy casual puzzle game set in a unique clay-crafted space universe. Explore small planets, solve logic challenges, and progress location by location to move further.

upcoming_games.name: Breeding Pit
upcoming_games.description: You are the Dark Lord. Breed an orc horde in the pit beneath your tower, where every whelp inherits real genes from its sire and dam. Send them to war in retro turn-based battles, and raise a dynasty strong enough to put out the Light.

upcoming_games.name: Ghosts Before Dawn
upcoming_games.description: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.

upcoming_games.name: The Guiding Light
upcoming_games.description: The Guiding Light is a single-player action RPG with pixel heroes and a 3D fantasy world. Choose Warrior, Mage, Tank, Archer, or Swordsman; master unique skills, explore villages and dungeons, and defeat foes and bosses. Find your fighting style, grow stronger, and light the way home.

upcoming_games.name: HELIX ARK
upcoming_games.description: Adam has crash-landed on an alien world with Eve, a human restoration device. Rebuild civilization from a single human, develop cities, and combine technology with cultures unlocked through alien diplomacy to fuel explosive population growth in this sci-fi incremental simulation.

upcoming_games.name: SNIP SNAP
upcoming_games.description: Snap it. Snip it. Stick it. An online party game: take photos in a colorful 3D world, cut them up and stick the pieces together to make what the round asks for. Then vote and guess who made what. No drawing skills needed.

upcoming_games.name: Dave: Leg it
upcoming_games.description: Dave’s starving and the chippy shuts soon. Run, dash, swing and slime your way across 16 levels of grim British streets in this fast, frantic speedrun platformer. Beat your best, race your ghost and get Dave his chips while they’re still hot.

upcoming_games.name: Mix & Slice: ASMR Simulator
upcoming_games.description: Pour coloured sand and soap into moulds, pop them out, then slice them open. Every grain keeps its colour, so each cut reveals exactly what you built. Watch slabs peel, fall and crumble to crisp, close-up ASMR sound.

upcoming_games.name: Project Babel
upcoming_games.description: Create custom maps and share your puzzles for others to conquer. Race on global leaderboards in a falling-block roguelite with typing, rune combos and strategic builds. Choose Oaths, raise the Heat and adapt as sanity shifts.

upcoming_games.name: SOMNIMAZE
upcoming_games.description: That night, after playing a maze, I dreamed I was in one. Find your way through five mazes and wake up to a refreshing morning.

upcoming_games.name: Sumverse
upcoming_games.description: Power your spaceship with number puzzles in Sumverse. Swap and stack cores, match row and column totals, and connect numbers into an unbroken trail. Brave cosmic hazards, deliver troublesome cargo, and upgrade your ship as you save for a bigger family home.

upcoming_games.name: 阿飛 AFEI
upcoming_games.description: A fruit fly in a glass box on a windowsill. A small, slow game: place fruit, tap the glass and watch it walk, eat and take off, across 20 tasks. Its brain is a simplified model built from the published wiring map of a fly's central nervous system. All movements are assisted by code.

upcoming_games.name: Peekour
upcoming_games.description: Peekour is a 2D pixel art platformer. YOU desperately need to pee and only the final toilet counts! Run, jump and parkour through 6+ levels. Collect coins and bottles of water to get more pee, and customize your experience with 40+ skins.

upcoming_games.name: Sort Them Dice
upcoming_games.description: Turn a chaotic dice shop into a satisfying collection. Pick up, inspect and sort 4,095 colorful dice into matching sets, fill wooden shelves and unlock handy upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.

upcoming_games.name: Flopball
upcoming_games.description: Flopball is a football party game for up to 6 players online. Score goals, slide into tackles and send your rivals tumbling. Power-ups and wild arena events can turn any play upside down. Team up with friends or practise against bots offline.

upcoming_games.name: HAMSTER WHEEL ISEKAI
upcoming_games.description: I died. I reincarnated as a hamster. Now I must break the world speed record. A pixel-art gear-shifting wheel racer and incremental RPG that starts cozy... and ends at the speed of light.

upcoming_games.name: Shelves Full of Figures
upcoming_games.description: A room full of empty shelves and a floor full of little figures. Pick up each one, find the shelf where it belongs and put it back on! Earn ability points as you go and unlock new ways to move and sort in this relaxing first-person organizing game.

upcoming_games.name: Mazehold
upcoming_games.description: Build the maze. Hold the keep. A tower defense roguelite without waves: wall in an endless horde across 7 worlds, combine 15 towers into 104 combos, draft cards as you level up – and survive 20 minutes until the final boss marches on your castle.

upcoming_games.name: Roadweave
upcoming_games.description: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.

upcoming_games.name: DEEP SEAL
upcoming_games.description: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.

upcoming_games.name: Scrapline
upcoming_games.description: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

upcoming_games.name: Crossfire 2D
upcoming_games.description: Crossfire 2D — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

upcoming_games.name: Softfall
upcoming_games.description: A cozy winter MOBA on a snowy mountain. Two teams of five fight to chase the other team's eagle off the mountain. Quick matches, Easy to learn, and best with friends. The basics come down to: chopping down trees, fishing, and even hiding in the snow.

upcoming_games.name: Close the strait !
upcoming_games.description: Close the Strait is an incremental modern warfare tower defense roguelite. Choose between the rival Meridian Compact and Vostra Union, defend your oil with tanks, missiles, aircraft, warships, and submarines, and upgrade after every defeat until you control the strait.

upcoming_games.name: Grindveil
upcoming_games.description: A free online idle RPG in Early Access. Develop your class, collect equipment, send your hero on missions, fight in the arena and challenge bosses. Join a guild or take a fishing break. The game is still in active development.

upcoming_games.name: Teddy Store: Tidy Up
upcoming_games.description: A cozy first-person sorting game. 2,100 plush teddy bears are scattered all over a toy store. Sort them onto the right shelves and bring the store back to order.

upcoming_games.name: Bustout: Anime Girls
upcoming_games.description: Smash through blocks and strip gorgeous anime women. Bustout is a fast, sexy twist on classic Breakout. Master every ricochet, chase high scores, and let those perfect busts out.

upcoming_games.name: Confess To Me
upcoming_games.description: Confess to Me is a dark, kinetic novella rated 18+ about power, psychological pressure, and dangerous attraction.

upcoming_games.name: Crash Relay
upcoming_games.description: Up to 10 players. Two players per car. Share the controls, grab weapons and powers, and sabotage rival teams in Crash Relay, a chaotic multiplayer racing game where teamwork is the key to reaching the finish line.

upcoming_games.name: Souls Caps
upcoming_games.description: A rhythm-driven roguelite deckbuilder. Hit the beat to drop your caps, chain throw after throw, and earn your job at Soulbuster!

upcoming_games.name: RENSE
upcoming_games.description: A fast survivors roguelite FPS with aggressive combat. Fight against waves of enemies and bosses. Level up, find and stack up loot and grow powerful until your attacks fill the screen. Create unique builds with deep customization.

upcoming_games.name: Crime and Punishment
upcoming_games.description: Dostoevsky’s complete, unabridged Russian text staged as a visual novel, with illustrated scenes and optional choices that preserve the original.

upcoming_games.name: Starlight Cove
upcoming_games.description: Cast your line, catch fish, and watch the numbers go up! Upgrade your gear, reel in bigger catches, and rebuild Starlight Cove in this cozy fishing incremental. Just one more fish, one more upgrade… and maybe you’ll finally help Grandpa catch the four legendary fish that have eluded him for years.

upcoming_games.name: A Bun Above
upcoming_games.description: Layers score off their neighbors: cheese melts onto the patty, tomato lifts the bacon, a full BLT multiplies the lot. Every layer adds to the score — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. A physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.

upcoming_games.name: BRAINFREEZE
upcoming_games.description: A first-person ice cream roguelike. Serve the line, hit the quota, and hand every cent to a boss who is very clear about what happens if you come up short. Draft cards between shifts to build a run that survives one more day. The truck is locked. The phone is ringing. Get scooping.

upcoming_games.name: Drawmi: Twin Stick
upcoming_games.description: An action-packed twin stick arena shooter where you can draw all of the enemies, players, weapons, and obstacles.

upcoming_games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
upcoming_games.description: A co-op INFINITE creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree. Grab new creatures from the Community Workshop to infinitely grow your collection and world.

upcoming_games.name: Pray Your God!
upcoming_games.description: Found your cult. You choose a number, I choose one after you, and praying is all you get. Miss, and your cult loses a follower. Match, and heaven removes me: sixteen ways, none I would care to describe. You will miss. Two to four minutes a cult. The paperwork is ready.

upcoming_games.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
upcoming_games.description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

upcoming_games.name: 2in1
upcoming_games.description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

upcoming_games.name: Hell is Neon Colored
upcoming_games.description: A minimalist twin-stick shooter drenched in neon glow. Deep weapon customization and more than 350 weapon and ability combinations provide your arsenal as you delve deep in rogue-lite progression and complex mounting challenges.

upcoming_games.name: PeeVPee
upcoming_games.description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

upcoming_games.name: Journey TD
upcoming_games.description: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.

upcoming_games.name: Tai Chi Tarot
upcoming_games.description: In just three minutes a day, draw Tarot through an original Bagua spread and receive a symbolic daily reading — a daily ritual where Eastern wisdom meets Western Tarot. Explore nine life themes across twenty-eight cards and eight palaces, framed by a quiet, ink-wash world built for reflection.

upcoming_games.name: WDR:window rush
upcoming_games.description: Ultimate mini idle tower defense! Cute pixel heroes are waiting to join you in defending against data invasions – right inside your desktop popups. Use an extensive variety of tower combinations and your brilliant tactical setups to fend off the boredom of everyday life!

upcoming_games.name: Infall: A Black Hole Incremental
upcoming_games.description: A short, relaxing incremental game about growing a black hole. Start smaller than dust, end swallowing galaxies.

upcoming_games.name: Piggy Monte
upcoming_games.description: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

upcoming_games.name: Crystalase
upcoming_games.description: Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.

upcoming_games.name: Neon Horde
upcoming_games.description: A neon action survivor: endless hordes, auto-firing weapons, and screen-clearing evolutions in 15-minute runs. The twist? You keep earning coins EVEN WHILE THE GAME IS CLOSED. Come back, spend them on permanent upgrades, master 7 heroes, and hit the arena stronger every single time.

upcoming_games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
upcoming_games.description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

upcoming_games.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive
upcoming_games.description: Operate a modular tape-decoding machine and solve hands-on puzzles to restore corrupted data and reconstruct the story behind a deadly attack.

upcoming_games.name: Deep Digger
upcoming_games.description: Dig down, sell what you haul up, go deeper. A pixel-art mining incremental about numbers that climb: 19+ ores, 40+ permanent talents, sealed caves, portals to other dimensions. Prestige and keep what you built. The tenth run clears in minutes what the first took an hour.

upcoming_games.name: Wheel Be Fine
upcoming_games.description: The world has gone dark! and only your hamsters can fix it. Spin the wheel, collect strange little hamsters and upgrade until your room powers the city, the country and the whole planet. A cozy incremental clicker that keeps running while you're away.

upcoming_games.name: Lucky Hell
upcoming_games.description: A dice game scored on Yahtzee hands. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Clear the target score and you move down a stage, and a shop opens in between. On the way down you hit stages where the dealer has bent one rule.

upcoming_games.name: Warpack
upcoming_games.description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

upcoming_games.name: Lucky Crafter
upcoming_games.description: A potion-brewing roguelite on a four-ring wheel. Every combination of ingredients is its own potion, with over 4,000 to discover. Ingredients add up, bottles multiply the price and boosts push it further. Pick runes and reach growing delivery targets before your spins run out.

upcoming_games.name: Avalon Jewels 3 Collector's Edition
upcoming_games.description: Restore the magic of Avalon in a fantasy Match-3 adventure! Battle the Shadow King's minions across 250 handcrafted levels, explore enchanted realms, master magical powers, and choose between Relaxed or Puzzle Mode as you save the kingdom from darkness.

upcoming_games.name: Nova Protocol
upcoming_games.description: A neon bullet heaven at absurd scale. Thousands of wireframe enemies, one auto-firing interceptor, and a grid floor that buckles beneath the swarm. Draft augments, evolve your weapons, and survive a boss every five waves — until the Black Hole arrives at wave thirty, then it's the Finale wave!

upcoming_games.name: When Life Gives You Lemons
upcoming_games.description: Run a lemonade stand with or against 3 of your friends! Cooperate or sabotage each other while you, mix ingredients, craft the perfect recipe, squeeze fresh juice, and keep your customers happy. Order fruits and equipment, unlock upgrades and grow your stand into the ultimate business empire.

upcoming_games.name: Procession Engine
upcoming_games.description: Not another turn-based deckbuilder. A real-time tug of war where you command a whole army: your buildings spawn it, your cards shape it, and two lanes decide whose stronghold falls first.

upcoming_games.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO
upcoming_games.description: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

upcoming_games.name: The Pretty Big Pile
upcoming_games.description: There is a pretty big pile of colored cubes. Sort those cubes by color into trucks. That is pretty much all there is! This game came to me in a dream, so I made it. Treat it as something to chip away at over time, slowly uncovering whatever lies within the pile.

upcoming_games.name: Cats Love Cakes
upcoming_games.description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

upcoming_games.name: First Light
upcoming_games.description: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

upcoming_games.name: Would you mine?
upcoming_games.description: A Minesweeper incremental game where you mine resources, upgrade your pickaxe and stats, and avoid being killed by enemies on your way to revealing ancient relics.

upcoming_games.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
upcoming_games.description: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

upcoming_games.name: Soundway
upcoming_games.description: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.

upcoming_games.name: Swarmbreaker
upcoming_games.description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

upcoming_games.name: SUSPECIES
upcoming_games.description: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode or show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.

upcoming_games.name: Dream Glitcher
upcoming_games.description: Enter the fractured mind of Luna, an android learning to feel. Explore memories, solve puzzles, and influence her perception through your choices in a hand-drawn cyberpunk point-and-click adventure where identity, control, and reality are never quite what they seem.

upcoming_games.name: Alpha 7: The Last Hope
upcoming_games.description: One-click evasive & defensive bullet hell. Interact with the environment and prove your reflexes to survive the greatest space mission in the year 2075 to save humanity from the reptilian invasion.

upcoming_games.name: Click Dystopia
upcoming_games.description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

upcoming_games.name: Turnabout Tactics
upcoming_games.description: A chess puzzle game where you play both sides, no opponent, no checkmate. Each level sets its own objectives. Some pieces explode when captured, others freeze or shield the squares around them, and some move right through other pieces. Rewind freely until every objective is met at once.

upcoming_games.name: Protocell
upcoming_games.description: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

upcoming_games.name: Defend The HexCore
upcoming_games.description: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

upcoming_games.name: Great Space Race of 3032
upcoming_games.description: Test your piloting skills in a 6-DOF space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or race the clock solo. Clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy. Get there first to win.

upcoming_games.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
upcoming_games.description: An idle breaker where you can't miss. Buy and upgrade orbs. Smash skeletons. Go deeper. The orbs bounce on their own: no aiming required, and no way to lose. Click if you want to help — or don't.

upcoming_games.name: TALES: INK GUARDIAN
upcoming_games.description: A 2D roguelike where ink and plants define your fate. Combine skills, relics, and plant abilities to craft a unique build every run. Purify the Void Ink threatening to consume the world — because no two runs, and no two strategies, are ever the same.

upcoming_games.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector
upcoming_games.description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

upcoming_games.name: Cubic Color Confusion
upcoming_games.description: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

upcoming_games.name: La Agencia del Riel
upcoming_games.description: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.

upcoming_games.name: One Lucky AA
upcoming_games.description: ONLY LUCK !!! In this adventure, every step is a bet. Navigate through perilous trials where strategy meets pure chance. Master unique luck-management mechanics to survive when the odds are zero.

upcoming_games.name: Patience Balls
upcoming_games.description: Tilt interconnected boards to guide the balls into their holes. Master 100 hand-crafted levels across walled Zen Mode and wall-less Patience Mode, create custom puzzles with the Level Editor, and climb global leaderboards.

upcoming_games.name: Gobs & Gears
upcoming_games.description: The Gob King wants his bomb and he wants it NOW! Scout the Fog, reclaim lost Buildings, run Trundler routes to feed them. Deliver the goods then rip it all up and move on. A scrappy logistics puzzle where nothing is permanent.

upcoming_games.name: Stress Buddy
upcoming_games.description: A stress-relief ball that interacts with your desktop. It’s your fidgety friend. Your anti-productivity accomplice. Your little buddy who breaks up the monotony of work, school, games, and streams. Fling it. Switch it. Send it on a mission of chaos. Now with multiplayer!

upcoming_games.name: Rocket.io
upcoming_games.description: is an online multiplayer arena game where hover-cars battle for territory. Leave a trail, claim ground, and cut off your rivals! Play quick matches, private rooms, and battles with 2 to 8 teams, or take on the AI. Collect and customize over 25 vehicles.

upcoming_games.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
upcoming_games.description: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

upcoming_games.name: 12 Board Games
upcoming_games.description: A collection of 12 board games, including Gomoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, Chinese Chess, Reversi, Draughts, Four in a row, Shogi, Jungle Chess, Junqi, Nine Men's Morris, and Mancala.

upcoming_games.name: Rejected Draft
upcoming_games.description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

upcoming_games.name: FISH OS
upcoming_games.description: An idle fishing game that lives inside a fake 1997 operating system. Click the water to fish, then run your catch through a desktop where every window is a mechanic: an aquarium that buffs your income, a fish market, a fleet you send out overnight. 250 species. Solitaire included.

upcoming_games.name: Physics Clicker
upcoming_games.description: A click-based incremental game themed around "physics". You will start with the most fundamental classical mechanics and gradually unlock more concepts. Through the process of easy clicking and growth, with the familiar media - PHYSICS, experience the fun of resource exploration and growth.

upcoming_games.name: Farm & Feast
upcoming_games.description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

upcoming_games.name: Hyperlane Highway
upcoming_games.description: A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed. Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards. Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.

upcoming_games.name: Slotbound
upcoming_games.description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

upcoming_games.name: Swarmbreak
upcoming_games.description: Swarmbreak is a Twin-stick survival shooter/bulletheaven with a swarm that never stops. Grab weapons off the floor, pick perks every level-up, and perma unlock new characters, weapons and harder Threat levels with every run. Then push past your best time.

upcoming_games.name: Bottled by Bears
upcoming_games.description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

upcoming_games.name: DNA FIGHT
upcoming_games.description: 3D Pretty Girl Dress-Up Fighting Game, earn DNA in battles to unlock skills and outfits. Experience the authentic feel of an arcade-style fighting game, with an original combat system, delivering exhilarating infinite combos and counter-infinite combos.

upcoming_games.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames
upcoming_games.description: Ride attractions, play minigames and chase online high scores across three themed islands! Shoot ducks, feed raptors with a crossbow, hunt pterosaurs from a roller coaster or rescue sailors from the kraken. Win teddies at the Claw Machine and collect Dino Cards for your Lodge.

upcoming_games.name: Woke Busters
upcoming_games.description: The world has gone mad and the only man who can fix it skipped leg day. WokeBuster is a satirical cartoon adventure through the culture war: puzzles, minigames, Buzzlings to catch and a cast with permanently unhinged faces. If one joke offends you, it's working.

upcoming_games.name: PegLotto!
upcoming_games.description: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

upcoming_games.name: Logic Arrows
upcoming_games.description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

upcoming_games.name: cenker's mod
upcoming_games.description: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.

upcoming_games.name: Last Chance: Birth
upcoming_games.description: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

upcoming_games.name: Tape Man
upcoming_games.description: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

upcoming_games.name: Treeternal
upcoming_games.description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

upcoming_games.name: Hexograph
upcoming_games.description: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

upcoming_games.name: Project: Haste
upcoming_games.description: Break in. Tear it up. Get out before the cops show up. Wall run, slide, double jump and rocket-jump off your own shotgun across places you don't belong. Headshot your friends mid-air and chain eliminations in a lightning-fast 4-player arena shooter you can pick up in a single match.

upcoming_games.name: Shroomy Garden
upcoming_games.description: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.

upcoming_games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
upcoming_games.description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

upcoming_games.name: 99Day Survival Guide
upcoming_games.description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

upcoming_games.name: Sting Operation
upcoming_games.description: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

upcoming_games.name: Brickino: The 3D Domino Game
upcoming_games.description: Tabletop Gaming Inspired, Brickino is The 1st 3D Domino Game, where matching numbers horizontal and vertical gains points on the scorecard; Don't knock or tip them over or Game Over! This is an Ancient Game with a Right-Now Vision, made into digital.

upcoming_games.name: The Devil's Due
upcoming_games.description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

upcoming_games.name: Nova's
upcoming_games.description: Join this R&D simulation to help Nova build better weapons for her galactic defense company. Upgrade your weapons, the simulated enemies, and the simulation itself in this satisfying idle/incremental game that sits at the bottom of your desktop.

upcoming_games.name: Hidden Bananas
upcoming_games.description: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all? 🍌🏝️

upcoming_games.name: UNBOXING: 1-BIT PARADOX
upcoming_games.description: Your death is the best tool you have. Throw yourself into spikes, pile up your own bodies, and use your remains and your companion box to solve logic puzzles. Break the loop in a 1-bit paradox where you have to die to survive.

upcoming_games.name: Homemaking: Build & Decorate
upcoming_games.description: Build a home from the first wall to the last cushion: draw the rooms, paper the walls and furnish them from a thousand pieces. Walk through homes built by other players, rate them and get your own homes rated.

upcoming_games.name: Tears Apart
upcoming_games.description: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built on five consecutive dash attacks called Tears. Equip upgrades to the Tears you choose, master your combat cycle, and carve through the Decay.

upcoming_games.name: Growth: Automate & Collect
upcoming_games.description: Growth is a cozy farming automation game where you turn a small farm into a growing production network. Plant crops, collect resources, process items, connect machines with conveyors, complete orders, and explore the world with your loyal dog by your side.

upcoming_games.name: Nocturnal 2
upcoming_games.description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

upcoming_games.name: My Child New Beginnings
upcoming_games.description: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.

upcoming_games.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior
upcoming_games.description: Imagine an alien Sudoku where the numbers are elements. Figure out which element to place on the grid, where, and when!? In order to maintain balance, each element must harmonize with the others. “Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!” For adults and children.

upcoming_games.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
upcoming_games.description: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.

upcoming_games.name: The Intruder
upcoming_games.description: This game is about escaping from a terrifying presence within an underground facility

upcoming_games.name: The Sea is Our Stage
upcoming_games.description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

upcoming_games.name: Block Garden
upcoming_games.description: A 3D puzzle game about bringing jelly blocks together. Blocks of the same color stick when they touch, and once they're stuck they move as one piece. Push them around small islands with a cat until each color is joined up.

upcoming_games.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
upcoming_games.description: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless business expenses, outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

upcoming_games.name: Corporate Dash
upcoming_games.description: Corporate Dash is a hilarious party racing game for 2–9+ players! Use your smartphones to place bets, play sneaky cards, and watch your office colleagues race through hilarious chaos. Outsmart your friends, survive unexpected disasters, and climb the corporate ladder!

upcoming_games.name: Vending Machine Simulator
upcoming_games.description: A first-person business sim about keeping a growing network of vending machines profitable. Start with $4,000, a tired van and one snack machine, then drive around Millbrook restocking, repairing and haggling over leases. Up to four players can share one company over a LAN.

upcoming_games.name: No One Runs Alone
upcoming_games.description: No One Runs Alone is a chaotic multiplayer survival game where you and your team are bound together by the Soulbinder. Outsmart the Hunter, grab powerful perks, adapt to wild game modes, and make every escape a hilarious fight for survival.

upcoming_games.name: 神话大乱斗
upcoming_games.description: MythBrawl is an ink-wash dark fantasy roguelike deck-builder rooted in Chinese mythology. Choose 1 of 5 classes - Sword, Martial, Bow, Magic or Talisman - forge a deck from 1200+ cards, and battle 125 mythical monsters across 5 realms to end the twilight of the gods!

upcoming_games.name: Hellmouth
upcoming_games.description: Hellmouth is a bullet hell top-down shooter that drops you right in the middle of post-industrial hell. Blast through hordes of demons, create unique upgrades, and hopefully escape?!

upcoming_games.name: Aveos
upcoming_games.description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

upcoming_games.name: Voltswarm
upcoming_games.description: A lone robot faces an ever-growing machine swarm in this 3D bullet heaven. Weapons fire automatically. Choose your weapons, upgrades, cores, and mods wisely, then survive escalating waves of industrial chaos.

upcoming_games.name: Dungeon Node
upcoming_games.description: Dungeon Node is a pixel-art action RPG where you battle relentless hordes, recruit mercenaries, and choose skill nodes to shape your growth. Journey from the forest to the depths of Hell, facing stronger enemies and new choices as you venture deeper.

upcoming_games.name: The Peg Mines
upcoming_games.description: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

upcoming_games.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
upcoming_games.description: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

upcoming_games.name: Deep Rise
upcoming_games.description: Colony management roguelite. After every combat, draft one of three cards to build your run. The surface world ended a thousand years ago. Now the road up is open. Build a colony, send your six survivors into the dark, and reach for the first dawn in a thousand years.

upcoming_games.name: Black Hole Surfers
upcoming_games.description: Trapped after being sucked into a black hole, your only hope is to gather resources from the passing debris, upgrade your ship and survive long enough to find a way to escape. A unique blend of bullet-heaven action and incremental upgrading, will you find your way back home in Black Hole Surfers?

upcoming_games.name: Bumper & Thumper
upcoming_games.description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

upcoming_games.name: Roll of Chaos
upcoming_games.description: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

upcoming_games.name: Idle Golf
upcoming_games.description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

upcoming_games.name: Zombie Hamsters
upcoming_games.description: You're tiny zombie hamsters trapped in a dangerous laboratory. Find a way out, experiment with crazy abilities, and unleash chaos. Every escape is unique. No hints! Just one goal and one challenge — can you escape?

upcoming_games.name: SonaCraft – Instrument Repair
upcoming_games.description: Take over your great-aunt's old workshop and repair real instruments. Find the fault by ear, take a trumpet, guitar or snare drum apart in 3D, replace worn parts, tune and adjust – until it passes the sound test.

upcoming_games.name: Pick The Suspect
upcoming_games.description: A cozy puzzle game about finding one person in a crowd. Read the note, check the clues and wave at the right person. Pick the wrong one and they just wave back. 100 levels across 10 places, from a quiet town square to a busy night carnival.

upcoming_games.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing
upcoming_games.description: The yacht is a dinghy. The wheel is a hubcap. The fish are something else.

upcoming_games.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
upcoming_games.description: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

upcoming_games.name: Spektr
upcoming_games.description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

upcoming_games.name: The Stolen Dawn
upcoming_games.description: The dawn has been stolen! Take it back in a pixel-art action platformer where clever puzzles meet charged bow shots. Journey through eight biomes in Story Mode, or chase your next high score in an ever-changing Endless Mode.

upcoming_games.name: Spring Breeze Shokudo
upcoming_games.description: 1978, southern Taiwan. Come home to reopen your grandmother's shuttered shokudo: shop the morning market, set the menu, hire staff and win the street back from the flashy restaurant across the road. Currently available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese only.

upcoming_games.name: Far Company
upcoming_games.description: Crew a starship with up to three friends. Fly its fighters, man its guns, board enemy ships and rob them blind, and carry each other home. Or throw each other out of the hangar. Friendly fire is on. The feed remembers who did it.

upcoming_games.name: Slay the Tire
upcoming_games.description: Welcome to the largest roguelike deckbuilder ever made. Ride four outlaws down the world's great roads, from Monument Valley to the Tokaido, the Scottish Highlands and the pyramids of Giza, and fight every car, truck and creature that wants you off the road, one card at a time.

upcoming_games.name: Cuby Clicker
upcoming_games.description: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

upcoming_games.name: Bust Out
upcoming_games.description: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

upcoming_games.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
upcoming_games.description: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!

upcoming_games.name: Compactor Baron
upcoming_games.description: Point and the hammer swings in this active incremental. Crush cans, toasters and safes into cubes, pay bills that grow as you earn, and build a bench of machines and a helper robot that work right alongside you.

upcoming_games.name: Hentai Furry Bunny 2
upcoming_games.description: A colorful furry anime puzzle game. Match pairs, solve puzzles, unlock new bunny outfits and illustrations, and complete all 48 stages to fill your gallery.

upcoming_games.name: Objecipher
upcoming_games.description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

upcoming_games.name: Bush League Baseball
upcoming_games.description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

upcoming_games.name: Astral Phase
upcoming_games.description: Wake in your own home, only to discover your body is still lying in bed. Trapped outside yourself, explore a familiar house shared with beings from other dimensions, uncover the truth, and find a way back before reality collapses.

upcoming_games.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
upcoming_games.description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

upcoming_games.name: ESCAPE SHOW
upcoming_games.description: A first-person game show: you and your friends are locked in identical rooms and only the master knows the way out — and the master can't speak. Read the mime and the giant board, turn the room upside down, raid another room through the tube and escape before the gas.

upcoming_games.name: 奇怪的三国模拟器
upcoming_games.description: This is an AI-driven story-driven strategy card RPG. In "Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator", you are not a spectator you are the one who rewrites the script. The Peach Garden Oath may not come to fruition, but if it fails to materialize, the course of the Three Kingdoms will be completely rewritten.

upcoming_games.name: ciaocargo
upcoming_games.description: Master the art of truck driving in this minimalist 2D top-down physics simulator set in Italy. Navigate tight Mediterranean streets and perfect your parking geometry. Relax in the stress-free Zen mode, or push your precision driving skills to the absolute limit in Time Attack.

upcoming_games.name: ONE MORE TERM
upcoming_games.description: Lead a republic through 48 months. Examine documents, manage your cabinet, pass laws, survive crises, and answer for the consequences of every political compromise.

upcoming_games.name: Build the Hole
upcoming_games.description: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

upcoming_games.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
upcoming_games.description: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a true 4v4 team esport. Across a shared central Nexus, pieces invade neighboring boards to flank opponents and rescue allies in synchronized team volleys. It's the world's first true multi-board competitive team chess.

upcoming_games.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
upcoming_games.description: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.

upcoming_games.name: Moon Swarm
upcoming_games.description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

upcoming_games.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE
upcoming_games.description: A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.

upcoming_games.name: Manifest Moonfall 月球坠落
upcoming_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder adapted from "Records of the Giant Moon." Master the unique Emotion system with five distinct characters to break the death loop.

upcoming_games.name: The Curator
upcoming_games.description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

upcoming_games.name: CRYMELIGHT
upcoming_games.description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

upcoming_games.name: AI Clicker
upcoming_games.description: Click Your Way to World Domination (Or Doom)! Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter… or creates a future where AI replaces you!

upcoming_games.name: No Alibi
upcoming_games.description: Rob banks, collect bounties, and gamble it all away in No Alibi. Up to 4 players work together to lead their criminal empire to success. Use your customized guns and equipment to take hostages and steal everything you can. Just make sure the boss gets paid.

upcoming_games.name: Math Time
upcoming_games.description: 45 seconds, 15 questions, one rival. Math Time is a fast 1v1 math duel: race real players or quirky math machines, pick the right answer from three choices and climb the leagues. Plus a Daily Challenge, Sudden Death, Blitz and Practice.

upcoming_games.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
upcoming_games.description: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

upcoming_games.name: VOID SOAR
upcoming_games.description: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

upcoming_games.name: Holtmezo
upcoming_games.description: The villagers were conducting an experiment, but it went wrong and they were transformed into monsters. You are a soldier and must clear the village of monsters.

upcoming_games.name: No Sleep Tonight
upcoming_games.description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

upcoming_games.name: Cutie Office
upcoming_games.description: What if your PC were a tiny pixel company? Every CPU core types away at a desk, every program you open clocks in for work, and the office cat naps when things are quiet. A cozy desktop companion that turns your computer's real activity into a living office.

upcoming_games.name: Somewhere, Together
upcoming_games.description: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.

upcoming_games.name: Jet Combat Sim
upcoming_games.description: A low-altitude jet combat game. Fly mouse-aim jets based on the real aircraft's public technical data over an endless procedural world, score low passes and streaks, break through SAM belts and enemy fighters to the core, and climb a ladder of 38 aircraft from the MiG-15 to the F-35.

upcoming_games.name: Gnome Miners
upcoming_games.description: Drill, sell, dig deeper: online co-op mining for up to 8 players. Raid procedural caves, build your own guns, climb into a mech and hunt a fire-breathing boss at the bottom of the pit. Just one more drill. Hats are mandatory.

upcoming_games.name: Dreamspire 2
upcoming_games.description: Return to a magical fantasy world in Dreamspire 2! Complete relaxing puzzles, meet beautiful fantasy heroines, and unlock a collection of explicit 18+ illustrations.

upcoming_games.name: Find The Clover
upcoming_games.description: Search a vast clover meadow for 50 rare specimens. Harvest by hand, upgrade to tools and garden machines, carry your crop to the buyer, and pour it out yourself. Bring special finds to your display cabinet.

upcoming_games.name: Repair Guru
upcoming_games.description: Every fault is real. Run a 1970s electronics repair shop where nothing is scripted: switch the machine on, let it warm up and measure your way to the one part that has failed. Fix it right and get paid; fix it wrong and it comes back. Twenty-six machines, 517 faults.

upcoming_games.name: Ribbit Racing
upcoming_games.description: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.

upcoming_games.name: Main Bastion
upcoming_games.description: As darkness deepens and monsters emerge from their shadowed dens, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread. Take command of the last bastion! Build cunning traps, merge towers, choose unique upgrade cards, and level up your defenders. Can you hold the walls against dragons and their hordes?

upcoming_games.name: Break the Piñatas
upcoming_games.description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

upcoming_games.name: Frostbeaks
upcoming_games.description: Outrun the avalanche. You are a penguin in a bobble hat carving down an endless procedural mountain — five biomes, seven weather states, six power-ups, and a wall of snow that never stops. Race up to ten players online, or chase your own line solo.

upcoming_games.name: PLOW
upcoming_games.description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

upcoming_games.name: TERRITORY SCRAMBLE
upcoming_games.description: Step, surround, conquer! Claim hexagonal tiles by stepping on them, then enclose areas to capture them at once. Fight for bases and cannons with weapons and items in fast-paced, top-down territory battles. Play online with up to 16 players across 2-4 teams, or take on bots.

upcoming_games.name: GhostLine - Origin Zero
upcoming_games.description: Breach the networks of Helix Dynamics in a cyberpunk routing puzzle. Recalibrate modules, inject pulses, and outsmart Firewalls, viruses, and ICE as GHOST uncovers a conspiracy that can erase people from records—and from their own memories.

upcoming_games.name: Saddlebow
upcoming_games.description: Ride, track, and loose arrows from the saddle. Saddlebow is a VR mounted-archery hunt: seven minutes, one bow, and ground that never stops moving. Chase your quarry through three forests by day and night, and put your score on the board.

upcoming_games.name: WHO CHANGED IT?
upcoming_games.description: Keep your eyes open and find the anomalies! "WHO CHANGED IT?" is a next-gen online anomaly game for 1-8 players. But there's a catch: the anomaly creator is one of you! Objects can move, disappear, or duplicate. Snap photos of anomalies in different game modes and beat your opponents!

upcoming_games.name: Fly Chicken Fly
upcoming_games.description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

upcoming_games.name: Wonderful Time
upcoming_games.description: Control time to manipulate the movement of objects in this third-person puzzle game. Use the flow of time to reach places that were once inaccessible. The reward you seek awaits you.

upcoming_games.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
upcoming_games.description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

upcoming_games.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
upcoming_games.description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

upcoming_games.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
upcoming_games.description: Tower Defense against massive zombie hordes. Build turrets, defend your tower, and discover roguelite and survivor-like progression.

upcoming_games.name: Is This Reversi?
upcoming_games.description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

upcoming_games.name: Spark of Tales
upcoming_games.description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

upcoming_games.name: JOINT LIABILITY
upcoming_games.description: Multiplayer blackjack in a bar that never closes. Keep your buzz burning or die of sobriety, fling your empties at the other players, and outlast every gambler at the table.

upcoming_games.name: Squadron 404
upcoming_games.description: Retro top-down space shooter: hold the mothership through 100 waves, build your fighter from 22 modules and 26 modifiers, earn eight complete ship designs, and fly with up to 4 pilots in Steam co-op through stargate corridors, the asteroid belt and the fog convoy.

upcoming_games.name: Kachow Kart Racing
upcoming_games.description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

upcoming_games.name: Dungebra
upcoming_games.description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

upcoming_games.name: Gatos Adventure
upcoming_games.description: Gatos Adventure is a single player, stealth like adventure - puzzle solving game. You are trying to escape the Water Cities and in the process collect as many balls of yarn as you can, to buy a place on a vessel that is set to take you to the newly emerging patches of land.

upcoming_games.name: Hardcoded
upcoming_games.description: A surreal 2D action-adventure platformer about a self-aware AI. Travel through unstable games, overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and adapt to the Creator’s interference.

upcoming_games.name: Deadly Match
upcoming_games.description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

upcoming_games.name: Faraday Corridors
upcoming_games.description: A brain-teasing puzzle game with a speedrun twist. Flip switches, rotate cells and guide your pawns to the exit. Then do it again, but faster.

upcoming_games.name: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
upcoming_games.description: A survivors-like action roguelite where you discover your class through the spells you choose. Transform into one of 470+ mages, unlock them for future runs, bend the rules with 30+ runes, raise other players' fallen mages, and climb the Endless leaderboards.

upcoming_games.name: Elecade
upcoming_games.description: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

upcoming_games.name: Lots of Axos
upcoming_games.description: Axolotls are nearly extinct. Your lab is their last hope. Build tanks, hatch axolotls, discover endless variations and help introduce them to new habitats across the globe

upcoming_games.name: Rhythm Roll
upcoming_games.description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

upcoming_games.name: Dave's House
upcoming_games.description: In this frantic first-person co-op horror, answer the phone before Grandma eats you! Cook the food exactly as ordered, or she’ll eat you! Throw the food on the table and hide—don’t let it fall, or she'll eat you! If she finds you, RUN! If she catches you... don't get eaten!

upcoming_games.name: Tie Down
upcoming_games.description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

upcoming_games.name: Survivor Joe Lost Island
upcoming_games.description: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

upcoming_games.name: Sound System
upcoming_games.description: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

upcoming_games.name: AI Digital Human Lab
upcoming_games.description: Meet Luna, a lifelike AI companion who lives on your PC: talk by voice or text and she answers in her own voice, with 74 expressions and natural gestures, all on-device. Optionally, an AI assistant that supports MCP can direct her: lights, camera, outfits, dance, songs.

upcoming_games.name: Radiant Starlets
upcoming_games.description: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

upcoming_games.name: Bridgelands
upcoming_games.description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

upcoming_games.name: Forged: Reconquest
upcoming_games.description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

upcoming_games.name: Code of Shadows
upcoming_games.description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where you don't just deploy drones, you command them. Switch modes mid-fight, fuse drones into stronger ones, and cut through rift-spawned hordes across collapsing dimensions.

upcoming_games.name: CardCraft Champions
upcoming_games.description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

upcoming_games.name: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
