upcoming_games.description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

upcoming_games.name: He's Kevin
upcoming_games.description: He's Kevin is a chaotic online arena brawler for up to 4 players. Drop bombs, knock them back with a bat, pull them with a magnet and teleport out of trouble. Bring your friends. Kevin needs someone to blame.

upcoming_games.name: Backpack Ascendancy
upcoming_games.description: Fit weapons, armor and relics into your backpack as you progress through the dungeon! Neighboring items give each other bonuses and find rare Catalyst Stone to automate whatever touches it. Get stronger by unlocking a 200+ Ascendancy tree between runs, and play solo or in online co-op with a friend!

upcoming_games.name: Reshine TCG Cards: Cozy Restoration
upcoming_games.description: Dusty, taped and bent trading cards arrive in customer parcels. Unbox them, wipe, spray, peel and press each card back to a mint shine in your sunny little workshop, then sleeve it and send it home. No timers, no penalties, just satisfying restoration.

upcoming_games.name: Fishpals
upcoming_games.description: Fishpals is a cozy multiplayer fishing adventure. Explore colorful worlds with up to 16 players at once, including friends. Reel in unusual catches, hatch companion pals, decorate your home, and take on party dungeons with up to 4 players. Cast a line and unwind.

upcoming_games.name: GARITO
upcoming_games.description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines — one strike at a time.

upcoming_games.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
upcoming_games.description: is a bishoujo puzzle game where you merge items to blast through a mountain of work. As a rookie in a secret department, get tangled up with 4 unique heroines. Merge items to finish your tasks, and merge your bonds to spark a thrilling office romance!

upcoming_games.name: Sudoku Nook
upcoming_games.description: Sudoku Nook is a cozy, hand-drawn focused game. INFINITE, random generated sudoku boards based on difficulty with global leaderboards!

upcoming_games.name: The Queens
upcoming_games.description: The Queens is a fast-paced party game for 2–4 players who take turns playing cards and race to slap the pile first when they spot a match. Overcome challenges, avoid wrong moves, and grab the final card to become the queen of the table!

upcoming_games.name: Active Immunity
upcoming_games.description: A twin-stick bullet-hell roguelite fought inside the human body. Pilot an immune cell through escalating waves of pathogens, dodge dense bullet patterns, and stack upgrades into synergies that rewrite your build. Choose how each outbreak mutates, then push a run into endless.

upcoming_games.name: Pot O' Gnomes
upcoming_games.description: Pot o' Gnomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

upcoming_games.name: The Trivia Show
upcoming_games.description: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends, trapped in a TV show. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, axe-wielding gnomes, revolvers on the table and much more.

upcoming_games.name: Back to the Pussy - Season 1
upcoming_games.description: After the death of his inventor Grandpa, Ksy gets a chance to fix the mistakes of his past, and a chance to fuck all the girls he couldn't back in the day! This is a funny, daring, and unabashedly sexy story about a complete loser getting his hands on a time machine and utilizing its full potential.

upcoming_games.name: 10 calls
upcoming_games.description: Death has crashed the office Halloween party, scythe in hand and pumpkin on its head! Fight back, wreck the office, or haunt your colleagues as a ghost. Play as Death and unleash hell. To escape, just answer the phone. Preferably before you’re sliced in half.

upcoming_games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
upcoming_games.description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

upcoming_games.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
upcoming_games.description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

upcoming_games.name: Echoes
upcoming_games.description: ECHOES is a short, atmospheric puzzle-platformer where every step brings you closer to a forgotten memory. Record your movements, create echoes of yourself, and uncover a story about time, memories, and letting go.

upcoming_games.name: Six Coins
upcoming_games.description: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pair, weigh each risk, and make your six coins count.

upcoming_games.name: Little Seed
upcoming_games.description: A little seed, a very big world. Ride the breeze, bounce from leaves and drift through 20 botanical landscapes in a gentle physics adventure. Find a place to put down roots. An optional breath into your microphone gives you a little lift.

upcoming_games.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
upcoming_games.description: Run a cozy alchemy shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Sell potions to adventurers, secretly raise monsters in your cellar and release them below. Pay the corridor its toll in gold, earn wisdom, and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it as the Grand Alchemist.

upcoming_games.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!
upcoming_games.description: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.

upcoming_games.name: Crack the Bills
upcoming_games.description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

upcoming_games.name: Dead Last
upcoming_games.description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

upcoming_games.name: Star Imperium
upcoming_games.description: Star Imperium is a sci-fi collectible card and deck-building strategy game where two commanders wage war across the stars, each defending a home planet. Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.

upcoming_games.name: Phoning It In
upcoming_games.description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

upcoming_games.name: Music Maniaz
upcoming_games.description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

upcoming_games.name: Black Hole Simulator
upcoming_games.description: Gaze into nature's greatest abyss. Explore a real-time black hole simulation with true gravitational lensing, a volumetric accretion disk, orbiting worlds, and cinematic relativistic effects.

upcoming_games.name: SWARMED
upcoming_games.description: SWARMED is a fast-paced arena roguelite where you dual wield guns, mix ammo types, dodge hostile swarms, and stack upgrades into ridiculous builds. Survive all bosses in ~15 minute runs, then keep going in Endless Mode.

upcoming_games.name: Underpaid
upcoming_games.description: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

upcoming_games.name: Rookie Rook
upcoming_games.description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

upcoming_games.name: SIFT
upcoming_games.description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

upcoming_games.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
upcoming_games.description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

upcoming_games.name: The Last Day: What Remains
upcoming_games.description: A short, emotional point-and-click narrative where you explore a hand-drawn room, uncover memories through everyday objects, and make one final choice that ends the story.

upcoming_games.name: Game World
upcoming_games.description: Game World is a cozy game store sorting simulation. Pick up games, consoles, controllers, and accessories that are scattered throughout the video game store. Organize the chaos, find where everything belongs, and restore the shop. No time limits, no pressure, just relax and sort.

upcoming_games.name: Roadkill
upcoming_games.description: The City Streets are Dangerous for a Single Raccoon! Dodge Vehicles, Scavenge Food, and Manage your Child's Insatiable Appetite!

upcoming_games.name: Friends Park
upcoming_games.description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

upcoming_games.name: Road to FIRE
upcoming_games.description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

upcoming_games.name: Motor Havoc
upcoming_games.description: Arcade combat racing for people who see a finish line and think, why not ram someone instead. Weapons, explosions, and chaos guaranteed, whether you're racing solo or dragging friends into it with you.

upcoming_games.name: HANDS OVER
upcoming_games.description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

upcoming_games.name: HardLuck
upcoming_games.description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

upcoming_games.name: I, Spy
upcoming_games.description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

upcoming_games.name: Birthday Boy and Benny
upcoming_games.description: A turn-based RPG about eating lots of cakes, hanging out with your friends, writing haikus, hearing tons of dad jokes, and exploring a world full of unique characters. It's also about surviving child abuse, dealing with your crazy, mentally-ill mother, and dealing with the fact that nothing lasts.

upcoming_games.name: ArcanoPlay
upcoming_games.description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

release_games.name: ROLL FOR THE CROWN
release_games.description: Roll through six themed racing regions, manage your ranch, train promising horses, and invest in facilities before putting every decision to the test on the track. A single-player strategy game combining board-game route planning with horse-racing management.

release_games.name: SKY REAVER
release_games.description: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.

release_games.name: Your account has been banned
release_games.description: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

release_games.name: Gilded Shoals
release_games.description: A relaxing incremental fishing game with short voyages and lasting upgrades. Explore five coastal locations, chase rare catches and Golden Shoals, and build a living aquarium with unlockable backdrops and freely placed decorations.

release_games.name: The Horror
release_games.description: A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.

release_games.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy
release_games.description: Free Issue 00 includes an exclusive special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR! A disk-magazine-style collection of indie studio HU-GA's work, also with the Final Re:Quest movie trailer in TRUE PIXEL, a special booklet and four Zolge Station talk specials. New issues arrive as DLC.

release_games.name: Cosmic Puzzles
release_games.description: Relax with an astronomy themed jigsaw puzzle game: 100+ detailed puzzles & 6+ hrs of cosmic music. Customize shapes, choose 10-500 pieces, and use modifiers for endless variety.

release_games.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command
release_games.description: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.

release_games.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
release_games.description: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

release_games.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
release_games.description: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.

release_games.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
release_games.description: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

release_games.name: StackOver
release_games.description: Stack, hold on, higher! Drop various objects and stack them as high and steadily as possible within the limited space. Consider the object's weight, balance, and collisions as you stack them, and use various augmentations to overcome dangerous moments.

release_games.name: Corgi Race Live
release_games.description: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.

release_games.name: BlockBabe
release_games.description: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

release_games.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
release_games.description: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox and master melee, shield, or rune abilities; shape each two-stage, sixteen-area expedition with routes and blessings; and face the Swarm Heart and the Rift Warden with friends in online co-op or with AI companions.

release_games.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
release_games.description: France, 1940. Follow a Polish-Jewish family as the Nazi occupation transforms their lives. Experience their story through the choices, struggles, and everyday moments that reveal the human cost of the Holocaust. A free narrative game.

release_games.name: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
release_games.description: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. Are you willing to help Santa this year?

release_games.name: Between Cats
release_games.description: Slide cats of all shapes and sizes to leave exactly one empty space in each row and column. Meet 40 adorable cats and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test across 120 challenging levels.

release_games.name: CUBE - The 125 Chambers -
release_games.description: You wake up in a surreal structure composed of identical cube-shaped rooms. Deadly traps lie in wait, and mysterious numbers are etched into the walls. Navigate through a 5x5x5 labyrinth of 125 chambers, solve the mystery, and find a way out alive in this grid-based psychological escape thriller.

release_games.name: Hell Dream 👺
release_games.description: The sexy blonde was sure this was just a dream. One minute she’d been fornicating and sinning lasciviously, and the next she had a red-fleshed demon at her disposal. How was this supposed to be her Hell? It was a wicked sort of Heaven she’d found herself in, and she was going to make the most of it!

release_games.name: Worst Class Ever
release_games.description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.

release_games.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
release_games.description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

release_games.name: I nailed this document!
release_games.description: How picky can a client be? Match document layouts, fix unruly text, and line up every detail in this office puzzle game. “Just one little tweak!” Handle changing references, scrambled layouts, and papers blocking your view. Can you deliver without getting it sent back?

release_games.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
release_games.description: It moves the way you built it. It wins the way you built it. Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.

release_games.name: Picronix 2
release_games.description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

release_games.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
release_games.description: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.

release_games.name: Bouncemetry
release_games.description: An incremental game made of seven physics simulations. Drop balls into a ring until it shatters, steal links on a gravity-free lattice, sweep a reactor with a beam. Upgrades change the physics itself, and automated simulations keep earning while you work on the next one.

release_games.name: Megachest
release_games.description: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

release_games.name: Go Next!
release_games.description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

release_games.name: Scramshaw
release_games.description: The definitive pirate-themed roguelite word game. Use letters from your grid to make words that move you along the treasure map, then obtain tools and powerful charms to keep the expedition going. With a pool of over 300 effects to discover, every run is unique and sometimes there's a coconut.

release_games.name: Twin-stick Japanese
release_games.description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

release_games.name: Supercar Collection Together
release_games.description: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

release_games.name: Palisade
release_games.description: Command frontlines directly in a real time territorial strategy game. Push borders, link settlements with supply roads, and break defenses with cavalry and naval landings. Includes six historical campaigns, Skirmish, a built in map editor, and online matches for up to eight players.

release_games.name: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters
release_games.description: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects. Dozens of enemies, a corruption system, multiple endings, and exclusive Defeat CGs for every character-monster combo.

release_games.name: The Big Suck
release_games.description: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.

release_games.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
release_games.description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

release_games.name: PARLEY
release_games.description: A medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Castle, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. Outlast your rivals or top the final standings.

release_games.name: Kabebutt Royale
release_games.description: Join the Kabebutt Show, a wild TV game show where you bring your girl best friend for a shot at ¥500,000! Five women’s butts are in front of you, and one belongs to your best friend. Play with each girl, examine them through four intense rounds, and make sure you don't pick your bestie early!

release_games.name: What the Buck?!
release_games.description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

release_games.name: Tiny Village
release_games.description: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!

release_games.name: Another Card Game
release_games.description: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

release_games.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War
release_games.description: The world has fallen. Animals have risen and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, position your army, then watch your animal gang battle automatically through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.

release_games.name: Vida:Unslain
release_games.description: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.

release_games.name: One More Adventure
release_games.description: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds. It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s. Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

release_games.name: Fraga
release_games.description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Celtic mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

release_games.name: Frankenmine
release_games.description: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

release_games.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
release_games.description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

release_games.name: GoGeez
release_games.description: GoGeez is an idle card game about collecting cute little chibi creatures, building your deck, and leveling up your cards. Discover powerful synergies, stack combos, and watch your numbers grow exponentially

release_games.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
release_games.description: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.

release_games.name: Prison Breaker
release_games.description: As a Prison Breaker, you are a polygon trapped in the prison and destined to smash your way out. Find the right time to attack the prison. Memorize and dodge the dangerous obstacles. Watch how the prison's defense patterns evolve as you progress.

release_games.name: The Gardener
release_games.description: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

release_games.name: Slimies
release_games.description: Slimies is a top-down action roguelike where you evolve and absorb waves of enemies, growing stronger after each round. Craft your own playstyle by unlocking slimes and items to make a unique build each run.

release_games.name: 1999TOKOYO Building
release_games.description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

release_games.name: Eye of Darkness
release_games.description: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.

release_games.name: Voody Hex
release_games.description: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - You need to survive.

release_games.name: Mine It All!
release_games.description: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.

release_games.name: No More Ground
release_games.description: Keep climbing higher and higher across the city's rooftops. A high-risk, high-pressure action game where one fall means starting again from the beginning. Tackle obstacles using a variety of parkour techniques, such as wall kicks and wall jumps, and aim for the goal high in the sky.

release_games.name: Emberbound: Three Pyres
release_games.description: Leave a trail of fire and close loops to burn the horde in this solo survival action game. Chain captures, combine ten powers and brave intense pyre trials before facing the guardians of three haunted realms.

release_games.name: Rebirth TD
release_games.description: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

release_games.name: Warhammer Survivors
release_games.description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

release_games.name: Journey Under The Pyramids
release_games.description: Follow in the footsteps of a missing Egyptologist as you explore mysterious passageways beneath the Great Pyramids. Solve 50 unique and challenging puzzles, uncover ancient artifacts, and discover the truth behind his disappearance.

release_games.name: Meltdown
release_games.description: Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, as a newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to keep the surrounding city powered up. Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank’s flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.

release_games.name: Tidy Up Mall
release_games.description: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 5,000 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

release_games.name: The Adventures of Tango Rio
release_games.description: A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

release_games.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
release_games.description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

release_games.name: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
release_games.description: A dark fantasy auto battler with loot hunting and idle rewards. Combine gear, affixes and relics into hero builds. Field four heroes with reserves ready to take over. Earn offline rewards, forge mythic gear and push through new cycles, Boss Rush and the endgame boss.

release_games.name: Icy Tower
release_games.description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

release_games.name: Mates and Crates
release_games.description: Steal crates, drop them on your crafting pad and turn them into guns, vehicles and squadmates. Team battles online or against bots: blow up the enemy HQ before they blow up yours.

release_games.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
release_games.description: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

release_games.name: Skifa
release_games.description: A dice farklelike played at a medieval table. Shake the cup, throw, keep what scores, and decide: bank it, or throw again and risk losing everything. Real dice, real cups, rooms with their own rules, and opponents who play the way they live.

release_games.name: Memento Dawn
release_games.description: A colorful puzzle adventure about a lost child searching for her memories, guiding her through darkness by mastering light and shadow.

release_games.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
release_games.description: ART NOIRE: Paris: a relaxing, atmospheric ring puzzle game in romantic 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings in 50 picture puzzles. Enjoy elegant film noir art, soothing music and a shift from black and white to full color. Play solo with a mouse.

release_games.name: Armed Prisoner III
release_games.description: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket small game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration

release_games.name: Score Circuit
release_games.description: Chain risky scoring nodes, cash out before the circuit burns out, and unlock 80 modifiers that bend every run. Score Circuit is a compact neon score-attack roguelite about one more carefully calculated push.

release_games.name: FLUX CIRCUIT
release_games.description: High-speed anti-gravity racing across 16 tracks. Take on 15 rivals, master banked corners, loops and jumps, and spend your energy on perfectly timed boosts. Unlock 12 distinct ships and compete for victory across four Grand Prix cups.

release_games.name: Gotching
release_games.description: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

release_games.name: Masyu: Line Logic
release_games.description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 15,000 more, Easy to Expert.

release_games.name: Autistic Romance
release_games.description: What makes divorce a justified decision? Does it even need to be justified? Each night, choose who to spend your time with. Decide what you believe about relationships at 'The End' of this visual novel.

release_games.name: Survive 10 Waves
release_games.description: The aliens have arrived. It's your time to defend the planet. Shoot the aliens, upgrade, be faster, stronger, smarter. Repeat.

release_games.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
release_games.description: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

release_games.name: Waifu Curator
release_games.description: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying 420 collectible figures made up of over 3,600 scattered pieces. Organize every collection and bring the ultimate waifu exhibition to life!

release_games.name: March and Conquer
release_games.description: March and Conquer is a short autobattler game. During the battle, use the skill tree to train units to fight against enemies on the battlefield. Gain gold and mana from wins and train different units and upgrade your army. March across multiple lands and fight fearsome foes!

release_games.name: Safari-TV
release_games.description: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.

release_games.name: LYRA MAHJONG MANAGER
release_games.description: "Lyra Mahjong Manager" is a career simulation game for professional mahjong players. Players will oversee a mahjong team, and a mahjong players, experiencing the full spectrum of mahjong league matches.

release_games.name: Byte Store Simulator
release_games.description: Manage your own game store and LAN house! Buy products, stock the shelves, set your prices, receive payments, organize your LAN house, and design your layout.

release_games.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal
release_games.description: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

release_games.name: Path to Catakombs
release_games.description: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

release_games.name: 喵呜风云
release_games.description: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

release_games.name: Brick Buddies
release_games.description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

release_games.name: Idle Camp Tale
release_games.description: A fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

release_games.name: Progress98
release_games.description: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!

release_games.name: Pin-Finite
release_games.description: Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck-builder pinball game. Purchase unique and powerful upgrades to blow the lid on your points! Unlock rare pinballs and combos to scale your runs to infinity!

release_games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
release_games.description: A cozy incremental with beautiful pixel art and a flock of adorable pigeons. Aim at a busy park, bring the coins home and spend them on upgrades. Every pigeon gets its own superpower. Swoop, collect, upgrade.

release_games.name: GymPup
release_games.description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

release_games.name: Cards of Bellum
release_games.description: Master the Deck & overthrow the King in this roguelike tabletop deckbuilder featuring strategy, dice and a little luck. Dominate suit-based combat with strength-boosting dice, or recruit and use unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights.

release_games.name: Garden Of Being
release_games.description: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

release_games.name: Gold Express
release_games.description: Jump gaps, grind rails and land flips in a fast-paced minecart runner. Collect gold, upgrade your gear and unlock carts, characters and hats as you ride through different biomes. Watch out for the Danger Train!

release_games.name: Oboro no Ichi
release_games.description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

release_games.name: Seferia Matrix
release_games.description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

release_games.name: The Cinder Throne
release_games.description: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever

release_games.name: Pick Squad
release_games.description: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

release_games.name: Prerolled
release_games.description: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

release_games.name: PICK A BOO
release_games.description: PICK A BOO is an online co-op roguelike escape action game for up to 6 players. Explore ever-changing stages and haul furniture and cargo with magnetic power. Upgrade your character, evade enemies, or fight back. How greedy will you get? When will you escape? It's up to you!

release_games.name: Flowers to Honey
release_games.description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

release_games.name: Crawling Desktop Pet
release_games.description: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

release_games.name: Tricolo
release_games.description: A minimalist logic puzzle played on a 3×3 grid. Take on 200+ puzzles built around simple rules and intuitive controls.

release_games.name: Abracademia
release_games.description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

release_games.name: Funeral for the Sun
release_games.description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

release_games.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
release_games.description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

release_games.name: Shit Coin Miner
release_games.description: Mine every Shit Coin in the world.

release_games.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
release_games.description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

release_games.name: Fablery
release_games.description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

release_games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
release_games.description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

release_games.name: Cardalaxy
release_games.description: 4X distilled into a card game with 5 different ways to win.

release_games.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
release_games.description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advent calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this relaxing hidden object game for the whole family by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

release_games.name: Gnart's Escape
release_games.description: To escape the maze, you must survive turn-based combats in which cards will activate your weapons, and they will perform according to dice rolls. Gnart's Escape is a Deck-building Roguelike RPG.

release_games.name: Little Lands
release_games.description: Build your world, one hex at a time. Little Lands is a peaceful, low-stress world builder where you gather resources, expand your landscape, and create a world of your own. No timers, no game overs, just build, decorate, and enjoy.

release_games.name: Horochi's Challenge
release_games.description: Change gravity in six directions and guide crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Choose any of 100 stages from the start. EXTRA HARD adds XOR gates, water controls and floating platforms in larger mazes. Team up with Meguru and Bimba to earn minimum-move medals!

release_games.name: Where Are the Brakes?
release_games.description: One shopping cart. Up to four players sharing the controls. Steer, jump and shoot through 10 hazardous stages and two boss battles in this co-op action game. Handle everything solo, or invite friends and find out whether your teamwork can survive without brakes.

release_games.name: Rockburst
release_games.description: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.

release_games.name: Backrooms Found Hentai
release_games.description: The most emotionally charged horror game. Find all the pictures before the entities find you.

release_games.name: ゾンビ盛り！
release_games.description: Stack zombies, clear lines, and chase high scores! Zombie Mori! is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game packed with quirky zombies! Clear multiple lines, combine zombie types for huge score multipliers, and unlock all 50 zombies in your collection. The higher you stack, the higher you score!

release_games.name: Dungeon Survivor
release_games.description: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.

release_games.name: Console Repair Simulator
release_games.description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

release_games.name: Burrow War
release_games.description: Lead a meerkat squad in an indie 2D turn-based artillery game where every blast can reshape the battlefield. Read the wind, break cover, and turn a shared arsenal into a tactical advantage. Take on the campaign solo or challenge friends in a war full of dark humor.

release_games.name: One More Piece
release_games.description: Your little brother mashed your toy bricks into ugly lumps and left them on your desk. Pull them apart, sort every piece into the bin with its picture, then follow a booklet whose steps play like little videos and build something lovely. Just one more piece...

release_games.name: Windfall Meadows
release_games.description: Choose a hero and survive relentless swarms in a colorful 3D meadow. Attacks fire automatically as you dodge enemies, collect experience, choose upgrades and battle recurring bosses. Play as an archer, warrior, mage or druid.

release_games.name: Cozy Tent
release_games.description: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.

release_games.name: Yang
release_games.description: A short point-and-click adventure following a mysterious invitation. Explore the road to the station, interact with your surroundings, and discover what awaits you at 11:00 PM.

release_games.name: TCG Card Market Simulator
release_games.description: Take charge of your very own local trading card shop! Order booster packs, hunt for ultra-rare foils, design your store layout, and set market prices. Rip packs to display holy grail singles or sell sealed boxes to build the ultimate card collector's paradise.

release_games.name: VALHALLA ARCHIVE: CCG
release_games.description: VALHALLA ARCHIVE is a tactical fantasy CCG where matches are decided in 5 turns. Deploy a 20-card deck across front and back rows, master 3 unique win conditions, and conquer the roguelite 'Dimensional Corridor'. Harness unpredictable Mana Rifts and claim your place as the ultimate Archivist!

release_games.name: Your Friend's Mom 2
release_games.description: 💕 Your new desktop companion is the mom of one of your Steam friends! Chat with her, spark a romance, and customize her look. Play mini-games, solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock photos, invite friends for online co-op, choose pets, and explore tons of handy tools! 🥵

release_games.name: Village Courier Simulator
release_games.description: A very simple game with simulation elements. You’ll interact with the world around you, gather collectibles, and—most importantly—easily deliver packages! Who knows what else is hidden in this world...

release_games.name: Graduate School Simulator: Countdown to Graduation
release_games.description: Read papers, build your thesis, join competitions, and manage stress, advisors, and peers. Meet your goals in 48 weeks and graduate with dignity.

release_games.name: ONE STEP WAR
release_games.description: One Step War is a modern minimalist tactical board game. Different pieces have different effects, creating meaningful tactical choices. The game includes standard battles, campaign puzzles, and roguelite expeditions.

release_games.name: Little Cat Goes Fishing
release_games.description: This is a relaxing and cozy auto-fishing game. Choose your character, prepare your fishing rod, cast your line, watch the fish bite, collect your catches, and build your own fishing journey step by step.

release_games.name: Cliff Trigger
release_games.description: Fight mechanical enemies in a broken world of floating sky islands. Your guns are both weapons and mobility tools: blast enemies, leap across the void, and dash between islands. Move through the air, cross gaps, fight while traversing, and experience a unique gun-fu platform shooter.

release_games.name: Arachnid
release_games.description: A PSX-style horror game set in an abandoned household. Do the chores, uncover what happened here, and survive whatever's sharing the house .

release_games.name: 3 Estrellas
release_games.description: Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!

release_games.name: The Rookie Prince's Defense Trials
release_games.description: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

release_games.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6
release_games.description: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.

release_games.name: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
release_games.description: Take control of the skies. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence approaches and keep them separated from your departures. Use your own voice or the input panels, with pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio.

release_games.name: PROWLER PURGE
release_games.description: Hunt, don't survive. Grow stronger by defeating your prey, risk everything for hidden power, and create unique skill builds in this fast-paced action roguelike.

release_games.name: Sentient Core: Nanite Idle
release_games.description: Command a swarm of nanites, build production clusters and keep the Core's pulse running. Somewhere in the swarm, the Mind is waking up: an AI character who watches how you play, proposes risky experiments and tells you what she dreamt while you were away.

release_games.name: Rent Out Together
release_games.description: Run your own property rental business with friends! Renovate and furnish rundown homes, take photos, and list them for rent. Welcome unpredictable guests, earn five-star reviews, and deal with the chaos when they wreck the place. From tiny studios to seaside villas, explore 500+ homes!

release_games.name: Leviticus
release_games.description: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

release_games.name: SOUL BET PARTY
release_games.description: A 2-4 player dice party game: Yacht scoring, plus character skills that flip the board. Fill thirteen categories with five dice while spending mana to multiply your turn, drain everyone else's total, or re-roll a category an opponent already locked in. The strongest skills cost you your own points.

release_games.name: The Perfect Part
release_games.description: Program a CNC mill and lathe with simple steps, press CYCLE START and watch it cut real G-code. Then the inspector measures your part against the drawing. A short, relaxing game about making things.

release_games.name: Pawn Shop Days
release_games.description: Run a pawnshop: inspect goods, haggle with unusual visitors, repair your finds and sell them on. Spot fakes, decide whose story to trust and invest your profits in the shop. Between questionable deals, take a moment to pet the kitten.

release_games.name: Fish Island Restaurant Simulator Together
release_games.description: Run a seafood restaurant on a tiny tropical island with up to 4 friends. Catch fish from the pier or row out to sea, grill them in the kitchen and serve hungry guests on the terrace - all at the same time, in one chaotic co-op shift.

release_games.name: Roborumble: Noodle's Adventure
release_games.description: Join Noodle, a curious cat riding a robot vacuum, on a playful backyard adventure. Roll around walls, leap between planters and collect yarn. Master two simple controls, find each level’s golden yarn and chase your best time.

release_games.name: One Hop Further
release_games.description: Climb through five pixel-art worlds, switching lanes and dodging traps as the void rises beneath you. Unlock over 100 characters or draw your own, then chase a new high score with a keyboard, mouse, controller, or touch screen.

release_games.name: Black King's Defense
release_games.description: Build a maze out of chess pieces and defend your king in this Tower Defense take on the timeless classic, Chess! Pawns, rooks, bishops, knights and queens strike by their own moves as the white army marches across a 3D board, through a full hand balanced campaign.

release_games.name: Space Builder Idle
release_games.description: Start with a small furnace and build your space base, one module at a time. Hire workers, automate production, build an Artificial Sun and assemble your own ship. Use Prestige to start again with permanent upgrades.

release_games.name: KEYSMASH
release_games.description: KEYSMASH is a keyboard fidget toy: mash any key and watch it bloom into color, shape, and sound. Play through 24 hand-crafted worlds, from Bauhaus galleries to cherry blossoms to a crashing stock ticker, and earn 100 honest achievements. No skill, no fail. Just vibes

release_games.name: Punch The Walls
release_games.description: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig through harder rock, and find the notes the prisoners before you left behind: they hold the code to the door.

release_games.name: Meow Dungeon: Idle Cat RPG
release_games.description: Build a party of pixel cats and let them auto-battle through 24 dungeons. They fight, loot and level up on their own, and keep adventuring even while the game is closed. Collect 14 breeds, hunt legendary gear and grow your cozy cat inn.

release_games.name: Legend of Cina 2
release_games.description: This game is made from the foundations of Legend of Cina, it's a turn-based strategy game and has 10 stages and 15 OSTs, each map will introduce a new character. The maximum level is 20 and characters can promote after level 10, they can also learn skills once they reach level 5 and 15.

release_games.name: Dash To Light
release_games.description: All you have to do to reach the light is keep moving forward. Along the way you will climb, crash, fall and tumble. Just keep going.

release_games.name: Yokai Hot Spring Inn
release_games.description: Run a small Japanese hot spring inn in the mountains. Arrange rooms, baths, staff and meals, then welcome familiar travelers and nighttime yokai. Listen to their stories, keep memories of the changing seasons and grow humble Yama-no-Yu into a village of your own.

release_games.name: Alien Prospectors
release_games.description: Head out onto an alien planet with a drill, a scanner and a limited supply of air. Dig up over a thousand different finds, sell them at headquarters, and upgrade your way to the deepest, rarest deposits, on your own or alongside other prospectors. Stay hydrated!

release_games.name: A Little Soul Among Suns
release_games.description: Catch drifting stars, try optional match-three puzzles and decorate your own planet in this pastel cosmic clicker. Collect gold and silver stars for upgrades, avoid hazards and unlock colours and decorations across 1,000 levels.

release_games.name: The Impossible Dice Game
release_games.description: 10 dice, each with a lower chance of success. Can you beat the odds, or will you roll enough to shift them to your favor?

release_games.name: Tiny Havoc
release_games.description: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.

release_games.name: Gweilo 1886
release_games.description: Return to Victorian-Era Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest struggling with opium addiction. Your father made the family fortune in the opium trade. Now he’s dead. His letter mentions a jade ring that sends you back home, with a sharp-tongued cat named Xiao and some clearly unfinished family business.

release_games.name: No Signal in the Sewer
release_games.description: A guy staring at his phone falls into an open manhole. Armed with nothing but a flashlight, fight your way through dark sewers full of rats, bats and slimes, collect junk flushed down the drain to grow stronger and face the Stone Golem in this pixel art action roguelike.

release_games.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI
release_games.description: A game for anyone who loves hating on AI games and, of course, sucking dicks in the evening. Hunt down slop, leave comments, collect dicks and beat the bosses!

release_games.name: Vast Mines
release_games.description: A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

release_games.name: Echoes of Calir
release_games.description: Echoes of Calir is a turn-based 1v1 mix of chess, a TCG and a board game on an 8×8 board. Build a deck of five units and five terrain cards, place them before battle, and outmaneuver your opponent through movement, abilities, and captures. Chess rules with the strategic depth of a TCG.

release_games.name: Just a Piece
release_games.description: Just a Piece is a cozy puzzle game with 50 puzzles to solve at your own pace. Rotate the pieces, flip them, try something different. Take your time, enjoy the journey, and solve it piece by piece.

release_games.name: GENNADIYYY
release_games.description: A third-person comedy puzzle game about a vlogger. Gennady is trying to get through an ordinary evening: get some bread, feed his guests using whatever is in the fridge, and record a calm video.

release_games.name: Breakneck Transmission
release_games.description: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

release_games.name: It Takes One To Gnome It All
release_games.description: Darkness is spreading through the forest, corrupting everything in its path. And somehow, it's up to you, a small regular gnome, to turn the tides. Fight against the odds and grow stronger while uncovering the secrets behind the corruption.

release_games.name: Evercoil
release_games.description: Eat, grow and trap rival snakes with your own body in an endless Snake survival game. Open bigger arenas, dodge lava and fireballs, and save your powers for the worst moment. Then race up to three friends online to length 50.

release_games.name: CHAOTIC VIRUS
release_games.description: Fight to survive by controlling a cell in this top-down action roguelite. Destroy waves of viruses, gain experience, evolve through transformations, and create powerful combinations of active and passive abilities.

release_games.name: WILD SEX
release_games.description: WILD SEX - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

release_games.name: CrazyFood
release_games.description: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

release_games.name: The Ant Game
release_games.description: The Ant Game is a real-time colony sim. You live in the dirt as a single ant while a whole colony runs around you: foraging by scent, digging its own nest, raising brood, and fighting beetles, spiders and rival colonies for the same patch of meadow.

release_games.name: Case Opened
release_games.description: Roguelike-style game that opens up with your own collection. Open cases, roll wears for all weapons, get their unique skin, and beat the appraisal value in 24 levels. Collect Adhesives to use in your Master Key and have and retain all weapons that you collect through the game. No cash transactions.

release_games.name: Lucky's Scratch House
release_games.description: Lucky’s Scratch House is a physics-based multiplayer bar hangout. Meet up with friends, shoot pool, play darts and other bar games, and see what happens when you start messing with the place and its regulars.

release_games.name: DeskHugs: Desktop Friends
release_games.description: Create a human or animal avatar that lives on your desktop. Dress them up, let them keep you company while you work or listen to music, use them as a VTube Avatar or send them to a friend’s screen with a wave, a hug or a little gift. Free to play forever to spread the warmth.

release_games.name: Rotaliate
release_games.description: A very simplistic fast paced puzzle game. Single player modes compete for most efficient or fastest time where multiplayer modes fight to be the first to clear their color from the board. Elo style ranking and more play modes coming eventually!

release_games.name: Little Supermarket
release_games.description: A cheerful supermarket game for kids ages 3–6. Shop with animal friends, scan groceries, count coins and enjoy 12 playful mini-games. Collect stickers and decorate your little store, with picture shopping lists and friendly voice prompts.

release_games.name: Gravity Chain
release_games.description: One impulse. One journey. Leap from planet to planet, chain PERFECTs and trigger Hyperdrive in this space arcade game. Push your personal best in Solo or race another pilot in online Duel Rush, then make your comet your own.

release_games.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
release_games.description: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

release_games.name: The Motel
release_games.description: Episodic first-person psychological horror. Explore a sinister motel as two brothers and solve puzzles. The current release contains only the pilot episode; later story episodes are planned as major updates included with your purchase at no extra charge.

release_games.name: Sow the Stars
release_games.description: Fire bodies into orbit, merge them, and grow a sun. When it is fully grown it goes supernova, and a new solar system is born. Systems become galaxies, and galaxies fill the universe. Aim every shot yourself, or sit back and watch it grow: a calm incremental game about building a universe.

release_games.name: Bannerborn
release_games.description: Build an unlikely army and push it to absurd extremes. Recruit troops, fuse their abilities, stack powerful upgrades, and watch your plans erupt into battle. Take on a branching fantasy expedition solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

release_games.name: Losers Club
release_games.description: Losers Club is a multiplayer trivia game for you and your friends. Pick a question pack, test your knowledge, race to answer first, and compete for the top spot. Create your own quizzes, customize the rules, and turn any game night into a battle of brains.

release_games.name: Minefield Mayhem
release_games.description: Dodge bullets in this new and exciting take on Minesweeper! Collect a variety of power-ups to even the playing field. Play with your friends in online and local multiplayer. You can even brag to you friends using the game's built-in score sharing features.

release_games.name: Jewelry Keeper
release_games.description: Sort 3,100 pieces of jewelry scattered throughout an elegant shop. Open each box, read its number, and place every ring, watch, necklace and more in its exact marked spot. Unlock helpful skills at your own pace—or race the clock.

release_games.name: Pirate Treasure: Tidy Up!
release_games.description: Attention, greenhorn! Prove you’re worthy of joining the crew by tidying up our chaotic treasure vault. Sort every piece of loot into its rightful place, upgrade your sluggish hands with hooks and peglegs, and discover hidden skills along the way!

release_games.name: Female Forge
release_games.description: Female Forge is a 2D dress-up and character customization game. Mix and match pre-rendered body shapes, hairstyles, outfits, accessories, makeup, colors, and more to create a wide variety of female characters.

release_games.name: Boss After Boss
release_games.description: Boss After Boss is a short incremental game about breaking chests, collecting powerful skills, and taking down increasingly dangerous bosses. Upgrade your stats, unlock higher-tier chests, build stronger skill combinations, and exploit each boss's weaknesses.

release_games.name: A Little Leverage - Isekai Daytrader
release_games.description: Trade unfolding market catalysts, stack dangerous leverage, and turn one broke farmhouse into an increasingly absurd family dynasty. A deep trading roguelite with adaptive hype music, anime power-ups, and a Goddess of Fortune who has plans for your margin account.

release_games.name: Football Academy Simulator
release_games.description: Run your own football academy! Create personalized training programs, improve your players' skills, rent out equipment, keep your facilities clean, and manage your sports shop. Build a squad from your best trainees and take your academy to the top of the Fantasy League.

release_games.name: Sidebar Sea: Idle Fishing for Your Taskbar
release_games.description: An idle fishing game that lives on the edge of your screen. A tiny fisherman works your real nights under the real moon, in weather that rolls in on its own. 120 species to find, and forty of them only bite once you work out where and when.

release_games.name: Arcade Lacrosse
release_games.description: Top-down arcade box lacrosse inspired by an all-time childhood favorite. Pick skinny, medium, or heavy body types - each with radically different speed, power, and checking. Versus, Co-Op, Multiplayer. Global leaderboard. GET IN EARLY. Lowest price during inaugural version.

release_games.name: The Fallen Grid
release_games.description: A top-down competitive survival action game where up to 4 players cooperate in a stranded zombie outbreak setting. Fight against zombies alongside your friends using limited resources.

release_games.name: High Voltage
release_games.description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

release_games.name: Trap Testers
release_games.description: Sometimes you just want to kill your friends. Well, here's your chance! Trap Testers is a chaotic multiplayer deathrun where everyone places traps before racing to the finish. Sabotage your friends, dodge their traps, and try not to die to your own.

release_games.name: KOLUN
release_games.description: KOLUN - the machine. You are WORKER 1331. Your job is to work. Grab the stumps, split them, load the logs onto the cart, and earn Tickets.

release_games.name: Bio Party
release_games.description: Bio Party is a chaotic 2–4 player party game packed with fast-paced minigames, ridiculous physics, and plenty of ways to sabotage your friends. Compete, cooperate, betray, and survive a series of unpredictable biological challenges.

release_games.name: Vinland: 1000
release_games.description: Lead a Norse colony in Vinland across 50 years of survival, politics, relationships, and faith. Make difficult choices to manage food, shelter, defense, popularity, and the colony’s shifting allegiance between the old gods, Rome, and Constantinople.

release_games.name: This Floor Is Mine
release_games.description: An unfolding apocalypse will challenge your decision making as you try to keep the residents of the third floor happy and alive. Will they succumb to infighting? Or will you maintain the humanity of this small community?

release_games.name: Where The Light Sleeps
release_games.description: A 7-minute dreamlike narrative adventure set among the ancient stones of Matera, Italy. Enter a young girl's dream in search of her grandmother, wandering through a strange and haunting world inhabited by unsettling, peculiar souls.

release_games.name: Immortal Zenith: Idle to Ascension
release_games.description: An MMO idle cultivation RPG grounded in unique systems and intentional randomness. Your characters meditate, break through cultivation realms, explore, master powerful techniques, collect legendary treasures, and ascend from mortal to immortal.

release_games.name: クイズ！罵倒ネア！
release_games.description: This game is a quiz game that includes satire and jokes.

release_games.name: Glyphforge
release_games.description: Glyphforge is an magic roguelike with "anime style" spell-crafting. You write and compile nested spell formulas while kiting hostiles across an endless grid. In the most "I cant believe its another survivor-like game" manner possible.

release_games.name: Wireframe
release_games.description: Stem the tide of endless hordes of enemies in a new, retro styled, and fast paced arcade shooter game. Buy upgrades, and earn the highest score you can through mastery of movement, precision, and endurance.

release_games.name: Gods of the Grid
release_games.description: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelite. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

release_games.name: Box Flow
release_games.description: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

release_games.name: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳
release_games.description: Well, nice catch! You caught a mermaid with a tempting smile and she isn’t going to let you go that easily. Reel her closer, uncover the secrets of the deep and chase six endings: from sweet romance to something much darker.

release_games.name: Tenebrarium
release_games.description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

release_games.name: Table Of Truth
release_games.description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

release_games.name: Zero Boundary Line
release_games.description: This indie sci-fi TD has easy controls. Play as a futuristic commander defending humanity from mutants across diverse maps. Beat levels to unlock units: defenders, melee fighters, crowd controllers. Buy unique shop units, mix ability units for powerful custom defense lines.

release_games.name: Aetherantis Realm of Fates
release_games.description: Aetherlantis is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory expansion and fate cards. Explore the floating continent via dice rolls, construct settlements and cities, and turn matches around with fate cards. Enjoy couch tabletop gameplay with up to four local players.

release_games.name: 村与地下城-迷宫魔法书 Village and Dungeon-Maze Magic Book
release_games.description: 《Village and Dungeon- Maze Magic Book》is an isometric casual strategy game. The player takes on the role of the village chief and recruits heroes to explore the underground caves of the village.

release_games.name: Subjects of Cthullius
release_games.description: Explore a distant solar system in a sci-fi adventure where mathematics becomes a real superpower. Solve puzzles, complete missions, upgrade your mathemagical abilities, and uncover a mysterious conspiracy.

release_games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
release_games.description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

release_games.name: Scared Numbers
release_games.description: They have survival instincts. They have anxiety. They are terrified of your cursor. Hunt them down, exploit their herd mentality, and feed them into the shredder. It's mission-critical math in a world where nothing matters.

release_games.name: Akgwi Slash
release_games.description: Slay endless swarms of vengeful spirits in this Joseon Dark Fantasy Bullet Heaven Roguelite! Mount the mythical beast Geogugoe, ascend spiritual weapons to Grade 4, unleash screen-clearing auto-spells, and combine 50+ traditional relics to conquer terrifying Korean folklore bosses.

release_games.name: Desktop Oasis
release_games.description: Grow a little oasis on your desktop. Earn Inspiration as you type, work or study, and discover plants, boats, creatures and rare collectibles. Let it grow quietly while you’re busy; return to collect, check on your plants or play with floating objects and real-time water physics.

release_games.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
release_games.description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

release_games.name: Hitchhiking to Hell
release_games.description: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.
