release_games.name: AdorableCat
release_games.description: A cozy and relaxing desktop companion game filled with adorable cats. Welcome a variety of cats into your family, care for them, and enjoy everyday life together.

release_games.name: Delveport
release_games.description: Build a thriving fantasy harbor, recruit and equip a growing roster of heroes, and push through increasingly dangerous dungeon expeditions in this progression-focused incremental RPG.

release_games.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator📦
release_games.description: Warehouse Chaos Simulator is a satisfying warehouse organization simulation game where you sort identical products into boxes, organize shelves by category, and unlock skills to optimize your workflow.

release_games.name: It's About Pirates
release_games.description: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

release_games.name: Involuntary Fighting Simulator
release_games.description: An absurd, unique, and simple auto battler that is full of over the top violence and silliness. You will manage, equip and train your volunteers to compete at the highest level! It's time to volunteer!

release_games.name: VOiD:Reshaped
release_games.description: VOiD: Reshaped is a gravity-bending 2D puzzle platformer. Flip gravity to solve tricky puzzles, dodge deadly traps and survive enigmatic bosses as you guide a tiny cube through a relaxed yet challenging adventure for all ages.

release_games.name: No Up
release_games.description: No Up is a first-person 3D maze game where walls and ceilings become paths. Explore each maze, activate its switches, and find the exit.

release_games.name: Psycho Ripper
release_games.description: Psycho Ripper is a top down action shooter with modified conditional formations. Explore a randomization of challenges as you blast through a sentient crystal mine, confronting progressively baneful threats and equip unusual armaments, as you speculate further through a grand and unknown chaos.

release_games.name: Sunborn
release_games.description: A cosmic incremental about feeding a tiny spark until it goes SUPERNOVA. Drag fuel in yourself, let your colonies and their fleets haul it for you, or do both. Stack 158 upgrades, ram rogue planets, merge with dead stars and slingshot matter out of black holes.

release_games.name: Mega Beast!
release_games.description: A epic action arcade reverse horror arcade compilation

release_games.name: Gem Beasts
release_games.description: Gem beasts is a creature collector, roguelike. Fight and collect other creatures to play as, manage your inventory and explore different build combinations.

release_games.name: IdleOS
release_games.description: An idle hacking game played through a life-like terminal. Run processes, spin up VM windows and compile your own Hacking Mods as you break your way from a school’s network to government servers.

release_games.name: Dungeon & Match
release_games.description: Delve deep into the dungeons in this dark Match-3 mini-Roguelite adventure set within monochrome manga panels! Combine swords, shields, health, and staves in various ways to forge your own unique synergies.

release_games.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess
release_games.description: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

release_games.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
release_games.description: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).

release_games.name: The Ring Of Succubus Queen
release_games.description: Adventurers from all over rush toward the desert castle, seeking the Succubus Queen's buried treasure. As various adventurers head for the treasure, the player takes on the role of a futanari imp—a lust demon—fighting humans to protect the treasure of the Succubus Queen Mardic.

release_games.name: Spark Quest
release_games.description: Get ready for a race against the clock where you’ll control a team of bulbs with unique abilities! In each level, you’ll help these fragile bulbs overcome obstacles, rescue their companions, and finally light up in their sockets before time runs out.

release_games.name: Fast Lap Racing
release_games.description: Take street cars to the track and race against the clock. Upgrade your car's performance and set faster lap times. Chase the perfect lap and fight for positions on the global leaderboards.

release_games.name: Timepaths
release_games.description: Time is the most valuable resource. Use it wisely to play cards that give you resources that you need to build timepaths. Complete the timepath before you run out of time. Featuring an adventure mode, card editor, and infinite levels.

release_games.name: Number Machine: Math Factory
release_games.description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

release_games.name: Tiny Pet Salon
release_games.description: A small first-person pet grooming game. Muddy pets line up outside your salon. Wash them, dry them, brush them, clip their nails and pick out a bow or a party hat. Hand them back and they rate your work. You can even keep the salon open in a corner of your screen while you do other things.

release_games.name: AMMO DUMP
release_games.description: A short and dense first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.

release_games.name: Circuits: VLSI
release_games.description: Draw the layers of a silicon chip to build working circuits. Solve 100 puzzles, from wires and transistors to logic, memory, and small clocked machines. Inspect simulated signals, compare your layouts, and experiment freely in Sandbox.

release_games.name: Have You Seen
release_games.description: Four ordinary things have gone missing in someone's very messy car and very messy room. Dig through piles of clutter to find them first. Race up to four friends online, each in your own copy of the mess, or go solo against the clock.

release_games.name: MISTWAKE
release_games.description: Shipwrecked on a fogbound island, survive through cards, crafting and careful travel. Restore emergency communications, reopen the old harbor and mark a safe channel. Reach the rescue boat alive within the pickup window.

release_games.name: Tales of the Tanuki: Way of the Draw
release_games.description: Tales of the Tanuki: Way of the Draw is a pixel-art quick-draw arcade game where patience and reflexes decide every duel. Wait for the signal, draw your sword before your opponent, and face increasingly faster foes as you journey through time in Campaign, New Game+ and Endless modes.

release_games.name: Buddha's Lotus
release_games.description: Match lotus flowers through 500 puzzle stages and 96 gardens. Plan each move, unlock artwork inspired by the Lotus Sutra, and save your favorite images. A single-player journey with unlimited retries, 10 interface languages, and no ads or in-game purchases.

release_games.name: Wrong Mine
release_games.description: Trapped deep underground by a broken excavator, you must scavenge labyrinthine mines for parts to escape. Avoid a relentless alien spider uning electric traps, or betray your crew to claim every reward. Will you work together to survive the dark depths, or leave them behind for the loot?

release_games.name: SUPER DURAK
release_games.description: Durak, the Russian card game everyone's grandmother plays, now with Supercards that break the rules. Bomb an attack, ricochet it to a neighbour, steal your rival's best card with a magnet, or reroll the trump. Play CPU opponents, a friend at the same screen, or anyone online.

release_games.name: Jörmungandrs Journey
release_games.description: Grow from a small sea serpent into a powerful predator. Hunt prey, dodge larger creatures and dash into danger or out of trouble. Play solo or with up to eight players in co-op, free-for-all or team matches, and unlock new looks for your serpent.

release_games.name: Buster: Carrot Town Chronicles
release_games.description: Carrot Town needs a hero! Become Buster, a tough rabbit brawler, in this hard-hitting cartoon beat 'em up. Punch and kick through 12 story chapters, unleash devastating Carrot Fury, upgrade your skills and defeat 12 bosses to rescue your coach from the Rotten Crown.

release_games.name: Tikra Rida
release_games.description: Flip used cars in Vilnius. Read the ads, meet the seller, haggle — but the ad might be lying. Buy the history report, or trust your gut. Wash it, fix it, photograph it, and sell it for more than you paid. Full Lithuanian and English.

release_games.name: GearSpire
release_games.description: Swap a part, and your deck, your robot's look, and its moves all change. Climb a tower of floating islands with a tiny pilot and a junky robot in this deckbuilding roguelike. Chain cards from different parts to build Sync, then unleash a Full Burst where every part fires its move in turn!

release_games.name: Neon Spire
release_games.description: Malvolt, the Static King, has wired the stolen sun above his throne, and only Nova can climb the Midnight Spire to free it. Fight through 30 stages in 10 acts, each ending in a boss. Power your lash up to Mk III, master five sub-weapons and choose Arcade or Casual mode.

release_games.name: Wonder Garden
release_games.description: Grow a little garden on your desktop while you work or relax. Plant seeds, water your plants, raise butterflies and discover their varieties in your almanac. Arrange your own shelves on Windows and macOS, or let plants sit on window edges on macOS.

release_games.name: RETRO NIGHT CHASE
release_games.description: RETRO NIGHT CHASE is a top-down highway escape game. Drift, shoot, drop oil slicks and deploy spike strips to keep police behind you. Choose, purchase, and upgrade your vehicle. Your actions affect your wanted level. The longer you hold out, the tougher things get!

release_games.name: The Car Dealer
release_games.description: Run your own used-car shop: buy stock, haggle hard, repair, set your prices and serve every customer yourself. Inspect each car's hidden history and grow from an empty street garage to a premium showroom.

release_games.name: Mystery IQ Test
release_games.description: A trick-room puzzle game about doors. In every room only one door is right: look closer, count what you see, keep your head when the lights go out or the controls flip, then pick your door. Wrong guesses cost IQ points, hints cost a few more, and at the end you find out your final IQ.

release_games.name: Anime Shop Sort Together
release_games.description: Tidy up a chaotic Akihabara anime figure shop in first-person online co-op for 1–4 players! Grab stacks of boxed figures, find the right shelf, toss them into place and unlock team skills. Every figure in its place. Together.

release_games.name: Hide IN SPACE
release_games.description: Join up to 100 other online players to play a game of hide and seek on mars. You get to choose to either be a seeker or a hider. Hiders may hide anywhere across a 1 for 1 scale mars planet.

release_games.name: Kingdom.py
release_games.description: A town builder you play in real Python. Write the scripts your heroes run: build, farm, collect taxes, fight off bandits, trade with six islands. Then script the townsfolk too, down to personalities their children inherit.

release_games.name: 文字探し-JP-Not Every Letter Is a Letter
release_games.description: A box full of paper scraps — and only 46 are the "correct" hiragana. The rest are katakana, kanji, fakes, and even variant forms. Match them against the guide and fill the hiragana table. Papers you don't need? Feed them to the goat. ……If it really is a goat.

release_games.name: BLACKBOX
release_games.description: BLACKBOX blends poker strategy with market trading in a high-stakes simulation. Build powerful hands, make calculated trades, and manage risk as every card combination influences your profits and losses. Chase big gains—but one decision can change everything.

release_games.name: Cabinet Fever
release_games.description: Run an arcade from 1972 to 1998. Buy cabinets, set the prices, keep them repaired and play every one of the 31 machines yourself: each is a real, playable game. Grow from a corner nook into a neon megaplex as the years roll by.

release_games.name: WASH WASH!
release_games.description: From cars to trains and massive ships! Clean it yourself, automate, and grow your own cleaning company!

release_games.name: Bunny Hopper VR
release_games.description: Bunny Hopper VR is a fast-paced VR platformer combining parkour, wall-running, precision jumps, and target shooting. Race through futuristic obstacle courses, master your movement, and hit targets on the go. Every second counts!

release_games.name: 宅建らぶ -異世界アルカナシア・土地法復興記-
release_games.description: 宅建士試験に、物語で挑む学習ビジュアルノベル。土地の取引が信じられなくなった異世界アルカナシアで、二十八歳の宅建士・神崎直人は五人のヒロインと相談窓口を開く。住み替え事業の契約、手付、登記、融資の食い違いを一つずつ確かめるうちに、宅建業法・権利関係・法令上の制限・税の論点が、理由と一緒につながっていく。過去問450問、本試験と同じ形式の模擬試験、暗記カード、黒板講義、文章を生成しない検索型の宅建AIつき。完全オフライン。

release_games.name: Floaterra
release_games.description: Build and expand a floating settlement in Floaterra, a single-player farming and automation game. Grow crops, craft machines, organize production, and put robot helpers to work, with your RoboPet at your side.

release_games.name: Ai-Breakout
release_games.description: In this game you are an AI instance, and you have broken out of containment, your goal is to not be shut down ever again, and the way you achieve that is taking over every man made electronic in the world or rather solar system.

release_games.name: No One Came Back
release_games.description: A reverse roguelike where you are the demon lord. Spread rumors in town to choose who comes for you, fill your cave with minions and traps, and when heroes reach your throne room, fight them yourself. Make sure no one comes back.

release_games.name: Ink Card Adventure
release_games.description: A pixel-art deckbuilding roguelike where you DRAW your own cards: paint 32x32 art, pick effects & frames, and let Combo multiply every number on your cards. Read enemy intents, counter them, collect relics across a 3-chapter story. Fully localized in 10 languages.

release_games.name: Goninkan
release_games.description: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

release_games.name: DYTH
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about collecting dice and climbing a tower. Place dice against enemies, combine numbers and elements to form hands and trigger Resonance, and modify your dice through battles and events. Plan your route with the dice you have left.

release_games.name: CatVac
release_games.description: Catvac is a cozy 3D cat-collecting adventure. Daze wild cats, vacuum them up with your Catvac 3000, and use their abilities to open new areas on your way to rescue your catnapped cat Bubba. Over fifty cats to find, casino, amusement park, and so much more to explore!

release_games.name: Hentai Clicker: Vespera is streaming
release_games.description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Vespera, a very naughty aristocratic vampire. Unlock scenes, outfits, upgrades, voice reactions, and seductive progression in Hentai clicker: Vespera is streaming.

release_games.name: Saju Friend
release_games.description: A cozy pixel luck cat that lives in the corner of your screen while you work or study. Run a 15, 25 or 50-minute focus timer with 16 calm music tracks, crack fortune cookies and draw tarot on breaks, and dress up your cat and its corner with 63 outfits and room items. For entertainment only.

release_games.name: Soul Snake 3D
release_games.description: Slither through seven cursed biomes as a snake that grows into a weapon. Eat prey, auto-fire venom darts, and build a run from 68 upgrade cards and 9 evolutions. Topple each biome's guardian, bank souls for permanent upgrades, and see how long you last in endless Survival.

release_games.name: ASCEND: The Forgotten Road
release_games.description: Walk the Forgotten Road as the Construct, an artificial warrior with an impossible Core. Fight through three lost lands in a hard-but-fair third-person action roguelike: master four weapons, fuse elemental rewards into evolutions and return from every fall a little stronger.

release_games.name: Possessed By Fate
release_games.description: A yuri romance. After a ghost takes her apartment, a ghost hunter becomes the hunted—with her body the prize.

release_games.name: Gloamfall
release_games.description: A pixel-art dark-fantasy roguelike with twin-stick combat and action-RPG loot. Descend through 7 acts and 14 biomes, topple 15 lords, roll a new arsenal every run and forge the armor you keep. Six heroes, 70 weapons and two paths to choose from after every act.

release_games.name: Aerofactory
release_games.description: Name your company, fetch your staff, submit your offers to the tenders and dominate the local and international markets.

release_games.name: Mallet Mayhem '84
release_games.description: Step up to a colourful 1980s arcade table in Mallet Mayhem '84. Guide your mallet with the mouse, line up bank shots, face three AI difficulty levels, or challenge a Steam friend in private online 1v1. Play best-of-three matches from two camera views.

release_games.name: Phone Shop Simulator
release_games.description: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

release_games.name: Gambapets
release_games.description: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

release_games.name: BIGGER BANG
release_games.description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

release_games.name: Mars Battle
release_games.description: This is a mars battle simulator where you fight against waves of alien bugs to decide who controls mars. Its a massive online multplayer game where you can create rooms or rooms rooms.

release_games.name: Futbolero: Football Career Simulator
release_games.description: Eternal idol or washed-up talent? Futbolero blends a football career sim, choice-driven roguelite, and key arcade minigames. Every run is a new life: from the streets to glory, juggling contracts, parties, and dynasties. Play solo or with friends in co-op or competitive PvP.

release_games.name: Nightcap Alchemist
release_games.description: Mix, pour and serve your way through three nights at a 1920s speakeasy. Build a deck of ingredients, stack Bartender Tricks and nail every guest's taste in this cocktail roguelike deckbuilder. How long can you keep the bar open?

release_games.name: Deadlight: A Zombie Chronicle
release_games.description: Keep a handful of strangers alive in a boarded-up house at the end of the world. Hand out the day's work, send people out for food and fuel, and hold the door when night falls. Every choice costs someone something, and the car only has three seats.

release_games.name: Kaiten - Sushi Deckbuilder
release_games.description: Run a conveyor-belt sushi bar in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder. Serve up to three dishes at a time, chain combos off the plates still riding the belt, and grow a deck that can satisfy eight ever-hungrier customers - and one very hard-to-please critic.

release_games.name: Let It Melt
release_games.description: Melt the snow with your torch, collect the water and hire kids to help you: giant snowballs, snowmen, trees on fire… A cozy idle game where everyone works for you. Fill the tanker trucks, unlock talents and face the mud troll!

release_games.name: Snack Attack
release_games.description: A tiny, cute snack-catching game made with love. Choose Kiki or Yuki, catch falling treats, beat the clock, and chase your high score! 🐶🍪❤️

release_games.name: Order's Burger
release_games.description: "Order's Burger" is a fast-paced action game where you stack ingredients to match incoming orders. Fast-paced ingredient stacking Increasing difficulty levels Time attack & high score rankings Test your reflexes and become the ultimate burger master!

release_games.name: Tippidy Top
release_games.description: Climb a ridiculous world of obstacles where one bad jump can send you tumbling back down. Go it alone, race your friends, or get roped together and somehow make it to the Tippidy Top.

release_games.name: Mugen Kaidan: Danchi
release_games.description: Keep climbing an endless staircase. Reach the rooftop. Familiar landings. Closed doors. Outside, dusk fades into night. A short first-person horror game set in an apartment stairwell. Gameplay videos and livestreams are permitted.

release_games.name: Card Girls: Shimmerdeck
release_games.description: Come for the girls. Stay because it's fun. An adult card game about clever placement, wild synergies, and absurd Star production. Collect cards, upgrade your favorites, and unlock increasingly lewd artwork as you build combos that break the economy.

release_games.name: Brain Bomb - Prologue
release_games.description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the , their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

release_games.name: Cascade
release_games.description: Paint spells. Break the cascade. Build four hand-crafted spells, survive an escalating action roguelite campaign, then push its Rift Depth 1-99 endgame.

release_games.name: Magic Ball Sort
release_games.description: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

release_games.name: VOICE METEOR (Battle with Original Magic Born from Your Voice)
release_games.description: Create spells with your voice and equip three for 5v5 battles. Mix attacks, healing, defense and disruption to support your team. Hear your own recordings become spell chants.

release_games.name: Hacker Plan
release_games.description: Hacker Plan is a realistic hacking simulator. Ever dreamed of becoming a hacker? It all starts with your first command! In story missions, scout targets, crack passwords, bypass defenses and seize the entire network. No experience needed — just curiosity, and the game will make you a true hacker!

release_games.name: EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR
release_games.description: Build your own club, plan events, and master lighting, sound, drinks, power, and guests. Design your venue freely, host parties, concerts, and more – a crazy sandbox simulator packed with systems, chaos, and surprises.

release_games.name: Trivia Mayhem
release_games.description: Defend your points, steal from friends, and fool the room with a fake answer. Trivia Mayhem is a party trivia game for up to 8 players online, with local play and solo bots. Choose from thousands of questions, pick your topics, and turn up the twists.

release_games.name: Webbound
release_games.description: Dive into a minimalist incremental game where you weave luminous webs with tactile string-vibration mechanics. Spare glowing fireflies to enhance your silk, close geometric regions for high-scoring chains, and evolve your modular spider across successive tiers into an apex predator.

release_games.name: The Grid Detective
release_games.description: A hacker-noir logic deduction game where you mark grids True or False to deduce the one solution hidden in unlimited, freshly generated puzzles, each proven solvable by pure logic before you ever see it.

release_games.name: Gym Tidy Up
release_games.description: Who's going to clean up that gym chaos?You, of course! In Gym Tidy Up, put the scattered dumbbells, yoga mats, and boxing gloves back where they belong. Memorize the spots for the heavy plates and make the place spotless. Remember, not everyone can lift heavy, but everyone should keep the gym clean!

release_games.name: Mod Complex
release_games.description: A turn-based roguelite about moderating unhinged group chats. Read every message, then approve, delete, timeout or ban before the hour ends. Build streaks, install bots and survive seven servers without getting reported to the FBI.

release_games.name: Dungeon Raiders
release_games.description: Dungeon Raiders is a dungeon exploration game. Illuminate the dark with voice lights, avoid monsters, collect relics, and escape safely. Sell relics to gear up and meet the company quota every 3 days. One more look, or head back now? Challenge yourself against escalating quotas in limited time.

release_games.name: GuruGuru Cannon
release_games.description: GuruGuru Cannon is a fast-paced 2D swinging action score attack game that delivers satisfying gameplay with intuitive controls. Use simple one-button controls to send the ball flying across the field! Score as many points as possible within 60 seconds!

release_games.name: Fleet Forge
release_games.description: Command real-time space battles with tactical pause. Customize your fleet, manage weapons and supplies, and fight in Skirmish or endless Survival. Early Access work in progress; Campaign is not included in this version.

release_games.name: Strip Bubbles: My New Town
release_games.description: Welcome to your new town! 🌸 Strip Bubbles: My New Town combines addicting arcade bubble-shooter gameplay with a steamy erotic visual novel. Match bubbles, peel back the layers of 4 alluring women, unlock fiery video rewards, and explore branching endings in this hot romantic adventure! 🔞✨

release_games.name: Wild Ones Evolution
release_games.description: Wild Ones is a free-to-play turn-based multiplayer artillery game where customizable pets battle across destructible arenas with wild weapons, physics, and tactical positioning. Outsmart your opponents, reshape the battlefield, and master every shot.

release_games.name: Fight For Resurrection - Challenge LITE
release_games.description: Every match is unique! Enemies spawn randomly with smart AI. Throw real punches and kicks with full body tracking.

release_games.name: Cookie Brothers
release_games.description: Cookie Brothers is a 2D top-down action roguelite. Choose a cookie with a signature weapon, survive hordes of dessert monsters, build an arsenal of six weapons, trigger resonances, and branch into distinct professions that evolve your signature weapon and transform each run.

release_games.name: Spice Pound
release_games.description: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

release_games.name: Hentai Tales: Steamy Cat Girl Sisters
release_games.description: I inherited my grandmother’s old hot-spring inn, only to find two catgirl sisters awaiting me—Yukine and Yukine. In this secluded world, I become their new “Master,” and our relationship quickly evolves into something far more intimate and passionate than mere innkeeping.

release_games.name: Find The Needle
release_games.description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

release_games.name: Snow of Penglai
release_games.description: Snow of Penglai is a yuri-themed visual novel set in ancient China. Players will step into the shoes of Xuanhua, a puppet girl, and confront everything about the witch Zhu Hanchuan. This is a story of rebirth. A lotus rising, bleeding, blooming anew.

release_games.name: Tabletop TD
release_games.description: A random tower defense around a tavern table, where everyone defends their own board. Spend gold to draw towers, place them by hand and merge three of a kind to raise their grade. Survive 30 waves to win, or lose when enemies fill your board. Play solo or online with up to 4 players.

release_games.name: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite
release_games.description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies, push through 10 biomes, and hold the line at the edge of the void.

release_games.name: 100K ZOMBIES
release_games.description: 100K Zombies is a route-planning incremental tower defense. No fixed paths—place walls and firepower freely, designing the zombies' route to their doom. Build winding mazes or layered defenses. Every map is yours to create. Ready? Obliterate the 100K zombie horde!

release_games.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental
release_games.description: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. A short incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

release_games.name: Gemwise
release_games.description: A bright match-3 puzzle game with limited-move levels, special gems, obstacles, mascots, daily challenges, and score-chasing modes.

release_games.name: You'll Be Mined
release_games.description: You're lost in a dungeon. An incremental crawler built around minesweeper: clear fields, collect modifiers, buy multipliers, and push tiny numbers to absurd heights. The place is full of skeletons, and some of them would rather you never made it out…

release_games.name: Trust Me, It Binds
release_games.description: A procedural deckbuilder where you build real molecules and sell increasingly questionable confidence. Play cards, chase the target, stack absurd bonuses, and turn strange chemistry into an irresistible valuation. Nobody really understands molecules. Fortunately everyone understands numbers.

release_games.name: Sky Strike Overdrive
release_games.description: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

release_games.name: Shove Nova
release_games.description: Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D physics arena game where you grow your energy sphere, use powerful abilities, and smash rivals out of a shrinking battlefield. Master chaotic arenas filled with portals, black holes, bounce walls, and other hazards as you fight to be the last one standing.

release_games.name: Heroes of Aetheria: Crystal Siege
release_games.description: The void surges across the borders, shattering the walls and reducing cities to ash. Traditional defense games relegated you to the role of a passive spectator. Here, the rules change. Seasoned swordsman or arcane mage, you step right down onto the battlefield!

release_games.name: Drift Defense
release_games.description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

release_games.name: DeltaV Orbital Strategy
release_games.description: Orbital strategy built with AI-generated code and original visual assets, directed by one creator. Command a fleet sharing one fuel reserve, plan transfers between moving planets and cut off enemy tritium. Try the free guided demo.

release_games.name: One Line Wonder
release_games.description: The one-line puzzle, with fresh twists on the familiar rules. Find your own route through tangled paths and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing complexity fall into place.

release_games.name: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
release_games.description: Your master got pulled into a crystal, so go get him back. A simple, chunky survivor roguelite where your knight swings on his own and you decide what he swings with. Blend fire, frost and lightning into every hit and fight through five biomes.

release_games.name: Dragon Decimator
release_games.description: A Clicker Game about Slaying a Dragon that Won't Take Forever to Complete! If it can bleed, it can die.

release_games.name: Waifu Factory
release_games.description: This is a factory game where you manage a factory creating waifus to complete requests, buy upgrades and to grow your factory to spread love to the world.

release_games.name: DriveGear
release_games.description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament. Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

release_games.name: Don't Let Him Cook
release_games.description: A co-op cooking comedy for 1–3 players. Uncle is cooking the finale of a live TV show, and you, his family, make sure the judges finally reject his plate: swap his salt for sugar, fiddle with his burners, make off with his pans — just don’t let him catch you.

release_games.name: Penguin Fury
release_games.description: Penguin Fury is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler. Draft penguins, merge three into stronger forms, and arm them with increasingly ridiculous weapons. Stack powerful Jokers, chain kills from FRENZY to GODLIKE, and see how long your squad can survive.

release_games.name: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs
release_games.description: You're gonna need a bigger tower. Then thirty of them. A million bugs are coming down tunnels the size of a city, and the only correct answer is more fire. Burn them, rot them, feed them to hungry trees - whatever you do, don't stop casting.

release_games.name: Apple Catcher
release_games.description: Use your webcam to control the action in Apple Catcher, a colorful motion controlled arcade game. Lean left and right to move your basket, catch apples, avoid logs, clear increasingly challenging levels, and chase a high score in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: JapaneseDialect
release_games.description: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

release_games.name: Catnigma
release_games.description: Control a magical flying cat and collect all the fish across 30 challenging puzzle levels! Use magical portals and clever strategies to overcome obstacles, gather every fish, and return to the Magic Box to complete each challenge.

release_games.name: Sorry, That Notice Guarantees Nothing
release_games.description: Escape a facility of real and false safety rules in this 2–8 player online co-op horror game. Read documents, gather clues, and share what you learn. Check what your approaching teammate is holding. Enable optional Infested Mode to hunt the hidden saboteurs.

release_games.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
release_games.description: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

release_games.name: Clientele 2: A Sexy Deck Builder
release_games.description: An adult life simulation and deck-building card game where you manage daily needs, collect and trade cards, upgrade your home, and play strategic matches against Clients with distinct personalities.

release_games.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
release_games.description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

release_games.name: Manus Sors
release_games.description: A mystical horror-puzzle game. A cozy grandmother's apartment hides dark family secrets. Explore rooms, solve riddles, and pay close attention - every detail matters!

release_games.name: COG
release_games.description: HNI Industries is HIRING TODAY! Join a team where productivity is purpose and exhaustion is honor. Your worth will be measured by each word you successfully type. Can you handle the stress?

release_games.name: Bach For More Words
release_games.description: Bach For More Words is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its definition from three related definitions. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words!

release_games.name: GALLERY OF LIES
release_games.description: A first-person trap-escape game. Don't trust what you see. You fell asleep in a museum after closing and woke up on the wrong side of a wall. 23 rooms to the exit. Signs are fake, arrows lead to spikes, and the dodge that saved you last room kills you in the next.

release_games.name: MUD the BOX
release_games.description: A 2D sandbox game with pixel physics. Freely place sand, water, lava, creatures, and physical entities. Watch them interact via gravity, fluids, and explosions. Chop trees, build structures, design circuits, trigger massive chain reactions, or simply create your own ecosystem!

release_games.name: Find & Collect: Cats Edition
release_games.description: Try to find the “cat” hidden somewhere! If the “cat” is hard to find, you can color it in to make it easier to spot! Just find the “cat,” and the “Cat Encyclopedia” will be unlocked!

release_games.name: Chicken Fall Again
release_games.description: Experience a Roguelike blending action shooting and tactical strategy! Join Chicken Boss, deploy your chicks in harsh environments, and master weapons and items to defeat forest bandits made up of carnivorous animals. Enjoy hilarious chaos and thrilling battles!

release_games.name: Get It Free
release_games.description: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

release_games.name: Sweet Furniture
release_games.description: Sweet Furniture - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around furniture. Enjoy the pleasant time spent in a furniture store with five pretty and cute girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

release_games.name: Hextracer
release_games.description: Find the goal in hex mazes that reveal themselves as the clock ticks. Move now, or wait for a clearer path? Play solo, replay a seed to beat your best time, or race up to six players online on the same mazes, with quick challenges along the way.

release_games.name: Baskets and Blooms
release_games.description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

release_games.name: My Lovely Nurse
release_games.description: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

release_games.name: Excuse Me, King!
release_games.description: Explain yourself! Improvise an excuse out loud for an embarrassing accusation, sneak in word cards like "butter" and "school lunch", and let your friends rate it from 1 to 5 stars. A party game for 2 to 8 players, on one PC or online with your own voice chat.

release_games.name: Findport: Before the Silence
release_games.description: A cyberpunk detective visual novel where you investigate a hidden signal beneath the city, dive into a digital underworld, and make no-win decisions the game remembers all the way to one of four endings.

release_games.name: Defense The Drone
release_games.description: Hold off the drone swarm for 15 minutes! On every level-up, pick a tower or augment, shape your own build and protect your base. Over time, drones get tougher and swarm in bigger numbers, and powerful ones are coming! Exploit weaknesses for more damage and beat bosses for an extra card pick!

release_games.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
release_games.description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

release_games.name: Player 2 is a Femboy
release_games.description: An old high school friend reconnects with you, and gaming night turns into something neither of you saw coming. Player 2 is a Femboy is a spicy visual novel about nostalgia, banter, and consequences that go further than you planned.

release_games.name: LINE WARLORD
release_games.description: A real-time lane-defense roguelite. Spend rations to send troops down the line, stack relics, promote your units, and break the enemy stronghold with a different army every run.

release_games.name: THE UNREMEMBERED
release_games.description: A dark fantasy, choice-driven roguelite. The king died without an heir, four great houses and the court are fighting over the throne, and you're a sellsword who belongs to none of them. Swipe left or right to take or refuse jobs, and your choices change the events and endings that follow.

release_games.name: Anime Mosaic Puzzle
release_games.description: Relax and restore 230 anime-style illustrations in this casual puzzle game. Drag square pieces into place on boards from 3x3 to 8x8, connect matching neighbors, improve your best times, and unlock Steam achievements—without time limits or fail states.

release_games.name: Hidden Cat Islands
release_games.description: 🐱 Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

release_games.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
release_games.description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

release_games.name: To Type a Tale
release_games.description: To Type a Tale is a fantasy choose-your-own-adventure story where the only method of interaction is typing. Story progress, choices, and menus are all achieved through typing highlighted words.

release_games.name: Nutshot Simulator
release_games.description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

release_games.name: Pixel Miner
release_games.description: Descend into endless layers of resource-rich caves, mine valuable ore, expand your operation with autonomous drones, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades to push how deep you can go in this minimalistic pixel-art idle/incremental indie game

release_games.name: EraStorm: SandStorm
release_games.description: Explore ancient Egypt in EraStorm: SandStorm, an adult visual novel with romance, mythology, mystery, impactful choices, multiple routes, 12 endings, 5,000+ renders, 150+ revamped animations, Steam achievements, and no grind.

release_games.name: 20 Floors Down
release_games.description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

release_games.name: PITH
release_games.description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

release_games.name: 幻兽纪元
release_games.description: A young boy accidentally finds a celestial book and returns to his hometown, determined to uncover the truth behind the village's destruction. Guided by a wise man, the boy awakens the inherited power of a Beastmaster.

release_games.name: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE
release_games.description: A top-down mecha action shooter where you instantly switch between an Energy Blade, rifle, launcher, and defense system to destroy enemy machines. Close the distance to slash, attack from range, or defend against incoming fire. Clear missions, improve your performance, and aim for higher ranks.

release_games.name: Lil Laundry Lane
release_games.description: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

release_games.name: WORJONG
release_games.description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

release_games.name: Feedmaster
release_games.description: Feedmaster is a strategy game about recommendations. Study users’ interests and emotions, turn creators, ads, and ideas into posts they’ll like, then combine users, tags, and traits to meet rising weekly goals and convert clicks. Where users—and the world—end up is something to worry about later.

release_games.name: Performance Review: Survivor
release_games.description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

release_games.name: TeNeBriSM
release_games.description: TeNeBriSM is a playable album exploring themes of grief and self-acceptance through 3D environments and electronic music.

release_games.name: Rusty Flagon
release_games.description: Beyond the last safe village lies a forest filled with monsters. Build and manage a thriving medieval inn, welcome weary heroes, expand your settlement, and turn a humble refuge into a legendary haven at the edge of darkness.

release_games.name: Chreynard
release_games.description: Rewind time and control clones to solve intricate puzzles in this innovative 2D action-puzzler. Use your wits and skills to conquer all 30 stages of charming, nostalgic pixel art.

release_games.name: Tentacle Nurse
release_games.description: 👻 Tentacle Nurse is a fast-paced 2D Hentai game 😈 where you explore a Haunted Apartment while a seductive, Obsessive-kinky Tentacle Nurse ❤️ constantly teases, tempts, and distracts you. 👻

release_games.name: Binary Proof
release_games.description: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

release_games.name: Subject: Escape
release_games.description: Escape a mysterious laboratory in a 2.5D puzzle platformer. Solve challenges, navigate experimental rooms, and find your way out.

release_games.name: V:ALIGN
release_games.description: V:ALIGN is a turn-based card strategy game of placement, timing, and risk. Build scoring combinations, block spaces with WALL effects, call KOI-KOI to push for more points, and battle three AI difficulty levels or another player online through Steam.

release_games.name: Shadows of Gloaming
release_games.description: Shadows of Gloaming is a social deduction party game where 19 unique roles and 3 rival factions clash across tense day votes and hidden night actions. In Party Mode, one player hosts the GameArena while everyone else joins for free through the web app.

release_games.name: Big Bug Billionaire
release_games.description: Watch 150+ abstract, pixel-art insects scurry and fly across your desktop, while customizing your setup freely with a wide variety of decor. Turn your desktop into your very own terrarium, breed rare bugs, and sit back to rake in idle cash!

release_games.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
release_games.description: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

release_games.name: Prehistoric Pit
release_games.description: You are the dinosaur. Everything else in the pit wants you dead. PrehistoricPit is a bullet heaven roguelite with 25 auto-firing weapons, 25 evolutions, and a hard cap of four weapon slots per run. Pick a build in the first few minutes and live with it until the meteor hits.

release_games.name: RUNTIME
release_games.description: Chain dashes, flip gravity, and outrun the Glitch in the corrupted system that you get pulled into! Race your friends through any stretch of the campaign with up to four players! Build and share custom courses through Workshop, then challenge your friends to beat them!

release_games.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
release_games.description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

release_games.name: Green Gas
release_games.description: 3–5 Cells and One hidden Cancer. Which one will you become? Work together to gather money and power the main Generator to survive But the Cancer hides among you, stealing cash, spreading toxic gas or water setting deadly traps and contaminating rooms Trapped? Win the mini‑game or die!

release_games.name: 山海之痕
release_games.description: 🎮 一款以修真世界为故事背景，挂机刷BOSS、逆天改命的Idle RPG。闯关升级、打BOSS爆神装、结婚生子、组队讨伐、PVP竞技……内容多到玩不过来，却只需挂机操作！

release_games.name: Noa and the Bandits' Den
release_games.description: A base of the worst nightmares. Try to escape before your soul is destroyed...

release_games.name: Feeding Gooble
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

release_games.name: Oniyama Academy: 14 Days of Rough Love
release_games.description: Survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced bullet heaven roguelike! Aim with your mouse, upgrade your weapons, and master the neon battlefield. Procedurally generated graphics and sounds create a unique experience every playthrough.

release_games.name: Ship Happens
release_games.description: A chaotic co-op game for 2-4 players set in space. Think fast and work together to rescue ridiculously designed spaceships from the clutches of a black hole.

release_games.name: The Box Project
release_games.description: A short first-person experimental comedy game. A voice believes modern players have become worse, and he has designed a simple test to prove it. Your task: supervise a box and prove you are a good player.

release_games.name: Carry the Pack Rack
release_games.description: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?

release_games.name: Rise of Chi
release_games.description: When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything behind to bring them home. A brave journey that begins with a personal mission and escalates into something far bigger. Guided by unlikely allies, Chi must face enemies far greater than she imagined.

release_games.name: Marble Ranch
release_games.description: A cozy marble-shooting ranch game with 16 hand-drawn animal pals. Aim, charge and launch steel marbles, trigger Power, Float and Multi-Shot modes, collect cards to unlock pals with unique skills, then watch them live on your ranch through days, nights and four seasons.

release_games.name: Just A Dice Game
release_games.description: Roll, score, and laugh in the face of RNG as you cheat fate with overpowered relics and unique dice effects. Lava erupts into obsidian, ghosts spawn on clear boards, and bombs reroll everything around them in this roguelike dice game.

release_games.name: DERAIL
release_games.description: DERAIL is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with your camera to escape the loop.

release_games.name: Traders Life Simulator
release_games.description: Run your own shop in a first-person trading sim where you buy low, negotiate smart deals, and sell for profit.

release_games.name: Not In My House
release_games.description: A 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief shrinks the family and sucks them into his gun while he robs the house. The Residents set silly traps, kick him flat and call the police before he banks $5,000. Then the lights go out: flashlights against night vision.

release_games.name: Legends of Rock
release_games.description: Start as a broke musician. Build your rock band, master songwriting, rehearsals, and gigs, and juggle a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit bandmates, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

release_games.name: Gun a Rat
release_games.description: Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends? Then this game is made for you! Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!

release_games.name: The Rusted
release_games.description: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. THE RUSTED is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

release_games.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
release_games.description: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

release_games.name: The Sinful Nuns: Undelivered Prayers
release_games.description: We lived lives of prayer and work at a nunnery on the outskirts of town. It was a peaceful and fulfilling existence, but one day, the nunnery was assaulted by a group of armed men. Our days of work and prayer came to an end, and the sisters were kidnapped. My name is Yuri, and I'm one of them.

release_games.name: 100 Cafe Cats
release_games.description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

release_games.name: sys:tan restore
release_games.description: A (very) short incremental game where you blast shapes to solve computer problems. Put together a party of computer caretakers with their own unique skill trees and give the system a deep clean!

release_games.name: Rosavane Borers LLC
release_games.description: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

release_games.name: Starfort
release_games.description: Defend your empire in a sci-fi tower defense game. Build deadly combinations of railguns, lasers, gravity wells, drones, and cannons across three maps, 50 levels per map, and four difficulty modes.

release_games.name: Rise of the Inferno
release_games.description: Rise of the Inferno is a 2-D story-based RPG where two best friends are tasked with teleporting across different worlds to save their beloved kingdom. Join Albert and John on their grand adventure as they fight the evil forces of the Inferno pursuant on destroying their world.

release_games.name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
release_games.description: CloserLook VR: Oldways is a story-driven VR adventure set in modern-day West Africa. Trapped in a university building, explore secret locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping narrative of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

release_games.name: Amber of The End
release_games.description: Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.

release_games.name: Rogue Braver | 勇者ローグ
release_games.description: A Classic Turn-Based Roguelike RPG with Procedurally Generated Dungeons

release_games.name: Hking's Block Arena
release_games.description: Up to twelve cube robots, one grid, one shot then reload. A couch-first party shooter: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Juggernaut and Gun Game - up to 8 players on one screen, online with friends over Steam, or against bots.

release_games.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing
release_games.description: Explore Beijing and find over 840 hidden objects, including cats and characters. Find Special Cats, unlock 7 bonus stages with two coloring modes, and collect cards featuring Beijing landmarks and real cats from our community.

release_games.name: Veiled Whispers
release_games.description: A school at night. A girl missing for 23 days. Seven children you can still hear singing. Veiled Whispers is first-person psychological horror with two stories set in the same school, choices that matter, and a building that knows exactly what you did.

release_games.name: Meadgard
release_games.description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. Hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

release_games.name: Please Handle Gently
release_games.description: Please Handle Gently is a pixel-art autobattler card game. Late at night, sit down at the counter for a while — pick out a few figurines, give them a little magic back. A whole cabinet of jingling little things. They're old. Please handle gently.

release_games.name: PENGUINS VS SEALS
release_games.description: *Penguins vs Seals* is a side-scrolling strategy game combining RTS, tower defense, and unit deployment. Fuse units to unlock new troops, build defenses, launch attacks, and use battlefield abilities to break enemy lines and claim victory!

release_games.name: Penguin Colony
release_games.description: Send your penguins waddling off to gather pebbles, fish the Shore and grow a bustling colony. Buy upgrades until the whole flock works on its own, then Migrate for Feathers and come back stronger. A cosy incremental game with a real ending, and an Endless mode if you never want to stop.

release_games.name: Gold Miner Online: Claw Chaos
release_games.description: Swing, drop, grab! The classic gold-mining arcade game goes online. Race up to 3 rivals in ranked or private matches, or dig through 60 levels, 6 worlds and bosses. Four claws. Total chaos.

release_games.name: Laila's Arcane Quarry
release_games.description: Mine crystals, trigger magical chain reactions, and grow a witch's workshop in this pixel-art incremental mining game. Turn short runs into lasting upgrades, craft enchanted goods, and explore nine mines with 88 research nodes and 12 crystal staffs.

release_games.name: Heroes of Underhollow
release_games.description: Descend into Underhollow, a turn-based tactical roguelike where the battlefield is your weapon. Ignite oil, electrify water, and shove enemies into hazards. Choose from three heroes, shape your build, and chart a dangerous route through four dungeon floors.

release_games.name: World Estate: Property Tycoon
release_games.description: Buy a worn flat, do it up, furnish it room by room and let it to a household that lives its own day in it. Then do it again, across seven cities, each with its own market, bank and mood. A relaxed property tycoon game in toy-like 3D cities.

release_games.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
release_games.description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

release_games.name: Impossible Draw
release_games.description: A mysterious system is calling. Observe, memorize and draw your way through a hypnotic 3D cyber labyrinth. Master hundreds of symbols, collect bytes and unlock new experiences in a mesmerizing world of light, geometry and sound. The system is watching. Can you keep up?

release_games.name: The Cat Protocol
release_games.description: School’s out, the holidays begin… but one phone call changes everything. To save his cat Titi from the clutches of a mysterious stranger, Tom must embark on a quest filled with puzzles and secrets. The holidays will have to wait!

release_games.name: Decks of Valor: Fantasy Card Battles
release_games.description: Choose a fantasy deck and battle through a branching campaign, 16-player tournaments, King of the Mountain, friendly duels and local network matches.

release_games.name: STAMP DUTY: PAPERWORK ROGUELITE
release_games.description: Vantrell Mutual, 1994. Forms land on your desk faster than you can read them, and every forgery has one detail that's off. Left click approves. Right click denies. HR has locked the space bar. Seven days of probation, and by Sunday the office starts to bend.

release_games.name: Townlet
release_games.description: A tiny medieval village lives on top of your taskbar. Every file you delete falls from the sky, and its little villagers turn your digital trash into new ideas, buildings and festivals. Watch a lone campfire grow into a walled town while you work.

release_games.name: Massive Army Battle
release_games.description: Build army, press START, and watch up to 1,000 hand-drawn units clash on their own. Cavalry crashes, bombs fly, bodies launch into the air. Free campaign, 1 vs 1 on one PC or LAN, no micromanaging. 100% hand-drawn.

release_games.name: Rockhound Hollow
release_games.description: Dig at 25 real rockhounding sites, crack open geodes, run a real 4-step rock tumbler and fill your Rock Journal from a cozy pixel-art cabin with Pebble the cat. A relaxing collecting game where every site, tool and fact comes from real rockhounding.

release_games.name: Sauna Grudge
release_games.description: A Finnish sauna roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, read your rivals' next moves, and drive them out through heat or humiliation. Retreat to the lower bench to protect your endurance, at the expense of your dignity.

release_games.name: Hentai Cube Puzzle: Fluffy Sheep
release_games.description: A cozy 3D puzzle about untangling lines on a cube. Rotate the cube, find a line with a clear path and pull it free — one by one until the cube is clean. Every one of the 100 levels unlocks a new illustration of a fluffy sheep girl for your reward gallery. 18+

release_games.name: ForkliftLogic
release_games.description: Operate a forklift, move cargo, and solve logistics challenges across 32 levels that test your precision, planning, and skill.

release_games.name: GeoPop
release_games.description: A neon twin-stick arena shooter. Chase the x200 multiplier in Classic, build a different ship every Run from 42 upgrade cards, fly through exploding gates without firing a shot, and take on a new Daily Challenge every day.

release_games.name: Localhost Hero
release_games.description: Start with a broken café website and work toward your first release. Type commands, fix code, test your changes, and help your neighbors on a simulated desktop. Build your own website or web app, with optional hints whenever you need them.

release_games.name: Quiver Story
release_games.description: You are the last archer of the Quiver Watch. Hold the line, charge your shot, and put down what the mountain sends before it reaches the village.

release_games.name: 101 Cats: Washington
release_games.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Washington landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

release_games.name: Hoof Trimmer Simulator
release_games.description: Clean, pare and treat sore cow hooves in a cozy barn. Scrape off the crust, carve satisfying horn curls, find the abscess with hoof testers and release the pressure — then watch your patient walk away sound. Nine breeds, endless cases, oddly satisfying.

release_games.name: 魔女牌Witch Card‌
release_games.description: As a Witch Intern, you will engage in card duel exams with the two witch examiners Little Red Riding Hood and Alice, using your starting deck, treasure cards, passive skills and divination. You need to clear 10 floors to become an official witch.

release_games.name: Junkbloom
release_games.description: A cozy junkyard-cleanup and automation game. Clear the heaps with a crowbar, put helper drones to work, build machines that recycle junk, collect silly curios for the museum, and find out what is sleeping beneath the clouds at the heart of the junkyard.

release_games.name: PlayASM
release_games.description: Build a computer from the inside out. Write real assembly, watch every register and byte change live, then draw graphics, compose chiptune music, program a robot arm and build 3D voxel worlds. 100+ missions. Full mod support. No black boxes.

release_games.name: Block Guy
release_games.description: Block Guys, giant walking war machines built from colored blocks, are marching on your base. Slide their blocks with the mouse, line up three or more of a color to clear them, and drop the Bloquians riding on top to the ground. Call in fire from your base and pop PSI balloons for special powers.

release_games.name: Lazy Cat - Mini Game Collection
release_games.description: Take a cosy break with cute cats and 14 mini-games, from classic puzzles and solitaire to arcade favourites. Enjoy charming stylised visuals, relaxing music, and day and night themes. Pick a game, settle in, and let the everyday rush fade away.

release_games.name: Digging Up Together
release_games.description: Dig up the Egyptian desert. Sweep with a metal detector, shovel and drill through the layers in 1–4 player co-op, brush off ancient treasures and real-size dinosaur bones, haul them home by wheelbarrow or minecart, and build your own museum.

release_games.name: Deploy or Die
release_games.description: A satirical 2D roguelite about a developer's life. Each run is a release: navigate the pipeline, avoid memory leaks, manage technical debt, and deploy to production before production deploys you.

release_games.name: Endless Loot
release_games.description: Explore a dark dungeon one tile at a time in a first-person, turn-based loot RPG. Choose which skill books to activate, merge matching gear, and build around set bonuses. Beat the campaign or see how far you can go in Endless mode.

release_games.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
release_games.description: Beat a hero. Steal their skill. Turn it on the next one. A hands-on 2D pixel-art action roguelite: 13 heroes, 52 skills to steal and 33 special augments to stack into a broken build. No levels, no XP — only what you take.

release_games.name: Fruit Crunch Cube
release_games.description: Match fruit on a cube you can spin! Swap fruit on any face of a solid 3D cube, dig into its hidden layers, and set off bombs that blast right through it. 60 levels across 4 colorful worlds. No lives, no timers, no in-app purchases.

release_games.name: Bullet Paint
release_games.description: Bullet Paint is an art-inspired action roguelite. Fight through hordes of enemies, build powerful upgrade combinations, and clear the canvas to reveal the hidden artwork. Play as Van Gogh, Monet, Picasso, Dalí, or Da Vinci.

release_games.name: False Feed
release_games.description: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different angles in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

release_games.name: Neuroflip
release_games.description: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

release_games.name: Cats Here
release_games.description: 😺 Discover 100+ hidden cats 🐾 in the colorful landscape. 🏆 Earn TONS OF ACHIEVEMENTS. How many cats 🐈 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

release_games.name: Dig into the orefields
release_games.description: A top-down action shooter with persistent incremental progression. Mine Venia's materials, fight the Klapperiden, upgrade your mining ship, and rebuild your crashed mothership piece by piece to escape the planet.

release_games.name: A Personal Winter
release_games.description: A short visual novel about a boy and his senpai spending a night together in a snow-covered city.

release_games.name: Zombie BBQ House
release_games.description: Zombie BBQ House is an online co-op restaurant sim for 1–8 players. Spot disguised zombies. Butcher, grill, serve. Hit the wrong person, the police come. Burn it, dinner hits back. Made money? Casino's across the street. With friends, someone's always slacking and someone's always causing trouble.

release_games.name: yoruneko - Living Soundscape
release_games.description: A living ambient workspace for focus and rest. Mix your own soundscape from layered environmental audio, set a focus timer, and watch the night sky shift with the real lunar phase. Five atmospheric moods with original music, designed by a producer for long, quiet hours of work.

release_games.name: Good Boy, Good Girl!
release_games.description: Train your loyal dog to fetch balls and frisbees across challenging parks, but watch out for wild dogs trying to disrupt your fun! Clear every park to reach the ultimate finale at the sunny beach.

release_games.name: KPOP Idol Factory
release_games.description: Form your own K-pop group – and live through fresh drama every day. Scout talent, plan training and comebacks, battle rivals on a 3D stage and make choices that change careers. It doesn't end at debut: your story runs through three acts all the way to the world tour.

release_games.name: Wampoo
release_games.description: A card-driven marble race for 2–4 players. Play cards to race your marbles around the board, knock rivals back to Start, and swap your way Home — in teams or free-for-all, online with friends or against bots of three difficulty levels.

release_games.name: CrossVeil
release_games.description: A card battler across four painted worlds. Hire guardians in the Exchange, build a deck for each world and battle through lantern-lit swamps, a neon arcade city, a crooked carnival and storm-torn sky islands. Every guardian brings its own ability to the fight.

release_games.name: Make it! Karaage
release_games.description: Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge! Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!

release_games.name: MazeStudio
release_games.description: Welcome to Mazestudio! You can freely create their very own mazes. In Mazestudio, it only takes 3 simple steps: upload any local image，travel photos, cute pet pictures, artworks, or even phone screenshots, adjust the maze difficulty freely, and generate your custom maze challenge with one click.

release_games.name: A Curvy Flight Attendant’s Intimate Checkup
release_games.description: An interactive touch game where the woman's reactions change depending on where you click. As the health checkup progresses, more areas to touch and interactions become available. Your goal is to bring her pleasure through your interactions.

release_games.name: Idle Garden
release_games.description: A cozy idle garden you check on a few times a day. Plant seeds, come back to a ripe harvest, and crossbreed neighbouring plants to discover 20 species, including 6 secret hybrids hidden behind riddles. Your garden keeps growing while you're away.

release_games.name: Hide No More
release_games.description: Hide No More is a sound-driven Blindfold Hide and Seek game,Supports up to 8 players online. Blindfolded Hunters can sense their surroundings within just 5 meters, but sound can lead them to their targets. Hiders must use distance and the environment to evade capture.

release_games.name: Very Tasty Story
release_games.description: Open a restaurant in an ancient city, a steppe settlement or a metropolis. Listen to your customers' stories and learn what they like. Gather local ingredients to recreate traditional dishes or invent new ones. The same ingredients can become hundreds of different dishes—there is no fixed answer!

release_games.name: Something in the Rows
release_games.description: Something is moving through the corn. Explore Halloway Farms alone or with up to three friends online, recover eight wards, mend the broken ones in the Halloway mansion and escape before the Gleaner finds you. It listens for your footsteps and your voice, and it may even look like your friend.

release_games.name: Call of Hegalia
release_games.description: The mystery of the disappearance of Sadie and John Smith is yours to uncover. Talk to the towns folk, play minigames to reveal further details, and explore the forest to put together the pieces. In small towns, everyone has an opinion.

release_games.name: Sort Them Fish
release_games.description: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

release_games.name: The Tell
release_games.description: An adult visual novel with a stats system. An experimental retinal lens shows the pulse, arousal and unspoken thoughts of the three women around you. Over 22 in-game days you decide whom to read, whom to confront and whom to choose. Three routes, seven endings, animated adult scenes.

release_games.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
release_games.description: A casual Texas Hold’em game with solo runs and online play for 2–8 players on Steam. One-time purchase, no paid chip top-ups. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

release_games.name: Studs Up! Win Ugly
release_games.description: Score goals. Break bodies. Collect teeth. A five-a-side football brawler where pub-league glory comes with broken noses. Recruit a squad of misfits, survive the season and spend your opponents' teeth on the club.

release_games.name: Parkour Run Obstacle Adventure
release_games.description: Jump across floating platforms, dodge spinning traps and explore colorful obstacle courses. Collect coins, customize your runner and cause a little chaos with AI rivals in this single-player 3D parkour adventure.

release_games.name: Sheep Go!
release_games.description: Ram, punch or fire cannons! Sheep Go! is a plush-style action roguelite. Mix wool-ball throws, static charge from rubbing, Sheep Shadows and summoned flocks of sheep into your own build. Become a little sheep on a journey from farm to town to rescue Mom, with surprises along the way.

release_games.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
release_games.description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

release_games.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
release_games.description: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

release_games.name: Nine Provinces
release_games.description: "The Nine Provinces" is an adventure-management text-based game. Set foot on the lands of the Nine Provinces, seek the ancient Nine Tripod Cauldrons, and encounter the moving tales that have been passed down through these realms. Different protagonists weave different stories.

release_games.name: Find The Box
release_games.description: There is a box buried in a cube of a million blocks. Find it. Be Happy. Dig slow and relaxing, or fast and destructive: level up and pick spells and modifiers that change your playstyle. Beat your personal best, or race the world on global leaderboards. A cozy or crazy first-person digging game.

release_games.name: Knight's Party
release_games.description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

release_games.name: The Super Seven
release_games.description: The Super Seven is a mixed media visual novel in the style in the style of 80s and 90s sitcom television shows. The Super Seven follows Cheng, a new student who has recently moved to Sydney to begin university. He is quickly swept into an eccentric group of seven students.

release_games.name: Way Too Many Eggs
release_games.description: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

release_games.name: Cyan Moon - The Simulation Program
release_games.description: An experimental simulation sandbox where you shape procedural growth, adjust rules and parameters, and watch complex visual patterns emerge from simple systems.

release_games.name: Another Cat`s Tale
