release_games.description: Anna is hiding in a cursed mansion, where lives an unfinished fairy-tale and an all-knowing Cat wanders, eager to see how the story ends. In this first-person adventure, Anna must explore the mansion, solve puzzles, and face.. all sorts of things. All in order to fulfill her most cherished wish.

release_games.name: MECCHA OCTOPUS
release_games.description: Sculpt yourself to blend in! Meccha Octopus is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where hiding means becoming part of your surroundings. Find the perfect spot, choose a shape, and sculpt yourself to fit the environment. Copy the texture around you to complete your disguise.

release_games.name: TinyBriks
release_games.description: TinyBriks is a relaxing minimalist plastic brick building game where there are no objectives, no building instructions, no time pressure and no maximizing shareholder value. Make whatever YOU want. Create fantastic dioramas from a plethora of brick styles and colors. Your imagination is the limit.

release_games.name: Marble Stars
release_games.description: Marble Stars is a challenging platformer made by one person. Explore 55 handcrafted levels suspended above the ocean, discover special abilities, speedrun each course to compete on the global leaderboards, and earn prestigious medals as you progress.

release_games.name: Old Man's Sushi
release_games.description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

release_games.name: PACKING SHIFT
release_games.description: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

release_games.name: Rind Town
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every customer’s order is a puzzle. Build the right juice from up to five ingredient cards, blend it, and chase scores that grow until they stop fitting on screen. Become the juice master of an anime town.

release_games.name: Pawn'd Chess
release_games.description: Pick up a controller and play chess against human-like CPU opponents with adjustable difficulty. Make yourself comfortable with extensive accessibility options, explore freely with undo and redo, and create or revisit your own positions.

release_games.name: A Little Faraway
release_games.description: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

release_games.name: Cute Kitty WAR
release_games.description: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.

release_games.name: Femboy Hot Springs
release_games.description: Burned out by city life, Kazuki inherits a debt-ridden hot spring inn in a snowy mountain village. Save the inn, grow close to four adult femboys, and choose your ending in a heartfelt 18+ visual novel of warm water, cold nights, and melting hearts.

release_games.name: Cardsharp
release_games.description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with up to 4 players online. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

release_games.name: Prigod Idle
release_games.description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

release_games.name: PUCKVPUCK
release_games.description: Arcade sports with pucks: SOCCER, DODGEBALL, a top-down SHOOTER and co-op ZOMBIES in one game. Boost, slam and charge your shots, or grab a gun off a pad and chase a kill streak. Up to 8 players, online or all on one PC, or solo against bots. A minute to learn, and the skill ceiling keeps climbing.

release_games.name: Unpredictable Cake
release_games.description: A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

release_games.name: MagiMine Orchestra
release_games.description: Smash ore by clicking or holding, scoop up scattered resources, and automate the mine with four specialist classes. Chain combos, flood the screen in Fever, then prestige for permanent power in this active incremental mining game.

release_games.name: Souterrain
release_games.description: Roll the dice. Cheat fate. Break the house. Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game where you manipulate colorful dice, build powerful combinations, and gamble everything on one more hand.

release_games.name: DeepCorp Rescue
release_games.description: DeepCorp Rescue is a physics-based arcade rescue game where you pilot a fragile rocket through dangerous caves, dodge traps, save workers, recover cargo, and land safely. Upgrade your ship, master tricky missions, and survive DeepCorp’s hazardous underground world.

release_games.name: Desktop Wallet Heroes
release_games.description: An intense idle RPG that unfolds right on your desktop! Desktop Wallet Heroes is an overlay idle RPG where characters hunt monsters at the bottom of your screen without interrupting your work. Upgrade items, collect loot, and trade on the Steam Community Market!

release_games.name: Continuum
release_games.description: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

release_games.name: Wardspire
release_games.description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

release_games.name: Player Life: The Seven Islands
release_games.description: Set sail on a cheeky adult adventure across seven islands. Make dialogue and action choices, solve connect-3 challenges, recruit seven unforgettable women to your yacht, unlock explicit scenes, customize their outfits, and decorate your captain’s cabin.

release_games.name: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper
release_games.description: Slimes are invading your desktop, and every keystroke becomes a powerful counterattack. Unlock all kinds of weapons, draw wildly inventive artifacts, and collect strange and wonderful slimes. Fight alone or team up with friends to give the slimes a beating!

release_games.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
release_games.description: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

release_games.name: Little Loops
release_games.description: A little idle game for the corner of your desktop. Flick a spinner, fit clock gears, or glaze a pot for your neighbor’s windowsill. Build a desk of favorites in Original or Pixel art, and bring one along in a compact companion window.

release_games.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
release_games.description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

release_games.name: Coverage
release_games.description: Grow to cover the board with your pieces--or absorb all of your opponent's. A board game similar to Othello and Ataxx, playable by up to 2 players online or offline, with a built-in board editor and 3 game modes! Relax with a classic experience or try a fast-paced simultaneous movement mode!

release_games.name: OneBody: Together
release_games.description: One character. A whole team. In OneBody: Together, your team shares the same body. One player moves, another controls the camera, another attacks. Switch roles, manage the chaos, and try not to fall off a cliff together.

release_games.name: Rogue Belt
release_games.description: Fight through a storm-wracked asteroid belt in this top-down space roguelite, solo or in online co-op. Mix ships and weapons, choose an upgrade every minute, and face the boss after ten minutes. Break through to unlock new ships, weapons, and permanent upgrades.

release_games.name: EndlessHorde
release_games.description: An Unreal Engine powered side-scrolling action game with visceral zombie combat. Scavenge loot, upgrade your character at camp, and survive endless hordes solo or in local two-player co-op with friends.

release_games.name: Nova Survivors
release_games.description: Blast through endless alien hordes in space and climb the Steam leaderboards. Pick from 21 ships, each with its own weapon and ultimate, stack cards and weapon evolutions, and push through a 100-level campaign or endless Survival until your build breaks the game.

release_games.name: Apocalipsis Survivor
release_games.description: In the first worlds the infected just walk at you. In the fourth they start shooting back. An action survivor across 10 worlds: pick your hero, upgrade your weapons on the fly and hold off ever denser hordes all the way to the alien source of the plague.

release_games.name: Trucktris
release_games.description: The puzzle driven game, literally. Take control of tetromino shaped trucks and carefully navigate them onto the soon departing cargo ship. Then reverse them into position for satisfying shipments!

release_games.name: Joker's Last Call
release_games.description: A dark casino card roguelike: match suits or ranks against two AI rivals. Stack attack cards to pass on a growing draw penalty, or reflect the chain with a Joker. The 54-card deck is fixed; relics change rules for the whole run, and each battle gives you one single-use trick card.

release_games.name: Isle Of Thundir
release_games.description: Explore the world, Capture Towns and Villages, Defeat your enemies in battle. Command troops and level them up. Defend your Towns and villages.

release_games.name: FLIP OVER
release_games.description: FLIP OVER is a puzzle game where you flip tiles to turn every tile white. Flip tiles with different rules and enjoy puzzles in many forms.

release_games.name: Diamonds and Spades
release_games.description: Create your own cards and share them with friends in this roguelite card game! Discover powerful combos, collect unique Tarot cards with special abilities, and push your luck to achieve absurdly high scores!

release_games.name: Vilnius Museum of Antiquities: A Temple of the Past
release_games.description: A virtual exhibition recreating the first public museum in Lithuania—the Vilnius Museum of Antiquities. Open the doors to the mid-19th century, discover over 100 unique historical exhibits, talk to the founder of the museum himself, and learn about the fate of the collection.

release_games.name: Lust Tap
release_games.description: Lust Tap — cinematic 3D adult clicker. Fill the bar, keep the rhythm, and unlock every scene. Easy to start. Hard to put down.

release_games.name: Shorted
release_games.description: Balatro-style scoring on a 9×9 grid. Your deck becomes the board: trace same-color Packets into scoring shapes, install Patches that hack the rules, and rebuild the deck that refills the grid. Six Firewalls stand between you and an overloaded high score.

release_games.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
release_games.description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

release_games.name: Sweet Corn Desktop Pet
release_games.description: Interface Name Core Functions Desktop Floating Window Stands on the desktop; click to expand the primary function panel Primary Function Entry Panel Displays the core entry points for raising, dressing up, online play, and settings Raising Operation Panel

release_games.name: Rollamech
release_games.description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

release_games.name: Trolley Dilemma
release_games.description: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

release_games.name: Cubus Tower
release_games.description: Cubus tower is a platformer game. Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

release_games.name: Höllenburg, Hell Castle
release_games.description: "Höllenburg: Hell Castle" is an arcade game with video adventure elements, where you must explore a dark and satanic castle to defeat the generals of evil. Collect items, gain experience points, and level up while uncovering hidden secrets.

release_games.name: My Deskmate Douki Cyan
release_games.description: Your favorite deskmate is closer than ever. Follow Douki-Cyan through work, workouts, coffee breaks, and lazy afternoons as you experience her daily life from different perspectives. Cute moments, charming expressions, and heartwarming interactions await with your beloved deskmate.

release_games.name: Swarmslam
release_games.description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

release_games.name: Pop An Old Man
release_games.description: is a game about playing various games with old man. After you discovered an old man, you can pop them out from a cannon, collecting their loots to your Steam item inventory and trade with other players. Understand old man, becomes old man, transcends old man.

release_games.name: Between Floors
release_games.description: A first-person anomaly-spotting horror game set inside a single elevator. Spot the differences between two contrasting corridors and choose: up or down? A tall figure is hunting you. Every stop could be your last correct call.

release_games.name: Type Me Home
release_games.description: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

release_games.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
release_games.description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

release_games.name: WizKitty and the Tower of Doom, Gloom, and Other Bad Stuff
release_games.description: Craft ridiculous loot in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck doesn’t attack, it builds the weapon that does. Upgrade, reroll, and stack modifiers as you climb the tower and bully RNG into giving you the perfect item.

release_games.name: Brick Builds
release_games.description: Build a spaceship, a tiny cottage, or something entirely your own in a relaxed brick-building sandbox. Start with a guided build or an empty plate, experiment with colors and moving parts, and keep your favorite creations in your own collection.

release_games.name: Sheepscape
release_games.description: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

release_games.name: Noodle Cable
release_games.description: The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

release_games.name: We Are Rebellion
release_games.description: WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you pilot a warship in command of a rebel crew. The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been devoured and polluted by capitalist corporations.

release_games.name: Hyperline
release_games.description: High-speed space arena for 2–8 players. Your ship leaves a permanent trail that fills the arena — touch any trail, wall, or ship and you're out. Play online with friends or solo against bots. 20 unlockable ships, host-configurable matches, Steam achievements & leaderboards.

release_games.name: Voxotron
release_games.description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

release_games.name: The Last Miner
release_games.description: Dig deep into a planet, mine precious resources, and upgrade your gear to survive endless waves of enemies. Find a way to escape this Planet

release_games.name: Dry Spring Monologue
release_games.description: Dry Spring Monologue is a chapter-based visual novel game that follows Lu Zimo. The story includes adult themes such as overtime work, insomnia, and performance reviews, as well as terrifying elements like living spaghetti.

release_games.name: Last Inspection
release_games.description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside — all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

release_games.name: Dirt Clicker
release_games.description: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig for treasures, unlock upgrades, get help from friendly pals and flip tools to dig up mountains of dirt. Will you find out what secrets are hidden beneath the dirt?

release_games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about manipulating a political simulation and becoming a dictator. Change how the political system works so it tears itself apart. 5% of profits donated to the godot and blender foundations.

release_games.name: Tzelem
release_games.description: The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.

release_games.name: Sushiamo
release_games.description: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

release_games.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
release_games.description: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

release_games.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
release_games.description: A binary decision-driven city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

release_games.name: Linear Chess
release_games.description: Chess on a single line of 21 squares. Rethink familiar tactics with adapted piece movement and win by checkmate or centre control. Play locally, challenge the AI or face another player online across four distinct 3D themes.

release_games.name: Magic Portals
release_games.description: A fast, elegant card game of elemental drafting. Draw from the shared Animus, forge crystals, and ignite sleeping portals. Blue attunes, Purple pays, Green multiplies, Yellow improvises. First to seven portals ends the duel - but only the sharpest planner wins. Solo vs AI or online duels.

release_games.name: Endless Dark Loot
release_games.description: Endless Dark Loot is a dark-fantasy card-style RPG all about the thrill of the loot. Dive into dungeon after dungeon, fight hordes of demons, and grab tons of gear and skills along the way. Every run is a fresh adventure — and every drop could flip your whole strategy on its head.

release_games.name: Axomorph Idle
release_games.description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

release_games.name: Moto Rogue
release_games.description: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

release_games.name: Stellar Smash
release_games.description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

release_games.name: Spincremental
release_games.description: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

release_games.name: Pre-Warp Age
release_games.description: A turn-based economic strategy game about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Plan the development of your colonies, assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems.

release_games.name: Node Crown
release_games.description: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here! Have fun!

release_games.name: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
release_games.description: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

release_games.name: Diskette Dungeon
release_games.description: A magical Diskette opens a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adapting, fighting, and collecting corrupted data to unlock the next world. With a wide variety of powers and weapons, every run offers a different challenge.

release_games.name: PIX Football Manager
release_games.description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

release_games.name: Storm Grill
release_games.description: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

release_games.name: MUPO
release_games.description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

release_games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
release_games.description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

release_games.name: Scared Crow
release_games.description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

release_games.name: PHUY
release_games.description: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

release_games.name: The Failed
release_games.description: As a failed experiment, you’re marked for disposal. That was the plan until the lab descended into chaos. Seize your chance and find a way out!

release_games.name: Lines We Draw
release_games.description: Lines We Draw is a 3D isometric narrative strategy game set at a tense Cold War border. Inspect documents, interrogate travelers, and manage a shifting checkpoint between rival states. Your stamp decides fates: Will you be a hero of the people, or a tool of the regime?

release_games.name: Turning Manor
release_games.description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

release_games.name: In Full Bloom
release_games.description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

release_games.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
release_games.description: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

release_games.name: Stack & Brew
release_games.description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

release_games.name: Chivalware
release_games.description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

release_games.name: StandOff
release_games.description: Lead a stick-figure army from the Stone Age to the Space Age in a single-player strategy war. Mine gold, recruit troops, build defenses, and break enemy strongholds. Research lasting upgrades, prestige for stronger runs, and unlock an escalating Endless War.

release_games.name: Build A Bot
release_games.description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

release_games.name: Slumber Realm
release_games.description: Battle your childhood fears in a 90s-soaked dice roguelike. One die roll triggers your entire build. Chain wild combos, fight broccoli, and decorate your bedroom with nostalgic relics.

release_games.name: fanxiu
release_games.description: Fan Xiu is an idle cultivation game. Break through realms while elixirs, artifacts, and rare treasures drop over time. Every item you earn can be freely listed and traded on the Steam Market — idle your way to immortality, and to real profit. Limited-time events regularly drop exclusive items

release_games.name: County of Fortune
release_games.description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

release_games.name: Minesweeper Sonar
release_games.description: A tense twist on the classic Minesweeper game! Each missile has a Minesweeper grid, solve them to protect your boat and earn currency, use the currency to attack the enemy ship and repair you boat.

release_games.name: The Maze: In Dark
release_games.description: With only a flashlight to rely on, secure your objective in the dark factory and escape while avoiding the gaze of 'Him', who roams the factory at random. Overcome the extreme fear of the unknown brought on by darkness and complete your assigned mission safely.

release_games.name: Faraway
release_games.description: Faraway is an endless procedurally generated, mastery-driven arcade game about a shooting star that creates constellations to stay alive.

release_games.name: Ragdoll Robotics
release_games.description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

release_games.name: Arcanos One
release_games.description: Go on a co-op adventure with expressive cars, pull your friends to safety and deal with pesky cops.

release_games.name: Soar Up The Charts
release_games.description: A fast-paced rhythm game and arcade-style rail shooter where music is your weapon! 🎸With tracks provided by Alden Ave and Keep Flying, be ready to turn it up and blast your way through those radio robots! 🎺

release_games.name: Starshapes
release_games.description: A calm and highly satisfying puzzle game about connecting shapes to create 3D star constellations.

release_games.name: Kill King 2D
release_games.description: Kill King 2D is a dark fantasy 1v1 tactical auto-battler. Secretly queue orders and spend Action Points, then watch your pieces carry out the plan on their own. Evolve your army, outpredict your rival, and kill the enemy King.

release_games.name: Laser Lightshow
release_games.description: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

release_games.name: MONO CHAMELEON
release_games.description: Melt into the shadows. Tag, hide-and-seek and prop hunt for 2–10 players in four retro shades: slip from shadow to shadow, paint yourself into the wall, or fool the seeker with a decoy. Short on players? CPU players fill in. Streaming? 239 viewers can watch, vote and take turns.

release_games.name: CRIME COAST
release_games.description: Chase dangerous money, drive your dream car, and get close to women with secrets—CRIME COAST is an illustrated narrative RPG where business, favors, and gunfire can open the way to a life on your own terms.

release_games.name: Fire of Changbai
release_games.description: Fire of Changbai is a 2D real-time tactics game set against the backdrop of the anti-Japanese guerrilla war in Northeast China in the 1930s. The game's story and maps are drawn from real history, narrating—from the perspective of a Korean anti-Japanese leader.

release_games.name: Ragnarok - Rise of the Nine Realms
release_games.description: Build a Viking settlement against the approach of Ragnarök. Gather resources, lead expeditions and venture into interactive adventures. Rebuild with earned legacy upgrades and raise Yggdrasil’s shrine to save each of the Nine Realms.

release_games.name: My Hockey Story
release_games.description: Shoot or pass? You’ve got seconds to decide! Learn simple hockey tactics with your coach, then try them in matches. Raise an 11-year-old from the Town League to the Nationals and get drafted before you turn 16.

release_games.name: 가문의 영광
release_games.description: Lineage-style hunting and farming, without the pay-to-win pressure or competition. A single-player Lineage-like RPG: farm rare gear and enhance it, collect transformations and doll companions, and clear 5 regions and 50 floors by auto or manual hunting. No extra payments to progress.

release_games.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing
release_games.description: A co-op arena survivors roguelike for 1–4 players where the leftovers fight back. Pick a food, pick a class and survive 20 waves of germs, mold and expired dairy with a ridiculous loadout of kitchen weapons. Fuse, evolve, synergize — and vote with your friends on what horror to open next.

release_games.name: Barbarians: The Free Tribes
release_games.description: Lead a small tribe against mighty empires in a story-driven strategy adventure. Sneak through living settlements, pause to plan your raids, bring your people home, and build a camp worth defending across five campaigns and four changing seasons.

release_games.name: High Lance
release_games.description: Tap to flap. Higher lance wins. A one-button arcade game: ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges, unseat rival riders from above, and catch them as they parachute down to build a capture streak. Miss them, and they'll return a rank tougher. Five lands, each ending with a dragon.

release_games.name: Bustbound
release_games.description: Make 21 your weapon. Bustbound turns blackjack into a roguelike deckbuilder: hit, stand, or double down to win turn-based battles. Combine effect cards and relics, choose your route through six stages, and face the Joker Couple.

release_games.name: Lullaby for a Titan
release_games.description: A titan sleeps beneath your village, and its dreams are your harvest. Build, hum the giant's lullaby on its breath, catch dreams and keep its sleep deep. Every building makes noise; every dream tempts you closer to the edge. Don't wake the giant.

release_games.name: Cleanup Gone Wrong
release_games.description: Clean up a world where the trash fights back! Play solo or with up to 4 players online. Collect rubbish, wash away grime, dismantle bulky junk, and upgrade your tools. Battle trash monsters, rescue your friends, and turn a filthy workplace into a job well done.

release_games.name: Jawless Fish Races
release_games.description: A quiz race for kids. Every right answer gives your Sacabambaspis a burst of speed, so the faster you answer, the faster you swim. Race the computer or up to three friends online. Math, spelling, telling time, money, science and geography, at three levels.

release_games.name: All in Place
release_games.description: Slide, bump, and make room. Guide each block to its matching goal in a grid-based puzzle game about planning moves and helping each other along. Combine rebounds, magnets, and split blocks to untangle the board. Undo a move whenever you want to try something else.

release_games.name: Piratocon: Dig, Restore & Collect
release_games.description: A cozy first-person collecting game. Dig lost model ships out of a sunny beach dune, rebuild each one on the shelf of her kind aboard an old galleon and scrub her back to her true colours. No combat, no rush, just sand, sea and a collection that grows a little every day.

release_games.name: Fast Taxi Driver
release_games.description: Taxi simulation car game, where player drives taxi and mission is to take cyborg passengers to desired location and collect random items

release_games.name: KabochaNoTorowa
release_games.description: Take control of Torowa the pumpkin and challenge all 40 stages! Stomp on monsters to defeat them, collect candies, and aim for a high score by defeating monsters in the specified order during Night Mode!

release_games.name: The Angry Zoo: The Animals Hate You
release_games.description: A charming zoo. A disastrous day out. In this trap-filled 3D comedy adventure, the animals are out to get you. Dodge kicks, escape chases, solve puzzles and swim through underwater dangers. Every ridiculous death teaches you something. Can you make it out in one piece?

release_games.name: Blocade
release_games.description: Race your pawn across the board and drop walls to cut off your rival, but never seal them in. Blocade is a free two-player strategy board game: ranked matches against real people on PC and mobile, a daily 128-player tournament, puzzles and a ladder of bots.

release_games.name: 101 Cats: Copenhagen
release_games.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Copenhagen landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

release_games.name: Maze Runner
release_games.description: How to escape any maze? Use the two-footprint rule!

release_games.name: Along Came A Spider
release_games.description: In a world spun from moving silk, you must guide your resourceful spider back to their web, solving puzzles and catching flies along the way in this minimalist, stylized indie platformer.

release_games.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
release_games.description: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

release_games.name: The Skull of the Howard Knight
release_games.description: Today, you are a guest. So forget your troubles, take a sip of hot tea, and listen to a tale of an artifact that, according to legend, can manipulate time...

release_games.name: Blasting Blobs
release_games.description: Blasting Blobs is a retro-inspired arcade platformer with cute characters for one or two players. Trap enemies in bubbles, pop them and ride bubbles across 60 levels in four colourful worlds. Defeat four bosses and help a lost star get home.

release_games.name: Retro Coder 2000
release_games.description: March 1991. Your brother Levan is gone, but his PC still boots and his mailbox still gets work. Fix code for clients, break into servers on a hidden network, write and share your own games on a programmable 90s PC, and follow what he left behind. Desktop or VR.

release_games.name: The Last Debugger
release_games.description: The Last Debugger is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where you collect equipment cards, combine powerful set effects, and plan around card speed and enemy intentions as four distinct characters fight through a broken game world.

release_games.name: Survivecraft
release_games.description: Survive ten minutes of pure horde in the dark fantasy world of Valdrath! 13 heroes, evolving spells, boss fights in blazing arenas and epic loot. Rebuild your ruined Sanctuary between runs – solo or in local co-op.

release_games.name: Have you seen my knife?
release_games.description: More than 1,800 parts from 216 unique guns and 17 ammo boxes rain down on your workshop. Assemble each gun part by part, test-fire it and rack it in its case on the wall. Tidying up has never been this loud.

release_games.name: Codeguess
release_games.description: Two teams, two spymasters, 25 secret files. One word and a number lead to the right files, the bomb ends it all. With gadget cards to help and sabotage, an AI spymaster from two players up, built-in voice chat and Twitch chat help.

release_games.name: Pentatile
release_games.description: Start with a star. Grow something unexpected. Pentatile is a geometric sandbox where you build a colorful mosaic, discover new shapes in the spaces between, and share your creations with other explorers.

release_games.name: Train Survivor
release_games.description: A survivors-like where you drive the train. Drive an armoured train through a valley overrun by the undead. Couple weapon wagons, pick upgrades and steer through switches while a horde of up to 1,500 skeletons closes in. Survive 15 minutes and face the Demon Lord.

release_games.name: Little Angler
release_games.description: Little Angler is a cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop. Catch dozens of creatures, complete your album, explore new regions, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and customize your angler with characters, islands, bobbers, rods, vests, and more.

release_games.name: HENTAI CONCENTRATION
release_games.description: Test your memory in a classic Concentration card game with 100 challenging levels! Match cards as the board grows larger with each level. Unlock a new CG after every level, including special video rewards every 5 levels. Collect all 80 images and 20 videos in the CG Gallery!

release_games.name: In Triplicate
release_games.description: An idle game written in immaculate bureaucratic prose. Stamp matters, staff the counters, file for Reorganization and feed the office horse per Form OH-1. Processing continues in your absence, as required by policy. Inquiries will not be accepted.

release_games.name: Tessera
release_games.description: A calm, craft-first jigsaw game. Feel every piece: seven interlocking cut styles across four board shapes, including grid, hexagonal, triangular, and organic Voronoi, from a few dozen pieces to 1,000+. Daily puzzles, shareable codes, and curated museum masterworks.

release_games.name: 我姓夏
release_games.description: Wo Xing Xia (I Am Xia) is a historical interactive fiction spanning 2,300 years. From the late Warring States period to 1949, sixteen generations of one ordinary family write, marry, fight and survive through every dynasty — in hand-drawn ink-line art, with no heroes and no shortcuts.

release_games.name: Arauto
release_games.description: Arauto is a turn-based board game of territorial conquest for 3 to 6 players, online against friends or bots. Roll the dice, hold continents, trade cards and chase a secret objective on the real world map or in the mythic realms of Ancalora and Asterra.

release_games.name: Gravity Miner
release_games.description: A PS1-style first-person mining roguelite inside a floating cube of a million blocks. Shift gravity to walk on any wall, dig for ore before your oxygen runs out, dodge buried bombs and hatching monsters, and haul 100 diamonds back to base.

release_games.name: Darts With Mates
release_games.description: Darts With Mates is a darts party game for 1–4 players. Host a pub night with Steam friends, play 501, Killer, High Score or Pub Bingo, team up in 2v2, and grab a pint or stay sober between throws.

release_games.name: Kamikaze Aliens
release_games.description: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

release_games.name: I Hate Scalpers
release_games.description: I just hate scalpers. So I made a game about bonking them so they don't come back! Figure out who the scalpers and sitters are and BONK THEM! Duel people in Cut The Line and be the hero the city.

release_games.name: Magic Clicker
release_games.description: Blast through hordes with magic and grow wildly powerful! Play as Shiina in a mix of 3D action and clicker progression. Defeat enemies to upgrade and awaken spells, from Magic Ball to Laser Beam. Use Rebirth to grow stronger, and reach new heights of power with your little dragon companion!

release_games.name: NIGHTWARD
release_games.description: Your mother was a night nurse. A month after her funeral, a hospital closed for twelve years calls your phone. Follow her route through Sislidere, one sealed building at a time, and learn who was kept awake there - and why. Some of them only move when you look away.

release_games.name: Pattern Rabbit
release_games.description: Prepare to die repeatedly in Pattern Rabbit! Master a unique physics system, dodge deadly traps, and face tricky enemies. Taking just ten steps won't be easy at all.

release_games.name: Memórias de Arassay
release_games.description: Memórias de Arassay is a pixel art game based on legends from Guarapuava, Brazil. Journey through 2D platforming stages inspired by the Lagoa das Lágrimas, the Capela do Degolado and the serpent beneath the Cathedral, in a retro style that brings players closer to local memory.

release_games.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
release_games.description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

release_games.name: The Crane Files: A Detective Mystery
release_games.description: A murder mystery deduction game. Investigate ten 3D crime scenes, question the suspects, collect clues as words, then fill in exactly what happened. Every answer needs evidence. And someone leaves a paper crane at every scene.

release_games.name: Liani
release_games.description: A tough parkour platformer set on an unknown planet. Climb upward with precise jumps, try again after every fall, and endure the rising difficulty of each stage. A mysterious maze awaits you at the end of the course. You must find Liani.

release_games.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
release_games.description: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

release_games.name: Sex Cultivation: Shatter Every Law
release_games.description: An adults-only visual novel rooted in authentic Chinese xianxia. Sects, karma, desire and ritual shape a living cultivation world, while dual cultivation drives its relationships, progression and long-form story.

release_games.name: Saucer Slam
release_games.description: Local multiplayer sumo mayhem for 1-4 players, with as many bots as you like. Knock, boost, and blast rival saucers off the arena across 39 maps and 9 modes: Free-For-All, Team Battle, Football, King of the Hill, co-op Gauntlet, and more. Grab some controllers and go.

release_games.name: Good Girls Get Treats
release_games.description: Adult-Only Visual Novel filled with wagging tails and heartwarming charm! Enter lighthearted world of adorable dog-girls where playful antics meet unexpected heat. It’s the ultimate cozy escape for anyone looking to unwind with sweet characters and high-energy fun.

release_games.name: Witnesses
release_games.description: Witnesses is a detective visual novel in a grim noir style. You are a private detective assigned two strange cases.

release_games.name: Solo Cards
release_games.description: Nine independent solo card games, all played with a single classic 54-card deck. Survive a frozen wreck, build a skyline, infiltrate a spy network, step into an underground ring or run a chic pastry salon: each game brings its own rules and tactical tension.

release_games.name: Hearsay
release_games.description: An archive of 164 recordings, from hundred-year-old records to country, funk, jazz, horror and video game music, cut into 724 unlabeled tapes. No titles, no search. Ten cabinets, a tape deck and your ears. Fill each set in order and find out if you heard it right. Free demo available now!

release_games.name: Fancy's Monster Girl Forest Jigsaw Puzzle
release_games.description: A relaxing 18+ jigsaw puzzle game with beautiful art and music where you assemble images of sexy monster girls. Complete 60 puzzles to unlock all the images in the gallery.

release_games.name: Grandma Left Me A Building - Prologue
release_games.description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

release_games.name: BugPot
release_games.description: BugPot is a casual roguelike where every spin shapes the fight. Match weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, build powerful combinations and adapt your strategy as you face a bizarre variety of bugs.

release_games.name: Lucky Shot VR
release_games.description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

release_games.name: INTERSECTION I
release_games.description: INTERSECTION I is an interactive audiovisual work shaped by music, image, and space. Walk, listen, and remain within an ambient, cinematic landscape where Human, Machine, Memory, and Nature quietly meet and dissolve.

release_games.name: Wildixir
release_games.description: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

release_games.name: APEX Trading Life
release_games.description: An endless multi-asset trading simulator. Start with $500 and a job you hate. Trade crypto, stocks, leveraged forex and property, cover the rent every week, climb five broker tiers to earn shorting and margin, and decide when you can afford to walk out of the day job for good.

release_games.name: Heroes & Co.
release_games.description: Hire the worst misfits in town and form the perfect team to face every disaster. Your mission? Survive one full week. Get ready for seven days of cascading emergencies, exhausted heroes and impossible choices to save the day.

release_games.name: ‌Tidy Up the Bookstore
release_games.description: Tidy Up the Bookstore is a relaxing organization sim. Return 4,018 unique books from 410 series to 82 shelves. Learn abilities and use strategy to tidy faster while enjoying calm, satisfying order.

release_games.name: Atom By Atom
release_games.description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

release_games.name: One More Floor
release_games.description: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

release_games.name: Flurst
release_games.description: Flurst is a fast, strategic card game for solo play against up to five bots or to battle it out with friends. Play matching cards, reset or burn the pile, tune the house rules, and survive your face-up and face-down table cards to empty everything first and get Flurst!

release_games.name: Dialshift
release_games.description: Dialshift is a fast score-chasing arcade game played on one relentless ring. Every turn is also a hit. Read the targets, choose your route, and hold your nerve as seven modes twist the rules.

release_games.name: Tumble Tavern
release_games.description: Farkle with enchanted runes. Throw six dice, bank your points or push your luck, and cast the runestone that turns a losing throw around. Take on 12 tavern regulars, run the roguelite gauntlet, or pass the dice to a friend on the same screen.

release_games.name: Flippy the Spider
release_games.description: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

release_games.name: RogueSlot
release_games.description: A dark fantasy roguelite where every battle begins with a spin. Build your hero, bend the odds, and turn a 5×5 slot grid into devastating combos as you fight through a cursed dungeon. Choose your upgrades carefully—every symbol, relic, and risky reroll can turn a losing run into a jackpot.

release_games.name: Neko Room Days
release_games.description: Care for cats, collect furniture, and create a room of your own in this cozy 2D pixel-art simulation. Enjoy 60+ lo-fi tracks, a Pomodoro timer, and a stopwatch while you work, study, or unwind. You can also switch to Mini Mode and enjoy your cats’ company as they stroll along your Windows taskbar.

release_games.name: Zero Castle
release_games.description: Take control of a unique flying castle, destroy enemy forces, build your playstyle with powerful upgrades, and survive every cycle.

release_games.name: Nozile
release_games.description: Nozile is a fast-paced hack-and-slash roguelike where you start with a fully realized build. Pick 2 styles, swap in real-time, absorb Stat Orbs directly from fallen enemies, and break the game in intense 5-minute runs.

release_games.name: Midnight Rogues
release_games.description: Build the sequence that fights for you in this roguelike auto-battler. Buy cards and arrange them across your board, then watch a timer activate them in order. Change their placement to create powerful combinations and take down The City’s corrupted superheroes.

release_games.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
release_games.description: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

release_games.name: Weeping Souls
release_games.description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

release_games.name: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
release_games.description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

release_games.name: Colorizing: Sunrise
release_games.description: A relaxing color-by-numbers game with a wide variety of pictures for every taste. Enjoy the simple pleasure of coloring pixels and watching each picture come to life.

release_games.name: ONE LAST BEAM
release_games.description: Aim your flashlight. Let your weapons fire. Survive escalating zombie hordes in this objective-driven survivor roguelite. Restore the power grid, evolve your arsenal, and reach dawn—but brighter light attracts more danger.

release_games.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
release_games.description: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

release_games.name: Sunday Fighter Pilot
release_games.description: Take the scenic route or blow stuff up. Fly warbirds and jets across a colorful open world, discover airfields and unlock new aircraft. Enjoy relaxed exploration in Casual flying, or unleash guns and rockets to destroy ground targets and capture territory.

release_games.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
release_games.description: The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience. You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

release_games.name: The Pass
release_games.description: A clicker "game" that is also a meta commentary and parody about you purchasing it for yourself or your friends. Get Achievements, show them on your user profile. Laugh and see just how regarded you and your friends are.

release_games.name: Traffic Architect
release_games.description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

release_games.name: 1.44MB RESCUE
release_games.description: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

release_games.name: Hearts Extreme
release_games.description: The classic card game Hearts, rebuilt as a solo puzzle. Every level sets a different goal for you to hit. Ten decks, each built from a different set of cards, played at 4, 5 or 6 player tables. And a ranked game where you compete with players around the world.

release_games.name: Gunship Incremental
release_games.description: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

release_games.name: Beatlash: Survival
release_games.description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

release_games.name: Dunjin
release_games.description: Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

release_games.name: SUPER GAHAKU
release_games.description: Draw directly in 3D space! Bring topics to life with your own 3D creations. Laugh at the hilarious results and guess what everyone was trying to draw! Imagination matters more than drawing skills. A party game where everyone can shine!

release_games.name: RIFTFALL
release_games.description: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 6 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.

release_games.name: Infi-Knight
release_games.description: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.

release_games.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
release_games.description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

release_games.name: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
release_games.description: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

release_games.name: Hush
release_games.description: Be quiet. Stay calm. Don't look at it. A 1–8 player co-op horror descent: search dark procedural levels, contain what you find, and extract — while a creature hunts whoever panics most. One shared panic meter, live proximity voice, and an infinite descent scored by how deep you get.

release_games.name: ERLIK
release_games.description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

release_games.name: Market Panic
release_games.description: Market Panic is a turn-based portfolio roguelite about surviving economic chaos. Build a fund across public markets, private equity and crypto, and read the companies inside it. Answer to clients who can leave, rivals who want them, and a committee that comes looking for you.

release_games.name: Sanslo:Spin of the Three Kingdoms
release_games.description: A unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary generals, build your army, unleash outrageous fantasy skills, and conquer the battlefield with strategy and luck in every spin.

release_games.name: FAIL GAMES
release_games.description: FAIL GAMES is a collection of brutally hard but simple minigames. Beat each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail and spend them on outfits and effects. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

release_games.name: Hexzen
release_games.description: A hexagonal logic puzzle game set against shifting skies. Use logic alone to read the clues and clear each board. Master a handcrafted campaign, enjoy infinite custom puzzles, and shape your own challenges with the built-in level editor.

release_games.name: HueTrix
release_games.description: HueTrix is a colorful block-stacking puzzle with a roguelike twist: clear lines to earn cash, then spend it in the shop on powerful mythic relics. Chain combos across seven colors, stack permanent upgrades, and build a game-breaking run. Easy to learn, endlessly deep, full controller support.ㄴ

release_games.name: Mancalero
release_games.description: Plan one perfect move and watch it chain into millions of points. Mancalero is a roguelike built on Mancala, the board game of moving stones from pit to pit. Collect marbles that burn, multiply and swallow whole pits, build a combo engine and climb 8 tables, each with a boss that changes the rules.

release_games.name: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse
release_games.description: A short, singleplayer time-loop puzzle game in which you restore a lighthouse to prevent a shipwreck that has already happened. Hunted by shadows across an island, you unfold the lighthouse keeper’s tragic story and piece together a way to end the nightmare.

release_games.name: The Wake Event
release_games.description: Awaken aboard an abandoned orbital research station. Explore its silent corridors, solve environmental and terminal-based puzzles, and uncover the fate of its missing crew. As the mystery unfolds, discover the truth behind ARGUS, the station's enigmatic AI.

release_games.name: Lagrange Front Idle
release_games.description: Grow from a mere few ships to thousands of ships fighting in realtime and while Idle. Call down orbital strikes, rip through fleets with chained lightning, or watch from the comfort of your seat as your fleet expands and takes over the universe.

release_games.name: Under the Elm
release_games.description: Inherit your grandmother's cabin and the woods she quietly guarded. Forage real mushrooms, brew the remedies she perfected, and tend a village that is slowly forgetting her. Something in the woods is taking what they remember, and only the oldest trees - and her cat - can help you bring it back.

release_games.name: Fate & Felt
release_games.description: Fate & Felt is a single-player poker roguelite built on Texas Hold’em. Read opponents, manage chips, and choose when to check, call, raise, fold, or go all-in. Roll skill dice and combine character abilities, Magic cards, Jokers, and shifting rules through three chapters and four modes.

release_games.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
release_games.description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

release_games.name: Guardian of Boss Neko
release_games.description: Guardian of Boss Neko is a 2D anime-style top-down survivor-like game that incorporates a gathering mechanic. You play as a maiden Guardian, guiding Boss Neko to gather Magic Crystals while beating up monsters (or getting beaten up by them).

release_games.name: Soul Strip: Waifu Card Battler
release_games.description: A deck-building roguelike where every card is a girl. Build your deck, fight through three acts and grow closer to the heroines. Everything unlocks through play, with no microtransactions.

release_games.name: Ape-tite
release_games.description: Cook through the chaos in an ape‑paced, local co‑op kitchen where everything almost falls apart.

release_games.name: SCRAPBOX
release_games.description: SCRAPBOX is a physics-based sandbox where you build vehicles from scrap, weld them together, and take on challenging tracks. Play solo, team up with friends in co-op, or compete online against other players and teams.

release_games.name: Lucky Punk: a push your luck Deckbuilder
release_games.description: Push your luck and beat the odds in this roguelike deckbuilder that always shows your chances of failing. How much are you willing to risk? Survive and thrive in a vibrant eco-dystopia … or don’t. ¯_(ツ)_/¯ Gather supplies and grow your community in the post-apocalypse. Do you feel lucky, Punk? 💀

release_games.name: Circuit Pulse
release_games.description: Circuit Pulse is a circuit puzzle game. Route glowing energy through cables and components on a board. Split, merge, and time pulses to power targets and trigger chain reactions across a board of escalating challenges.

release_games.name: The Things Left Behind
release_games.description: Soft, narrative-driven 2D indie-queer game that explores the little moments of Disabled and Queer experiences and the intersections between. Our team has woven these stories together, drawing from our lived experiences.

release_games.name: Monked
release_games.description: Monked is a third-person roguelike castle defense where you play a holy monk of the Castle of Bellwick. Battle through 16 waves of unique enemies and bosses, collect blessings between waves and fortify your city with barricades and allies. Unlock and collect over 100 blessings, items, and more.

release_games.name: HELLO HACKER - Project Daybreak
release_games.description: A story-rich hacking sim played inside a real Linux desktop. Recon networks, break web apps, crack crypto, and extract hidden data with tools that behave like the real thing, while an autonomous AI watches the network, learns, and hacks back. The commands are real. So are the consequences.

release_games.name: Hull Rupture
release_games.description: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

release_games.name: Cold Rails
release_games.description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

release_games.name: Drilling
release_games.description: "DRILLING" is a relaxing game focusing on the pure joy of digging and moving forward. You play as "Mr. Drill," who has awakened deep underground, and begin an expedition toward the surface. Mine 9 kind of ores found across various layers, and use the resources you gather to upgrade your modules.

release_games.name: Mandala: Type To Defend
release_games.description: Type to survive. Defend a glowing mandala against swarms, shooters, and incoming projectiles in a fast-paced typing arcade game. Choose from four attack forms, combine upgrades, unleash devastating chains, and fight through escalating waves.

release_games.name: Keystroke Pursuit
release_games.description: Type to escape! You're a raccoon thief racing through a toy-like 3D city with Sgt. Shiba on your tail. Clean, fast words speed up your getaway car; every typo lets the sirens close in. Grab loot, freeze in the searchlight, sneak past the lasers and chase three stars on every case.

release_games.name: DoDoon
release_games.description: Master a unique cannon trajectory and blast away incoming enemies! Defeat enemies, upgrade your castle, and create your own build as you fight through all 30 Waves.

release_games.name: Chinese Childhood
release_games.description: School’s out. Play a round of marbles, stop for snacks, and head home when Mum calls. Be a boy or girl in a small Chinese town around 1998, with friends to meet, holidays to spend with family, and trips beyond the neighborhood.

release_games.name: Veil of Remorse
release_games.description: Veil of Remorse is a retro-inspired arcade bullethell where you steer a ship through a corrupted solar system, build synergies through the roguelike-structure of upgrades, and appease to the hunger of the void. Will you break through the mist and leave?

release_games.name: Pulse Drive
release_games.description: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with a rhythm element. Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

release_games.name: Kick
release_games.description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

release_games.name: Stick N' Sheep
release_games.description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

release_games.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
release_games.description: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

release_games.name: Lost Host
release_games.description: Can a toy car become the hero of a video game? One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace. Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

release_games.name: Gloom Break
release_games.description: A relentless action-puzzle game about escaping a strange pit.

release_games.name: Tirade
release_games.description: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

release_games.name: Demon Source
release_games.description: Demon Source is a soulslike roguelike game with procedural generated dungeons. Try new builds each run. Gather the Source to unlock new items and abilities. Solve the mystery of seven inhabitants of the Church. Try the Ultimate Challenge with great classical music. It is made by one person!

release_games.name: Cave In: Miner Rescue Team
release_games.description: Cave In: Miner Rescue is a 3D match-3 puzzler. Rescue the miners trapped in a collapsing mine before it caves in. Push, kick or shoot rocks to solve puzzles and escape. 80 hand-built levels, Survival, Multiplayer, Daily and Weekly Challenges, Tournaments and Workshop maps!

release_games.name: Knight Survivor
release_games.description: This is a survival game inspired by Vampire Survivors. This is a very simplified version.

release_games.name: THE LAST STONE
release_games.description: Up to 100 million stones, one tiny toy shovel and one hidden diamond. Dig, haul and sell stones to afford better gear in this absurd first-person incremental game. Start with a yellow plastic shovel. The diamond could be in your very first successful scoop.

release_games.name: N in One Logic Puzzle Collection — Sudoku, Nonograms, Hashi & Slitherlink
release_games.description: Settle into a cozy collection of 20 logic puzzle types, from Sudoku and Nonograms to bridges, islands and hidden fleets. Explore 800 fixed puzzles across 10 levels per type, with offline play, separate progress, undo and redo, and illustrated guides to help you find your rhythm.

release_games.name: WARPROOF
release_games.description: This is an empire simulator wich the decisions you take will impact on gameplay.

release_games.name: The Alley Workshop
release_games.description: A cozy crafting puzzle game set in a quiet alley workshop. Fit parts, cut new materials, and piece together fragmented blueprints. Complete everyday objects for your neighbors and discover their stories through handwritten letters.

release_games.name: mirror
release_games.description: One sleepless night, you look into a mirror and fall into Kyoukai, the world behind the glass. A girl named Lumière asks you to help take back her stolen kingdom, and in the mirror world the road leads left. Parry, swap sword skills and six elements of magic, this action RPG.

release_games.name: BELL SHOOTER
release_games.description: No guns. Just bells! Bounce 4 types of bells into enemies, strike weak spots for CRITICAL hits, and build massive combos! Defeat 6 unique bosses, upgrade your ship, and conquer 30 stages. Keep the bells flying and climb the global leaderboard!

release_games.name: King of Billiards
release_games.description: Take your place at the table. Aim with the mouse, feel every stroke, and play Chinese 8-ball, 9-ball, Snooker or Skill Duel. Jump over obstacles, change the table with skill cards, practise alone, or challenge AI and friends.

release_games.name: Desktop Bonsai Towns
release_games.description: First world: Cyberpunk Town. A tiny voxel bonsai grows on your desktop for hours while a cyberpunk city builds itself along its trunk and branches. Watch residents live their lives as storms, meteors and giant invaders strike. Unlock pruning shears and collect a variety of bonsai styles.

release_games.name: Killing Maze
release_games.description: Top-down horde-survival roguelite in a tower. Fight down 80 floors through 4 monster themes, one timed battle each.8weapons auto-fire at the nearest target, so you only move. Loot gear, stack 130+ relics and 30 talents, beat a boss per theme. Controller support. Chinese and English.

release_games.name: Order, My Lord! Tidy Up the Dungeon
release_games.description: You're the Dark Lord. Heroes have turned your dungeon upside down, and now it won't let you reach your throne until you tidy up! Sort 4,500 objects across 10 rooms, unlock magical abilities, and put goblins and skeletons to work in this first-person organizing simulator.

release_games.name: High T
release_games.description: Own the streets. Survive the climb. High T is a top-down action sandbox with a 100-floor combat tower, escalating weapons, dangerous hazards and ten bosses. Build your action hero, take the wheel and fight through a city wrapped in a heavy 90s CRT glow.

release_games.name: We Have a Gnome Problem
release_games.description: Your toy shop has a gnome problem. In this cozy first-person tidying game, catch a whole shopful of runaway gnomes, toss the troublemakers and put every single one back on its proper shelf.

release_games.name: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border
release_games.description: Stop to shoot. Draw to cast! Restore an overlapping Gensokyo in this Touhou action roguelite. Choose from six heroines, draw Spell Cards with your mouse, and face bosses from other timelines.

release_games.name: I Swear I Parked Here
release_games.description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

release_games.name: Domain Expansion
release_games.description: Draw lines and claim territory in a 3D arcade action game. Read enemy movements, choose between safer captures and bold DEEP cuts, and take on 24 stages followed by a tougher second loop.

release_games.name: EscapeFromSeoul
release_games.description: Explore, fight, and extract from a Seoul built from text and symbols. A real-time, top-down PvE extraction shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to 3 players. Scavenge gear, customize weapons, complete contracts, and upgrade your hideout.

release_games.name: Plunder & Booty
release_games.description: Sixteen pirate queens, sirens, ghost captains and navy officers, and every one of them wants to bet against you. Beat them at cards on the high seas, sign them to your crew, then pour the rum in your cabin to unlock 96 animated scenes. One purchase. No microtransactions.

release_games.name: 破壊伝説 瓦井
release_games.description: A single-player action game combining manga-style storytelling and top-down combat. Follow construction worker Kawarai as he reaches his breaking point, and use attacks and dashes to face the crowd. In-game text is Japanese.

release_games.name: Moonlit Cat Diner
release_games.description: A rainy night, a little diner at the end of the alley. Cat customers take a seat, place an order, and open up as you play — six solitaire games, Shisen-Sho, and six puzzle rules. Every story you hear fills your cat codex, and every coin you earn goes into your own diner.

release_games.name: Kill The Boss
release_games.description: Commander. Kill what steps into the arena. When it drops, something worse takes its place. You land the first blow. Your ninjas do not wait for a second order. The fire stays lit. The stone keeps falling. Leave the yard empty.

release_games.name: Tinker to the Moon
release_games.description: Launch a chair on springs. Earn money, bolt on better parts, and fly higher. Turn your unlikely invention into a balloon, a propeller plane, then a rocket in this physics-based upgrade game. The goal? The Moon.

release_games.name: One More Brick
release_games.description: A cozy incremental brick breaker on a scribbled sketchbook page. Smash bricks, collect the rewards, and buy upgrades until balls split, lasers fly, and the page gets wonderfully messy. Grow your skill tree, put the Infinite Breaker to work, and turn over a new page.

release_games.name: Deskrot
release_games.description: Deskrot turns your desktop into a playground. Launch pinball balls or control a parkour character: run across text, jump between windows and swing on a rope. Your screen becomes a live level that changes in real time as you work.

release_games.name: Stillwater: Coastal Maine
release_games.description: Make yourself at home on the Maine coast. Explore an old captain's house, read by the window, fish from the dock, and look for sea glass along the tide line. Choose the season, weather, and time of day, or watch a storm come in off the Atlantic. A quiet place to return to at your own pace.

release_games.name: Tank Dungeon
release_games.description: Paint the arena and build your arsenal in a top-down action roguelite. Unlock vehicles, combine rockets, lasers and helper bots, and collect powerful equipment sets. Fight solo or in local co-op, then challenge friends in local or online territory-control skirmishes.

release_games.name: Horde Lab
