release_games.description: A maze-building tower defense against hordes of thousands. Raise walls, build 15 kinds of defenses, pick a card every wave and unlock a 562-upgrade skill tree. Slow-motion missiles, a boss every wave and endless waves: how far can you go?

release_games.name: Make Me Whole
release_games.description: A letter with no sender, a photo of the doll you lost as a child, and an address: a shuttered doll workshop where the same room keeps repeating. Something off? Sewing machine. Nothing? Take the exit. First-person anomaly-spotting horror about finishing a doll, and what moves when you look away.

release_games.name: Dreadmarch TD
release_games.description: Hold the road through ten cursed lands. Dreadmarch TD is a dark fantasy tower defense game with 50 campaign stages, branching tower talents, and an endless Maelstrom. Build your defenses, break the next wave, and return to the campfire with another story to tell.

release_games.name: Universal Chess
release_games.description: Universal Chess is a chess variant on an 8×8 board. King and Queen are both Sovereigns. Play alone against the computer, with two people at one computer, or with two computers. Choose from 192 setups, the regime, and standard or enhanced movement.

release_games.name: Oddlay
release_games.description: Flip the grid with overlapping pieces where placement matters. Take your time with this relaxing puzzle game as the challenge grows. Can you beat the Oddlay?

release_games.name: Woolwater
release_games.description: Woolwater is a puzzle game about sheep, fences and water. Give your sheep room to roam with only a few fences to keep them in. Blocking a stream can free up more land for your pasture — and open an escape route.

release_games.name: MiningPassion 挖矿狂潮
release_games.description: Mining Passion is a 2D mining and resource-management simulation. Pilot a mech through procedurally generated underground sites, hunt for valuable ore, manage equipment and debt, and profit from a dynamic market of trading, auctions, black-market deals, and hard-earned information.

release_games.name: Frogs Jump Together
release_games.description: Leap to new heights in Frogs Jump Together! Play solo or team up in online co-op where you control agile frogs navigating tricky obstacles. Jump on your friends' backs to reach secret shortcuts, master your leaps, and climb your way to the very top!

release_games.name: Hivetide
release_games.description: Hold a mining outpost on an alien world while thousands of insects pour through the rock tunnels like a flood. Place towers on the high ground, aim their firing arcs, and spend the biomass from every run, won or lost, on upgrades that let you hold a little longer next time.

release_games.name: Crown to Callus
release_games.description: A story-driven incremental clicker about a proud king learning the value of hard work. Shoot arrows, mine ore, smelt alloys, and build a production chain. Recruit helpers, upgrade your tools, and work your way home, one click at a time.

release_games.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
release_games.description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

release_games.name: Chopsticks
release_games.description: Move rice from one bowl to another, one grain at a time, with a pair of physics-driven chopsticks. Pinch, lift, carry, and try not to knock anything over. Every run is timed and ranked, twenty challenges wait on the same counter, and there are ten thousand grains.

release_games.name: LILY'S TASKBAR HUSTLE
release_games.description: Start from nothing and become a millionaire in GRIT City! Join Lily in this chaotic desktop idle game as she earns coins through construction, deliveries, cleaning, and more. Encounter random events, take breaks, and work your way toward 1,000,000 Coins—all while you work, study, or relax!

release_games.name: Hentai Clicker: Zafira is streaming
release_games.description: Hentai clicker: Zafira is streaming — Click, collect hearts, buy upgrades, and unlock scenes and outfits with Zafira, a very naughty fortune-teller streaming playful adult anime reactions.

release_games.name: Figure Me Out
release_games.description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

release_games.name: Devotheon
release_games.description: Build absurdly powerful combos in this strategy roguelite inspired by Greek mythology. Combine spells, blessings, and relics, reshape the board to your advantage, and break the rules to turn every Odyssey into a devastating chain of synergies.

release_games.name: CookingBaby
release_games.description: An adult story and minigame collection featuring Minori. Play eight challenges with clicking, sliding, rhythm, and timing controls. Build your stats, unlock new stages and scenes, and revisit the gallery. Includes difficulty options and repeat modes in supported games.

release_games.name: deep rabbit hole
release_games.description: Face the gruesome reality hidden behind hallucinations in this short 2D pixel psychological horror game. Fight and flee from rabbit-masked entities in the woods as a protagonist struggling with their mental state. When the delusions break, what reality will be left at the end of your blade?

release_games.name: console.log
release_games.description: A terminal-style text adventure. Mix classic commands like look and take with real Unix commands (ls, cd, cat) and uncover, across 8 chapters and 4 endings, whether you are real or just code that believes it is.

release_games.name: Mafia Solitaire
release_games.description: Defeat the mafia and restore justice! Solitaire with a mafia twist! Dive deep into 1920s Americana!

release_games.name: IRON SOL
release_games.description: You do not unlock any abilities - you only learn the truth about what you have always been able to do. Explore a ruined world, overcome unique platforming challenges, collect remnants of your kin, and discover what you are.

release_games.name: Potato Please
release_games.description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

release_games.name: EternalCircuitBoard
release_games.description: Place chips on a 6×6 board and build circuits that generate energy. Completed circuits stay on the board, generate energy every turn, and can be reused in the next circuit. Connect circuits within a limited number of turns and reach the target score.

release_games.name: The Returns Desk: A Cozy Library
release_games.description: A cozy tidy-up game for VR. Put 864 books back where they belong in a Victorian rotunda library, by hand. Every cover tells you its wing, its row and its slot, and nothing sorts itself. Finished rows open new wings and bring back the weather and the hours of the day. No timers, no fail state.

release_games.name: Panorama of All Beings
release_games.description: An online multiplayer pixel-art game on one shared 1920 x 1080 canvas. Place a pixel, wait for the cooldown, then contribute again. Build on others' designs or overwrite them—and expect yours to change too. Discuss the canvas through comments and replay its history. Internet required.

release_games.name: Horiforge
release_games.description: A game about exploration, where you travel across infinite worlds, where all the content is procedurally generated.

release_games.name: Harvest Hook
release_games.description: Harvest Hook is a short incremental fishing game. Control Fururu as you fish on coastal islands. Fill your backpack with catches, return to the shore to sell fish for coins, keep buying upgrades, and discover more rare fish species.

release_games.name: KanaCross Together
release_games.description: A cozy word game played in Japanese hiragana and katagana. Build real words on a Crossword board, outscore a clever bot across Classic, Card, and Special Crossword tile board and Relax, Time-Limit, and Versus Crossword puzzle, and learn JLPT vocabulary as you play.

release_games.name: Potrero - Football life sim
release_games.description: You are a footballer, straight from the youth ranks until your last season. One decision at a time: when to shoot, when to pass, what to say to the press. A whole career decided by what you choose, and a little by your luck.

release_games.name: Keepers of the Farkle
release_games.description: Roll the dice, and challenge the CPU or Freinds in a fast-paced game of risk and strategy. Unlock colorful characters and custom dice, conquer tournaments, and compete with friends in local multiplayer without an internet connection! Will you bank your points? Or risk everything on one more roll?

release_games.name: Echo Harvest
release_games.description: Live, die, and leave an Echo behind. Gather resources, nurture autonomous settlements and shape a growing colony through the lives you've lived. In this fantasy colony roguelite, your past selves become your workforce, and every fallen timeline leaves behind a Chronicle of its history.

release_games.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
release_games.description: An active incremental about running an AI data center. Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs, drones and more. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI.

release_games.name: Hunt The Ducks
release_games.description: Shoot ducks, grab the cash, upgrade, repeat. Hunt The Ducks is a fast, addictive incremental shooter where you grow stronger every round: turn a calm sky into a storm of feathers and cash with crits, exploding ducks and chain reactions. Grow your hunting map step by step.

release_games.name: Windowsill Isle
release_games.description: A tiny voxel island lives quietly in the corner of your desktop. Its residents go about their days on their own; tides roll in, the lighthouse comes on at dusk, letters wash ashore. While you're at your computer it stays awake; step away and it slowly drifts off. Nothing to manage, nothing to lose.

release_games.name: Heirs of the Fountains
release_games.description: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

release_games.name: TRACE//5
release_games.description: Explore an office swallowed by darkness with only a camera to guide you, photographing and reporting traces of spirits in this short psychological horror game. Use flash and night vision to uncover anomalies. But not every anomaly is something you should photograph.

release_games.name: Decadrive
release_games.description: Outrun a road that never ends. Decadrive is a top-down arcade racer about endless traffic, a fuel gauge that is always dying, and ten phases that come back harder every cycle. Dodge, boost and chain overtakes into combos, then spend what you earn on faster cars and a deadlier skill tree.

release_games.name: Merge Command
release_games.description: Merge and launch rockets in 1v1 battles, earn resources, fund research, upgrade silos, program attacks, rank up!

release_games.name: Traceroute
release_games.description: A network-building simulation across the cities of a nation. Lay routers and cables to design your network, balancing bandwidth and latency on a limited budget. Survive sudden traffic surges and DDoS attacks as you connect city after city, learning real networking concepts as you play.

release_games.name: Wanxiang Corridor: Elements
release_games.description: Wanxiang Corridor: Elements is a 2D roguelike action shooter. Wield a bow through procedurally generated corridors, switching between Water and Ice to trigger Freeze and stun your foes. Clear rooms, pick randomized buffs, forge your build across five stages. Pixel art, a fresh run every time.

release_games.name: VampOS: Red Ledger
release_games.description: Run a vampire corporation from within a blood-red operating system. Recruit thralls, harvest victims, design blood products, manage Suspicion, and sacrifice your company for permanent power in this dark management Incremental.

release_games.name: Minefield: Rupture
release_games.description: It's Minesweeper, but much more. Procedurally generated maps, unpredictable geometries, moving mines, and roguelike elements make each game unique. Think cool, adapt your strategy, and discover how far your logic can take you before the field surprises you.

release_games.name: Card Harts Reborn
release_games.description: A F2P 3D strategy card game. Invoke Combatants, cast Sorceries, and wager Hearts on an altar inside of an Ancient Egyptian tomb, in a game far older than this age.

release_games.name: House of the Lost: Revived
release_games.description: House of the Lost: Revived is a top-down action roguelike built for players who grew up clearing rooms, dodging traps, and learning from every death. Each run is a new house, a new build, and a new chance to craft absurd weapons and get a little further before the House gets you.

release_games.name: Hush Piñata
release_games.description: She got tired of being hit, blindfolded herself and came back thirsty for revenge. A horror-comedy party game for up to 9 players, the blind Piñata hunts by sound, and even your voice on the mic lights a silhouette in her darkness. Do the chores quietly and rip off her tail before she notices.

release_games.name: Sand Bingo
release_games.description: Five-in-a-row puzzle where the pieces pour

release_games.name: Colsword
release_games.description: COLSWORD is a logic puzzle game where you paint cubes in the right sequence using enchanted colored swords.

release_games.name: Collapse Vector
release_games.description: Pilot an experimental probe through collapsing celestial fields in a fast-paced rage arcade space game. Push deeper into the Transfer Gauntlet, build your probe, chase records, and see how far you can get before the Vector ends your run.

release_games.name: Seal & Sentence
release_games.description: Serve as a border officer in a medieval kingdom on the brink of war. Inspect documents, interrogate suspicious travelers, and decide who may enter. Will you obey the Crown or follow your conscience?

release_games.name: BrouHaHa
release_games.description: Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

release_games.name: PlayCard Football
release_games.description: A football strategy card game where you are the coach and the cards are your plays. Level up your coach with perks, use your team's roster to pick the best play possible against your opponent. You manage your team, the recruits, their development from high school to college and the pros.

release_games.name: Pop The Ghosts
release_games.description: The ghosts have taken over the building! Become a ghost hunter and face different spirits across 30 platforming levels. Run, jump, destroy crates, activate checkpoints, and defeat every ghost!

release_games.name: Domino Descent
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is a box of dominoes. Chain them, paint them, curse them, and build a multiplier that runs away with itself. Twelve floors down, something is waiting on every third one. The stairs keep going after that.

release_games.name: Velocity - Midnight Run
release_games.description: Hold speed through an endless night city. Climb a 100-car field in Midnight Run, slip past traffic, shake the cops, and cash every near miss into style. Then take it to Solo, private Crew rooms, or Online matchmaking. An arcade night-driving racer built for one more run.

release_games.name: Hollow Warden
release_games.description: Something is wrong in the ward. As a detective investigating a serious crime, navigate the ruins of an abandoned psychiatric hospital, gather evidence, and follow a trail that leads deeper into madness

release_games.name: RIA 26
release_games.description: Enter the storm-covered desert arena of RIA 26 and fight to be the last buggy standing. Battle rival drivers with cannons, rockets, mortars and mines, collect weapons, and master the terrain. Complete Wasteland Contracts, earn XP, level up your career, and Play solo or over LAN.

release_games.name: Perfect Route
release_games.description: Perfect Route is a billiards puzzle game centered on route planning. Plan the direction and path of each shot, make use of various special mechanisms, overcome carefully designed challenges, and find the Perfect Route through each level.

release_games.name: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
release_games.description: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing single-player simulation where you organize hundreds of bottles in a legendary cellar. Place bottles on shelves with realistic physics, upgrade skills, manage the power of drunkenness, and restore the cellar to its former glory.

release_games.name: Dynamic Breach
release_games.description: Top-down tactical shooter, military and gothic, necro-technological horror. Requiem: a solo campaign of 33 operations across 6 acts, on hand-made maps. An AI squad to command, 7 classes, 41 weapons. Onslaught: horde mode, a boss every 5 waves. All modes play against bots, offline.

release_games.name: Castellan
release_games.description: A real-time roguelite castle defense made by a solo developer. Shoot from your castle, drag soldier cards onto the field and cast spells to hold the line. Lose, upgrade, return: 13 chapters, 33 different soldiers, 85 different enemies.

release_games.name: Terminidle
release_games.description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal.

release_games.name: KIBAKI !
release_games.description: KIBAKI! is a strategic card game of prediction, collection, and evolution. Master 8 classic cards, outsmart rivals with Instant cards, build your deck, and expand your Virtuamon collection through packs, potions, and powerful evolutions.

release_games.name: Cabin in Time
release_games.description: Incremental game where you get to continually break an increasing speed of light across many universes in order to make the 100th gear of a googol machine spin

release_games.name: Old Money – Build Your Dynasty
release_games.description: You're 18 with €2,500. Work your way up, trade stocks and crypto, buy property, build companies, run for office. Then your life ends, and your heir gets what the taxman leaves. One life is short. How long can your dynasty last?

release_games.name: Elemental Bomb
release_games.description: Elemental Bomb‌ is a survivor-like game blended with Bomberman elements. You play as a mushroom in the forest, defeat slimes using bombs, collect drops and wave-clear rewards to grow stronger, and ultimately disrupt the slimes' ritual.

release_games.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE: A Roguelike on the Night Shift
release_games.description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Build outrageous combos in a solitaire roguelike, then open ZONE.EXE and destroy your friends in real-time card mayhem. Install plugins, beat the quota and survive the performance reviews. Your night shift starts here.

release_games.name: Sweeplings
release_games.description: A cute logic puzzle about scanning the board to find Starlings and avoid Boomlings. English UI · No spoken dialogue. If you love logic puzzles like Minesweeper but want something warmer and more visual — with clues on the board instead of numbers — Sweeplings is for you.

release_games.name: Path to Power
release_games.description: Path to Power is a political turn-based strategy game with visual novel elements. Choose your candidate, implement reforms, strike deals, manage resources, contain protests, and pave your way to the pinnacle of power in 1992 Kazakhstan.

release_games.name: Space Lot
release_games.description: Spin. Match. Expand the universe. Upgrade symbols, combine rules, and expand the board itself in this cosmic slot incremental game.

release_games.name: THW's Calcudoku
release_games.description: Fan of Sudoku, logic or puzzles? Try THW's Calcudoku, the most addictive logic game ever according to THW. Unlimited puzzles, no ads, one low price, can it really be true! Yes! Whether you've never heard of Calcudoku, Mathdoku, Kenken or you're an expert, THW's has unlimited puzzles for you.

release_games.name: Dead Market
release_games.description: A card game about debt. Win two of three rounds — but every advantage is bought on credit, and the Ledger beside the board is checked on every single turn. Five factions, 247 cards, and a market that will happily sell you something you cannot afford.

release_games.name: Crimson Spine
release_games.description: A Metroidvania set in a dark fantasy world where Raed, a knight resurrected under mysterious circumstances, uses her new heart as a weapon to recover her lost memories.

release_games.name: Immune Response
release_games.description: An exciting twin-stick shooter with a progressively increasing difficulty. Fight waves of pathogenic enemies, face difficult boss fights and survive for as long as you can!

release_games.name: Wend
release_games.description: A tower defense game with a heavy focus on mazing. Includes a campaign, ranked PVP, and an endless PVE mode you can play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. New maps are generated daily, weekly and monthly so you will never run out of content!

release_games.name: Nanoquarium
release_games.description: A whisper-quiet aquarium that lives in the corner of your screen. Collect 200+ real-world fish across tropical, coldwater and reef tanks, breed them for rare strains, run a whole fishroom, and let the tank tick over while you work. No pressure, no fail state — just your fish, drifting.

release_games.name: DashBreaker
release_games.description: From breaking asteroids to piercing massive warships, grow your small craft into a force to be reckoned with. DashBreaker is an active incremental game: dash through enemies, gather resources, and buy permanent upgrades. Unlock new abilities and wipe out more enemies with every dash.

release_games.name: Pluricubus
release_games.description: A puzzle game about using rotation to move. Pass through complex levels, making use of special tiles along the way. Teleport, change shape, move along walls and ceilings, and sometimes control multiple shapes at once to reach the end.

release_games.name: Stash Grabber
release_games.description: Start inside the vault with the cash, then get out of the building. Stash Grabber is a physics platformer about heists in reverse: 72 levels of lasers, cameras, bounce pads and pressure plates, with a safe route for getting out alive and a faster one for chasing times.

release_games.name: Dice Breakers
release_games.description: Dice Breakers is an incremental game where you break dice, earn rewards, unlock upgrades and automate your destruction empire in this addictive clicker with prestige progression.

release_games.name: Hollow Life
release_games.description: A short first-person psychological horror game where a voice gives you daily instructions — watch television, take your medicine, tidy up. The more faithfully you obey, the more your apartment decays into something wrong.

release_games.name: Capy Farm
release_games.description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

release_games.name: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
release_games.description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

release_games.name: SoundRoom
release_games.description: Guess the type of instrument being played.

release_games.name: Royale Smith
release_games.description: Open your shop as a novice blacksmith and raise your reputation all the way to royalty. Assassins, archers, knights, and peasants will visit your shop as customers, demanding common, rare, or legendary swords, axes, daggers, bows, arrows, and various other goods.

release_games.name: You Must Die
release_games.description: Build your own dice in this turn-based roguelike! Customize individual faces, combine powerful abilities, hunt dangerous bounties, and collect new dice and relics to create devastating builds. Every face matters. Every roll counts.

release_games.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
release_games.description: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

release_games.name: MarsCity3026
release_games.description: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the atmosphere control fans back online so that the humans can wake from cryosleep.

release_games.name: BE2
release_games.description: BE2 is a 2d Jump and run game.

release_games.name: Neon Blackfall
release_games.description: Build your deck, survive the Blackout, and fight for control of Neurovale. A fast-paced card game with +100 single-player chapters and online multiplayer battles. Lead one of five rival factions and adapt as the city changes between the Neon and Blackfall eras.

release_games.name: Patsy's Retirement
release_games.description: Patsy just retired, and she's spending it on a tiny island that lives on your desktop. Watch her water the flowers, feed the ducks and sweep the leaves at her own gentle pace while you work. Lend a hand with quick optional mini-games, grow her skills, and unlock 170+ cozy cosmetics.

release_games.name: Marketfield Idle
release_games.description: Marketfield Idle is all about growing crops, selling goods, cooking recipes, automating production, and prestige into stronger runs in a cozy incremental farming game with 1200+ upgrades, strategy paths, and lots of synergies to discover.

release_games.name: Mythopolis
release_games.description: Mythopolis is an online board game for four to eight players. Race across four mythologies, buy the medallions that win the game, and swing your rivals' fortunes with a hand of mythic cards — or lose everything to a single one.

release_games.name: Wall Street Tycoon
release_games.description: You start as an intern clicking SIGN on paperwork nobody reads. An hour later the SEC is at your door and you are deciding whether to bribe them. An incremental tycoon about how fast a small amount of money turns into a problem.

release_games.name: 六艺中文填字
release_games.description: 经典填字游戏的中文版。《六艺中文填字》是一款以中国古代“君子六艺”为核心框架的纯正中文文字解谜游戏。游戏有丰富的关卡数量、贴心的UI交互和趣味的主题设计，在这里，你可以穿梭于“礼、乐、射、御、书、数”六大主题卷宗，挑战包罗万象、纵贯古今中外的海量知识点。

release_games.name: Strike Wings
release_games.description: A top-down modernized retro space combat epic. Choose from over fifty warships and be part of massive fleet actions with hundreds of ships on the field. Fly for Earth's church-state or the Martian forge that armed it. Play solo, in split-screen or in co-op.

release_games.name: Wealth Explosion
release_games.description: Wealth Explosion is an idle game with endless growth, divine trials, and deckbuilding. Rise from a shack to become the universe's richest being and the God of Reincarnation. Collect artifacts, challenge gods, explore adventures, and build decks. For fans of idle games and roguelites.

release_games.name: Survive The Apocalypse
release_games.description: A turn-based survival roguelite set in a sun-baked urban wasteland. Fight, scavenge, and manage your needs through 11 procedural city districts. Every step is a choice with fatal consequences. Eat well, sleep well, and try not to die.

release_games.name: CarSim Racing
release_games.description: CarSim Racing is a racing game where you start from the bottom with ordinary cars and work your way up to supercars, competing against the best racers! The game features more than 45 cars across different classes. Each vehicle is unique, with its own strengths and weaknesses.

release_games.name: Harvestide
release_games.description: A unique Roguelike farming game blending deckbuilding with farm management! Farm with cards, survive the Wither Moons. Build your deck, tend your farm, and reap the harvest—or starve.

release_games.name: Drum Incremental
release_games.description: A satisfying incremental game where every click has rhythm. Tap patterns, earn Rhythm Points, unlock new techniques, and build your ultimate setup. No music experience needed — just the urge to keep going.

release_games.name: Beyond The Abandoned
release_games.description: Climb through the shifting realms of your mind, confronting hazards, enemies, and risky decisions on your ascent to regain consciousness.

release_games.name: Aptamirror
release_games.description: Aptamirror is a meditative physics-based puzzle game inspired by molecular biology. Manipulate RNA strands by grabbing, mutating, cleaving, and ligating to match increasingly complex target structures. Challenge yourself with 50 handcrafted puzzles designed by a PhD Biochemist. Think. Fold. Repeat.

release_games.name: Reflection Of Feelings
release_games.description: Alex, a mid-level manager from the big city, is forced to return to his home village following a family tragedy. A temporary visit soon becomes a deeply emotional trial. He will have to confront a mystical lake, put his friendships to the test, and find true love.

release_games.name: Ego Lifting Simulator
release_games.description: A physics-driven lifting career sim where you physically control every rep. Train hard, train smart, manage your work-life balance and diet, and become the next lifting champion.

release_games.name: Agebound
release_games.description: A fast-paced farming idle game where each year lasts under a minute. Plant crops, automate production with workers, and advance through Ages to build a thriving, high-yield farm.

release_games.name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
release_games.description: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

release_games.name: Beat For Speed
release_games.description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

release_games.name: HOLD MY WHEEL
release_games.description: You need to visit grandma - twin brothers, apocalypse, and all. Keep the bus running, and try not to eat your friends when the hunger hits.

release_games.name: Broken Soccer
release_games.description: Pick one of 38 ridiculous teams, roll the die and unleash a dinosaur charge, a zombie infection, a bull market (with an actual bull) or Nietzsche off the bench. Tied at full time? Boots off, fists up. Solo, co-op or online versus up to 4v4.

release_games.name: The Plunge Of Sludge
release_games.description: The Plunge Of Sludge is a 2D bullet hell roguelite where you collect trinkets, weapons, and hats from a pool of over 500+ items to conquer a dungeon and defeat THE KEEPER. You will fail and perish, but every attempt will be different and more chaotic than the last. Will you take the plunge?

release_games.name: The Ice is Watching
release_games.description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

release_games.name: Swarmfall
release_games.description: Pilot humanity’s last starship and survive relentless alien swarms. Your automated fleet fights for you as you dodge, collect, and grow stronger every run.

release_games.name: BOOTH BUTCHER
release_games.description: No backup. No easy way out. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the shift from hell in this retro slasher horror experience. Uncover the theater's dark secrets and survive the night, or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

release_games.name: Siren's Call: Second Wind
release_games.description: A wedding where one of the guests arrives dead. A strange black hole eclipsing the Florida sun. And your best friend? Gone. Is all this a butterfly dream or is reality breaking? Is their story romance or mystery? Your choices will determine the genre of his soul. Welcome to the town of Siren's Call.

release_games.name: marblebuilds
release_games.description: A creative marble physics sandbox. Place blocks on an infinite grid to build anything you can imagine: marble runs, functional calculators, precision platformer courses, playable minigames, pinball machines, automated music tracks, and more.

release_games.name: Null Recall
release_games.description: You work for a government agency that studies the effects of demonic possessions.

release_games.name: PolyDogfight
release_games.description: Prepare to Fly, Dodge, Shoot, and Destroy in PolyDogfight. Unlock all the planes and maps to find your style. Obliterate waves of planes in an open-air arena as quickly as possible to get the high score and top the global leaderboard!

release_games.name: Corner Arcade
release_games.description: Live the dream and run your own arcade in this idle management sim. Purchase arcade machines and build your space, your way. Run your arcade, level up and upgrade your machines to attract elite gamers and watch as they empty their pockets to fill yours! Then sit back & enjoy the buzz of the arcade.

release_games.name: Corpus et Spiritus
release_games.description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!

release_games.name: Shwoop
release_games.description: Draw curves to guide projectiles into matching collectors. A physics puzzle game of logic and precision. Climb the leaderboards, then build and share levels of your own.

release_games.name: Factory Works Idle
release_games.description: Build an automated industrial empire from stone tools to singularity tech. Click, automate, and research through 10 eras, then breach reality to conquer parallel dimensions with unique rules, resources, and threats. Idle factory builder with deep prestige and cross-dimensional logistics.

release_games.name: Construction Store Simulator
release_games.description: Build and run your own construction supply store from the ground up! Arrange products, keep shelves stocked, serve customers, manage employees, set prices and expand your store. Grow from a small shop into a thriving business and make your store the go-to place for builders!

release_games.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
release_games.description: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

release_games.name: Gridfire
release_games.description: A fast top-down PvP shooter: capture flags, hold points and escort the VIP across six modes and dozens of maps. Build and share your own maps, play with friends — or switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

release_games.name: Coin Factory 2
release_games.description: Build a coin factory, one tile at a time. Connect machines, discover useful combinations, and upgrade as the coins roll in. Try different maps, collect coin charms, and make it your own with a level editor and Steam Workshop.

release_games.name: PlinkIdle
release_games.description: PlinkIdle is a retro-inspired game with an idle/incremental spin on a classic ball drop mechanic. Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

release_games.name: Derail Party
release_games.description: Drive a locomotive that never stops, grab gold nuggets to add wagons and cut off your rivals so they crash into your train. Up to 30 real players per match, solo mode against bots, daily quests and leaderboards. Free to play, same account as the browser version.

release_games.name: Gourmet Zombie
release_games.description: Imprisoned in a mansion's cellar, you're the personal chef of Toufic, the Gourmet Zombie. Master real knife techniques, fight off the infected with kitchen tools and butcher the fallen in a PS1-style survival horror where you're either the chef… or the dish!

release_games.name: TRAUMATA
release_games.description: TRAUMATA is pure, concentrated adrenaline! Dive into the underbelly of psychological horror where every secret brings you closer to ascension... or drags you into the abyss of madness. Fight off endless waves, master the ultimate action, and dominate the global leaderboards!

release_games.name: Magtiles
release_games.description: Magtiles is a chill and relaxing puzzle game about moving tiles. There's no rush! Just play at your own pace, disable the move limit, skip levels, or come back later if you just want to relax. Listen to chill lo-fi and classical music and satisfying sounds. Simple is good.

release_games.name: Castlepult
release_games.description: Crush an army with a catapult. Defend your castle with huge boulder impacts. Stack fire, frost, and gravity upgrades, and spend your gold on enough firepower to survive the next wave. Bigger crowds? Better targets.

release_games.name: Backdraft
release_games.description: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

release_games.name: Constellations
release_games.description: Connect the stars to reveal each constellation in a minimalist puzzle game inspired by all 88 real-world constellations. Revisit your discoveries in the Catalogue, play at your own pace and enjoy the journey through an imagined sky.

release_games.name: Gate Fall
release_games.description: An astronaut falls through an ancient Gate onto an unknown world. Dig with your laser, fly with your jetpack, build a factory, help living towns… then cross the Gate: crystal lands, a floating Paradise, and three epic bosses in 2D, 3D and first person.

release_games.name: Torchestra
release_games.description: Light your torches and descend together. Torchestra is a first-person voxel dungeon crawler for 1 to 4 players in online co-op. Nine classes, ever-changing dungeons full of traps, elite enemies and bosses, shared loot, and friends to help back on their feet.

release_games.name: Unscrewed
release_games.description: Run a cozy recycling depot at golden hour. Drill out every screw from chairs, fridges, arcade cabinets and more, watch them wobble and collapse in a satisfying heap, sort the scraps for cash, hunt rare finds and upgrade your drills in this chill physics sim.

release_games.name: URANUS
release_games.description: Bounce, pierce and shatter alien swarms. Pick three of five pilots, then choose, evolve and fuse balls every level-up in this pixel-art ricochet action roguelite. A 10-chapter story, then endless Survey levels and an Endless mode.

release_games.name: The Arcane Archive
release_games.description: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

release_games.name: I Just Tidied Up!
release_games.description: The last block goes in. Your toddler tips the basket. So much for a tidy room! Snap the lid shut next time, or sit down and play together. Spend seven cozy days sorting toys, finding a favorite plush, and filling a little album with memories.

release_games.name: Cursor Cult
release_games.description: A tiny pixel civilization lives on an island at the edge of your screen, and it worships your mouse cursor. Every 20 seconds its priests read your cursor's trail as an omen: farm, build, trade, pray, study, or march to war. Just use your computer; your habits become their scripture.

release_games.name: Three Tides
release_games.description: After years away, the main character returns to his coastal hometown, only to find his life pulled in three different directions by a mysterious stranger from a cruise, a bittersweet childhood friend, and a free-spirited new flame.

release_games.name: Runaway Rocket
release_games.description: Your rocket blasts into the sky — but the monster could turn around at any moment! Time your landing, build up the target prize, and push your limits!

release_games.name: MERDAN: Night Protocol
release_games.description: Work the night shift in a city where emergency calls and official records do not always agree. Question callers, connect evidence, challenge MERDAN's recommendations and decide where limited help goes. The consequences follow you into later shifts.

release_games.name: SAPU: Reborn
release_games.description: SAPU: Reborn is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art platformer. Master jumps, dashes and wall jumps, avoid deadly traps, defeat enemies and collect fireflies across 25 handcrafted levels.

release_games.name: Nyangdom : Dark Cat Defense
release_games.description: Deploy your cats to hold off endless waves of enemies. A 2D random defense game where you utilize random draws, passive skills, and perfectly timed active skills. There is no single meta. Maximize your luck and risk management to dominate the battlefield with your unique composition!

release_games.name: Tooth & Tide
release_games.description: Search tropical shores for shark teeth, craft necklaces, and grow your island museum and shop. Follow the tides across multiple islands, discover 50 collectible species, and settle into the changing rhythms of Tooth & Tide.

release_games.name: Desktop Cat or Potat
release_games.description: The keyboard is a cat bed. The monitor is standing between you and your cat. Productivity? That can wait. A cozy desktop idle game: grow potatoes, feed your furry friends, and unlock new experts in the art of distraction.

release_games.name: Poly Magic
release_games.description: A fast fantasy survivors-like where magic becomes a weapon of mass destruction. Choose a hero, build a deadly set of spells, and survive 12 minutes of enemy waves — alone or in online co-op for two.

release_games.name: SCHISM WORLD
release_games.description: Divide the world—and rule the fragments. A turn-based strategy game in the style of a digital board game, where diplomacy, economics, and tactics decide everything. Gather the shards of a shattered world, forge alliances, and redraw borders across a procedurally generated cosmos.

release_games.name: Cropocalypse
release_games.description: Plant. Grow. Harvest. Outplay. A farming party game for one to four farmers on one field. Spread your roots to wall off rivals, haul your harvest home, raid their stores and guard yours from foxes and bears. When the market bell rings, the farmer who sells the most wins.

release_games.name: 까마귀슬레이어
release_games.description: A game where you survive for 20 minutes by using skills and defeating crows.

release_games.name: A SHEEP GAME
release_games.description: Free cartoon puzzle mayhem in the spirit of Lemmings: guide a stubborn flock through 218 levels, from a sunny meadow down to Satan's throne room. Dig, build, blow things up – while the soundtrack slides from country to death metal and the bleating turns into a growl.

release_games.name: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
release_games.description: A tiny VPet device lives on your taskbar and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points, catch a box or a key every 30 minutes of play, open boxes on a spinning reel and collect 140 devices from 7 series, pets, straps and charms you can trade on Steam.

release_games.name: Chronicles Unwritten
release_games.description: Command an army from colliding timelines in this free-to-play strategy card game. Combine Units, Relics, and Events across four eras, complete Chronicles, and outthink AI opponents. All 220 base cards are included from the start.

release_games.name: Desk Pixie
release_games.description: Desk Spirit is a cozy, desktop-companion idle RPG. While you work or slack off, your little desk spirit grows, collects materials, goes on adventures, and logs your daily life and to-dos. Let it quietly accompany you through every mindful moment.

release_games.name: Galaxy Cube: Falling Blocks
release_games.description: A falling-block puzzle game with roguelite deckbuilding. Place blocks, clear lines and cast spells from six schools of magic. Buy cards and artifacts, upgrade your abilities and face bosses that reshape the board. Find powerful combinations to push your next run further.

release_games.name: Mutualist
release_games.description: An idle strategy game about the trade beneath a forest. Route Carbon, Phosphorus and Water through a mycorrhizal network, sporulate to begin again stronger, and press down through deep time until the forest becomes one organism.

release_games.name: The Restoration Studio: Masterpiece Nonograms
release_games.description: The Restoration Studio is a puzzle game where you restore darkened masterpieces by solving nonogram pieces. Mona Lisa, The Starry Night, Kim Hongdo’s Ssireum (Korean Wrestling), Hokusai’s The Great Wave off Kanagawa and more: 112 paintings from East and West in 2,597 puzzles, from 10×10 to 20×20.

release_games.name: ISTAKA
release_games.description: ISTAKA is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder where you battle with Okey tiles. Form melds to deal damage, build powerful combos with special tiles, and cheat to turn the tables. Face masked opponents, upgrade your rack, and choose your path to the top as techno beats pulse around you.

release_games.name: Cozy Karaoke Tycoon
release_games.description: Build the cosiest karaoke bar in town! Design rooms, hire staff, serve bubble tea and pizza, and keep every singer smiling. Win the City Karaoke Championship, then expand from a little street-corner bar to a mall and a rooftop lounge above the city lights.

release_games.name: Kart League Manager
release_games.description: Manage a Division 4 kart team and lead your drivers to the title. Raise six drivers, ban and pick maps, set your 4v4 grid and karts, then watch bumps, drafts and last-lap boosts turn the race around. Climb to Division 1, or let each driver shine in the Winter Solo Cup. Play solo or with friends.

release_games.name: Corner Pocket: World Billiards
release_games.description: Play eight billiards games online for free, including snooker and Taiwan 235. Enter Corner Pocket: World Billiards, aim freely, hold to build power and feel every shot. Challenge opponents or invite friends in seven distinct halls, using potting and cue-ball positioning to win.

release_games.name: Oh My Balance!
release_games.description: The scale settles. Perfectly still. Stack things on the right pan until they weigh the same as what is already on the left. That is the whole rule.

release_games.name: SWIMSUIT ZOMBIES
release_games.description: Gear up and prepare in this wave-based FPS! Battle against endless hordes of zombies wearing swimsuits. Upgrade your weapons and complete challenges to increase your odds of survival. Claim victory over the beachgoers by successfully defeating all rituals scattered throughout the maps!

release_games.name: Habet
release_games.description: You were sold onto the sand and walked off it free. Now you own men who stand where you stood. Buy them, train them, send them out to bleed. Every one of them wants what you were given, and however long you last, the sand is waiting.

release_games.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
release_games.description: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or with up to 8 players!

release_games.name: Little Pagan Land
release_games.description: Restore a magical glade and grow a forest at the bottom of your screen! Gather berries and coins, feed and pet magical creatures. Some roam by day, others emerge at night - and life in the glade carries on while you go about your day.

release_games.name: KROSTEL: Architecture Bureau Simulator
release_games.description: Build and run your own architecture bureau. Hire architects and engineers, compete for contracts, manage projects, finances, contractors, deadlines and risk, then automate the company and grow from a small office into a self-running firm.

release_games.name: Just Kukuruza
release_games.description: That corn isn’t going to shell itself! Take on a mountain of 1,000,000 ears. Start with hand tools, hire workers, and build automated production lines. Discover hidden collectibles, sell your corn, and race to the top of the leaderboard. Can you clear the mountain faster than anyone else?

release_games.name: OVERSTACK
release_games.description: OVERSTACK is a relaxing falling-block roguelike where 59 unique pieces and dozens of buffs create endless build possibilities. Build, Stack, Break, and discover powerful synergies as you push your build further with every run.

release_games.name: Everbastion
release_games.description: An idle tower defense where your castle fights on its own: archers, cannons, lasers and traps fire without you. Sweep the hordes with elemental auras, bring down bosses to grow your fortress for good, and never lose your progress.

release_games.name: Vampire Suplex
release_games.description: Punches won't finish them. Kicks won't either. SUPLEX will! Vampire SUPLEX is an absurd parody of classic 2D fighters. Survive the onslaught, seize your opening, and bring those arrogant bloodsuckers crashing down. One decisive SUPLEX. One spectacular finish.

release_games.name: Hot Vacation 2: Summer Heat
release_games.description: A hot summer match-3 adventure with beautiful anime girls, relaxing gameplay, and explicit 18+ artwork. Complete levels, unlock new illustrations, and fill your gallery.

release_games.name: LUCKY BLOCK
release_games.description: Open boxes, collect strange items, manage your limited inventory, sell what you don’t need, and take risks on your journey from street junk to cosmic treasures.

release_games.name: CatPurrEngineRace
release_games.description: Pet cats to power your engine with purrs! Pet with one hand and steer with the other as you race around the world and collect cats and cars. Take on World Tour, CAT—a high-difficulty, roguelike-inspired 30-race challenge—or compete online and in Time Attack!

release_games.name: ROCK//CLICK
release_games.description: Defend a stabilizing crystal with your laser, absorb projectiles in the pipe, and create a shield. Mine ore, choose upgrades, and advance through the depths in this sci-fi mining roguelite.

release_games.name: Ode of the Wandering Knight
release_games.description: *Ode of the Wandering Knight* is a wuxia‑themed cozy farming & life‑sim game. Step away from chaotic martial‑world conflicts. Till your land, build your homestead, farm, fish and craft, meet wanderers from jianghu, and live your own reclusive knight‑errant life.

release_games.name: Spellarium 14 Standart Edition
release_games.description: A new Match3 Puzzle game with a city to build and tons of extras ( spot the difference,jigsaw,drop tiles) More content available in the Collector's Edition version!

release_games.name: Orbital Desires 🛰️
release_games.description: Gao Chao Station was the embodiment of future wealth and prosperity, an orbital paradise for sexy women needing to escape Earth’s doomed gravity – and a place for them to find their every wanton desire tended to! Only a select few could afford it, but the thrills were worth it!

release_games.name: Lucky Debt
release_games.description: A roguelike about debt. Eight deadlines, one rigged slot machine, and a simple problem: the money that keeps you alive is the money that makes you stronger. Build a deck of symbols and charms, chain multipliers, and pay what you owe — or don't.

release_games.name: John Whisk
release_games.description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

release_games.name: Wildmane: Blood Bay
release_games.description: Your horse lives on your wallpaper. She grazes behind your windows, wanders across every monitor, and comes when you call. Usually. Ignore her long enough and she'll let you know how she feels about it. Pet her, play with her, fence her in. She is not productive and she is not sorry.

release_games.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
release_games.description: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

release_games.name: Obolus
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands — and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

release_games.name: Goats and Shrubs: Desktop Topiary
release_games.description: In this desktop idle game, watch your goats graze on wayward shrubs as you build and personalise your own desktop topiary. Your trusty goats collect leaves for you to spend on upgrades, decorations and new ways to customise your goats and topiary.

release_games.name: Sort My Comics !
release_games.description: Comics everywhere. It’s up to you to bring order back to the collection! Sort, shelve, complete your series, and unlock powers that gradually turn this gigantic mess into something wonderfully calming.

release_games.name: Shady Contractor
release_games.description: You're the least trustworthy contractor in town. Eyeball the blueprints, cut every corner you can, and pocket the difference. A physics-based construction puzzler where greed pays, right up until the building falls over.

release_games.name: Table of War
release_games.description: A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

release_games.name: SpaceShooter
release_games.description: Survive 20 escalating stages of meteor chaos in a fast-paced 2D arcade shooter. Master unlockable weapons, face unique meteor threats and powerful bosses, customize your ship, then push your limits in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: MMO Simulator: ASCENSIONS
release_games.description: Experience the thrills and clicks of a Massively Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game without the needless fluff in this idle/incremental game that captures the endless grind of an MMO while boiling the game systems down to their absolute barebones.

release_games.name: Hotel 13
release_games.description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

release_games.name: Nightwire
release_games.description: Wire up a data-theft rig, launder stolen bytes on a live black market, and climb the netrunner underworld one burned identity at a time — until a ghost of who you used to be logs on, learns how you fight, and comes for the only chair that fits one of you.

release_games.name: Pixel Chroma
release_games.description: A 2D pixel hide-and-seek game for up to 12 players! Paint your body pixel by pixel to hide, then hunt down anything that looks suspicious. No art skills required—it’s pixel art! Blend into the scenery, fool the seeker, and survive!

release_games.name: BOB LOGISTICS
release_games.description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.

release_games.name: Freewill - Sci-Fi Music Platformer
release_games.description: Freewill is a linear, rhythm based 3D platformer. Experience songs by Magic Circuit come to life as you jump, slide and wall run in a futuristic landscape.

release_games.name: Glow up Hero
release_games.description: Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins. Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

release_games.name: House Of Echoes
release_games.description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

release_games.name: CLAWSTROPHOBIA
release_games.description: You are trapped underground in a Japanese subway station and must pay off an impossible debt in this rogue-lite claw machine deckbuilder.

release_games.name: Couch Pirates
release_games.description: Couch Pirates! is an easy to play local Wi-Fi party game that allows anyone to play using their phone or gamepad! Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island. The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening.

release_games.name: Snot Pop!
release_games.description: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

release_games.name: Silent Protocol
release_games.description: Infiltrate the server in this top-down point and click 2D action game, Using precise mouse movement, Teleport and Slash your way through a series of hand-crafted levels to destroy the AI named AISEN.

release_games.name: Cooking Carnage
release_games.description: In a world where money is hard to come by, play as a cook of odd manners, and serve alien customers in your weird dinner. Prepare them nice and comforting meals… Or kill them, slice them and turn them into fresh meat to serve to your next order in line !

release_games.name: Black Market Dealer
release_games.description: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

release_games.name: Fission Mirror Grid
release_games.description: Drag film cards on a 14×6 grid—facing and dyeing shape every hit. Face-up draws; chain Start, Instant, and End timings each turn. A 54-floor roguelike with four camera travelers, ~100 cards, and 119 relics.

release_games.name: Sortilege
release_games.description: A roguelite dice duel against someone across the table. Every boon you pass up stays on the table for your rival to take. Fight through world after world of rivals and keep the dice of every boss you beat, or duel a friend online.

release_games.name: Tale Sweeper
release_games.description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

release_games.name: Jeremy is Broke
release_games.description: Trade stock, dumpster dive, and repair laptops in this unemployment simulator

release_games.name: Legend of Defenders
release_games.description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

release_games.name: The Last Ores
release_games.description: Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

release_games.name: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire
release_games.description: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

release_games.name: Magical Ascent
release_games.description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

release_games.name: Creative Aquarium
release_games.description: What if your doodles could come to life on your desktop? Creative Aquarium is a relaxing idle desktop game where every fish you draw becomes a unique companion. Name your creations, decorate your tank, discover fish made by other players, and build an underwater world of your own.

release_games.name: The Background Warrior
release_games.description: Always open at the bottom of your screen, this idle game lets you advance through stages full of monsters. Master different jobs and become the strongest.

release_games.name: Astromino
release_games.description: A roguelite battle against cosmic evils - drop customized polyominoes, collect relics, and execute powerful combos to defeat your enemies!

release_games.name: Clicker Astro Planet 2
release_games.description: Click the planet, do prestige, develop businesses with cats, complete space missions, and unlock 80+ achievements while exploring the galaxy in Clicker Astro Planet 2! Perfect for a 100% completion challenge.

release_games.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
release_games.description: Carry your inventory above your head. Solve puzzles with it. Play as a dwarf in a turn-based puzzle crawler with roguelite elements. Place objects, activate mechanisms, and outwit monsters as you explore dungeons.

release_games.name: Bull Run
release_games.description: Trade stocks, short the market, and outsmart AI rivals. Play a match, a 13-scenario campaign, the Daily Challenge, or a Career from your mom's basement. Online with friends on Steam.

release_games.name: Subsomnia
release_games.description: Explore an ever-changing dream universe in this 2.5D action roguelite. Wield your slingshot, solve physics-based ricochet puzzles, and traverse procedural worlds. Every magical object is a gateway to a new dream: will you reach the source?

release_games.name: Jokey and Jolly´s
release_games.description: Jokey and Jolly’s is a gripping indie horror game. Use the Jolly figures on your desk to ward off terrifying jumpscares. Explore a mysterious location, uncover the hidden truth, and attempt to beat in total seven Dreams by Jokey.

release_games.name: Priority One
release_games.description: Priority One is a game where you and your friends play as a SWAT team where you defuse bombs, rescue hostages, locate evidence and arrest or eliminate Hostiles Also features a Alternative mode With Zombies ,objectives to search for and survivors to rescue 1-4 player Co-Op

release_games.name: Manual Teller Machine
release_games.description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

release_games.name: Only Mining
release_games.description: A short game about becoming the ultimate town miner. Strip away the farming, the town chores, and all other distractions so you can focus on 'Only Mining'. Every ladder found sends you toward larger rock and more valuable rewards. How deep will you descend before you run out of air?

release_games.name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Kill Line
release_games.description: One card per turn. Rent, debt, and no room for mistakes. Build a deck around cash flow, evidence, and mutual support to survive mounting bills. A darkly funny, story-driven roguelike deckbuilder about a 38-year-old father trying to keep his life together.

release_games.name: MyDear.exe
release_games.description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

release_games.name: Meow Time: cozy cat room
release_games.description: Decorate a cozy room and work, study, or relax with an adorable cat. Earn its trust through daily care, petting, and play. Discover how its reactions change with your bond and its mood. Enjoy your time together with handy productivity tools!

release_games.name: Golf 5 MAX
release_games.description: Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust, where every hole is all or nothing. Play solo or challenge rivals worldwide. 25% off until November 16!

release_games.name: Food Delivery Simulator 2027 - Prologue
release_games.description: Take orders on your phone, pick up meals from restaurants serving world cuisines and deliver them across a living city on foot, by bike, scooter or car. Start your courier career with the Prologue of Food Delivery Simulator 2027!

release_games.name: Lockdown Dom
release_games.description: A visual novel where you can either dominate or submit to the love interests.

release_games.name: I Don't Do Overtime
release_games.description: Your coworkers won't let you clock out. Fight your way from rush hour to your company's cosmic HQ in this darkly comic FPS. Bullets don't hurt coworkers directly—use knockback to slam them into obstacles! Survive absurd encounters, uncover corporate secrets, and get home without overtime.

release_games.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
release_games.description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's teams in the world!

release_games.name: Barely Alive
release_games.description: A co-op survival party game. Hunt your friends or survive until sunrise.

release_games.name: Message From Aliens
release_games.description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

release_games.name: The Haunted House : Dark Island
release_games.description: Your friends have vanished into the darkness… now, you are their only hope! Collect and grow your ghosts, and stand against powerful enemies.

release_games.name: Liberate: Escape Room for Two
release_games.description: Two prisoners, two neighbouring cells, one wall between them. Each on their own device, no network: describe what you see, listen, guide your partner. 52 co-op puzzles played by voice, in an abandoned laboratory.

release_games.name: Sea Train
release_games.description: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

release_games.name: Makarov Astronomy Suite
release_games.description: Explore space through 120 interactive astronomy modules: black holes, planetary rings, stellar evolution, galaxies and orbital flight. Change the parameters and watch the universe respond. 3D scenes, graphs and experiments that run locally.

release_games.name: Domain Controller
release_games.description: You're the new IT hire at Kelmore, a research lab that keeps the dead. Work the helpdesk queue with real PowerShell and Active Directory, go one floor deeper each day, and find out what the last admin left running.

release_games.name: Last Dispatch
release_games.description: Keep the last post office lit with your feathered postal companion. Rotate conveyor belts, switch routes and plan waiting times across 100 puzzles in 12 chapters. Coordinate gates, delivery orders and simultaneous arrivals. No real-time countdown—think, rewind and retry at your own pace.

release_games.name: 離島旅程
release_games.description: Explore Hong Kong from Cheung Chau in a relaxing fishing adventure. Watch your float, time your strikes and discover 170 fish species. Collect postcards, enjoy minigames and help clean the sea. Traditional Chinese interface and stories.

release_games.name: N in One: Puzzle Minigame Collection
release_games.description: A quick break, with a little overtime for your brain. Enjoy 20 minigames, including 2048, tile matching, bubble popping, box pushing and mazes. Pick from four difficulty levels per game, learn with illustrated guides, and play offline with local autosaves. Supports eight interface languages.

release_games.name: Sort Sort Yokai
release_games.description: A cozy sorting puzzle game set in a little Japanese shop full of spirits. 640 yokai figurines, and every one has a place on the shelves. It should be simple, but the yokai have other plans!

release_games.name: Find The Gold
release_games.description: A mountain of sand. Gold hidden somewhere inside. Dig, haul and sell your first loads, then build the machines that take over the hard work. Connect conveyors, power a growing factory and uncover natural gold specimens in a first-person digging and automation game.

release_games.name: Slime Splitter
release_games.description: A pixel art incremental game about popping slimes. Sweep your jelly ring across the arena and split every slime into smaller pieces until the screen overflows, then spend the jelly on a huge skill tree and card deck to push past 15 bosses and into endless mode.

release_games.name: Librarian Together: Manga Tidy Up
release_games.description: Tidy up a chaotic Tokyo manga shop in first-person online co-op for 1–4 players! Grab stacks of manga and merch, find the right shelf, toss volumes into place and unlock team skills. Every volume in its place. Together.

release_games.name: Fish with Friends
release_games.description: A co-op fishing game for 1 to 4 players. Catch fish, sell your haul and buy better rods and bigger boats. Head further out for bigger catches, but keep an eye on the weight. Every fish goes in the boat, and too many will sink it.

release_games.name: Too Many Orbs!
release_games.description: You fell asleep in magic class. Your punishment? Sort 3,493 magical orbs. Explore a magical orbirary, find where each orb belongs.

release_games.name: Rakuworld
release_games.description: Draw your own hero and play as it. Your drawings come alive to face hordes of enemies across 11 worlds made of paper and crayon. 36 heroes, 22 bosses, evolving weapons and 1-4 player co-op.

release_games.name: Tower Hero Survival
release_games.description: A tower-defense roguelite with automatic attacks. Choose from 60 towers and combine 95 weapons with 100 upgrades. Survive 30 waves or challenge other players online. Every run brings a new build. Whose tower will stand the longest?

release_games.name: Anubis Temple: La Perla de Egipto
release_games.description: Can you conquer the temple? A highly demanding 2D platformer: 50 single-screen rooms with levers, fire and acid traps and a chamber where gravity is reversed. Choose the boy or girl explorer and uncover the secret of La Perla de Egipto.

release_games.name: Pipsquad
release_games.description: Explore 108 hero classes and shape their dice in a turn-based roguelike. Read enemy intentions, keep key rolls, and combine attacks, shields, spells, and relics. Try custom parties, generated heroes, and ten-hero Raid battles.

release_games.name: 基因織女 Gene Weaver
release_games.description: Enter the smallest scale. Re-weave life’s narrative at a molecular level. Freely explore the genetic universe for superpower genes. Create your own magic carpet!

release_games.name: Vesper Vector
release_games.description: Blast through space and fight on the ground in Vesper Vector, a sci-fi arcade shooter. Dodge projectiles, battle bosses, and upgrade your ship and equipment. Play solo offline or team up with a friend in online or LAN co-op.

release_games.name: Beastforger Autobattle
release_games.description: Forge an army from the monsters you defeat. Build a team of ten, combine Heroic creatures into powerful fusions, and reclaim a fallen kingdom in this fantasy incremental autobattler. Push deeper for better loot, rebuild your citadel, and grow stronger through reincarnation and New Game+.

release_games.name: Bearded Dragon Nursery
release_games.description: Bearded Dragon Nursery is a relaxing desktop raising game. Start with a pair of adult bearded dragons, care for them, breed new generations, and discover different genes, colors, patterns, and rare looks. Check in when you like—your dragons won’t die if left for a day.

release_games.name: 崩老头模拟器
release_games.description: An absurd conversation card game and life sim. Build your deck, read the room and chain cards into combos while balancing affection, suspicion, time and rent. Your next outrageous request might earn a transfer or an awkward reply. Simplified Chinese only.

release_games.name: DOOD
release_games.description: Bring your drawings to life with eyes, legs, wings, and other parts, then set them loose on the Junk Planet in this sandbox ecosystem sim. Breed and fuse surprising new creatures, tackle strange research requests, and recreate the lost ecosystem of Sage’s home planet.

release_games.name: Northgate Dispatch
release_games.description: You run the signal box on the night shift. Bring trains in, hold the late ones, and send them back out before the timetable buries you. Route one wrong and the line locks up. A keyboard-driven dispatch puzzle on an 80s green-CRT board.

release_games.name: Myriad Auction
release_games.description: Blind-bid an entire warehouse in a roguelike auction. Spend resources to uncover clues about what is really inside, sharpen the appraiser's estimate, then make the one call that matters: bid or pass? Win the lot, then crack it open item by item to find out whether you struck gold or got fleeced.

release_games.name: Manikin Mimic
release_games.description: Manikin Mimic is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek party game! Become a wooden manikin, control your pose, create decoys, and blend into the environment. Or play as the Finder, spot the impostors, and make every shotgun shell count!

release_games.name: RaviWar 1: A Perfect Sonday
release_games.description: A free first-person adventure of puzzles and precarious jumps. It is 2077. The world lives inside Takarek, a tower of 17,769 floors, and Consensus has decided what everyone in it thinks for forty years. You are twenty, new to the job of deprecating data. Tonight you keep one file to save the world.

release_games.name: Sex Shop Chaos
release_games.description: Things are getting hard to keep organized! Run a cheeky adult boutique in Sex Shop Chaos: grab the goods, slide them onto the right shelves, and try not to get yourself in a twist.

release_games.name: Hotpot Party
release_games.description: Run a hotpot restaurant solo or with up to three friends. Queue ingredients, grab them from the conveyor and serve dinner before it burns. Buy better ingredients and upgrades between days, and try to keep your friends from filling the belt with tofu.

release_games.name: Guess What's Behind!
release_games.description: Guess the absurd image behind you while your friends give clues without saying the forbidden words. Simple, chaotic, hilarious!

release_games.name: Corner TCG
release_games.description: An idle game that sits in the corner of your screen where you open card packs, sell cards and buy upgrades

release_games.name: Punch Rock
release_games.description: A casual idle survival game in a small window beside your work. A lone climber wanders a mountain in real time. Give her the day: forage, chop, mine, climb, or camp. Then get back to whatever you were doing. You cannot lose, and the mountain keeps its own time while you're away.

release_games.name: Moving Company Simulator
release_games.description: Run your own moving company with friends! Pack fragile items, carry heavy furniture, load the truck, and deliver everything in one piece. Play solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Earn tips, build your reputation, and grow from a small crew into the city's top movers.

release_games.name: Idle Survivor
release_games.description: You are stranded. Your ship's weapons are all you have against wave after wave of enemies. Combine elemental abilities, unlock new ships, and see how long you can survive in Campaign or Endless.

release_games.name: Mikey The Hero: MANIA
release_games.description: Run through the stage as Mikey, John, Ralph, Rosever, and Sarah to stop Fred. find the Mystic Gems to determine your ending, and maybe along the way find out some lore of Rosever's past in this all new entry into the Mikey The Hero series.

release_games.name: Jarkeeper
release_games.description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

release_games.name: Holiday Alliance
release_games.description: Stop Santa's hordes from taking over the Holiday Lands in this festive, fun Tower Defense game. Drop roman candles, sparklers, snowblowers and deploy heroes to hold the line across a storybook campaign.
