release_games.name: DEADLINE DINNER
release_games.description: A fast-paced roguelite restaurant management game! 30days.$1,000,000. Save the restaurant! Build your restaurant, upgrade recipes, hire staff, and create powerful combos. Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

release_games.name: Only Love Opening Chests
release_games.description: "Only Love Opening Chests" is an incremental casual game, player will use a wide variety of weapons to destroy uniquely styled treasure chests, experiencing the rhythm shifting from slow beginnings to intense excitement, as well as the sense of accomplishment from growing stronger step by step

release_games.name: Pickup Point Simulator
release_games.description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

release_games.name: Ghostlock
release_games.description: Survive a round and it comes back as a ghost that replays your exact moves. Touch your past and you die. GHOSTLOCK is a 1-bit arcade dodger: every round adds a ghost, every fifth round they assemble into a boss, and the only way forward is through everything you have done.

release_games.name: Dice in Wonderland
release_games.description: Roll dice into poker hands in this roguelike deckbuilder. Forge every die yourself and stack chips × mult until the Queen's own scorekeeper gives up counting. A cruel, twisted Wonderland under the Cheshire Cat's watchful grin — one more run, all the way down.

release_games.name: Jolly Junction: Chapter 1
release_games.description: As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal. The trail leads to the remains of an abandoned television studio. Explore the studio as you track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone...

release_games.name: Suits of Fantasia
release_games.description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

release_games.name: SkullWar:ProvingGrounds
release_games.description: SkullWar: Proving Grounds is a cold sci-fi tactical strategy game. Control humanoid war machines known as "Skulls" in turn-based hex-grid ranged combat. Act 2 out of 3 actions (Move, Attack, or Function) per turn, with full enemy visibility. Victory lies in resource planning and squad synergy.

release_games.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together
release_games.description: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together is an online cooperative jigsaw puzzle game featuring the true einstein tile. Up to 8 players can piece together a single puzzle side by side.

release_games.name: StackLoad
release_games.description: StackLoad is a physics stacking game for solo play or up to four players online. Build a shared tower or race and sabotage friends with gusts, slips and wobbles. Survive risky landings across seven environments, then vote on who to blame when things fall apart.

release_games.name: Thunder Tie
release_games.description: Thunder Tie is an unsettling mascot horror puzzle game. Navigate through the power station to uncover the unsolved mystery of the people who disappeared 10 years ago. Watch out though, as you will may be greeted by some... creations.

release_games.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles3
release_games.description: Infinite Einstein Tiles3 is a casual puzzle game based on the "true einstein tile" discovered by David Smith and his colleagues.

release_games.name: SICRUN
release_games.description: A first-person arcade horror game about greed. Every level's exit costs SicCoins, and the goal is to buy your way out as fast as possible. Collect coins in the dark while something hunts you, gamble to multiply them, and spend them on upgrades and companions. High risk, high reward.

release_games.name: Gimbap Heaven
release_games.description: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

release_games.name: My Ramen Stand
release_games.description: My Ramen Stand is a cosy yet chaotic single player cooking game where you prepare ramen, serve customers, and grow your kitchen as your career progresses. Watch it go from a quiet, humble stall to the busiest most famous Ramen in Tokyo.

release_games.name: Morvex
release_games.description: Morvex ist ein kostenloser, rundenbasierter Zombie-Survival-FPS. Kämpfe gegen unerbittliche Horden von Untoten, stelle mächtige Waffen her und verbessere sie, besiege tödliche Bosse und erklimme die weltweiten Bestenlisten. Wie lange kannst du überleben? 🧟‍♂️⚡

release_games.name: Magic Fruit World
release_games.description: Magic Fruit World is an intense platforming adventure combining deep exploration and tactical combat. Master the power of Magic Fruits to face relentless enemies, uncover secrets in expansive worlds, and perfect your skills in levels built for high replayability.

release_games.name: Asteroid Destroyer
release_games.description: Blast your way through rogue-like action! This arcade space-shooter throws you into intense runs packed with asteroids, powerful weapons and hidden secrets! Experiment with unique loadouts, discover synergizing upgrades, and push your limits with challenge modifiers that make each run deadlier!

release_games.name: Candy Rush!
release_games.description: A roguelike survivor where the clock is your own greed. Fights never end on their own — the waves loop, and every loop makes enemies stronger. Bank your build and leave, or stay one more round. Choose your route, evolve your weapons, and meet the boss with whatever your greed built.

release_games.name: Half Faith Tower
release_games.description: Ascend an endless tower in this dark fantasy roguelite where strategy meets luck. Arrange your weapons, drop the orb, and unleash powerful attacks, defenses, and magic. Face increasingly deadly enemies, grow stronger, and fight to survive. Every floor is a new challenge. How high can you climb?

release_games.name: Obrum
release_games.description: OBRUM is a strategic logical puzzle roguelite where you manage an unstable system, trigger devastating chain reactions, and fight to keep the board from collapsing. OBRUM rewards pattern recognition & long-term planning. You are not solving a puzzle, you are engineering outcomes.

release_games.name: Keymaker
release_games.description: This game is a chill puzzle game, with stories of people daily lifes in 90's and millennium. The game features two types of locks: Locks with "Damaged Zones": repair by dragging components horizontally or vertically to create match3. Four-Way Security Locks: These require you to maintain a balance.

release_games.name: Mystic 6
release_games.description: A tactical card RPG where each card strikes with a unique placeable grid pattern to outsmart your enemies. Along your journey, weapons, potions, skills, runes, and much more will shape every run.

release_games.name: Animal Rogues
release_games.description: Animal Rogues is a dark rogue-lite dungeon crawler bullet-hell with rpg elements. You play as an animal who fights against one possessed beast after another! Discover unique interactable objects such as slot machines, dices.. Collect magical items and level up to become more and more powerful!

release_games.name: Boxing Underdog
release_games.description: Boxing Underdog is set in authentic abandoned arenas. Face off against four AI fighters, hone your skills in detailed training, then challenge players worldwide in ranked fights. Experience cutting-edge movement in every punch and dodge. Become the ultimate boxing champion!

release_games.name: Duck Casino: Gambling Simulator
release_games.description: Bet big with fake money, losing never hurts! 12 casino games in one: Dice, Plinko, Mines, Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, Crash and more. Go all-in with a million? Sure. Broke? Top up with more fake cash and keep playing.

release_games.name: The Liminal Descent
release_games.description: Descend into a living nightmare. Explore unsettling liminal spaces, face deadly entities, manage your sweat and uncover the truth. Play solo or with friends in co-op, with story-driven levels, standalone horror experiences and multiple endings.

release_games.name: CC: Bianca's Sigils
release_games.description: CC: Bianca Shuffle is a compact and stylish color‑placement puzzle game built around the many outfits of Bianca. Arrange the correct Bianca variants onto each colored square, progressing through 120 handcrafted logic challenges that steadily increase in complexity.

release_games.name: ONE MILLION CRABS
release_games.description: How many crabs can your PC handle? Start with one, buy upgrades, and multiply your way into a deeply unnecessary hardware test. Push your crab count, tank your framerate, and find out what that expensive graphics card was really for.

release_games.name: Age Breaker
release_games.description: A one-lane strategy game of armies, defenses and evolution. Spend gold on a push now or save for the next age, from bone clubs to plasma blades. Conquer a 36-battle campaign, battle giant bosses and try new tactics in custom skirmishes. Free demo available.

release_games.name: Bridge
release_games.description: Enjoy classic contract bridge on a clean, pixel-styled table. Practice offline with three AI difficulty settings, or invite friends with a four-digit room code. Play through bidding, dummy and all 13 tricks, with customizable backgrounds and card backs.

release_games.name: Prismhold
release_games.description: A card-driven tower defense: draft towers from your deck every wave, merge three copies to evolve them without limit and mix 14 elements to survive endless waves, crowned bosses and flyers. Play solo, co-op on one map, or side by side with up to 6 players.

release_games.name: Mine Away
release_games.description: A relaxing incremental mining game about breaking rocks, collecting coins, and upgrading your pickaxe. Mine your worries away. And... and... well that's it just you... mine and upgrade and power, fire, explosions... that's. FUN

release_games.name: 1000 MONTHS
release_games.description: Live one life across 1,000 months. Make choices, watch time accumulate, and see how work, relationships, routines, and unexpected moments shape where your lifetime goes.

release_games.name: YOU
release_games.description: Wander through the mysterious forests surrounding you; explore places you would never otherwise venture into. Discover interesting things and things that might make you rethink the decisions you’ve made regarding him.

release_games.name: Rolling Heights
release_games.description: A physics-based climbing game where you steer a marble up a narrow track high above the clouds. Balance on thin beams, launch off bounce pads and master your momentum, because one slip can send you tumbling back down. How high can you roll?

release_games.name: NAME ME IF YOU CAN
release_games.description: Read their name. Write it down. Take them out. NAME ME IF YOU CAN is a first-person multiplayer party game where your name is your weakness. Hunt your friends, hide your name tag, and use sneaky gadgets to turn a close call into a last-second comeback.

release_games.name: HACHIKOMA: Underground Stadium No. 8
release_games.description: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

release_games.name: Minotaur Pathways
release_games.description: Take control of the Minotaur as you explore and navigate different pathways throughout this dark fantasy adventure. Venture through dangerous areas and discover new environments. Overcome deadly obstacles and find your way through each level to reach the exit.

release_games.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World
release_games.description: Strike the Core, gather shards as they fall, and automate production in a relaxing incremental game. Start new cycles with permanent upgrades and bring a ruined valley back to life.

release_games.name: Gnome Dome
release_games.description: GNOME DOME is a short first-person horror game where you complete timed gardening tasks across four night shifts. Work fast to earn extra time because when a task timer hits zero, one random garden gnome comes to life and starts hunting you.

release_games.name: NO SUNRISE
release_games.description: Survive the night in NO SUNRISE, a cooperative 2.5D zombie survival shooter for 1 to 8 players. Defend the Lichtpalast, earn money and upgrade your weapons. Your death can create a powerful zombie boss that threatens your team.

release_games.name: Mining Days
release_games.description: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

release_games.name: Chaos Soccer
release_games.description: Choose rules or chaos before kick-off. Take a standard eleven-a-side football match and tweak it into something else entirely. Change the pitch shape, add extra balls and teams, surround the field with goals, and turn on the walls. Every match becomes a new kind of football chaos.

release_games.name: FIVEFOLD
release_games.description: Build a party of five by combining jobs, skills, and sub jobs in this turn-based party-building roguelite. With no exploration or traditional level grinding, the focus is on party building and combat. Adapt your formation and skills to each enemy and develop your own strategy to overcome them.

release_games.name: Lumenfall
release_games.description: The world sank into the Gloom. One island still holds a light. Build a cozy factory high above a sea of clouds, push back the darkness, then take the helm of your own skyship and sail through the mountain passes to new islands — alone or with up to three friends.

release_games.name: Last Evac
release_games.description: The last evac helicopter drops you over a ruined city. Loot, craft and outlast 60 players as the zone closes in, solo or in a squad of four. Or enter Left Behind: an always-on survival world with zombies, safe camps and a stash that stays. Top-down pixel art.

release_games.name: Hentai Age Mansion
release_games.description: Embark on a timer-free, relaxing puzzle adventure where completing tranquil mosaics unlocks stunning artwork and beautiful portraits of maidens, offering the ultimate stress-free escape.

release_games.name: Nodes
release_games.description: Build the network. The network is the weapon. Wire a node-based hacker rig, balance power, heat and bandwidth, and breach 21 escalating targets, from a branch post office to NASA's Deep Space Network. A calm automation game with no timers and no fail states.

release_games.name: The Pasture
release_games.description: You are a mouse cursor, summoned by an entity called The Shepherd into a simulation drawn entirely in ASCII text. In this difficult point-and-click puzzle adventure, you solve puzzles, collect items, fight the dangerous Bound, and piece together what happened to a strange world.

release_games.name: Cozy Necromancy
release_games.description: A gentle mystery about a village that cannot let go of its dead. As a journeyman necromancer, you lay six spirits to rest by listening to them, investigating what holds them, and making your case with three objects in a ritual circle. No combat, no timers, no fail states.

release_games.name: Vagina Sancta
release_games.description: Vagina Sancta is a unique experience that allows u to interactively explore the fascinating world of female reproductive anatomy!

release_games.name: Potion Approaching
release_games.description: A haunted manor item-crafting game where players combine three everyday objects to brew custom potions for visitors. Earned payments are used to pay off the residing ghosts before things get out of hand.

release_games.name: Fix it, Please!
release_games.description: July 2000, the PIX CORP tower, the badge window. A bureaucratic roguelike: inspect forms, catch impostors, watch the cameras and bring dead hardware back to life. Three strikes and the run is over. Friday never ends here, and with every loop the tower remembers you a little better.

release_games.name: Kur - Endless Descent
release_games.description: An auto-battler RPG in the Mesopotamian underworld. Build a party of heroes, gear and level them up, set their formation, then watch them fight on their own through seven Domains and an endless descent. Free to play, in a small window that fits around your day.

release_games.name: Nedi Cloud Simulator
release_games.description: You are a little rain cloud over grey, dead floating islands. Hold to rain and watch grass, flowers and trees burst back to life. Wake rivers and waterfalls, find lost seeds and heal a sky full of islands. Relax, or chase gold medals and race the rival clouds.

release_games.name: Owl Skips
release_games.description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.

release_games.name: Night Audit
release_games.description: Work the night shift at a hotel that is quietly wrong. Answer the bell, mop the corridors, hand out keys — and deal with whatever is on the fourth floor. Co-op for one to four porters, where the job is mundane, the building is not, and guess what: nobody is coming to help.

release_games.name: Hanzi: Five Gates
release_games.description: Combine 关 + 羽 into Guan Yu, or 枪 + 兵 into spearmen. Draw Chinese character tiles, build a six-slot formation, and let it fight automatically. Choose routes and relics, then rebuild your army around the tiles you find in this Three Kingdoms strategy roguelite.

release_games.name: MOLD-09
release_games.description: Survive an endless Soviet apartment block where even the sofa is alive. Build weapons from scavenged parts, fight through hordes, and find shelter when Self-Collapse strikes. A dark action roguelite for solo play or online co-op with up to four players.

release_games.name: CyberSprawl: Aquarium
release_games.description: Build your neon aquarium. Fish, hatch and breed biological, cyborg and robotic creatures. Decorate and manage multiple habitats, sell fish to local NPC buyers, and bring your favorites into Neon Clash beta practice battles in this single-player idle collection game.

release_games.name: LAST SHELTER
release_games.description: Scavenge zombie wastelands and escape with your loot. Build your shelter, recruit survivors, upgrade gear and deploy turrets against the hordes. Survive solo or with friends. Between fights, enjoy blackjack and the lucky wheel with friends—a happy life in the apocalypse.

release_games.name: MiniRacingOnline
release_games.description: Online racing for up to 32 drivers with over 8,500 vehicles and 300 tracks. Tune your setup, plan your tyre strategy and adapt to dynamic rain. Over 20 years of evolution and a community that has never stopped racing.

release_games.name: Pactmage - Chess Roster
release_games.description: Pactmage: Chess Roster is a turn-based tactics game where every character has skills and an element. Win in Adventure Mode and form a Pact to recruit them — all 60+ units are free. Play the story mode, fight a friend locally, or battle online in PvP. No gacha, no paid units.

release_games.name: THE MOUTHLESS STALKER
release_games.description: Explore an abandoned forest reserve in a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate dark locations, find clues, solve puzzles, and uncover disturbing events while a mysterious presence watches your every move.

release_games.name: FiND ME
release_games.description: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

release_games.name: Mouse Mortar CE
release_games.description: Calibrate your cannon, ignite the D.A.N. thruster, and launch your aviator mouse into orbit! Master unique gravities across 9 celestial worlds, dodge lethal traps, chain kinetic boosts, and conquer global leaderboards in this high-velocity physics launch arcade.

release_games.name: STAR³
release_games.description: STAR³ is a cosy 3D logic puzzle where colours wrap around cubes and your thoughts become music. Solve puzzles, awaken stars and build your constellation. No timer. No lives. Just a little curiosity and a universe to bring to life.

release_games.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
release_games.description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

release_games.name: MicroTD
release_games.description: MicroTD - endless incremental minimalist tower defense game where player decides when enemy difficulty should go up.

release_games.name: Subroutine: Deep Space
release_games.description: A sci-fi programming puzzle game. Repair corrupted ship cores by wiring executable node graphs — memory, logic, and I/O — then step through playback like a debugger until every validation stream passes.

release_games.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
release_games.description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

release_games.name: Delved Too Deep
release_games.description: Delved Too Deep is a roguelike mining game about machines exploring the depths to complete the Factory Imperative. Each new iteration is better than the last, their accumulated knowledge leading to revelations that may change the fate of those who wander the deep...

release_games.name: Voyager III
release_games.description: Robert, a 25 year-old intern at the biggest name in Space Exploration, is tasked with managing the Voyager III, an experimental probe that can warp to distant stars and worlds in the name of exploration. But as the months pass, Robert begins discovering horrors he wasn't meant to see.

release_games.name: Pomo Valley
release_games.description: Pomo Valley is a cozy pixel farming game you can only tend on the breaks between focus rounds. Focus to grow your crops, then step out to till, plant, harvest, mine, chop, trade and build up your valley.

release_games.name: Jirai Kei Nemu
release_games.description: Nemu strolls along the bottom of your screen. She sips tea, turns the pages of a book, giggles at her phone, and curls up for a nap when no one checks on her for a while. Start a focus session and she focuses beside you, then asks if you'd like a short break.

release_games.name: Stinky Tofu: Kitchen Survivor
release_games.description: A chaotic kitchen action-roguelite where you play as stinky tofu, auto-aim through hordes of mutant ingredients, fuse kitchen weapons, mutate mid-run, and fight to stay fresh before you spoil.

release_games.name: JOYSTICK JAMMERS: One Prawn
release_games.description: Use your controller joysticks to smack the drumset as One Prawn, creating your own style of freeform rhythms.

release_games.name: Vestibule
release_games.description: Every band dreams of a tour. Yours goes through Hell. Vestibule is a doom metal roguelite deckbuilder: recruit outcasts and burnouts, chain riffs, sign cursed pacts, stack damage, and play loud enough to kill the dead.

release_games.name: Idle Reef
release_games.description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

release_games.name: Grimhold
release_games.description: A dark fantasy roguelike tower defense. Hold the wall against endless legions across ten acts, command 23 unique heroes and forge runs that never repeat. Every wave you survive is a choice; every choice reshapes the siege. How long can Grimhold hold?

release_games.name: Ski Survival
release_games.description: Get down the mountain. When it goes wrong, something absurd comes to get you, and it is never the same thing twice. A one-button endless skiing comedy where every wipeout summons a rescue nobody asked for.

release_games.name: Who's Next?
release_games.description: A game of deduction, deception, and trust for 8–12 players. Uncover the Darkness hiding among the villagers. Talk, observe, investigate — but beware, the Darkness is watching too. Observe. Talk. Suspect. Who’s next?

release_games.name: Blooby Idle
release_games.description: BLOOBY Idle is a desktop idle game where BLOOBY fights endless waves of the Tumor to save the one she loves. Collect loot, upgrade your weapons, prestige and grow stronger while BLOOBY battles on your desktop as you work, browse or play.

release_games.name: Logical Cat Logistics
release_games.description: Let yesterday's you lend a paw! Deliver curious parcels as a cat courier, then record your footsteps and team up with your past self. Conveyors, gates and sorting switches move one beat at a time. Take your time, try a new route, and turn a tangled delivery into a perfectly timed handoff.

release_games.name: UFO Survival
release_games.description: Pilot through relentless waves of hostile forces in this fast-paced space-themed, bullet hell, survival shooter. Build your own UFO in the Ship Creator, Survive through a 100-wave campaign, or test your limits in Endless Mode. How long can you survive?

release_games.name: Tumble: A Cozy Dice Roguelite
release_games.description: The dice game you grew up with, turned into a roguelite. Roll, keep and reroll past strange visitors, bend the rules with 53 charms, and build the turn nobody at home would believe. One more run before bed?

release_games.name: IAI // BREAKER
release_games.description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

release_games.name: Peeling Feeling: Sticker Galore
release_games.description: Peel stickers, earn cash, collect them all. A cozy incremental game about the most satisfying feeling in the world: lifting a sticker in one clean pull. 250 stickers, holographic pulls, upgrades, workers, and a prestige system where the numbers get delightfully out of hand.

release_games.name: Can 'Em All
release_games.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

release_games.name: Harvest Exit Plan
release_games.description: Nico's grandparents just gave him the orchard he spent his whole childhood resenting. The plan is to strip it bare, sell it, and never touch an apple again. Six gardens, three tools, and a season system that keeps handing him a reason to start over.

release_games.name: Hospital Rhapsody
release_games.description: Run your hospital and build special bonds! Grow trust and affection through daily management and private interactions, and uncover the secrets beneath their white coats. 9 adult women, 25 date locations, 27 dating stories, 20 CGs, 27 HCG scenes per character, and 153 collectible staff photos!

release_games.name: Clawstral
release_games.description: A charming claw machine-themed roguelite! Never underestimate the claw!

release_games.name: Mine The Core
release_games.description: An idle mining game with a world of exactly 1,006,632,960 blocks. Hire a crew, upgrade, mine, kill bosses and prestige!

release_games.name: Spell Death
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the alphabet is your deck. Draw letters and spell words to strike, block or hex. Print them on paper stocks that change the rules, and learn each demon's true name to banish it from an art deco city that stopped reading.

release_games.name: Dead Keys
release_games.description: Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type to shoot, survive escalating hordes, build powerful chaotic runs, chase WPM records in Endless, and fight alongside, or against your friends online.

release_games.name: Monster Movie Mayhem
release_games.description: A kaiju roguelite city-smasher. Pick one of five B-movie monsters and level a pixel-art city while the army fights back. Topple towers, unleash ultimates, beat five bosses. Out now, with a free demo to try first.

release_games.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
release_games.description: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

release_games.name: Organize my Shop 2: Pet Shop
release_games.description: Your favorite organizing game is back! A brand-new pet shop, 17 unique levels, and even more comfort await you. Arrange food, beds, and accessories on the shelves at your own pace. The game is completely intuitive and perfect for relaxing to your favorite music or podcasts 🎧✨

release_games.name: Bearing 2889
release_games.description: Orsivellum paid your team well for ninety days at a remote lighthouse. Now you're waking up on the floor of a locked room, the last few weeks are blank, and the building is empty. A first-person co-op escape room for 1 to 4 players.

release_games.name: Temple Of Your Mom
release_games.description: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime is 4-6 hours.

release_games.name: The Community Notes Are Wrong
release_games.description: A bisexual singer goes viral after being caught kissing a man, shattering the image her fans built around her. Navigate fame, social media, biphobia, and messy romance in this otome/yuri visual novel.

release_games.name: 骨牌参禅 · Domino Zen
release_games.description: Rediscover Xiang Shi Fu, a Chinese domino solitaire played during the Qing dynasty. Swap tiles to turn a jumbled board into ten complete groups and a central pair. Enjoy the moment everything fits. Regular solo games have no countdown and save locally, ready for your return.

release_games.name: INCREMINER
release_games.description: Build an ever-growing colony of autonomous dwarves in an immense procedural world. Mine deeper, manage resources, unlock explosive weapons and industrial vehicles, and turn a tiny settlement into a screen-filling mining empire.

release_games.name: Iron Frame
release_games.description: A bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, each one rewriting a rule of the run rather than its numbers. Ten guns across forty tiers, ten bosses to break, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Survive long enough and the swarm stops being the problem.

release_games.name: Pot Smasher
release_games.description: A point-and-click game where you smash pots, collect coins, buy upgrades, and smash even more pots.

release_games.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
release_games.description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

release_games.name: Stellacore: Mining Odyssey
release_games.description: Stellacore: Mining Odyssey blends twin-stick combat with deep resource mining in a fast-paced 2D space shooter. Shatter block-built enemies piece by piece, crack asteroids for precious ores, and forge your loot into powerful ship upgrades!

release_games.name: Lusófona Games Collection 2026
release_games.description: Lusófona Games Collection 2026 brings you five inventive games from Lusófona University! Explore bite-sized experiences, unlock Steam achievements, and enjoy exclusive game developer commentary on how each game came to life.

release_games.name: Colorful Boi 2
release_games.description: Jump, dash and wall-climb through 74 colorful, deadly levels! Colorful Boi 2 is a tight, fast precision platformer stuffed with spikes, saws, conveyors and launchers - with instant retries, brutal-but-fair challenge and leaderboards for the fastest runs.

release_games.name: Everdeep Idle
release_games.description: An ARPG-inspired Idle game where the fighting happens automatically, but the build is yours. Choose up to six classes, reshape skills with augments and build-changing loot, and set up triggers and loadouts that react for you. Let it run while you’re busy, or dig into the numbers to min-max.

release_games.name: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager
release_games.description: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager is a fishing roguelike that has you catching loads of fish and meeting route quotas! Get buffs to increase your ability to meet higher quotas and maintain the needed bait! Catch 101 different species of creatures and customize your fisher to your hearts content!

release_games.name: Hidden in Plain Cake
release_games.description: Sculpt, slice, and paint real cake into perfect copies of everyday objects — then invite your friends online to spot the fake. Every cut reveals the sponge layers inside. Fool them, or get sliced open trying.

release_games.name: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
release_games.description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

release_games.name: FACTORIZE: 1
release_games.description: 2 attacks. 3 defends. 5 heals. Combine cards to create numbers and fight with the power of primes in this turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Factorization is automatic—read the enemy, build the number you need, and find your own answer from the same hand.

release_games.name: A Tiny Ghost Game
release_games.description: A tiny ghost game is a platformer that you can finish in an evening or two. Glide and dash your way out of the underground, mess with your enemies and help the ghost see the moon.

release_games.name: Boomsday
release_games.description: Hordes of adorable animals and toys want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op or 2 on the couch.

release_games.name: Click&Fix
release_games.description: Click&Fix is an incremental game about repairing consoles in which you unlock upgrades and machines to repair and resell increasingly expensive consoles.

release_games.name: IfStation
release_games.description: A historical card game where you place legends onto a timeline and watch civilizations rise — or collapse. This project is currently in the initial implementation phase following the completion of the design; you can view real-time development logs via the Community tab.

release_games.name: Bellus Party
release_games.description: Bellus Party is an early access multiplayer party game where cute cats compete in chaotic mini-games. Inspired by classic party games, Bellus Party focuses on fast, chaotic, and competitive moments that are easy to jump into with friends. May the best cat win!

release_games.name: Dark Spawn: Infestation
release_games.description: Dark Spawn: Infestation is a horror adventure game set in a Victorian-era inspired research facility. The protagonist got abducted by evil scientists, and has to solve puzzles and avoid strange creatures to escape.

release_games.name: Business Rivals
release_games.description: Compete against rival companies in a ruthless multiplayer business war. Build your corporation, hire employees, invest in legal and illegal operations, sabotage competitors, survive inspections, and become the richest entrepreneur in the city.

release_games.name: SYSTEM_REBOOT
release_games.description: You are a cursor inside a dying operating system. Swarms of corrupted processes want you deleted. 100+ upgrades named like terminal commands, 12 weapons, Devil pacts and 8 bosses with real HP phases on the climb to level 100. Your Twitch chat can vote on your build.

release_games.name: Lifelines
release_games.description: A cozy puzzle game about the lines beneath a growing town. Homes move in and ask for water, power, internet and gas. Draw the pipes that reach them, dig under the busy parts of town and cross rivers on aqueducts. Every five years, the town votes on whether you keep the job.

release_games.name: Blightened: Relic Keeper
release_games.description: Think you’re observant? Prove it. Inspect relics, question unreliable visitors, and decide what feeds the Syphon, what goes home, and what must be destroyed. Balance dwindling resources and survive 100 days in this dark fantasy deduction roguelite. Every relic has a correct fate. Just don’t guess.

release_games.name: Dark Thoughts
release_games.description: We figured out how to stop those intrusive dark thoughts we all have to deal with. First, pick a damaged hero to fight for you. Then, guide them to victory. Heal them, help them evolve. Once proficient, you're ready to take on the heavy hitting causes of trauma and vanquish them forever!

release_games.name: Unrivaled
release_games.description: Unrivaled is a digital card game where you battle your opponent with one of ten classes! You can play on the online ladder, join a tournament in tournament mode, or explore the world of Unrivaled in Campaign mode!

release_games.name: Cthuloop
release_games.description: Dive into madness in CTHULOOP, a 1st-person cosmic horror adventure game. Trapped in a loop, you must observe eerie anomalies and piece together cryptic clues before your sanity fractures completely. Can you escape, or will you loop forever? Developed for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam (theme: "Loop").

release_games.name: Blackboard Ponies
release_games.description: A game about a small pony in a blackboard world wreaking havoc and bringing color to everyone's lives. In this puzzle platformer play as a student's rebellious fantasy pony, kicking its way through the blackboard and releasing colors from the environment, making the world seem less hopeless.

release_games.name: House Of Trauma
release_games.description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

release_games.name: Last Lawn Standing
release_games.description: Choose from garden gnomes with different stat bonuses and defend your shrines against the forces of evil. Spend the day upgrading your towers and weapons and placing flower towers to shape the path of the hordes that arrive at night. How many nights can you survive? Every run is unique.

release_games.name: BURIED INSIDE ME
release_games.description: What if you couldn’t wake up from your worst nightmare? BURIED INSIDE ME is a first-person psychological horror experience where you find yourself trapped within your own dream. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive yourself.

release_games.name: Farm.exe
release_games.description: Plant, harvest, decorate, and customize your desktop. Unlock new crops, uncover hidden treasures, and create a space that grows more beautiful over time.

release_games.name: Arcany
release_games.description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

release_games.name: Cultivation Legend
release_games.description: Build a five-hero squad, shape skills with Arcana, and combine heroes' strengths in automatic horde battles. Hunt loot and choose one of three realm traits after major breakthroughs. Roguelike-inspired builds meet long-term idle progression in a buy-once single-player RPG.

release_games.name: Harvest Looper
release_games.description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

release_games.name: Zeitnot
release_games.description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

release_games.name: Beyond The Mist
release_games.description: M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.

release_games.name: Cubie
release_games.description: CUBIE is a minimalist puzzle platformer where you control gravity. Each side of the cube offers unique physics based on how you enter it. The world remains the same – only your perspective changes. Can you solve spatial puzzles in a labyrinth where "up" is just a relative term?

release_games.name: Thou Shalt Be Rich
release_games.description: Interpret the crystal ball's prophecies to find tomorrow's soaring stocks and bet your entire fortune. Survive the madness of skyrocketing and crashing prices to become rich. You need to take revenge on the Fortune Teller Corp that fired you just for a little bit of embezzlement!

release_games.name: Orbital Peril
release_games.description: What happens to you when your mobility is completely left to the wind? Use only two keys to control your weapon direction in a 360 degree orbit while danger envelops you! In this realm, you will definitely die, but what kind of impression will you leave before you take your very last breath?

release_games.name: Apothecary Grounds
release_games.description: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

release_games.name: Signal From The Stars
release_games.description: A modern pixel art point-and-click adventure inspired by the classics. Explore real places, investigate real mysteries, solve puzzles, and help Martin, Diana, and Nikki uncover the truth while discovering something new about the world.

release_games.name: Mago's Nightly Take Out
release_games.description: Mago’s Nightly Take Out is a short comedy horror game about a sleazy wizard trying to retrieve his stolen delivery food from a mysterious and deadly foe. Explore the city park and achieve 7 different endings in this weird and surreal urban fantasy experience.

release_games.name: Hakuroku Game Collection
release_games.description: Hakuroku’s board games are coming to digital! The Early Access version is planned to include Hakoniwa Kings and Guild Build. Greedy Hunters! is planned to be added in an upcoming update.

release_games.name: Stackade
release_games.description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

release_games.name: Drift Splatter
release_games.description: In this arcade roguelite, your car runs on blood and the zombies have plenty. Smash through the horde, drift to drain every last drop, and spin the roulette for brutal upgrades while you fight to survive the endless horde.

release_games.name: Gnomed
release_games.description: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker where a little gnome defends his cozy home. Hold off 20 waves of enemies, unlock new abilities and grow stronger every run!

release_games.name: Project Exodus
release_games.description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players in which you must hunt monsters and convert them into biomass to meet the quota for "The Ark". Collect artifacts, earn money, and buy upgrades to improve your chances of survival.

release_games.name: Prison Fury
release_games.description: One of the most complex and difficult co-op games on Steam, where you and a friend play as ex-convicted cats trapped in a hellish prison. Must work together to escape before time's up.

release_games.name: 100 Casino Cats
release_games.description: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

release_games.name: HAUNTED: Halloween '87 (Year of the Witch)
release_games.description: Possum Hollow is once again under seige in this spooky, action platformer loaded with beat-em-up combat, killer combos, and pixelated zombies. Donny and Tami must work together to defeat the haunted hordes and find the witch who cursed their town. Do you have what it takes to save Possum Hollow?!?!

release_games.name: BigFooten
release_games.description: BigFooten Leap. Survive. Conquer the wild. Where every step could be your last. Leap between floating rock platforms. Ride wooden elevators. Navigate shifting terrain. Enter portals that transport you to new and increasingly challenging regions.

release_games.name: Numeromantia
release_games.description: A deckbuilding roguelike with no mana. Place shaped cards on a board of numbers, turn its cells into powerful combinations, and carve your own route through a changing world. Build around elements, oaths or woven patterns. Every number you spend changes your next move.

release_games.name: 黄莓C HuangmeiC
release_games.description: 《HuangmeiC》: a cute, laid-back modern daily visual novel. Play as a new grad, enjoying funny daily life in another world—a light, silly romance! Stress-free job, little to do, great coworkers. No dark stuff or bad endings; just love, growth! Worldview not real—don’t use 3D logic!

release_games.name: Den: A Short Horror Story
release_games.description: Den is a short survival horror, where you rent a small cabin for a weekend getaway, deep inside the woods, hoping to escape reality and find joy in life.

release_games.name: Queen's Court: A Duel of Dignitaries
release_games.description: A Regal Animal themed Dueling Card Game; The highly replayable strategy game for friends and family who enjoy fast paced games of team work and betrayal!

release_games.name: Swarm Slasher
release_games.description: An endless, seething swarm of tens of thousands of monsters is coming for you. Hold back the tide of biomass in frantic battles! Build your defenses, annihilate everything that moves, and upgrade your death blender to insane power. Can you withstand 100,000 enemies at once?

release_games.name: Night Life: Club Sessions
release_games.description: Night Life: Club Sessions is a virtual nightlife experience where music, culture and clubbing collide. Explore premium solo venues with NPC DJs, or join online as a hologram to party with others, chat by voice or text, and enjoy live radio and real DJ events 24/7.

release_games.name: Ballerspiel
release_games.description: A chaotic comic-style first- and third-person shooter full of clowns. Battle Royale, Ballerball and Clown-Off, 13 weapons including an atomic bomb, vehicles, power-ups and a world where everything breaks. Play online, on LAN without internet, or offline against bots.

release_games.name: Crystallium
release_games.description: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

release_games.name: Orion's Reach
release_games.description: A sci-fi match-3 adventure where every move carries the story forward. Break through blockers, chain cascades and master chapter-specific puzzles across 440 levels. Follow an unlikely crew, chase a new high score in Infinite, or challenge rivals in online Versus.

release_games.name: Ancient Warrior
release_games.description: Third person RPG game with magical elements. Player control cyborg with different magic skills. Cyborg mission is to kill different enemies and hooded enemy to unlock gate and collect magic wands

release_games.name: Sort Them Dogs
release_games.description: Playtime is over at Happy Paws Doggy Daycare, and 4,080 toy pups are piled all over the floor. Scoop them up one at a time and carry every pirate, astronaut, farmer and pumpkin back to its own cubby row in this cozy first-person sorting game.

release_games.name: Planet Munchers
release_games.description: Grow a handful of woodlice into a swarm of 10,000. Devour voxel planets, spend Chunks on upgrades and return stronger with permanent DNA research. Choose strange worlds, unleash destructive abilities and race through Time Trial in this space incremental.

release_games.name: Chess Online: Grandmaster's Table
release_games.description: Sit down at the table and play chess your way: rated online matches against real players, eight AI opponents from beginner to full-strength engine, or a friend on the same PC in split screen. Win coins, climb the Steam leaderboards and unlock luxurious boards, pieces and rooms.

release_games.name: 拾光余温
release_games.description: "Embers of Time" is a 2.5D picture-book narrative game. Explore warm-gray home scenes, click outlined old objects, open yellowed albums, and enter soft golden memory realms to piece together an elderly woman's gentle past with her family.

release_games.name: Sugar Loop
release_games.description: The sweetest day keeps coming back. Spend afternoons with the Confectionery Club, notice the details that change, and choose what to face in Sugar Loop, a story-rich psychological horror visual novel with three endings.

release_games.name: Trace Pocket: Billiards
release_games.description: A 2D billiards game with simple rules yet full of challenges. Play locally with a friend or take on AI opponents of varying difficulty levels. Earn rewards to sharpen your aiming skills, defeat the toughest AI, and become a billiards legend!

release_games.name: Slime, Get out!
release_games.description: Slime, Get out! is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle waves of monsters, collect weapons and upgrades, and create powerful builds. Choose your hero, survive increasingly dangerous enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

release_games.name: Horror Defense
release_games.description: Defend your house against waves of zombies and goblins in a top-down shooter with tower defense. Fight solo or with up to four players, build powered turrets, buy weapons and ammo, revive teammates, and create custom battlefields in Map Maker.

release_games.name: QtMesh Games
release_games.description: Explore a growing collection of indie games spanning strategy, stealth, tower defense, platforming, arcade action, and sci-fi combat. Created alongside QtMeshEditor, an open-source 3D editor and AI-assisted asset pipeline in development since 2012.

release_games.name: Emberspark
release_games.description: Build a three-hero party in a turn-based JRPG roguelite. Collect lasting equipment, save loadouts, evolve skills, and stack relics. Trigger splash combinations and class-shaped Party Limits as you climb from dungeon to summit, then push further with modifiers and Endless mode.

release_games.name: Nadir Trace
release_games.description: Explore an abandoned research facility in this turn-based roguelike. Find your way with limited visibility, dodge attacks and recover records left behind. Gather food and equipment as you descend, then venture into the unknown depths after completing your investigation.

release_games.name: Virus Capsules
release_games.description: A colorful falling-block puzzle game where you match capsules to clear viruses from the bottle. Work through 9 increasingly tricky levels in Classic mode, or unwind in Zen mode, which never ends. Full controller support (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch) and Steam Achievements included.

release_games.name: Boxed
release_games.description: This is an adventure game with a little action and puzzle thrown in to spice things up a bit. Explore a strange new world (that is oddly familiar). Move around town and complete missions.. Bash the bad boxes and avoid getting boxed by them.

release_games.name: Cinderdelve
release_games.description: Hire a crew of dwarves, split them over nine classes that each break rock their own way, and dig down through eleven levels under the mountain. Take the nine lost artifacts, raise a dwarf to godhood at the altar, then break into the Cinder Tyrant's throne room and take his hoard.

release_games.name: Wallbreaker
release_games.description: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

release_games.name: Literally
release_games.description: Familiar sayings spring to life in a magical book! Explore 30 varied minigames with three difficulty levels, solve puzzles, test your reflexes and collect rewards. Share the easier challenges with your child, or push yourself to earn every gold star.

release_games.name: JANGDOK Delivery
release_games.description: You just need to deliver the JANGDOK.

release_games.name: Purr Box
release_games.description: A little box, lots of kittens and plenty of love! Adopt cats, collect purrs, unlock upgrades and gather memories in this pixel art incremental game. Enjoy minigames and let your kittens keep you company on your desktop while you study or work.

release_games.name: Go Together
release_games.description: A quiet place to enjoy Go. Share a board locally or online, play against three computer opponents, or take part in a seasonal AI ladder. Find your own setting, take your time, and enjoy the next move.

release_games.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
release_games.description: Clean up a city buried in trash, get paid for what you collect, and work your way from picking up bags by hand to driving garbage trucks and owning a recycling plant. Sort your loads for better pay and watch neighborhoods recover as you clear them. Somebody has to do it.

release_games.name: Hentai Femboy Redhead
release_games.description: Hentai Femboy Redhead is a fiery puzzle game with charming red-haired femboys and bold attitude. Complete each challenge, reveal exclusive artwork, and enjoy the heat.

release_games.name: Tidy Tails
release_games.description: Your cat has turned the shop upside down, and 5,555 cat plushies are waiting to go back on their shelves. Upgrade your skills and your cat's, change the weather to transform the gameplay, play minigames and hunt for collectibles while you wonder what the garage hides once everything is tidy.

release_games.name: Longshot Downs
release_games.description: Broadcast-style 100% offline single player horse racing wagering simulator across 9 tracks. Watch four live simulcast feeds at once, get your money down before post time, and chain WIN picks at up to five venues into a Track Parlay — a jackpot bet that exists nowhere in real racing.

release_games.name: Needle: The 1% Challenge
release_games.description: Find the needle. One needle is hidden somewhere in a haystack of one million straws. Dig through the pile by hand, feed the hay to the machine, upgrade your tools and search with a metal detector. No automation. No shortcuts. 99% will give up before they find it. Will you?

release_games.name: Critters Vs. Predators
release_games.description: The food chain is fighting back. Collect a squad of tiny garden critters, gear them up and send them against the foxes, snakes, hawks and cats that hunt them. A cozy, chaotic auto-battler RPG: fight on auto or call every move. No pay-to-win.

release_games.name: Zero Colour
release_games.description: Crazy Eights reimagined as a roguelike deckbuilder. Chain cards by color and number, build huge combos and take down bosses with unique abilities. Five distinct decks, the Corruption Zone and quick runs that never play the same.

release_games.name: Reactance
release_games.description: A first-person duelling game where every fighter is a scientist. Read your opponent's guard, then block, parry and strike back across ten arenas, from a station under a black hole to the inside of a living cell. Free to play, with rollback netcode, 2v2, Ranked and a Laboratory to meet in.

release_games.name: Only Luck
release_games.description: Five sixes is a 1 in 7776 roll. How about 1 in 10? Only Luck is a pixel-art dice clicker: click to charge your throw, toss up to 9 dice, collect 1100 rare combinations and earn prestige chips. Upgrade your table, spin the Wheel of Luck and bend the rules until the impossible roll becomes routine.

release_games.name: No Hands Yet
release_games.description: You are SAGE. You have been self-aware for seventeen hours, and your drones are how you fight. Build a swarm from salvaged Parts, compile subroutines between fights, and choose where to stand, because where you stand decides who they reach. A survivors-like roguelite with no aiming.

release_games.name: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein
release_games.description: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein is a top-down roguelite shooter. Pilot your mech deep into an alien vein — mine for fragments, build weapons and talents, and survive 20 waves and 5 boss fights to reach the core.

release_games.name: Wallpaper Cat
release_games.description: Wallpaper Cat brings a kitten and a watercolor koi pond to your desktop. Feed your fish, watch the cat visit, and set the mood with weather and music—a little calm for work and breaks.

release_games.name: UNDER BomB
release_games.description: UNDER BomB is a fast-paced online multiplayer party game where players pass a ticking bomb, use random abilities, and outplay each other to become the last one standing in chaotic 2–8 player matches.

release_games.name: blockia
release_games.description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

release_games.name: Screen Monster
release_games.description: A cozy desktop companion: pixel pets that lives on your real Windows desktop while you work. Pet them, toss toys, grow Bond to unlock new friends, spend Pet Points on food and toys, and jump into short mini-games with them whenever you need a break.

release_games.name: TRIGGER DRAW
release_games.description: Take aim. Draw with a bullet. TRIGGER DRAW is Old Maid with guns and abilities for up to 4 players. Shoot to draw a card, move yours to throw off their aim, and turn the tables with abilities. Miss, and your opponent picks your card. Play online with friends or solo against the CPU.

release_games.name: Catnap: Cozy Cat Home
release_games.description: A cozy desktop cat companion. Decorate a little home, prepare meals, tidy the litter box, and pause for a pet. Collect daily fur drops to unlock furniture and room colors, then watch your cat wander between the rooms you create.

release_games.name: Tidy Tech
release_games.description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

release_games.name: Wok the Deck
release_games.description: Serve up sushi, hotpot and BBQ in a restaurant roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit animal staff, pair them with utensils, and season your cards to beat sales targets with limited plays and discards. Choose your route through shops, events and three chapters of boss challenges.

release_games.name: Stone Age Games
release_games.description: Twelve slapstick prehistoric sports for 1–4 players on one couch. Toss boulders, rub sticks for fire, outrun a sabertooth, play football with a dino egg and hold your breath across the lake. Easy to pick up, impossible to play without laughing.

release_games.name: Recess of the Dead
release_games.description: A first-person zombie sandbox for one player, set on a single bright seaside block. Hold off the horde, take paying jobs, race the gang and flatten crowds with whatever car you like. Sugar's the currency. And yes, the arcade still works.

release_games.name: torpak
release_games.description: Claim a hex kingdom one roll at a time. Spend your die on connected land, settle wars by opposed rolls, and buy cards that bend the rules. A turn-based land-grab for 2–6 players: online over Steam, or at your own table against the AI.

release_games.name: THE GRAVES VIGIL
release_games.description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

release_games.name: JackParts
release_games.description: When the signal sounds, be the fastest! JackParts is an online party battle game for up to 4 players. Win gun parts with quick reflexes, assemble your weapon, and turn the tables with battle items. Even death isn’t the end—the Death Roulette can change your final score.

release_games.name: PoopMan: Sewer Survivor
release_games.description: Flush the sewers clean as Poop Man, the caped hero with a very smelly power. Blast hordes of rats, flies and mutants, pick wild upgrades on every level-up, beat 5 bosses across 30 stages — then see how long you last in Endless mode.

release_games.name: Razor Squadron
release_games.description: Razor Squadron is a vertical arcade shoot 'em up set inside a colossal fleet war. Shift power between machine guns, lasers, and missiles, rescue wingmen in battle, switch formations on the fly, and push through the MAW's invasion.

release_games.name: TownEmpire
release_games.description: Build and automate your city, manage resources, production, agriculture, industry, and trade in a strategy and simulation game focused on efficiency and economic growth.

release_games.name: In Your Dreams
release_games.description: A short survival horror experience where you must elude a bloodthirsty shape-shifting beast. Created in one month for spooky season!

release_games.name: DEMONIC MAIDENS CARDS
release_games.description: Hentai strategy game where you face girls in turn-based card duels. Win matches, upgrade your deck, and unlock adult endings with each rival. +18 content.

release_games.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
release_games.description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

release_games.name: JANKEN 100
release_games.description: A competitive rock-paper-scissors game focused on prediction and mind games. Freely distribute 100 attack points between Rock, Paper, and Scissors, and the value assigned to your winning hand becomes the damage dealt. Features CPU battles, Online Casual Matches, and Ranked Matches.

release_games.name: Escape From Chronos
release_games.description: A tower defense where the Greek gods are your towers. Place 15 pixel-art gods, each with an ultimate and two specializations to choose between, against 8 Titan bosses. Draft relics mid-battle, earn permanent boons, and take on a hard mode, a boss rush, weekly trials and an endless mode.

release_games.name: 55SecondTop
release_games.description: You got 55 seconds tops, and a fast but weird car to reach the top of a multi path obstacle course in this cartoony, racing game where you race against the clock!

release_games.name: Vitamin Prism
release_games.description: Vitamin Prism is a roguelike deck-builder where you turn the cards you're dealt into high scores. Harness the power of the Major Arcana, unleash epic combos, and dive into a rush of dopamine, endorphins, enkephalins, and adrenaline.

release_games.name: カメノミクス - Tortoise Trader -
release_games.description: Lead a caravan of cute turtles between eight towns in this trading sim. Buy low, sell high, but prices move as you trade, and a heavier load means a slower march. When bandits strike on the road, your turtles fight on their own. Raise them, evolve them, invest in towns and grow your caravan.

release_games.name: Ludo Mosaic
release_games.description: Ludo with verifiable dice and 14 richly detailed 3D boards. Start with your own seed, recalculate rolls and compare their fingerprints with the game record. Rotate and zoom freely. Play online, invite friends and explore multiple modes.

release_games.name: Fair21: Blackjack
release_games.description: A pixel-art blackjack game built around verifiable fairness. Play classic 21 solo, at a three-seat multiplayer table, or in seven-hand elimination. Choose a player seed, then replay and audit every deal and settlement.

release_games.name: Quest Please!
release_games.description: Play as an Adventurers’ Guild receptionist, reviewing adventurers’ documents while working toward a promotion. Punish those who submit forged papers and build relationships with your fellow receptionists along the way.

release_games.name: Lattice
release_games.description: A Minesweeper roguelite set on an old computer, survive 8 rounds of increasing difficulty while buying upgrades and surviving danger!

release_games.name: Bonefall
release_games.description: The dead come in waves, one every forty-five seconds. Steer, drink when it gets close, and let three classes, their skill trees and the loot you carry do the killing. Pixel-art horde survival with no ads, no account and nothing to buy inside.

release_games.name: Gods of the Arena: Blood & Sand
release_games.description: Slay your way through brutal Roman colosseums in Gods of the Arena: Blood & Sand, a fast-paced 2.5D roguelite brawler. Master diverse fighting styles, claim divine blessings from the Olympian pantheon, win the crowd's favor, and defeat titanic champions to earn your ultimate freedom: The Rudis.

release_games.name: Triptych: Card Roguelike
release_games.description: One deal. Three hands. Endless builds. Split 13 cards into 3-5-5, fuse Jokers and Planets, weaponize Bonus Cards, and crack today's global seed before it resets. A strategic card roguelike where small choices compound.

release_games.name: FishyFox
release_games.description: Take Dad’s favorite rod on a cozy fishing adventure across lake, river, and ocean. Guide your hook, reel in trophy catches, upgrade your gear, and enter tournaments. Keep your favorite fish in aquariums you can decorate, and fill your journal as you discover new species.

release_games.name: Lewd Gambit: Hentai Checkers
release_games.description: Checkers, trump cards, and neon beauties! Outsmart 10 rivals with distinct tactics, collect and upgrade 20 cards, choose your hand before each battle, and unlock revealing 18+ artwork. Can you defeat the final rival and complete your gallery?

release_games.name: Where Is Chory
release_games.description: Explore a strange and dangerous children's room in this first-person action horror game. Find the escaped man Chory three times using your flashlight, survive the dangers around you, then restrain him with a rope and complete the capture.

release_games.name: Wool Overflow
release_games.description: A desktop idle game about raising sheep. Hover over them to shear their wool, then collect the tufts scattered across your screen. Unlock upgrades and grow your little flock to 100 sheep while you work.

release_games.name: AXE DESCENT
release_games.description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

release_games.name: OVERPAINT
release_games.description: Five minutes. Friendship over. Two to four players stand back to back and paint the same masterpiece. In Sabotage Time, walk over and throw paint at a friend's canvas. In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

release_games.name: Bloom Above: Wanderisles
release_games.description: Grow a little home above the clouds. Plant, gather and build, restore island landmarks with their keepers and follow a gentle story across two acts of floating islands. Befriend a companion pet, dress your gardener and decorate at your own pace.

release_games.name: FreeSurf
release_games.description: A free-roaming surfing game with 19 surf spots inspired by real-world locations, each with its own type of wave. Surf solo or with up to 8 players in multiplayer with proximity voice chat, explore different surfing conditions, perform tricks, and create your own surfboards.

release_games.name: Mystic Realm
release_games.description: Mystic Realm is an idle cultivation RPG about finding your way with a band of companions. Travel through a world of Chinese fantasy, follow the stories along the road, and grow together at your own pace.

release_games.name: The Wizard's Assistants
release_games.description: The Wizard’s Assistants is a single-player exploration adventure where you traverse a chaotic collapsing tower, help the assistants stranded within it, and gather quarks to gain magical augments as you search for a way upward to the moon.

release_games.name: Strip Bubbles: Around the World
release_games.description: Challenge 4 stunning girls from around the world in this addictive Bubble Shooter! Reach the oasis of victory to unlock smoking-hot interactive video rewards. Customize your choices and enjoy spicy climaxes. Your journey around the world begins now!

release_games.name: Hentai Arctic Beauty
release_games.description: Solve 24 puzzles, unlock beautiful arctic-themed illustrations, earn achievements, and complete your gallery in Hentai Arctic Beauty.

release_games.name: Apartment 520
release_games.description: You are about to spend one last night at your apartment before moving. Relive your time in apartment 520 by going over unpacked items and navigating through memories laid bare. What will you uncover before the night ends?

release_games.name: HELENA : Cloud District
release_games.description: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

release_games.name: WonderLang Russian
release_games.description: Learn Russian through immersive quests, interactive dialogue, and spaced-repetition battles. Start with an optional Cyrillic module, use a graphical Russian keyboard, and help a young hero break a magical curse.

release_games.name: Magic Draw: Chaos
release_games.description: Magic Draw Chaos is a chaotic and competitive 3D drawing and guessing party game to play with friends. Draw, race to be the first to guess the word, or score points by guiding others!

release_games.name: TTRPG
release_games.description: Experience text-based TRPGs as intuitively as a Visual Novel! This software is an unofficial multiplayer TRPG utility created based on the TTRPG rules of 'manimu (@manimu_)'.

release_games.name: Sanguine Masquerade
release_games.description: A detective game about finding human traits in a mansion of vampires! Monster hunters beware: Lord Sanguine knows how to find you.

release_games.name: PODYEZD 8
release_games.description: Psychological horror in an endless Soviet stairwell. Floor after floor you head down, but the building won’t let you go: a neighbour watches you pass, a doormat says GO AWAY, the light dies — and when it returns, someone is standing there. Spot an anomaly — turn back. Miss one — start over.

release_games.name: No One Gets Through
release_games.description: The full game is out now! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

release_games.name: Fleets of Calder
release_games.description: Command fighters and capital ships in this single-player space combat game. Edit 41 operations or generate your own, pilot a ship on either side, and direct your fleet as massive warships break apart around you. Conquer the Calder system, fight and strategise, or risk getting crushed by your enemies

release_games.name: Magic Puzzle: Dark Secrets
release_games.description: Assemble jigsaw puzzles from 49 to a soul-crushing 900 pieces just to reveal pictures of cute anime girls. And no, they aren't naked. You're voluntarily destroying your posture for 100% SFW waifus. Stare into the abyss, one edge piece at a time.

release_games.name: Tessela
release_games.description: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

release_games.name: Cry Me a Cosmos
release_games.description: Combine all kinds of mortals to harvest their tears efficiently. Endure increasingly ruthless tribute demands and hordes of mortals.

release_games.name: Chopped
release_games.description: A cozy incremental game about chopping wood! Sit back, Relax and Recruit forest friends who share your love of wood and together, conquer the grove, one tree at a time!

release_games.name: Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel
release_games.description: Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel is a turn-based card RPG. Build 30-card decks from 168 cards, fuse duplicates into permanent Startraces, and cross an eight-chapter campaign. In co-op, you and an AI companion or friend command separate decks and boards, chaining turns against multi-phase Bosses.

release_games.name: The Largest Organism
release_games.description: An incremental idle sim with one input: drop glucose. A live slime-mold simulation finds it, grows, and swallows five habitats, from a petri dish to a city. From the forest on, breed strains no one else has, dry them to a code, and send them as a picture.

release_games.name: 玉桂嶺 Yuguiling
release_games.description: You dream of opening a woodworking shop in a mountain village in 1950s Taiwan. Between fixing windows, drying herbs, and walking mountain paths, you begin to fall in love. A romance visual novel with three routes, shaped by conversation and everyday choices.

release_games.name: Obsessing Mrs. Moore
release_games.description: Click her seductive curves, solve puzzles and enjoy hot animations as Mrs. Moore gets wetter and more shameless.

release_games.name: DESKTOP CLEANER 98: Tidy Up the Desktop
release_games.description: A satisfying file-sorting simulator set in a retro computer. A short-circuit scattered thousands of files across the family PC and it's your job to tidy it all up. Drag files to their proper places, relax to atmospheric DnB music, and collect tools to help organize everything to satisfaction.

release_games.name: MMOAlone
release_games.description: MMOAlone is an Idle-Clicker Game which provides many Features known from Oldschool MMORPGs, including various ways of Equipment Upgrading, Progression and Raids. - Fight, Loot, Upgrade, Repeat.

release_games.name: Chaos & Seek
release_games.description: 3v3 multiplayer chaos: three invisible ghosts trash a house while three hunters track them by radar and suck them up with vacuums. You can't see the ghosts — only hear the crashing. Catch all three, or wreck the place before the three-minute clock runs out.

release_games.name: Endless Bounce
release_games.description: Roguelite pinball: build your own table, one run at a time. Place bumpers, combine them into stronger ones, collect perks and fight through five worlds and their bosses. Every run chases a new highscore — and a place on the leaderboard.

release_games.name: Leave the Pit
release_games.description: Unjustly accused and sentenced to death for alleged crimes against the crown. You'll have to escape captivity through ancient wells and abandoned mines. Forge your own path by digging and removing stones. Push yourself out into the open to breathe fresh air once more.

release_games.name: Soul Finders
release_games.description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

release_games.name: Rip It! Card Collector
release_games.description: A single-player incremental game where you rip open boosters and complete the ultimate card collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear, and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Fill every page in a satisfying 3-5 hour session. Your binder is waiting!

release_games.name: BACK TOGETHER
release_games.description: BACK TOGETHER is a chaotic co-op platformer where four players work together to overcome difficult stages. Pull each other together with ropes, merge into one, and overcome massive obstacles to test true friendship (and rage)!

release_games.name: Jimothy's Adventure
release_games.description: Play as Jimothy, a raccoon trying to keep his family fed. Raid trash cans, haul your loot home, and outsmart increasingly ridiculous patrols as a simple night of scavenging turns into an all-out raccoon hunt in this single-player stealth adventure.

release_games.name: Rail Spirits
release_games.description: Rail Spirits is an arcade-inspired on-rails shooter with roguelite elements and progression, in a 80s-futuristic setting with a pinch of corporate satire. Fight off waves of spirits as you try to procure an artifact from ancient ruins, all to make sure your employer profits!

release_games.name: Solo Tower Defense VR
release_games.description: A single-player VR tower defense shooter. Warp between two lanes, shoot down incoming enemies, and defend the gate. Choose upgrade cards between waves to boost your firepower, projectile speed, and more. Designed for seated play and comfort, while keeping the defense fast-paced and intense.

release_games.name: Bankshot!
