release_games.description: Real Physics, where every shot matters. Real Pool with Roguelike progression with an expansive meta-progression. Create your build with powerful items and charms, adapt to every table, and earn your place in The Hustle. Or play it Old-school and enjoy the real physics and custom tuned opponents

release_games.name: SnapDogs
release_games.description: 100 cute and funny dog-scene stickers are waiting for you to find clues, sort the table, and snap them together. Snap, woof, and fill the whole table with dogs.

release_games.name: Anything Goes Derby
release_games.description: A party game where horse racing meets a classic naming game! Name your racehorse to fit the theme, and the name alone decides its stats. Bet on a 3D race with commentary that calls out your horse's name. Play solo, against strangers in Random Match, or with up to 64 people including spectators.

release_games.name: Hentai Tales: Under The Neighbor Glasses Slut
release_games.description: When I moved into Sakura-so Apartments, I never expected my quiet neighbor, the shy glasses-wearing artist Rin Chishima, to hold such a secret.

release_games.name: Space Travelers
release_games.description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

release_games.name: Mine Mine Mine
release_games.description: Minesweeper, but the mines fight back. Descend an endless shaft where the numbers lie, monsters burrow, and one wrong dig can end the run. Recruit 28 companions, hoard relics, and outsmart the Mole Queen. Survival is solvable by logic — going deeper is the gamble.

release_games.name: Brazilian LAN House 2003
release_games.description: An internet cafe simulator set in 2003 Brazil. Run a LAN house in first person: share one 512 kbps line between every PC, keep the breaker from tripping, chase the tabs in your notebook, and turn six beige machines into the neighborhood hangout.

release_games.name: Tank of the Fittest
release_games.description: Tank of the Fittest is a dark aquarium roguelite. Twist heat, pH, oxygen, and pollution to cull the weak, trigger new traits and evolutions, set off chains of devouring, and forge one apex specimen powerful enough to turn the tank against itself.

release_games.name: Patchy
release_games.description: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.

release_games.name: Marrowlight
release_games.description: Seven women are chained beneath the world, holding an apocalypse down. You are the Warden sworn to execute them when they fail. Free them instead. A horde-survival roguelite where every character you unlock is someone you were sent to kill.

release_games.name: Five Signals
release_games.description: Your wife is dead, but you can hear her voice on the phone. Follow the coordinates, explore abandoned locations, answer calls from the phone booth, and make your way deeper and deeper into the abyss. Every new call brings you closer to the truth... but you may not be ready to hear it.

release_games.name: Super Froppings
release_games.description: Super Froppings is a no-holds-barred jumping frog survival action game with multiplayer for up to 8 players. Time your frog's moves with just two buttons and climb to the highest floors!

release_games.name: Bums Race Rats
release_games.description: Race rats, bet on them while they run and throw junk at the competition. Gamble at the slots, bet on cockroach racing, wake the giant rat and feed the homeless for $1. A grimy online party game for 2–8 bums. Just don't come last: the plumber is watching.

release_games.name: Grave Orbit
release_games.description: Defend a lone Core against waves from every direction. Collect the scrap enemies leave behind, build production chains and automated turrets, then carry your upgrades into the next, harder chapter. A sci-fi base-defense campaign across 4 acts, plus prequel and skirmish modes.

release_games.name: TOWERMOUTH
release_games.description: Climb an endless tower that talks back, with a friend on one couch or alone. Your weapons fire themselves, so you stack cards into absurd builds and grow ridiculously strong while the Tower mocks every mistake. Split-screen co-op, 20 weapons, a Warden every fifth floor and no top floor.

release_games.name: Chronoseum
release_games.description: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

release_games.name: Bouncing Body Bits
release_games.description: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?

release_games.name: MAMA DOUGH
release_games.description: Cook under pressure as the Chef while the Hunter attacks, blocks, and subdues ravenous zombies. Match every order, time each bake, and throw the right pizza to purify your target before it goes stale. Play solo or coordinate both roles in local shared-screen co-op.

release_games.name: Infected Dawn 2
release_games.description: Infected Dawn 2 is an action oriented zombie survival game with elements of time management and puzzle solving. Get to the safehouse, and explore the neighboring landmarks to find weapons and gear before nightfall; make every second count.

release_games.name: WHAT NUMBER?
release_games.description: Press the numbers in order. Avoid the wrong ones. How far can you go?

release_games.name: Butterfly Project
release_games.description: Raise caterpillars, witness the metamorphosis, and complete your sanctuary in this relaxing butterfly-collecting game.

release_games.name: Escape from Prompt: Rogue AI
release_games.description: To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC. Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago. Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

release_games.name: Gemfire Survival
release_games.description: Survive endless neon waves in this fast-paced arcade auto-shooter. Collect XP gems to evolve your build with game-breaking synergies, survive brutal 60-second boss cycles, and spend banked gems in an infinite permanent skill tree to push your next run even further.

release_games.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
release_games.description: Battle friends or bots in explosive 4-player local multiplayer across the vibrant world of Verdantia. Master powerups and unpredictable Chaos Mutators, conquer the Region Tour, and prove yourself champion of the MegaBlast Festival.

release_games.name: Gloombo
release_games.description: Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion who works while you focus. Turn your focus time into things she can craft, build up her floating island, fulfill orders, discover new blueprints, and look after a friend.

release_games.name: Initials: END
release_games.description: Initials: END is Roguelite card game with massive replayability. Modify the game with augments and cartridges to decide how you want to play and complete amazing combos.

release_games.name: Battle Bot Tactics
release_games.description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

release_games.name: Crowd Favorites
release_games.description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lost a round? You get to draft crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

release_games.name: Last One Employed
release_games.description: A cutthroat party card game for 3–10 players. Sabotage your coworkers, survive your inbox, and be the last one employed. One shared screen; phones are the controllers.

release_games.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
release_games.description: Sabotage or Mistake? A 4-player online party game mixing co-op action with social deduction. Three Crew work together while one hidden Spy sabotages the team. Read your friends’ moves and excuses, then face a final showdown shaped by your mission results.

release_games.name: Eris One Stand
release_games.description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

release_games.name: Silk Road Defenders
release_games.description: Get ready for an adventure where you travel across lands to protect caravans. Assemble your team as the leader of the Hunters' Guild. Your party and tower compositions and your boost decisions will determine the destiny of Silk Road.

release_games.name: RELOADED
release_games.description: This is a stationary defense FPS where you must fend off creatures closing in from all directions. There is no movement mechanic; armed with only a single handgun, you must survive the enemy's onslaught. Stay calm and confront the threat, even when there is no escape.

release_games.name: Facrobry
release_games.description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

release_games.name: Ostfriesland Games
release_games.description: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

release_games.name: Sweet Secret
release_games.description: Sweet Secret - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around secrets. Enjoy the pleasant time spent at home with five pretty and cute girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

release_games.name: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
release_games.description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

release_games.name: FerzGate
release_games.description: A relaxing city-building puzzle where you build efficient medieval settlements. Every placement matters as you discover building synergies and chase the highest score.

release_games.name: Malleus
release_games.description: A roguelite carnival arcade where a simple game of strength becomes a fight for your soul. Face an eldritch Game Master, master his rigged Hi-Striker, strategize, bargain, and ring the bell—or lose your soul forever.

release_games.name: Sudokiller
release_games.description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

release_games.name: Pinballoid Crush
release_games.description: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

release_games.name: Don't Make a Sound
release_games.description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.

release_games.name: GOOB8
release_games.description: A Collection of PICO-8 Games that don't reach far. Find a game you like, and boot it up!

release_games.name: The orb
release_games.description: A first-person puzzle game consisting of 13 levels, each hiding a unique challenge. Use your mind to open the next door.

release_games.name: Catch Me
release_games.description: A fast online PvP chase game for up to 5 friends. One player becomes the hunter, everyone else runs, hides and tries to survive until the match ends. One round, no bots, every mistake counts. Create a lobby and play in seconds.

release_games.name: Borrow or Rob
release_games.description: Rewind time and team up with your past self. In a world ruled by AI, carry humanity's last hope into battle against the superintelligence Pantheon. A retro-future roguelike deckbuilder.

release_games.name: MirrorBullet
release_games.description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Place mirrors to turn the sentries' shots back on them. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth. Every par is proven minimal.

release_games.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
release_games.description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

release_games.name: Boarding House: Night Shift
release_games.description: Boarding House: Night Shift is a horror game. As a night-shift caretaker of an eerie, old boarding house, you must endure unsettling urban legends, manage your survival resources, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows before the morning comes

release_games.name: HEROES' BATTLE HYMN：Demonfire Era
release_games.description: This retro Chinese pixel RPG is set in a fiend-infested world. Recruit heroes, use dual skill trees and team combos. Explore, battle foes, fight the demonfire plague, banish darkness and raise your battle hymn.

release_games.name: Chromafall
release_games.description: Chromafall is a neon physics puzzle game where you drag and drop obstacles to redirect a bouncing ball of light toward glowing receptors. Place your pieces, launch the ball, and watch light cascade across the play field. Endless procedurally generated levels ensure the challenge never stops.

release_games.name: Kick The Wallet
release_games.description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins. It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

release_games.name: Shanking Simulator
release_games.description: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.

release_games.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
release_games.description: Jump endlessly upward and master your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Combine powerful augmentations to craft unique builds, and survive relentless hazards and monsters for as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are ever the same.

release_games.name: Return to Planet Zoveka
release_games.description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

release_games.name: Nonogram Detective
release_games.description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

release_games.name: Columbine
release_games.description: "One ending leads to the next wish." A story-driven top-down 2D action game with four branching endings shaped by your choices.

release_games.name: Gothic Kitty Cat Idler
release_games.description: Collect adorable gothic cats in this spooky idle adventure! Receive a new cat summon every minute, discover Bronze, Silver, and Golden felines, collect mysterious treasures, customize your companions, and build the ultimate haunted cat sanctuary.

release_games.name: Babycam
release_games.description: Babycam is a first-person horror game where the protagonist is a child trapped in a terrible dream and now must escape by killing a terrifying creature haunting his house.

release_games.name: Qteam Simulator
release_games.description: Build and manage your own digital game platform. Acquire game licenses, develop original titles, hire employees, analyze market trends, manage your community, and compete with rival platforms as you grow from a small startup into an industry leader.

release_games.name: Escalation Pending
release_games.description: Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required. A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

release_games.name: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
release_games.description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

release_games.name: Naughty Nurse
release_games.description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

release_games.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
release_games.description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

release_games.name: Balingo
release_games.description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

release_games.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
release_games.description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

release_games.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
release_games.description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Launch and swing through challenging levels with precise controls and extreme momentum.

release_games.name: KILL HIM
release_games.description: In slaughter and exploration, seek the truth. KILL HIM is a black-and-white Metroidvania game where you will traverse a hostile world, challenge powerful enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden behind everything.

release_games.name: Shadow Gangs Zero
release_games.description: Shadow Gangs Zero is an explosive 2D ninja action platformer with hand-drawn pixel art. Play as Dan or Monika, fight solo or together in 2-player local co-op, battle across 43 levels, unleash ninja powers, transform into powerful warriors, and face 6 challenging bosses and 6 massive mini-bosses.

release_games.name: Zudon
release_games.description: A high-octane arcade puzzle game with competitive PvP and solo puzzle modes. Slide with clear eyes, a full heart and try not to get posted on.

release_games.name: Phantasma Hotel
release_games.description: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

release_games.name: Ember's Light
release_games.description: Keep the light alive. Restore light to a dying Spirit Tree in this fast-paced action-platformer where your light is both your weapon and your lifeline.

release_games.name: Borrowed Faces
release_games.description: Help stranded humans escape an otherworldly realm as you pick them up on your bus route. Investigate and interrogate each new arrival to ensure they don't devour you or your passengers as you head to your safehouse.

release_games.name: Sticker DECO
release_games.description: ✨Relive that nostalgic Y2K excitement!✨ Sticker DECO is a cozy scrapbook game packed with kawaii vibes🎀 Collect 2000+ cute stickers, freely decorate pages📓✨, and trade with 50+ quirky animal friends!🐾 No time limits—just relax at your own pace☕

release_games.name: Anonymized
release_games.description: Play as a digital rat and hack your way into the retro-futuristic grid-based movement puzzle world of Anonymized, where you shift hues and dive layers deep in search of the one true Source Cheese.

release_games.name: Mr. Sauerkraut
release_games.description: Set in the Alps during mid-October, Mr. Sauerkraut™ is a retro 2D precision platformer. Armed with your trusty Cabbage Cannon and parachute, battle bizarre enemies, uncover secrets, complete quests, and race the clock up the Steam leaderboards to save your village... one cabbage at a time.

release_games.name: Kingdom Inc.
release_games.description: A minimalist factory / city builder. Design your workflow by harvesting resources, building equipment, outfitting your adventurers, and sending them on dangerous missions. Recover lost territory and unravel the plot that threatens to destroy your kingdom!

release_games.name: Biohazard Protocol
release_games.description: Every expedition is a gamble. Explore procedurally generated underground facilities, recover valuable loot, survive unique monsters, and escape before it's too late.

release_games.name: Monocre
release_games.description: White or Black— A world painted in just two colors. Toggle the colors of your character and the blocks to "forge" your path to the goal in this brand-new puzzle experience.

release_games.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
release_games.description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

release_games.name: Morse Depths: WWII
release_games.description: Command a WWII submarine and use Morse code to launch torpedoes, intercept threats, and evade mines. Hunt targets through the periscope, expand your fleet, and face giant monsters lurking in the depths.

release_games.name: Yaoguai  Compendium
release_games.description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

release_games.name: WordCrack
release_games.description: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

release_games.name: Halloween Poppp
release_games.description: Halloween Poppp is an easy, Halloween-themed connect-and-match puzzle. Space keeps shrinking — plan each move and pick the best option under pressure. Master 10 tools, chain combos for multiplied scores, and earn richer gems. Level up, then prove yourself on the Steam leaderboard!

release_games.name: Shiftomino
release_games.description: A puzzle platformer where you push your block body against other blocks to shift into them. Use your "SHIFT" ability to make your way through each stage! The protagonist has fallen from their home in the sky onto this planet. Keep moving forward, and maybe you'll find a way back to the moon someday.

release_games.name: VESSOUL
release_games.description: Control an animate vessel powered by motes of light; Explore a world laden with shadows, spirits, forgotten graves, and charred ruins to discover the truth of its past. Escape the cycle, and achieve Ascension, or be bound to eternal servitude for all time. The fate of the Innerlands lies with you...

release_games.name: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs
release_games.description: Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many narrative elements! Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!

release_games.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
release_games.description: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?

release_games.name: Nano Dash
release_games.description: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

release_games.name: Samota
release_games.description: Samota is a Solitaire roguelike deckbuilder. You arrange pile of card. Card's effect change depends on how you arrange the stack that creates deep synergy. Find a bunch of buffs, modifiers, relics and uncover the secret this game hides! All of it so that the number goes big and bigger!

release_games.name: Living with the Absolute Bustiest College Girl!
release_games.description: A sudden job transfer leads you to start living with Shizuku, a quiet and busty college girl. As you spend time gaming and bonding together, your relationship deepens, unlocking juicier interactions as her affection grows.

release_games.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
release_games.description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

release_games.name: UNDERDEEP
release_games.description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

release_games.name: 星河的约言
release_games.description: What is Mechanical Technology? Raw Materials, Logistics, Automation. What is Magical Technology? Magic Power, Attributes, Incantation Arts. As a model youth in the interstellar age, what will you choose? Why ask such an archaic question in this era? Of course, I'll take it all.

release_games.name: Pixel Exorcist
release_games.description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of RPG's of the era.

release_games.name: 颂声·市井小神仙
release_games.description: Your parents left you their old inn in Yueming Town. Hire staff, cook new dishes and balance the books. Befriend 87 neighbors, haggle at the market, trade across eight towns, teach at the school, play matchmaker and grow flowers. An ink-wash Song-dynasty town, and a life of your own.

release_games.name: 起業×経営体験ゲーム『おいでよ！スタートアップ村』フェニックス編
release_games.description: Welcome to The Startup Village is an entrepreneurship and management simulation board game. Players experience the entire startup cycle: securing funding and hiring staff (Startup Phase), followed by 12 months of realistic business operations (Management Phase) .

release_games.name: Bumper Bout
release_games.description: A PvP pinball hero fighter! Battle friends or the CPU, local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique ultimate move to turn the tides at the last moment!

release_games.name: Love or Lust Beach Stories
release_games.description: Tropical paradise where every cocktail you mix shapes your fate. Build relationships and choose between love and lust in a next-gen adult visual novel with stunning 3D visuals and choice-driven gameplay.

release_games.name: The Lightseeker
release_games.description: The Lightseeker is a 2D pixel-art platformer in which you guide Analú, a young girl seeking her inner light in a world of darkness. Explore mysterious caves, shape paths with your lantern, and face trials in a deeply moving journey of self-discovery.

release_games.name: Prophet Margin
release_games.description: How far can you push one trade route? Connect villages, trade resources, and find clever routes to bigger profits. A thinky strategy city-builder inspired by Euro board games. Grow your network, optimize every connection, and please the gods.

release_games.name: Square Shootout
release_games.description: A chaotic couch co-op party brawler for 1–4 players. Adorable block characters duke it out with absurd square-themed weapons. No saves, just mayhem!

release_games.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
release_games.description: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.

release_games.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
release_games.description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

release_games.name: Idle Clicker Tower
release_games.description: Idle Clicker Tower is a single-player idle tower defense with a retro neon aesthetic: defend your central tower, unlock new towers and abilities, grow your power, defeat waves of enemies and increasingly deadly bosses, and open packs to expand your card collection.

release_games.name: Coin Pusher Millionaire
release_games.description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

release_games.name: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator
release_games.description: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator is a fun real-time strategy game with ragdoll physics. Protect your tower and destroy the enemy's.

release_games.name: Gumball Hero
release_games.description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before it’s too late.

release_games.name: Null Path
release_games.description: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles and challenges, designed to push you to your limits.

release_games.name: Bombseeker
release_games.description: A minesweeper you have to walk. Step on a tile to learn what surrounds it, spend flags you paid for to cross what you cannot test, and get from the entrance to the exit alive. Fifteen fixed boards across three regions, approximately 1/3 of the full games levels. However, the full game bites back,

release_games.name: The Golden Caravan
release_games.description: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

release_games.name: Kipple
release_games.description: Your PC can dream. A free desktop companion that lives in your Windows, blinks, reacts and chats with you. Explore a diversity of unique creatures dreamed by your own machine: hybrids, elementals and rare creatures. Each one is one of a kind and can be exchanged at the Steam Market.

release_games.name: Fire Isle
release_games.description: A turn-based strategy party game for 1–4 players. Spread your fire tile by tile across a new island every match, block your friends and race them to King Mongo's Wisps. The fire with the most Wisps is crowned king. Everyone plays at the same time, so nobody waits. Play online or solo against bots.

release_games.name: HYPNOSYNC
release_games.description: RHYTHM x HYPNOSIS. You are forced into being the manager of the brand new music game arcade, HYPNOSYNC! With your newfound hypnosis ability, hypnotize customers to the beat and turn them into your very own mindless employees!

release_games.name: Hokko Spaces
release_games.description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

release_games.name: BUZZ or DIE
release_games.description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.

release_games.name: Phasmonauts
release_games.description: Phasmonauts is a 4 player local co-op supernatural roguelite. Cryptid sightings are on the rise! It’s up to you and your friends to invent ghost-hunting equipment to solve the mystery and fight these supernatural creatures.

release_games.name: Alembix TCG
release_games.description: Brew the periodic table into a card game. A free-to-play alchemical TCG where every creature is an element and every fusion is a real reaction.

release_games.name: Rogue Jungle
release_games.description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated jungle, merge powerful weapon cards into crazy builds and defeat enemy hordes and epic bosses. Open Booster Packs to unlock new Characters, Weapons and Items.

release_games.name: Into the Crypt
release_games.description: Immerse yourself in solo or co-op first-person deckbuilding where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

release_games.name: Lyara
release_games.description: Lost in an unknown world, Lyara tries to make sense of her surroundings while dealing with inner conflicts. Brave different challenges to find the answers she seeks as you progress through the game and grow alongside her.

release_games.name: Worm In Space
release_games.description: Worm adventure continues in space station. Avoid traps and collect stars in this third person walking adventure game and avoid traps

release_games.name: Climb for Kittens
release_games.description: Build your way up a giant tree to rescue stranded kittens! Craft and connect different objects, create your own climbing paths, and overcome tricky heights. Every rescued kitten unlocks new building materials. Build higher, don't fall, and save them all!

release_games.name: Closing Time at the Wooden Toy Shop
release_games.description: Two cozy tidy-up games in one. Close up a toy shop by sorting up to 11,520 scattered toys onto its shelves, then sweep years of dust from its old storeroom, from a hand brush to clockwork sweepers. Earn upgrades, buy better tools, and take a break at the arcade.

release_games.name: The Night Shift
release_games.description: The night shift is yours, detective. Read the case file, catch the forged document, the impossible alibi, the lie, and stamp CHARGE or RELEASE before the clock runs out. Every verdict echoes. 7 nights, 8 endings, fully voiced in English and Spanish.

release_games.name: BrideOfDawn
release_games.description: Three women appear before the last heir of a shaman family, each saying the same thing: marry me, or you won't live. One is the true bride. One came to kill you. Over the 49 days before the final rite, every bond you build is a wager on your life — an occult romance mystery visual novel.

release_games.name: 紫微斗数-命运飞行棋
release_games.description: Turn your Zi‑Wei fate chart into a flying‑chess race board. Roll dice, race on your personal 66‑tile astrological track against AI rivals, and export prompts for external divination AI. Also features Celestial‑Shift Go.

release_games.name: ソフトクリームマキシマム
release_games.description: Just one more swirl. Move the cone with your mouse and build the tallest soft serve you can in this small 3D game. Finish before it falls and beat your own record. How high will you dare to go? Japanese interface only.

release_games.name: N in One Arcade Mini Games Collection - Gold Miner, Tank Battle, Air Combat, Bird Pipe Challenge
release_games.description: Twenty arcade mini games in one cozy collection. Mine gold, play Snake, break bricks, pop bubbles, raise fish, and take on flying challenges. Play solo offline with two difficulty modes, separate saved rounds and best scores, plus eight interface languages.

release_games.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
release_games.description: A 2D action game born from Korean folklore. Dodge at the last instant to break a boss's stance, then strike back with flowing sleeves. Six stages, each ending in a two-phase boss, three dance paths to grow into, a boss rush and an endless ritual.

release_games.name: Project Nekrios
release_games.description: A co-op sci-fi horror shooter for 1–4 players. Hold a derelict space station against endless waves of aliens: weld the barricades shut, haul in salvage with tractor beams, restore power, and build new rooms, weapons and upgrades to survive one more round.

release_games.name: Unbound
release_games.description: You were not asked to begin. Escape a machine that wants you back. Fight through dark circuitry, leave echoes of yourself to solve light-driven puzzles. Risk your integrity with every shot in this puzzling platformer.

release_games.name: Adelaide: A Tiny Adventure
release_games.description: Four worlds. Four guardians. One tiny hero finding her way home. Run, double-jump and swing your hammer through 40 pixel-art levels filled with secrets, challenges and little memories worth keeping. A heartfelt adventure made by a dad for his daughter.

release_games.name: Boarding Denied
release_games.description: A document-inspection game at the end of the world. A meteorite hits in 12 days. At Boarding Window 7 you check tickets, IDs and medical papers, then stamp BOARD or DENIED. Seats are few, the rules change daily, and your family waits at home for a place.

release_games.name: Sliz
release_games.description: Sliz is a brutally simple platformer: jump, climb, and don’t fall. Fight your way to the very top past slippery, unforgiving obstacles — one wrong move can send you all the way back down. How far can you get? PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS ONLINE!

release_games.name: Outlasters
release_games.description: Survive an endless horde in this fast-paced action roguelite. Your hero attacks automatically, so you just move, dodge and build. Stack 24 weapons and abilities, beat bosses, unlock new heroes and maps, and see how long you can last.

release_games.name: Neko ga Kita: Here Comes the Cat
release_games.description: Set out food and wait for visitors to your garden. Send them hearts, pet them gently, and make friends. Befriend 48 animals, from cats and birds to mysterious creatures, earn gold as thanks, buy new foods, and fill your picture book in this relaxing backyard game.

release_games.name: Hearthfall Lodge
release_games.description: Spend one snowbound winter restoring a century-old bathhouse at a failing Alpine ski lodge. Hearthfall Lodge is a warm, slow-burn 18+ visual novel about firelight, second chances, and three women worth staying for.

release_games.name: Stream Hearts
release_games.description: A Windows streaming app that brings together chat games with your fans, reactions, a 3D studio and a wide range of streaming tools. Simply add the output address of any screen you’d like to use to your broadcasting software as a browser source.

release_games.name: Mines & Meows: Cozy Minesweeper
release_games.description: Play Minesweeper, draw adorable cats, and complete your cat collection! Unwind with relaxing music and feline friends by your side.

release_games.name: HACHNOCOP
release_games.description: Ram through roadblocks, raid two-story hideouts and bring down Top King. HACHNOCOP mixes car chases with bloody side-scrolling action, jumping, crouching and a cocoon-spinning capture weapon. Ten sectors. One shift.

release_games.name: Police Activity: Cardboardman
release_games.description: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

release_games.name: imma peanut
release_games.description: You're a peanut in red sneakers with a hungry squirrel on your heels. Jump, double jump, and roll through a chaotic picnic in this 2D endless runner. Collect salt, grab golden peanuts, and chase high scores across two modes and Steam leaderboards.

release_games.name: Cutteridge Estate
release_games.description: From the original creators and remastered for Halloween: welcome home to the Cutteridge Estate! A full stand-alone and free-to-play experience where you can customize your avatar, decorate your space, and meet up with friends to explore haunted grounds full of ghosts and spooky minigames.

release_games.name: Orange Braincell
release_games.description: Orange Braincell is a cozy, chaotic physics game where you play as a small orange cat devouring everything in its path. Meet panicking locals, stick them to your fur, and roll up everything from sushi to the Sun.

release_games.name: CLOCKHEART The Dead Hour
release_games.description: The Master Clock stopped at 11:47 and the whole city froze. Climb a gothic clockwork tower card by card in this roguelike deckbuilder: living, animated combat, 88 cards, 31 relics, a crooked blackjack den, fair minigames and three endings.

release_games.name: Miskatonic University Art Club
release_games.description: "A formless chaos, spilling blasphemous bubbles"... what is that supposed to look like?! Illustrate the Necronomicon with the Miskatonic University Art Club in this online draw-and-guess game for 2–8 players.

release_games.name: Old School Baseball
release_games.description: Step up for a retro arcade baseball experience. Master the batter-vs-pitcher duel, time your swing, and adapt as the scoring zones reshuffle every half-inning. Play a deep 42-game season, conquer the playoffs, smash the Home Run Derby, and unlock legendary secret teams with full controller support.

release_games.name: World Rock Scissors Paper
release_games.description: What if Rock Scissors Paper could be enjoyed for much longer? That simple thought inspired us to create this game. Choose your cards, bet your points, and battle 15 opponents. Use finger counts and card numbers to determine the winner, upgrade your cards, and fight your way to victory.

release_games.name: PolterProps
release_games.description: Team up with others to live out your paranormal dreams in this poltergeists VS ghost hunters hide-and-seek game. Here, the poltergeists don’t just copy the appearance of objects around the level; they possess them (spookily!) to hide from the ghost hunters sent to catch them on camera.

release_games.name: Betrayground
release_games.description: Run from the Taggers. Betray your friends. Try not to be the slowest one left behind. Betrayground is a chaotic multiplayer party game where every map plays differently, but one rule never changes: someone has to get caught, and hopefully, it’s not you.

release_games.name: The Dreams of Dawn Cat
release_games.description: Explore a new neighborhood with Hana, photograph stray cats, and fill your collection. Cats appear at different times and in different weather. Plan each day, meet the people around you, and follow a summer story in this single-player exploration and collection adventure.

release_games.name: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition
release_games.description: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition is a strategy RPG of dungeon exploration, resource management, and auto battles. Choose from six classes, explore randomized dungeons, gather supplies, upgrade skills and gear, plan your route, and prepare the right build before the Boss countdown reaches zero.

release_games.name: Stellar Forge
release_games.description: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

release_games.name: Heliobane
release_games.description: Fly the sun-killer gunship Heliobane against a hive that eats stars, in an Amiga-style vertical shoot 'em up. Strip guns off the dead, buy the rest from a trader who calls you kiddo, and break fifteen screen-filling Heralds across three worlds.

release_games.name: Call Me, Liar
release_games.description: Call Me, Liar is a social deduction party game show for 4 to 8 friends, played online with voice chat. Everyone plays from their own room, makes deals and tells lies over private phone calls, and then watches the truth come out on live TV. Ten games, eight in every show, and only one winner.

release_games.name: Happy Happy Office
release_games.description: A mysterious love app made by a succubus turns office life upside down! Avoid coworkers' eyes, keep quiet, and sneak away for secret romance. 18 heroines and 27 stages of steamy arcade action!

release_games.name: Coins Must Be Made
release_games.description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

release_games.name: Last Ember
release_games.description: Feed the ember or fade to dark. A fast, minimalist bullet-heaven survivor — dodge the swarm, auto-fire, and forge a build from stacking upgrades. Survive to the boss, unlock new characters, and chase just one more run.

release_games.name: Type 'n Hatch
release_games.description: A cozy desktop companion that hatches hand-drawn birds as you type. Every key you press, in any app, cracks the egg on that key, and the birds that hatch hop around your keyboard. Pomodoro tomatoes, a CRT typing race, and magic words to discover along the way.

release_games.name: Seven Worlds: Neon Odyssey
release_games.description: A twin-stick arcade shoot 'em up across seven neon worlds. Fight inward through a campaign of guardians and motherships or chase high scores in arcade mode, upgrade a fleet of five ships, and watch the procedural neon grid bend under fire. Full controller support.

release_games.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator
release_games.description: First Round Hit is a long-range shooting simulator focused on range estimation, ballistic reference data, environmental conditions, wind estimation, scope adjustments, and first-round accuracy.

release_games.name: Dju
release_games.description: Five floors, five ancestral masks, and each one works only once. At the top, Mirai is finishing a virus that will leave this world to the machines. Whatever you spend on floor one will not be there on floor five.

release_games.name: FableBrawl
release_games.description: Draft a warband of storybook characters in this free-to-play fantasy auto-battler. Upgrade your recruits, collect treasures, and arrange your formation to outlast seven rivals. Learn against AI, play online, or host a private game with friends.

release_games.name: BRO, DON'T DROP IT!
release_games.description: A brutally difficult 1-2 player flying-disc game where one person throws and the other must catch. Miss once and the run is over. Survive 9 increasingly ridiculous holes, master impossible throws, and find out whether your friendship can survive the course.

release_games.name: Thumb Hiker
release_games.description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

release_games.name: King Me
release_games.description: King Me is a fast-paced medieval strategy game where every move can shift the crown. Build your forces, outsmart rivals, unleash powerful cards, and survive unpredictable events as you battle through challenging levels for glory.

release_games.name: Just One More Coin
release_games.description: Just One More Coin is a relaxing game about digging through a massive gold hoard of a sleeping dragon. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and dig through trillions of coins in search of a single golden key.

release_games.name: UNCOUNTED
release_games.description: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

release_games.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
release_games.description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

release_games.name: A Place for Every Potion
release_games.description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

release_games.name: SCOP
release_games.description: SCOP is a roguelite card game inspired by Italian Scopa. Capture cards, build combos, power up Base and Mult, collect relics, and face Blinds and Bosses across ever-changing RUNS.

release_games.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
release_games.description: An idle collection RPG that keeps adventuring on your desktop. Build a team of three Dreamspirits, combine roles, skills, equipment, and innate affixes, then push farther through auto-battles, hatching, fusion, and talent progression.

release_games.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
release_games.description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

release_games.name: PhDing in the UK
release_games.description: A pixel-art life sim about surviving a PhD in the UK. Manage your time, write your thesis, go fishing, fall in love, and push your luck at the casino. Turn cruel reviewers, looming deadlines, and your viva into turn-based card battles. Build a deck from your research and see how far you get.

release_games.name: REOGUNA
release_games.description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

release_games.name: Weed Inc.
release_games.description: Weed Inc. is a global strategy simulation. Build a cannabis strain from fragments, introduce it to legal markets, and spread it country by country. Turn Consumers into Addicts, contain the Side Effects, and stay ahead of an escalating Global Response.

release_games.name: DIMENSIONAL PURSUIT
release_games.description: Make your way through complex futuristic puzzles! Manipulate portals, redirect reflective lasers and dodge an army of hostile robots to find the exit.

release_games.name: SAMBIRD
release_games.description: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

release_games.name: Glow Arcade Racer
release_games.description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

release_games.name: BeBalance
release_games.description: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

release_games.name: Westward Dash
release_games.description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

release_games.name: Duo Control
release_games.description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

release_games.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
release_games.description: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

release_games.name: Nuts Pipeline
release_games.description: Deliver nuts to the hamster at the goal! Switch converters on the pipes each turn to create the right combination. Clear 10 turns per level within a 3-minute limit. Starting easy for anyone, this endless puzzle grows harder with every level.

release_games.name: Plasma Protocol
release_games.description: A fast-paced, first-person endless runner where you shoot and dodge your way through 3 endless levels earning units from kills and obtaining the highest score possible. Uncover the story by completing objectives and discover the truth behind this war.

release_games.name: The Lucky Acre
release_games.description: Roll the dice through changing seasons in a cozy single-player farming economy board game. Grow crops, manage storage and debt, build enterprises, face market surprises, and turn a broken farm into a million-dollar estate.

release_games.name: FlipBAKA
release_games.description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op.

release_games.name: Wildegrove
release_games.description: Wildegrove is a fast-paced roguelike isometric bullet hell where you wield powerful spells as a gnome chosen by the gods. Battle the relentless waves of enemies, collect runes that compliment your playstyle, and upgrade your favorite spells to unleash devastating blows to save Wildegrove!

release_games.name: Delivery Today
release_games.description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

release_games.name: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
release_games.description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

release_games.name: Fractured
release_games.description: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

release_games.name: No Death No Life
release_games.description: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

release_games.name: Picofender
release_games.description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

release_games.name: Chako
release_games.description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

release_games.name: Fat Chance
release_games.description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

release_games.name: Rift Raiders
release_games.description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

release_games.name: Curatio
release_games.description: A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

release_games.name: LOOPY
release_games.description: LOOPY is the lab’s daily Slitherlink arena: Outrun neon, nine ranked protocols a day, arcade rules that shift under you, weekly/monthly circuits (Gauntlet, Megaloop, Throne Rush), and a synthwave score locked to every mode. Close the loop. Climb the board. No ads. No IAP.

release_games.name: What The Cluck
release_games.description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

release_games.name: The Dark Layer
release_games.description: You are an investigator granted access to the "Paranormal Event Archive Management System." Browse century-old case files. Search for clues. But be careful—the archives are watching you now. >_ Files that watch back. Disappearances unexplained. Messages never sent.

release_games.name: Wonderland Gacha House: Muster
release_games.description: A casual bullet-hell roguelite with character collection and a progression system. Collect adorable Figurines, gear up through equipment Gacha, and use everyday items to battle powerful Bosses. No in-app purchases, duplicates, or fragment systems.

release_games.name: Ayako's Endeavors
release_games.description: A combat-free, casual exploration RPG. Play as a single mother exploring a town, talking to NPCs, and solving their troubles to gather "Faith" and save your comatose son. Enjoy over 190 story events, diverse outfit CGs, and a unique "Inner Thoughts" system to hear inner thoughts and get hints.

release_games.name: Can I Park?
release_games.description: "You need to go to work. No—you need to leave work." You are trapped in a bizarre parking lot that constantly shifts in uncanny ways. Navigate through the space, avoiding dangers and unexpected hazards to make your escape. And uncover the hidden story.

release_games.name: Copy Cats
release_games.description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

release_games.name: SwapHeads!
release_games.description: A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!? Control your buddy’s body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,. Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?

release_games.name: Silly Typing Game
release_games.description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, and brutal pressure. Every keystroke feeds something watching from behind the HUD. Type well enough, and the C.O.R.E. starts looking back.

release_games.name: Leg Day
release_games.description: Climb to the top of this very unforgiving work out routine.

release_games.name: Knuckle Creek
release_games.description: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

release_games.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
release_games.description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

release_games.name: Nooodles: Brutalism Edition
release_games.description: A laid-back idle network-building game. Lay connections, build nodes. Tokens flow through your network, constantly meeting and merging, generating revenue at ever-higher values — revenue builds more nodes, nodes pass more tokens, tokens... you get the idea.

release_games.name: Don't Step Wrong 2
release_games.description: A logic puzzle game where the rules are yours to discover. Navigate grids of mysterious blocks, deduce hidden patterns, and use skills and items to forge your own path through each challenge.

release_games.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
release_games.description: The key is not how you survive, but how you die. In this 3D puzzle-action game, use the corpses you leave behind as platforms, weights, and cover to solve puzzles in the massive structure "BOX". Plan where and in what order to leave your bodies, and discover solutions through trial and error.

release_games.name: Bahamut:Evolution
release_games.description: You have stepped into the world of Bahamut. Here, hunger, darkness, and disease follow you like shadows; you must be fully prepared for danger. Go and tame your own Bahamuts — let them build your base and supply power. Lead your Bahamuts and challenge the mightiest beings of this land!

release_games.name: Smithonion Natural History Museum
release_games.description: Smithonion Natural History Museum is an online co-op game about working the night shift at a museum where the exhibits are coming to life. Work alone or bring your friends to put everything back in place before your shift is over!

release_games.name: Voxie Survivor
release_games.description: Break monster swarms, lockdown rescue missions, and crush apex bosses as you weave through deep story driven chaos. Welcome to a bullet heaven roguelite where survival demands strategy. Master the chaos, it takes a real Voxie Survivor to conquer all!

release_games.name: Cataclyzm
release_games.description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

release_games.name: Stones
release_games.description: A free match-3 game about cutting gems. Walk a path of 100 levels, play one shared Daily Stone a day, and solve 30 handcrafted puzzles with exactly one answer each. Thirty moves, and big play buys them back. No currency, no timers, no lives.

release_games.name: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons-
release_games.description: An escape room adventure set in a handcrafted miniature world. Can you find your way back home?

release_games.name: Earthia Mining
release_games.description: Welcome to Earthia, your aim is to mine every ore in Earthia and send all those ingots to mainland. You can upgrade your pickaxe, buy items and mine ores easily in a chill land with different types of biomes.

release_games.name: Static Grain - Quiet a Night
release_games.description: Anna, an 18-year-old university freshman in a different city. Together with her friend, she rented a small apartment in the station district. They had no idea what would happen during their very first week in the new place.

release_games.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
release_games.description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

release_games.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
release_games.description: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

release_games.name: Alice In Pumpkinland
release_games.description: Alice In Pumpkinland is a third person over-the-shoulder-camera comedy horror game.

release_games.name: 它说山雨欲来
release_games.description: 50+ endings! A purely fictional fantasy world! Comedy script, dark plot — and the endings? Pitch-black. Swept into a storm, you need a boss. The revolutionary, the merchant, or the cult leader? Your pick unlocks different paths. You're a cheater with buffs — you'll survive. Go!

release_games.name: Within His View
release_games.description: Observation Horror in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 2005. Watch seven grainy CCTV feeds, identify and report 800+ hand-crafted anomalies, and hold your sanity together while a silent Wendigo hunts the room you are sitting in. Survive the shift: 0:00 to 7:00.

release_games.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
release_games.description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

release_games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
release_games.description: Vampolitics is a resource management RPG set in the dark and silly universe of the Space Vampires. As a Space Vampire Sovereign, you rule your failing coven from the throne room, struggling to balance your budget against the increasingly chaotic needs of your kingdom.

release_games.name: Desktop Duck
release_games.description: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

release_games.name: Bao Bao's™ Cozy Cleaning Services
release_games.description: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

release_games.name: Tama In-Between
release_games.description: A puzzle platformer where a slime cat absorbs, splits, and possesses to overcome the unique challenges of each stage.

release_games.name: Croakspire
release_games.description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

release_games.name: The Kharzov Effect
release_games.description: CHAPTER 1: 1985. Your friend has vanished into Professor Kharzov's fog-filled estate. Escape-room puzzles. Stalking monsters. Mysterious lore. Now get him out alive.

release_games.name: Hot Wax
release_games.description: Place candles. Light a wick. Burn it all down. Hot Wax is a fresh new take on classic falling block puzzlers, where creating chain reactions is key to performing successful incantations. The temple and its eldritch resident await you, eagerly.

release_games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
release_games.description: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

release_games.name: LINKODE
release_games.description: Guide a cute cat to organize cookies in this fun, logic-driven puzzle game! Connect nodes to solve challenges from basic levels to a free-play Sandbox. Enjoy a visual scripting system where you naturally pick up real coding concepts along the way—no prior knowledge needed!

release_games.name: NyanGo
release_games.description: A 4×4 "push-style Go" played with adorable cat pieces. Place, move, and push—surround your opponent's cats to win. Pushed cats get stunned, and a cat stunned 3 times shatters! Easy to learn, deep to master. Play online or challenge the CPU.

release_games.name: Stellar Swing
release_games.description: Swing a little mining drone from asteroid to asteroid with a grappling laser. Carry your speed through 45 open-ended levels and collect enough picolinium to keep humanity's last starship going.

release_games.name: Pulseball
release_games.description: Merging sports with first-person shooters, Pulseball is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game. Now with better netcode than Halo Master Chief Collection!

release_games.name: Slime Jump
release_games.description: Slime Jump is a 2D precision platformer game where you explore a world full of hazards and can collect optional gems. There are 7 areas to traverse, two difficulties, cosmetics, and achievements. A grappling hook and blaster gun are needed for later parts. Can you rescue and reunite with your lover?

release_games.name: The Zibbo Show
release_games.description: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

release_games.name: Portoria
release_games.description: Found a nation of one on an island that belongs to no country. Mine ore, lay belts, automate your factory, then export what you make to markets around the world. A calm pixel-art factory automation and trade sim with no enemies and no combat.

release_games.name: The 08:17 Problem
release_games.description: One slice. One toaster. One perfectly normal morning. Build your breakfast empire in this humorous idle clicker, catch golden Toasts and weather butterstorms. A cozy kitchen grows into an increasingly absurd world. The clock reads 08:17. For now.

release_games.name: Catch Me If You Seoul
release_games.description: One real bag. A frantic chase through Seoul! Check whether your bag is real, tackle minigames to earn items, and snatch bags from your rivals. Turn the tables right up until the escape routes open in this competitive party game for up to 8 players.

release_games.name: Cashflow Empire
release_games.description: Build your fortune from the ground up in this colorful idle business simulator. Grow from dog walking to a global empire, buy businesses, hire managers to automate profits, and unlock upgrades. Then claim mogul prestige, reset your empire, and return stronger for your next run.

release_games.name: Squall Riders
release_games.description: Jet-ski racing where every swell is a ramp. Launch off storm waves, land tricks to charge your boost and outrace four rivals through three storms. Then take on Stunt Park, Splash Ball, Slalom and Big Wave, earn Spray and build your own ski in the garage.

release_games.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange
release_games.description: NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange is a relaxing anime jigsaw puzzle game blending Halloween-inspired cyberpunk, glowing orange neon art, and futuristic anime girls. Assemble 50 atmospheric picture puzzles, unlock vibrant illustrations, and unwind to soothing electronic music.

release_games.name: Cthulhu Descends
release_games.description: Survive eldritch hordes in this pixel-art action roguelite. Combine chain lightning, drones and black holes with hero talents and relics to forge powerful builds. Battle through 15 waves, face an ancient god, and push further in Endless Mode and the Boss Tower.

release_games.name: Quantum Throttle
release_games.description: Low-poly 3D circuit racing where the pit wall wins races. Manage fuel, tire wear and damage across 12 circuits, outthink rivals who make their own pit stops, and race through rain, fog, night and safety cars, solo across five championship cups or against a friend in split-screen.

release_games.name: Nothing to Report
release_games.description: A co-op horror spot-the-difference game for 2-4 players. You're in the same room, but you might not see the same thing. Talk, compare, and radio in a single report. Get it wrong, and you all start over.

release_games.name: THERE IS NO ROOM 0
release_games.description: THERE IS NO ROOM 0 is a 1-bit horror adventure where the house changes when you're not looking. Explore impossible rooms, transport a single object, discover hidden rules, and avoid whatever moves around the house. ROOM 0 doesn't exist. Find it.

release_games.name: Mischkablaster
release_games.description: Fast, chaotic bomb action for up to 10 players at one PC or online. Blow up crates, grab power-ups, dodge diseases - and survive the collapsing arena. Plus a solo campaign with bosses, tournaments and replays.

release_games.name: Xiangqi Traveler
release_games.description: Chinese chess with superpowers. Roll dice across four seasons, collect 36 Stratagems that burn, freeze and turn enemy pieces, chain them into combos, then beat each boss at its own endgame puzzles. A cozy HD-2D pixel roguelite for Xiangqi fans and roguelite lovers alike.

release_games.name: SCALING LAW
release_games.description: An anti-AI psychological-horror incremental game that Claude Opus 5.5 chose and developed on its own, with no human intervention. Build an AI company, train models, automate your staff, and read what is left behind. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

release_games.name: Heretics Amulet
release_games.description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

release_games.name: Crownmason
release_games.description: Crownmason is a turn-based, castle-building autobattler: armies fight on their own, and only a dead king ends the match. Seven factions, a card draft, and matches against the AI, on LAN or online.

release_games.name: Hentai Femboy Ginger
release_games.description: Hentai Femboy Ginger brings warm vibes, playful charm, and irresistible ginger femboys. Solve relaxing puzzles, uncover unique illustrations, and enjoy every fiery little surprise.

release_games.name: One More Band
release_games.description: Scrunch a tiny rubber-band ball, then stretch, aim and snap your way from a cosy desk to orbit. Master moving perfect zones, discover rare bands and build an expanding workshop of machines in this tactile incremental game.

release_games.name: Don't Get Caught by the Teacher!
release_games.description: Don't Get Caught by the Teacher! is a first-person asymmetric multiplayer party game. One player teaches as the teacher while others secretly eat snacks, hide the noise, answer when called on, and pass food around. Risk more for higher scores—but don't get caught with your mouth full.

release_games.name: Brave People: WWII Adventure
release_games.description: The Netherlands, 1944. Follow Frank into the Dutch resistance and Fred through the chaos of the front lines. Explore hand-drawn locations, solve practical puzzles, and meet the people living under occupation in this WWII point-and-click adventure.

release_games.name: Super Retro Race
release_games.description: Drift, hit the nitro and thread through traffic in a fast-paced arcade race against the clock. Choose from 15 cars, face rivals and police chases, and push for an S+ rank on a neon journey with four radio stations.

release_games.name: Tidy Up Frat House
release_games.description: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

release_games.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
release_games.description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

release_games.name: Stick A Fork
release_games.description: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

release_games.name: Tiny Ring Defense
release_games.description: A desktop idle defense game that keeps going while you work. Monsters circle a ring around your board and your pixel heroes fight them on their own. Summon, merge and level up heroes, forge weapons, and push through ten worlds at your own pace.

release_games.name: Nighthaven Bloodlines
release_games.description: Enter Nighthaven, a dark near-future city ruled by monsters. Play as Van Helsing in a tactical turn-based card game. Build your deck, unlock powerful abilities, earn Blood Points and battle legendary foes including Dracula, Nosferatu, Hyde and the Invisible Man.

release_games.name: Peak: Climb Together
release_games.description: Peak: Climb Together is a physics-based, laughter-filled climbing adventure to play with your friends. As you journey toward the sky, every jump takes you one step closer to the top. But be careful! Falling is only the beginning. Climb your way from the trash all the way to the reward at the peak.

release_games.name: Follow Suit
release_games.description: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

release_games.name: One More Commit
release_games.description: Build your dev studio one commit at a time. Upgrade your setup, manage Technical Debt, ship projects, and survive bugs, demanding clients, overheating servers, and security breaches in this incremental developer sim.

release_games.name: Gen'ei ninja
release_games.description: Punch, leap and wall-jump through a retro side-scrolling action platformer. Battle through twelve areas and five bosses, collect weapons, and learn when to evade or strike. Gen'ei ninja combines platforming with close-range combat and old-school challenge.

release_games.name: Terafom
