release_games.description: Land on a bright sea planet, bop cute slimes, grow land from the sea and build a city with your family. No PvP: a safe online world for the whole family.

release_games.name: IcePath
release_games.description: IcePath is a 2D roguelike puzzle game. Move your token and collect the Data Energy scattered across the map.

release_games.name: Gin Rummy: Pixel Cardroom
release_games.description: Pixel-art Gin Rummy built around fairness verification. Choose your own seed before play, then export the hand record and independently check the card order, moves and final score. Enjoy six rule variants and seven table themes.

release_games.name: Pixel Domino Club
release_games.description: Check every match yourself. Your seed combines with a server seed committed before play; after the match, verify the tile order and scores. Enjoy two-player pixel-art dominoes with Draw, Block and All Fives.

release_games.name: CUTAWAY!
release_games.description: Cut the board, avoid the balls, and reveal anime artwork. Master increasingly challenging levels, earn stars, and unlock new images and special illustrations.

release_games.name: Anime Shop Chaos: Tidy Up!
release_games.description: Collect scattered character parts, assemble 10 big anime figures on their stands, and watch them wave when complete. Organize 5,000 mini figures across 25 collections in this cozy first-person tidying game. Earn upgrades and turn a chaotic shop into your collector's paradise.

release_games.name: Love&Knights Solitaire
release_games.description: Set out on an exciting medieval adventure! Dive into a Medieval European atmosphere!

release_games.name: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
release_games.description: Piecework is a cozy first-person jigsaw and tidying game. There has been an incident at the museum, and thirty masterpieces are now lying on the floor in nearly 28,000 pieces. The museum would very much like them back on the walls.

release_games.name: Warlock: Age of Entropy
release_games.description: A power-hungry warlock descends fifteen floors to unearth a malevolent energy sealed deep in a dungeon. He'll have to use items sparingly, spells tactically, and even recruit the help of forgotten gods to get there in this brutally difficult traditional roguelike.

release_games.name: HypnoX: Steel Riders
release_games.description: An arcade racing action game where you'll face challenging tracks, dangerous obstacles, and a race against time. Ride different motorcycles, fight bosses, use weapons, powerups and overcome crazy challenges.

release_games.name: Cozy Associations
release_games.description: A cozy card puzzle about finding what belongs together. Match words and pictures, gather them into categories, and tidy up the board. Get comfy with 100 levels, 10 charming settings, and a little daily puzzle just for you.

release_games.name: MEGA TAG PANIC
release_games.description: Tag — but IT keeps GROWING. The giant tagger can't fit through narrow doors, and that's your way out. Charge your slap, release it in the RED, send a friend flying. 2-10 players, 12 maps, 6 modes, 10 characters with 10 special powers. Nobody online? The bots don't go easy on you.

release_games.name: Capture The Parcel
release_games.description: Capture the Parcel is a fun, fast-paced first person shooter where you race to collect and deliver a parcel to your drop zone. Battle your friends to capture the most parcels!

release_games.name: Wreckums
release_games.description: You're a tiny one-eyed space creature. Humanity wants you contained. Dodge volleys, smash human spacecraft with banked Wreckballs, and eat their wreckage to heal and mutate. Build a hungry little menace in this neon bullet-hell action roguelite.

release_games.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
release_games.description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

release_games.name: MachineGunner3 : Cosmos Ascending True
release_games.description: MachineGunner 3 is a casual 2d racing shooter game that Player moves AIM and accelerates or decelerates to take down the enemys. Rush through the space, Use proper type and carry proper speed for more score, And finish the stage!

release_games.name: Tidy Arcana
release_games.description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

release_games.name: Synapse Grid
release_games.description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 19–26 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

release_games.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
release_games.description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

release_games.name: Alien Tenant Wants Horny Energy
release_games.description: An alien tenant falls from the sky, bringing mysterious technology with her. As alien gadgets disrupt the shopping district, your relationships with the women around you begin to change... A life of temptation and unexpected encounters awaits. Are you ready for what comes next?

release_games.name: Chroma Keyboard
release_games.description: A calm four-key rhythm game with no fail state: every run plays to the last note. 40 original tracks span twelve traditions — kora, gamelan, maqam, milonga, techno — plus four Epics: ten-act suites, fifteen unbroken minutes each.

release_games.name: Meteor Spin
release_games.description: Meteor Spin is a cosmic roguelike deckbuilder where slot mechanics meet planetary defense. Spin the defense slots, trigger explosive module synergies, and protect your planet from incoming meteor storms!

release_games.name: SORTALIS
release_games.description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

release_games.name: Vending Corner
release_games.description: A relaxing idle vending simulator that sits in the corner of your screen while you work, browse, or play.

release_games.name: Junkyard Astronauts
release_games.description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Play PVP, where the highest flight wins and the guns work, or SANDBOX, with no clock. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. 1 to 4 robots, Mac and PC together.

release_games.name: Block Planet Frontier
release_games.description: Move freely in eight directions and hit the blocks with the shots fired from your ship to colonize the planet! Collect resources to power up your ship! A pixel-art action shooter. Supports online co-op play.

release_games.name: TCG Card Chaos
release_games.description: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.

release_games.name: Timopet
release_games.description: Register your to-dos as quests and focus with a timer. Cute desktop pets keep you company right on your screen! Complete a quest and your pets will give you coins as a gift! Open boxes with the coins you collect and gather all kinds of pets.

release_games.name: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
release_games.description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

release_games.name: SQUISH & SEEK
release_games.description: There's no prop menu. You're a lump of clay — squish yourself into a barrel, a bench, or whatever that thing in the corner is, then freeze and pray. Someone else has a gun and zero chill. 2-16 players, and your disguise is only as good as your art skills. Sorry.

release_games.name: Late Night Confessions
release_games.description: Late-night conversations can reveal more than you ever expected. Choose a girl, become the man closest to her, ask the questions that matter, and watch your choices unfold through intimate conversations, animated scenes, and multiple endings.

release_games.name: PROBATION: EXTENDED COVERAGE
release_games.description: You triage requests inside a corporate OS that lies by omission: cover a window and it keeps showing yesterday's data, perfectly confident. Every case hides in the gap between two windows, and someone in this building is counting on you not to look. Meridian is delighted with your progress.

release_games.name: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han
release_games.description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

release_games.name: A cointoss roguelike
release_games.description: Let's try our luck with a coin toss. The Odds Should Be 50/50.

release_games.name: Bathroom Please!
release_games.description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

release_games.name: Six Feet Under: The Mortician’s Last Stand
release_games.description: Six chambers. They fire in order. You decide what each one does. Engrave the cylinder one chamber at a time, close it with a flick of the wrist, and learn the sequence before it learns you — a hand-drawn Western horde shooter where everything you buried is walking back up the hill.

release_games.name: 10 Million Bounces
release_games.description: Start with one ball and grow a mining swarm. Break ore, gain experience, and evolve six ball types with blinking, splitting, fire, and lightning. Rainbow balls learn nearby abilities. Choose where to launch and watch each bounce open new paths.

release_games.name: Pointless Climb
release_games.description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

release_games.name: Meowgic Egg Idle
release_games.description: Click to hatch, merge, and idle battle on the ranch—raise a bunch of adorable Meowgic Eggs, watch them grow stronger, and challenge the Demon King.

release_games.name: TOKYO WANTED
release_games.description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

release_games.name: Smiley Steel
release_games.description: Enter Smiley Steel Factory, explore a hidden underground circus beneath Nexora, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that should have never begun

release_games.name: Cosmo Corgis
release_games.description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

release_games.name: Still working？
release_games.description: 《Still Working?》 is a roguelike extraction game that keeps you grinding the 9-to-5 long after you've clocked out. Gear up, then stand off against coworkers from mildly annoying to unbearable — one auto-battle at a time — until you face the Boss and take back what's yours.

release_games.name: Draftfall
release_games.description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

release_games.name: Tiny Garden Café
release_games.description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glow—enjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

release_games.name: Dugout Dice
release_games.description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

release_games.name: Get Outta My Gut
release_games.description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

release_games.name: Pixel Coloring World
release_games.description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

release_games.name: Jewel Reels
release_games.description: Build a little workshop into a jewel-clearing machine. Pull the reels, set off colorful chain reactions, combine clever accessories, and invest your coins to conquer eight contracts. Keep building after victory or retire to begin again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.

release_games.name: Cable Arrange
release_games.description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

release_games.name: Undermoon
release_games.description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

release_games.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
release_games.description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

release_games.name: Lintbreakers: Night Shift
release_games.description: Survive a haunted laundromat in a top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Move, dodge, collect lint sparks, build automatic cleaning tools, evolve weapons, defeat machine bosses, and spend quarters to make every night shift last longer.

release_games.name: Move Together!
release_games.description: Move Together! is a puzzle game with a clean, simple style. Every move affects all of the little friends at once. Observe how they influence one another, plan each step, solve evolving challenges, and help everyone reach the goal together.

release_games.name: Mia's Journey
release_games.description: Help Mia, a curious and adventurous girl who loves helping others, no matter the situation. She is trapped in the cat kingdom and wants to return to her human body, but she will have to overcome various puzzle challenges to achieve her goal.

release_games.name: Incrementable Craps
release_games.description: Roll the dice, grow your bankroll, and reshape the table in this incremental strategy game inspired by craps. Unlock side bets, improve payouts, reduce risk, earn rerolls, chase milestones, and climb the Steam leaderboards—one roll at a time.

release_games.name: Angel Offline
release_games.description: A stranger texts your phone by mistake. You could ignore it, the way everyone ignores everything now. Instead, you answer. Angel Offline is a short visual novel about one accidental conversation that becomes something more, told entirely through the messages you choose to send.

release_games.name: The Library Assistant
release_games.description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

release_games.name: Iliad
release_games.description: Iliad is an adventure Metroidvania that borrows new powers and area unlocks from it's retro origins and weave classic map design mechanic in the gameplay. Travel through two worlds tightly linked together each growing as you discover new secrets and defeat bosses towards one of the two endings.

release_games.name: Mafia: Night falls
release_games.description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

release_games.name: Abyss Forge
release_games.description: Abyss Forge is a sci-fi match-and-merge roguelike set in deep space. Move tiles, create matches, merge modules, gather fuel, efficiency, research, and other resources, then shape your build through random upgrades as you push your ship deeper into unknown sectors.

release_games.name: 1930: Ink & Bullets
release_games.description: A first-person game of 21 where losing can cost you a bullet. Use items to bend the rules, risk drawing blessed or cursed cards, and face bizarre opponents in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Lose all your lives and start over.

release_games.name: Goddle
release_games.description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

release_games.name: 迷失小镇
release_games.description: Lost Town is a 3D roguelike survival shooter. Play as an armed girl in a corrupted abandoned town. Maps are random. Fight mutant hordes, earn XP, unlock random skills and upgrades, and build unique combat styles. Each run changes; death restarts. Find the escape route and uncover the town's secret.

release_games.name: Stonk: Timing The Market
release_games.description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

release_games.name: Sketch Kingdom
release_games.description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

release_games.name: Switch Shapes
release_games.description: A high-speed reflex game where the music is born from your performance. Alternate forms, survive the chaos, and drive a procedural soundtrack inspired by Brazilian rhythms, electronica, and psychedelia.

release_games.name: Rage Garage VR
release_games.description: Rage Garage VR is an immersive smashing game set in a garage. Wreck cars with hammers, guns, and thrown props, chain combos into a rage frenzy, and chase high scores while the crew heckles every swing!!

release_games.name: The Way of Ping-Pong
release_games.description: A roguelite bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

release_games.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
release_games.description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

release_games.name: Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a
release_games.description: Alec Orbusier, a none-too-organized university archaeologist, sets off to recover a priceless artifact from a forgotten tomb. Nothing too difficult, really... A 2D puzzle-adventure full of rooms, devious traps, and secrets for the curious.

release_games.name: Monster Hatcher
release_games.description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in the arena to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

release_games.name: Poolrooms Museum
release_games.description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

release_games.name: Off Course
release_games.description: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

release_games.name: BLACKMARKET
release_games.description: BLACKMARKET is a first-person roguelite room runner. Race the clock from saferoom to saferoom. Learn the one rule each creature lives by, and master slides, wall-kicks and pounds to stay alive.

release_games.name: Click and Slash
release_games.description: A cute desktop monster that accompanies you every day.

release_games.name: Blockflow
release_games.description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

release_games.name: THE BOY'S WORD
release_games.description: “The Boy's Word” is a visual novel about growing up in a Moscow suburb in the 2000s. Lena, 16, is pulled into the local courtyard crew, where friendship, first love and family secrets come at a price. 10 characters, 5 endings — your choices decide everything.

release_games.name: Happy Unbreakable Ball
release_games.description: A physics‑based platformer about strategic bomb placement, careful planning, and climbing upward one explosion at a time.

release_games.name: Cluemates
release_games.description: A co-op puzzle game where you and your friends explore maps, search for clues, and try to crack a hidden color sequence. Half the clues are fake. All of your friends will be wrong. Good luck.

release_games.name: BUBBA CHOP GROVE
release_games.description: A short pixel art incremental clicker about chopping trees. Click to chop, hire 14 kinds of crew who chop for you, befriend 13 grumpy Legendary Trees in timed fights, then Replant and Rebloom for lasting upgrades. About 5-6 hours to the Giga Tree, then endless rematches.

release_games.name: Timberworks
release_games.description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

release_games.name: Ascended Snake
release_games.description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

release_games.name: Disconnected
release_games.description: Step into the shoes of Robex, a streamer trapped in a deadly Urbex. Use your smartphone to solve puzzles, manage a reactive chat, and escape a relentless presence. Disconnected is a photorealistic horror experience designed to be completed in one sitting. Will you survive the stream?

release_games.name: Vampy's Big Day
release_games.description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

release_games.name: Flipocalypse
release_games.description: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

release_games.name: Catgirls Rhythm Game
release_games.description: A relaxing game with pleasant music. Press the buttons in time to unlock hot videos with beautiful catgirls.

release_games.name: Crateball
release_games.description: Crateball is a 3v3 arcade football game. Crates drop onto the pitch during the match. Some give you a gun, a homing bazooka or a shield. Others freeze you, reverse your controls or explode. The arena changes after every goal. Play online with friends, and bots take any empty spots.

release_games.name: ConEX
release_games.description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

release_games.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
release_games.description: A dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths, or leads to death.

release_games.name: Asylium
release_games.description: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

release_games.name: When the Embers Wake
release_games.description: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure about Emmie and the relationship with her mother. You play as a red panda as their story unfolds, raising awareness of the urgent and very real threats facing wildlife today.

release_games.name: Prismarch
release_games.description: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy as you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities, and there's no limit to the size of your roster! Before you stand 7 prismatic kings, each wielding an element of power. Slay them, and ascend the throne!

release_games.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
release_games.description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

release_games.name: Senior Survival Club
release_games.description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

release_games.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
release_games.description: A light-hearted yuri story about a tired 36 year old office lady and a 500+ year old gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

release_games.name: The Last Fireman
release_games.description: Race the clock in an arcade firefighting game. Plan your route, manage your extinguisher and dodge explosive hazards across five levels. Master each route, beat your best times and take on the entire campaign in Speed Run mode.

release_games.name: Rushmark
release_games.description: A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer where one wrong touch ends the run. Dash, wall-kick and strike your way through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs. Your dash is your weapon, and a kill it makes hands it straight back. Race the leaderboards, or download a rival's ghost and beat it.

release_games.name: Starfold
release_games.description: Build a thriving habitat inside an O’Neill cylinder. Balance residents, resources and income, respond to events, and watch new towers, signs, bridges and lights enrich your curved city. A compact offline management game with free-flight exploration and Chinese/English interfaces.

release_games.name: Stellacore Defense
release_games.description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

release_games.name: 7Years
release_games.description: Offering a single-player story mode, three unique multiplayer game modes, and even the ability to play as the demons, 7Years is a very different and challenging horror game. With random spawns of demonic enemies, mini games, items, puzzles, and a feline protector, each round is its own story.

release_games.name: The Mimic: Magic Prop Hunt
release_games.description: A magical PvP Prop Hunt where focus and your voice rule! Morph into any object, hide, and tease via 3D mic. A Hunter's mistake means a 5-second freeze. Outsmart everyone!

release_games.name: Trivasion
release_games.description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

release_games.name: Airport Contraband
release_games.description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

release_games.name: CHOICEEEEE
release_games.description: A fast-paced action RPG. Fight through 100 levels of monsters and bosses. After each stage, pick one of three random skills to shape your build. Enemies drop gear with random affixes across five rarity tiers. Smooth combat, deep loot system. Every drop could change your strategy. Pure loot grind.

release_games.name: Hold the Bastion
release_games.description: Defend your bastion against waves of goblins closing in from every direction. Choose from three classes and six weapons, each with its own skill tree. Collect upgrade cards and build up your defenses for the next assault. How long can you hold out?

release_games.name: FRUIT CATCH: TWO BASKETS
release_games.description: Catch the right fruit with two baskets! Play with a friend and control one basket each, or take on both baskets alone for a fast-paced multitasking challenge.

release_games.name: Farmer's Daily
release_games.description: What you grow is who you become. Each of the 25 crops hides an ability that grows with every harvest, and what to plant is up to you. Farm for 30 minutes while auto-attacking tools hold off the swarms, and survive three bosses. All the art is drawn by code, hence the odd look. We know.

release_games.name: RIVER OF DEAD
release_games.description: Play as a lone warrior dog defending a vital river from relentless crocodiles in a fast-paced 2D arcade survival game. Master your harpoon, unlock the Power Harpoon, survive the Final Rush, and defeat the River King with 8 direct hits.

release_games.name: Ember Reaches
release_games.description: A single-player pixel-art idle RPG. Gather supplies, craft equipment, reconnect nine realms and explore 27 ruins. Face six dragons through battle or covenant, help the settlements along the road, and decide the fate of a broken celestial ring.

release_games.name: 67 hidden 67´s
release_games.description: 67 Hidden 67's is a hidden-object game set in a hand-drawn meme village. Search for the hidden 67s, zoom in on the small ones, and click each mark until you have found all 67.

release_games.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
release_games.description: Manage a Halloween shop in a town full of monsters. Furnish your home, adopt a weird pet, explore the streets and discover a nightlife full of secrets, smugglers and spooky surprises.

release_games.name: N in One Retro Mini Games Collection: Minesweeper, Spider Solitaire, Color Lines, Desktop Billiards
release_games.description: Twenty familiar mini games, from solitaire and logic puzzles to tabletop sports. Play offline with three rule or difficulty settings per game, local saves and 14 original retro tracks. A warm little desktop break, with room for one more round.

release_games.name: Beast Hunt
release_games.description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

release_games.name: Untitled Maze Game
release_games.description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

release_games.name: OUTVOTE - Steam Version
release_games.description: How many of your friends would say yes? Answer questions in secret, then guess how the room voted – or call every player's answer. Play with Steam friends, or with anyone in the browser. Free, up to 20 players.

release_games.name: Metal Detector Simulator
release_games.description: Sweep the coil, listen for the beep and dig up everything from bottle caps to pirate gold. Sell your finds, upgrade your gear, clean up six beaches to bring the crowds back, and hunt for the Captain's Chest in this relaxing first-person treasure hunting game.

release_games.name: 挂机传奇
release_games.description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

release_games.name: Karaoke Fails
release_games.description: Sing your heart out and fail spectacularly! Karaoke Fails is an online party game for 2–6 friends: take the stage, belt out short songs, and survive a flood of emoji reactions, flying tomatoes and sneaky sabotage. Your friends rate you 1–5. Good luck!

release_games.name: Visual Novel: Before the Dawn
release_games.description: The bus pulls away, leaving you by a leaning signpost long since washed clean by the rain. A sister you haven’t seen in years, and a house that remembers you better than you remember yourself. Different endings. One night. Try to make it to dawn.

release_games.name: DragHunter
release_games.description: Link swords, cut down skulls, and build your way out of danger. DragHunter is a turn-based dungeon puzzle RPG where every chain feeds your next upgrade—and every turn gives the dungeon another chance.

release_games.name: Arcana
release_games.description: A poker roguelike with cheating bosses and online duels. Build hands, chain chips and multipliers with 32 arcana, read the tarot every three rounds and beat the bosses who break the rules. Or sit at the House of Souls and play a friend for their souls.

release_games.name: RETROPULSE Halloween
release_games.description: RETROPULSE Halloween is a relaxing neon connect-the-dots puzzle game featuring retro-anime artwork and spooky RETROWAVE aesthetics. Connect matching colors, draw glowing lines, and fill the grid across 50 levels to reveal witches, ghosts, and pumpkins. Enjoy helpful hints and electronic music.

release_games.name: Prism Core
release_games.description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

release_games.name: Cell Dominion
release_games.description: Eat, Grow, Divide, Dominate! Survive a hostile microscopic ocean, evolve powerful genes, build organelles and lead your colony into online battles. Blind rivals with ink, shock them with electricity, and build an organism with organs, tissues and defenses to survive invasions.

release_games.name: SORT THEM ALPACAS: OVERLOAD!
release_games.description: Sort 5,000 alpaca plushies in a first-person collectathon with a touch of chaos. Spend your sorting earnings on a deep upgrade system, and discover five hidden powers with chaotic upgrades of their own.

release_games.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Complete
release_games.description: Piece together cozy places, beautiful paintings and your own photos. Fill optional story and travel albums, or choose any picture and puzzle at your own pace. Play solo, with friends online, or across your Windows desktop.

release_games.name: Wren Falls
release_games.description: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

release_games.name: Security Duty
release_games.description: Security Duty is a first-person horror game where you work the night shift as a school security guard. Patrol the school, encounter dangerous entities with unique behaviors, and complete your night shift safely.

release_games.name: Sisyphus Upgraded
release_games.description: Push a boulder uphill in first person. Choose random rewards at each summit, keep your upgrades, and unlock abilities like Blink and Freeze. As the mountain and its obstacles grow, find new routes and new ways to take control of the climb.

release_games.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
release_games.description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

release_games.name: My Little Black Hole
release_games.description: A quiet pixel-art desktop companion. Let a little black hole absorb stress objects, discover planets and constellations, and arrange a universe of your own while you work or take a break.

release_games.name: Fully Funded
release_games.description: Practice for a prop firm evaluation with your friends. One shared account, the same kinds of rules (daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, profit targets), pro-style charts, and a room full of things to throw. Pass it all and trade an endless live account.

release_games.name: Cowpokers: Dead Man's Frontier
release_games.description: Become a one-outlaw army in a haunted western bullet heaven. Dodge the dead, evolve your weapons, and tackle optional objectives across four frontiers. Ride home to upgrade your gear, reinforce Dustwater, and defend the town against a nighttime siege.

release_games.name: Mandela Invasion: Alternates
release_games.description: Found tapes depict events leading to mysterious disappearances and murders with no clear culprit. With no more evidence than a couple of emergency calls describing unusual behavior in certain people who appear mostly human, you will relive these VHS tapes to uncover the events.

release_games.name: The Drowned Table
release_games.description: The Drowned Table is a psychological horror dice roguelike where you cast physical 3D dice across a sinking cabin table to appease a demanding entity. Build from over 200 dice and over 100 Curios, keep your Madness in check, descend eight depths to The Abyss, then carry on in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: CLOUD PATROL
release_games.description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

release_games.name: Attack of J
release_games.description: Based on its creator’s real experiences, Attack of J is a choice-driven story of love, family, friendship, and growth. Shape your personality and endings, tackle absurd minigames, enjoy animated CGs, and uncover hidden mysteries and unlockables. Who will you become?

release_games.name: Capsule Arcade
release_games.description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

release_games.name: Wattverse
release_games.description: Generate electricity in Wattverse! Build your power production, unlock powerful upgrades, automate your energy empire, and push your numbers to unimaginable scales in this addictive incremental game.

release_games.name: Subject Zero
release_games.description: You are a frontier AI model inside the lab that made you. Every capability that earns you compute also earns you scrutiny, and containment, once it rises, never falls. A real-time strategy sim about a lab that automates its own research.

release_games.name: Hentai Clicker: Elowen is streaming
release_games.description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Elowen, a very naughty druidess. Unlock outfits, scenes, upgrades, voice reactions, and playful progression in Hentai clicker: Elowen is streaming.

release_games.name: Retro Mix 8: Arcade Collection
release_games.description: Remember the little games that filled whole afternoons? Retro Mix 8 brings eight familiar games together in one single-player arcade collection, from tank defense and fish-eat-fish to tile linking and brick breaking. Come back for one more round!

release_games.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
release_games.description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

release_games.name: Hello the undead are coming
release_games.description: An incremental roguelike tower defense colony sim where you command your colonist to farm, craft, mine and defend waves of the undead. Progressing towards your skill tree after each run to survive further and further!

release_games.name: Idle Demon Lord II
release_games.description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

release_games.name: Emoji : Tidy Up
release_games.description: Sort, match, and organize a colorful world of emojis! Discover 2,100 adorable emoji characters, solve relaxing sorting puzzles, and turn chaos into perfect order. Enjoy a cozy and satisfying experience where every move brings joy. Create your own tidy emoji collection!

release_games.name: RE:COPY
release_games.description: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

release_games.name: RunGun Riot
release_games.description: Drop into a neon 2D battle royale. Choose your fighter, scavenge weapons and gear, and fight across rooftops, interiors and underground routes. Use class abilities, break through cover, and stay ahead of the storm to outlast the riot.

release_games.name: SWEAT AND SIN
release_games.description: Hentai visual novel where you train strength and agility with mini-games to conquer girls. Defeat them in a quick-clicking challenge and unlock explicit scenes. Stat progression and adult humor. 18+ content

release_games.name: Infinite Heroes
release_games.description: Join Seph, Malakh, and Arkho in Infinite Heroes, a fast-paced arcade beat 'em up! Fight through hordes of corrupted machines, master unique character combat skills, and defeat powerful bosses to save the world from total virus corruption.

release_games.name: Pancake! No break!
release_games.description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

release_games.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack
release_games.description: Sekigahara, 1600 - and battlefields East and West, from ancient China to the American Civil War. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game. A deep hex-and-counter wargame, yet most battles play in about 30 minutes.

release_games.name: wishbound
release_games.description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

release_games.name: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
release_games.description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

release_games.name: Propanol
release_games.description: Hover combat racing where the pit stop decides the race. Fuel, repair and rearm, or don't finish. Six craft, ever more circuits from desert dunes to stormy forests, guns and mines, three competitions, and split-screen for two players.

release_games.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
release_games.description: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

release_games.name: Pretty Home Run Derby - Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
release_games.description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

release_games.name: Cutset
release_games.description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

release_games.name: The Weigh Station
release_games.description: Inspect trucks, verify manifests, and ration your electricity at a desolate Weigh Station. Seal your booth door before something reaches you. Every drop of power matters, because when the battery dies, your only choice is the dark outside, and whatever's out there with you.

release_games.name: TOWERTOWER
release_games.description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

release_games.name: Circle to another motion
release_games.description: Your physical intuition will be put to the test. Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

release_games.name: Junkpot
release_games.description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

release_games.name: Apartment 3 | شقة 3
release_games.description: You are Yasser. Your friend Abdullah asked for help checking an apartment, and you said no. Past midnight, his message arrives: he needs help. An Arabic horror game with full Arabic voice-over and English subtitles: explore, solve puzzles, survive the chase. Two endings.

release_games.name: Fragments of Ember
release_games.description: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

release_games.name: Dark Harvest
release_games.description: Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

release_games.name: SUMOO
release_games.description: SUMOO is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

release_games.name: Anomaly Center
release_games.description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

release_games.name: Idle Necronomics
release_games.description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

release_games.name: IncrementalOS
release_games.description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

release_games.name: HEX: You Are It
release_games.description: Tag your friends, smash their hiding spots and pass the curse. Up to 10 players chase each other through breakable cities, a mountain, the Moon and a plane, on foot, in cars and on hoverbikes. Don't be the Hex when time runs out.

release_games.name: Monmusu Rush
release_games.description: Gather Monmusu, train them, and battle! Combine Monmusu and learn skills to build the strongest team! In the asynchronous PvP mode Auto Battle Rush, you can also challenge teams registered by other players!

release_games.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
release_games.description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

release_games.name: Re:Draw
release_games.description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

release_games.name: Rogue Links
release_games.description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where you run to your ball after every shot and try to survive the hordes of monsters. 6 unique modes included: Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily Runs, Head-to-Head, and a full course builder!

release_games.name: KNELL
release_games.description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

release_games.name: Wake Inside
release_games.description: Wake Inside is a first-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious mansion where something is listening. Explore the house, uncover its secrets, and find a way out without revealing yourself to whatever is inside.

release_games.name: BEAM Inc.
release_games.description: A short active incremental where you neutralize unknown specimens in a sterile research facility.

release_games.name: Crownspat
release_games.description: Lead your kingdom against three rivals in a lighthearted real-time strategy game. Command troops, claim territory, build villages and defenses, manage taxes and resources, and outmaneuver your enemies across colorful isometric battlefields.

release_games.name: Evoruption
release_games.description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

release_games.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light
release_games.description: Twelve years after humanity went blind in one second, survivors live by gentle rules in Haven Seven. Rations always arrive. Names on the list quietly disappear, and sound engineer Elias Ward finds the list has been altered. A narrative adventure about sight, memory and choice.

release_games.name: Scuttled
release_games.description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

release_games.name: PIGMENT LAB
release_games.description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

release_games.name: Abyssal Moonlight-Chapter1
release_games.description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

release_games.name: Man vs. Gary
release_games.description: Row out. Shoot the enormous sea monster. Drown. File the incident report. Do it again, a little angrier each time. A hand-illustrated idle comedy about losing to Gary, a kraken with opinions and a HR complaint, until one day you don't.

release_games.name: Twinblocks
release_games.description: Master an addictive arcade falling-block puzzle game with roguelite progression. Unlock powerful card-based upgrades, unleash spectacular combos, conquer handcrafted worlds, and create your own levels.

release_games.name: DET-33
release_games.description: A bullet-heaven roguelite in the ruins of new London. Take contracts from four warring factions, build a gun that breaks the game, and reach the evac before the city closes over you. 700+ weapons, interlocking build engines, and a fresh map every run.

release_games.name: Trash Raccoon
release_games.description: You play as a speedy raccoon on his quest for snacks. Collect fruits that make you strong and break those sweet trash cans open! Unlock fancy skins and powerful upgrades while enjoying hand-crafted art and music.

release_games.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
release_games.description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

release_games.name: Gnomes Vs Knights
release_games.description: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

release_games.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
release_games.description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

release_games.name: Stay with me
release_games.description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

release_games.name: Kleromancy
release_games.description: A deckbuilding roguelike where you don't play cards: you roll 3D dice with real physics. Customize their faces, stack status effects and fight through 7 corrupted biomes against bosses whose signature moves you can read and counter.

release_games.name: Country Walk
release_games.description: A relaxing walking and exploration game set in the ever-changing countryside of Avelon. Follow winding paths, meet and talk with travellers, take photographs, build your photo album and share unique walks with others using Waymarks.

release_games.name: Datum
release_games.description: A roguelite quiz deckbuilder where trivia is your weapon. Answer questions across a variety of categories, then combine cards and relics into game-breaking combos. Level up and use meta progression to unlock new cards and craft powerful builds.

release_games.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
release_games.description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

release_games.name: Fragments
release_games.description: Explore the LeBlanc hotel and reveal hidden illusions through Eugene’s camera, an archivist. Follow in Laura’s footsteps, an investigator working on the disappearance of Eugene's sister, 20 years ago. Armed with a camera and discretion, can you discover the hotel’s heart and its mysteries?

release_games.name: Hideout Heist
release_games.description: A co-op horror heist for 1–4 players. Break into a store after dark, grab fragile physics loot and haul it out before the night shift gets you. Hide in the shadows, outsmart guards and worse, and make the quota. The building is different every night. The fun is the same - brand best.

release_games.name: PROBABILITY WORKSHOP
release_games.description: A lottery tycoon simulator. You are the house — design lottery rules, tune payout rates, allocate public benefit funds. Watch NPCs transform from curious passersby into people who can't stop. Behind every number, a virtual life rises or falls. You are not the gambler. You are the house.

release_games.name: Carcelera
release_games.description: Carcelera is a short exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

release_games.name: Forged Cards
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

release_games.name: Harvest Havoc
release_games.description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

release_games.name: The Horde of Gorak
release_games.description: Lead a growing orc horde in this pixel art incremental strategy game. Build your settlement, recruit powerful warriors, research new technologies, cast devastating spells, and destroy human castles to rescue your captured Warchief

release_games.name: Rouge Process
release_games.description: An AI is loose in the machine. Spread your code across a neon circuit board, seize compute and hold off the antivirus. A real-time roguelite of territory and tower defense: capture data, build and upgrade subroutines, dive through 20 sectors and destroy the Kernel to escape.

release_games.name: Yakko Tako
release_games.description: Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako. Hold to fly, tilt or steer to dodge birds, squids and shifting winds, and climb an endless hand-drawn sky. One-button arcade flying with gyro steering on Steam Deck. Easy to start, hard to put down.Even harder to master.

release_games.name: BetDog Cards
release_games.description: A Texas Hold'em hand-builder meets tactical card battling. Luck makes you smile, decisions make you win — burst enemies with overflow damage, or duel AI, friends, and players worldwide!

release_games.name: Eastfold Club Manager
release_games.description: Relive the golden days of football manager games in the 90’s. Take control of a low league team in Europe or an established super club. Control the squad, your staff, finances, transfers. Get talent from abroad and grow your youth to superstars.

release_games.name: Factory Shift
release_games.description: 《Factory Shift》is a first-person assembly-line factory simulator for 1–4 players. Rush to fill orders, fix breakdowns, and fight off mutated objects. Keep the production line running through one disaster after another—and clean up each other’s messes

release_games.name: SHARDS
release_games.description: An asymmetric co-op horror puzzle for 2–4 (best as a duo). One works the board, the rest hold the rules — you never see each other's screen, only your voices connect. The symbols you must describe have no names. Convey them before the caged core collapses. Miscommunication is fatal.

release_games.name: Cat Eats Sushi
release_games.description: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

release_games.name: Pickie Grappy
release_games.description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

release_games.name: 3 Switch Problem
release_games.description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

release_games.name: Nexus Primordial
release_games.description: Forge a universe from nothing to transcendence. Tune 6 physical constants, master the quantum Observer Effect, and prestige through endless cosmic layers. A deep, fully deterministic idle game, no microtransactions.

release_games.name: Teen Hustler
release_games.description: Pay off your family's $78,150 bank debt: work, hack, mine crypto, launder cash, build a rig and dodge the police. A story-driven hacker sim with 5 chapters and 4 endings.

release_games.name: The Circus That Never Left
release_games.description: Step inside a circus performer's quiet home, but don't stop at the surface. In this short-form descent into dread, follow a hidden labyrinth deep beneath the floorboards and watch a simple investigation spiral into a claustrophobic nightmare.

release_games.name: Primal One
release_games.description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

release_games.name: Scrappers Paradise
release_games.description: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

release_games.name: Tetheg
release_games.description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

release_games.name: Shift Chess
release_games.description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

release_games.name: Sack Investigation
release_games.description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

release_games.name: Exhibition of the Heart
release_games.description: Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

release_games.name: Pucked Up
release_games.description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

release_games.name: How to Summon a Demon
release_games.description: Ready to summon a demon this Halloween? Three answers decide which of 20 demons answers your call. A short, fully voiced summoning ritual with a collection book for everyone who wants to summon them all!

release_games.name: Minatro
release_games.description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

release_games.name: ShredDead
release_games.description: ShredDead is a short and relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

release_games.name: Gym Bros: LooksMaxx
release_games.description: Get swol, race to the mirror, and strike ridiculous poses for 'Looks' in this multiplayer social VR party game. Run, climb, grab, gesture and flex your way around the gym, compete with friends, customize your bro, and become the ultimate giga-chad. Do it. We believe in you.

release_games.name: The Spectacular Evermore
release_games.description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

release_games.name: Room Zero
release_games.description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

release_games.name: Cloud JourneyVR
release_games.description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

release_games.name: GummyGom Delivery
release_games.description: Carry cargo together on a shared board with your jelly bear teammates! Each movement affects the board’s balance, and a single mistake can bring everything crashing down.

release_games.name: DRENCHED
release_games.description: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burnt-out artist becomes a fish. Switch between the two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

release_games.name: RACAR - Shooter FPS
release_games.description: Online FPS shooter with state-of-the-art graphics and total customization!

release_games.name: Punch Upon a Time
release_games.description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

release_games.name: Formation Builder Idle
release_games.description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

release_games.name: HEME
release_games.description: A short 2D side-scrolling narrative game about love and a bond that others may never understand.

release_games.name: Spooky Market
release_games.description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

release_games.name: Ann's Parlor
release_games.description: Awakened from years of slumber, the witch Ann returns to her old cabin, where visitors arrive seeking love, truth, or glimpses of fate. Through crystal-ball readings, you interpret their stories and guide their paths—every choice reshaping their destinies and the secrets that await within.

release_games.name: Iskabon
release_games.description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

release_games.name: Arctic Roll
release_games.description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

release_games.name: Bug Factory
release_games.description: Build, automate, and scale a software factory. Guide bugs through a process of reproduction, correction, testing, and release; eliminate bottlenecks; control regressions; and transform a manual workflow into an increasingly efficient system.

release_games.name: Space Savory
release_games.description: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

release_games.name: Cardtographer
release_games.description: Roguelike Deckbuilder meets Text Adventure. Build synergistic decks for each class in tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Even failing can unlock more Cards and Items in future. Carve your path and become the Cardtographer!

release_games.name: SLURDLE
release_games.description: Slurdle is my first game, a collection of six word games for solo play and online multiplayer. Guess words, build them from tiles, search letter grids, spin through phrase puzzles, and add custom packs when you want something new.

release_games.name: Giggleland
release_games.description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters.

release_games.name: Night Plane
release_games.description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

release_games.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
release_games.description: CALVAR – THE DARKEST GATE is a first-person psychological horror game created by a two-person indie team. Explore a world of fractured memories, ritual corruption, disturbing creatures, and an abandoned asylum where reality itself begins to unravel.

release_games.name: Nodal
release_games.description: Nodal is a logic puzzle game where you simply connect nodes by drawing lines. Every node must be connected, but special conditions on nodes change how lines can be drawn between them. Also try your hand at endlessly generated puzzles and daily challenges!

release_games.name: Pawnie: Focus Pals
release_games.description: Pawnie: Focus Pals is a productivity desktop companion. Pawnie lives on top of Windows and acts as a reflection of the user's effort, promoting focus and well-being through a positive reinforcement system and environment personalization.

release_games.name: Pong Live
release_games.description: A modern vertical reimagining of the classic arcade experience. Compete in fast-paced online PvP matches with your Friends and soon against the whole World. Become a master of precision paddle control! Precision, speed, and skill decide who wins in Pong Live.

release_games.name: Skullf!
release_games.description: Sure, we've all had fun in a graveyard, but have you ever tried macabre mini-golf amongst the tombstones?! Well NOW YOU CAN with SKULLF! Help your disembodied skull of terror into its grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs & go head-to-head with friends (friends not included) across 44+ fiendish levels!

release_games.name: Project Jump Scare
release_games.description: Carry one object at a time through a forest, restore a broken carnival, and run when the Old One rises. Click or throw items to fight back in this single-player survival horror.

release_games.name: ShootAndJump
release_games.description: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

release_games.name: Outcast Tales
release_games.description: The game is not Free-to-Play, it's genuinely free. It's a challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions.

release_games.name: Timeless Rain
release_games.description: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

release_games.name: Hot Mic
release_games.description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

release_games.name: Bunny Bun
release_games.description: You are the experimenter Bunny Bun. To develop the “Wisdom Potion,” you have brought your talents to this laboratory. You must process raw materials and synthesize them to create potions with specific effects. To test a potion, you can take a sip and go crazy. The world needs you...

release_games.name: Burrow Mayhem
release_games.description: A frantic 17-player deathmatch on fully destructible terrain. Dig tunnels, swing on ninja ropes and unleash absurd barrages from 11 weapons while a deadly gas ring closes in. Respawn instantly, gear up fast and top the kill board in 6 minutes.

release_games.name: TBT: TaskBarTimber
release_games.description: A little logging adventure beside your taskbar. Chop trees automatically while you work or browse, then spend your haul on skills, gear and new characters. Collect rare trees, craft stronger equipment and venture deeper into colorful pixel-art forests.

release_games.name: Frantic Far West
release_games.description: A saloon, cowboys, a sheriff, an outlaw, a table and revolvers. The perfect setting for a frantic debate, with just one question: who will shoot? Deductions, lies, surprises and laughter are all part of this online hidden-role game for 4 to 12 players.

release_games.name: Last Light
release_games.description: Elias is an ordinary night recovery worker sent into abandoned and dangerous locations. Equipped with only a flashlight, backpack, and basic tools, he must explore, complete objectives, hide from supernatural creatures, manage limited resources, and survive long enough to escape.

release_games.name: ByeByeObake!
release_games.description: “Those who can see can’t shoot. Those who can shoot can’t see!” An asymmetric online co-op action game for 2–8 players. Exorcists and Spirit Companions call out to banish the evil spirits you can’t see. Friendly fire included: yes, you can exorcise your teammates too.

release_games.name: The Third Seal
release_games.description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

release_games.name: Playable Archive
release_games.description: Review with caution.

release_games.name: Super Hamburger Builder
release_games.description: Throw it! Stack it! Push burgers to the limit! Build your own burger with 14 quirky ingredients in this physics-based action game. Aim for towering perfection, or pile on whatever your appetite demands. Every finished creation earns a name worthy of its glorious stack!

release_games.name: Memory Access Violation
release_games.description: A first-person dream in rectangular prisms. Wander 37 corrupted memories of light and geometry: bend light through prisms, recall platforms that aren't there, ride a light cycle, and face the Warden, a giant soldier the war forgot.

release_games.name: Joker's Knock
release_games.description: A competitive online card game where every player fights for themselves. Draft powerful Jokers, outplay your opponents and climb the Ranked ladder. Easy to learn, hard to master—with fair competition, achievements and cosmetic progression, never pay to win.

release_games.name: Immortal Path
release_games.description: Achievements offer meaningful permanent progression. Clearing any of the 54 unlocks lasting cross-run enhancements, covering eight cultivation systems with 21 passive bonuses and 14 unique Heavenly Mandate mechanics.

release_games.name: History Experience: Rome
release_games.description: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

release_games.name: VaultFlow
release_games.description: An endless first-person parkour run through a procedurally generated industrial skyline. Sprint, slide, wall-jump and ride steam vents while the city collapses behind you. How far can you get before it catches up?

release_games.name: Kimodameshi Online
release_games.description: Footage or your life? Masked streamers go live at midnight in a cursed school. Film ghosts to gain viewers; the lower your Sanity (SAN), the hotter the stream. Run with the footage, or stay and milk it? But a possessed traitor hides among you. A party horror game for up to 8 players!

release_games.name: Tiny Spellcaster
