release_games.description: Blast through endless hordes and hold the line against these demons! Tiny Spellcaster is a corner arcade idle shooter with rogue-lite upgrades, where rng and strategic builds help you overpower the rapid swarms of monsters closing in. Master the magic, unleash the chaos!

release_games.name: Munshi Meadows
release_games.description: Hatch a Munshi, raise it in your garden and see what it grows into. Breed a family line whose coats, patterns and eye colours really pass down, then race, fight and puzzle your way through fourteen cups, with friends dropping by over Steam.

release_games.name: Adventurer 95
release_games.description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

release_games.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
release_games.description: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

release_games.name: Picpic
release_games.description: Sharp eyes. Fast combos. Fierce rivals. Picpic is an anime-style spot-the-difference PvP game. Find differences before your opponent, rack up combo scores, and attack to disrupt their play. Keep your focus as the clock ticks down!

release_games.name: Teleport Master
release_games.description: Teleport Master is a first-person puzzle adventure where you create portals to move through space, reach impossible places, and solve clever environmental challenges. Explore stylized sci-fi levels, experiment with movement, and find your way forward.

release_games.name: Demonfall Continent
release_games.description: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.

release_games.name: DOOM MATES
release_games.description: An online multiplayer horror for up to 5 players. One of you is the hunter, and the rest have to work together to escape strange places. No two runs are the same, because these places always change. Create your own jumpscare and watch your friends run into it in the dark!

release_games.name: Peckout
release_games.description: Pick a side — Crow or Dove — and dive into fast, funny 8v8 egg warfare. Grab a launcher, hold the trenches, and splatter anything that moves. Six maps, six weapons, zero dignity.

release_games.name: Trials of Dash
release_games.description: Stay ahead of a deadly wall, change color with every jump, and land on the right platforms to survive.

release_games.name: Slacking Squad
release_games.description: Slacker Squad is a lightweight desktop idle game that reacts to your keyboard and mouse activity. Work hard and your squad speeds up; slack off and they do too. Mine, cook, unlock characters, and capture defeated monsters as pets while your squad keeps you company.

release_games.name: 单机斗地主
release_games.description: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

release_games.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
release_games.description: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

release_games.name: Excids: Endless Siege
release_games.description: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

release_games.name: Scopa Sweep
release_games.description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

release_games.name: Mythaka
release_games.description: A single-player stone-casting combat roguelike inspired by Mancala. Read the Foe’s rules, choose your pockets and combine Charms, Relics and Potions to build attacks across eight worlds inspired by mythology.

release_games.name: Nitro Nonsense
release_games.description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!

release_games.name: TRAPPIST-1
release_games.description: A short sci-fi horror game. Extract energy from a red dwarf, tune signals, and power distant worlds. Do your job. Don't ask what really keeps the station running.

release_games.name: TEXAS DOMINOES
release_games.description: Play classic All Fives dominoes with a Texas twist. Score in multiples of five, control the Spinner, draw from the Boneyard, or block the game. Play against friends or solo. Relive your best rounds with game replays, stats, and badges.

release_games.name: Village of the Mirror
release_games.description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

release_games.name: Sweet Memories
release_games.description: Enjoy a colorful and perfect Halloween night. Just don't eat that candy... Please... I went to a lot of trouble to make everything better...

release_games.name: Tetromancer
release_games.description: Tetromancer is a puzzle battler where the board is your war economy. Clear lines to conjure an army, then command it in real time against wave after wave of invaders. Stack greedily and you'll field a bigger force, but crowd your board and one bad piece can bury you.

release_games.name: Mahjong Rush
release_games.description: This isn't your typical Mahjong game! Build sets and sequences to score points, land a winning hand to send your score soaring. Every run brings new shops, bosses, and challenges. Never played Mahjong before? You'll pick it up in just three minutes!

release_games.name: Horny Halloween 🎃
release_games.description: You thought going to a haunted graveyard on Hallowe’en would be a thrill-ride. Maybe see some ghosts. What you didn’t expect was her, the sexy ghoulish femme fatale who knows how to suck the very soul from your boner! Is she a curse or a gift from Heaven itself?

release_games.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar
release_games.description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

release_games.name: Topdeck Duel
release_games.description: An incremental card roguelike where every victory expands your deck! Position cards for powerful buffs, claim enemy cards, and merge them to increase their rarity. Accumulate gold for permanent meta-upgrades between runs and master the Topdeck Duel!

release_games.name: Laser Lode
release_games.description: Slice through endless ore veins with a high‑energy laser, listen to the clear ring of rare minerals hitting the ground, and witness your wealth skyrocket from single digits to astronomical numbers. 10 minerals, 80 achievements – an incremental feast reserved solely for the laser.

release_games.name: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
release_games.description: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

release_games.name: 60病　The 60-Second Syndrome
release_games.description: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

release_games.name: Chain of Command
release_games.description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

release_games.name: Endless Tower
release_games.description: Climb an endless tower, keep your momentum, and time each jump to reach the next platform. No enemies — just your reflexes and your own record. The tower regenerates every run, so every climb is a chance to beat your best.

release_games.name: Adultery Marriage Punisher
release_games.description: "Adultery Marriage Punisher" Curing marriage pests! Investigate. Infiltrate. Snap. Spy. Steal. Outwit. What is your spouse doing behind your back? Your evidence, the deadliest sanction. Now, become the shadow of justice, and unveil every betrayal and infidelity!

release_games.name: Flipping Phantom
release_games.description: A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

release_games.name: Sign: Broken Kether
release_games.description: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

release_games.name: The Gassal
release_games.description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

release_games.name: Spin To Win
release_games.description: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

release_games.name: TRACE IT
release_games.description: A cozy paper-style train-track logic puzzle. Use the row and column numbers to lay one railway from entrance to exit; every level has exactly one solution. 500 levels plus Endless, Relax and Daily modes. Finish the line and watch the little train roll out.

release_games.name: Bubble Hunters
release_games.description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

release_games.name: PrankzPlz!
release_games.description: Every great prank starts with a simple idea. Matt’s usually ends in complete chaos.

release_games.name: Reel to the Stars
release_games.description: Drag your bobber and reel in a whole screen of fish! Upgrade your rod, grow a huge skill tree, and fish your way from a quiet pond through the Arctic, the deep sea and the Dragon Palace all the way to outer space. A cozy fishing incremental with 278 fish species and your own aquarium.

release_games.name: Quota: Hit Your Number
release_games.description: The sales satire as an incremental career game: you start on the phone yourself, nailing call timing and chasing meetings. The higher you climb, the more your team works for you, until you take the company public. Ripen deals, fuse your team, conquer the map as VP.

release_games.name: N in One 中国骨牌合集：牌九、天九、接龙、顶牛
release_games.description: Pull up a chair! Discover 16 domino games, from Pai Gow and traditional Tien Gow to connecting, collecting and matching tiles. Learn with illustrated practice, face two BOT difficulties, and unlock cozy table styles with play-earned points. A single-player collection with local saves.

release_games.name: Last House Standing
release_games.description: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure, then take it to the whole city: six chapters, 140 waves and 28 bosses. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree.

release_games.name: SLUP
release_games.description: Collect Gems, keep your combo alive, and outrun your own past. Every path you take returns as a moving Past, turning your previous choices into deadly obstacles in this strategic arcade score-attack game.

release_games.name: Halmweit
release_games.description: A cozy building game to play alone or with friends. You share one village, one storehouse and everyone who lives there. Chop trees, plant fields, lay a railway and get your village through the winter. There's no fighting, and you can't lose.

release_games.name: Give Us Back Gravity
release_games.description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

release_games.name: Lumbrix
release_games.description: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

release_games.name: SpellWeave
release_games.description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

release_games.name: DeepCore Breach
release_games.description: Thousands of rift creatures. One base. Aim every turret's line of fire, then take the main cannon into your own hands. Take down five bosses across 15 maps, grow stronger between runs, and climb the global leaderboard in Endless. Build and share your own maps on the Workshop.

release_games.name: Gross Survivors
release_games.description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

release_games.name: Project Neko
release_games.description: Pilot a cat-shaped ship through a neon rhythm tunnel. Hit, hold and trace notes to the beat, chase high scores, and take a loud, unruly cat band from rehearsal room to stage. Unlock partners and songs across six difficulties in this music-driven arcade adventure.

release_games.name: Quiz Bang!
release_games.description: 《Quiz Bang! 》is a first-person party shooter for 2–6 players. On this not-so-safe TV show, answer questions or beat minigames to earn ammo. Take on another challenge, or turn around and shoot your friends? A friendly reminder: watch your back while answering.

release_games.name: KING 4 A DAY
release_games.description: KING 4 A DAY is a small, straightforward roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Lead four humble pawns across procedurally generated levels, adapt to ever-changing laws, and brave a kingdom of black-and-white roads to rescue the kidnapped White King.

release_games.name: KickOff
release_games.description: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

release_games.name: AVXRPG
release_games.description: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.

release_games.name: Shear line
release_games.description: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

release_games.name: Dead Pulse
release_games.description: Dead Pulse is an atmospheric, adrenaline-fueled zombie survival FPS set in a red-tinted post-apocalyptic wasteland. Face endless waves of the undead, unlock powerful weapons and roguelite skills, and fight to survive the crimson night in a dark, gritty world.

release_games.name: Fire Bug
release_games.description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

release_games.name: +PROTECTUS-
release_games.description: 🧲 A minimalist first‑person puzzle game where you have to escape from a ruined lunar complex using an experimental magnetic cannon and uncover the secrets of the ECHO project together with the drone Kruitni.

release_games.name: Homeless Kiosk Simulator
release_games.description: You work the night shift inside a small aid booth. People arrive at your window asking for help. Food. Water. Medicine. Sometimes… things that don’t belong in a donation box. Every box you prepare makes the night worse.

release_games.name: Behind the Corner
release_games.description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

release_games.name: My Stylish Life
release_games.description: It's 2008, and you just sat down at the family computer. Run your own boutique, build your dream wardrobe, make new friends, fall in love, and explore a colorful world where every day is yours to style. Welcome to My Stylish Life.

release_games.name: Ball Bugz
release_games.description: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

release_games.name: AL-Mafia
release_games.description: AL-Mafia is an online social deduction game where players lie, investigate, save, silence, and vote each other out. Move through the map at night, use voice and text chat to deceive or defend yourself, and survive across maps with unique elimination systems.

release_games.name: Nile Express
release_games.description: Build the first railway network in Africa. Create profitable routes in Egypt, from Alexandria to Aswan. Deliver passengers and goods to the right destinations. Take care of your railway network and deal with accidents.

release_games.name: Iron Online
release_games.description: Iron Online is a new indie PvP MMO in Early Access! Designed around player vs player world events. Join our Discord! The invitation link is available on the game's login page. Still has lots of bugs! I'm working through them, please be kind for now.

release_games.name: Foodland Puzzle
release_games.description: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

release_games.name: Clapitalism
release_games.description: Turn a single clap into a worldwide ovation. Clapitalism is an incremental game about growing an audience, engineering louder applause, and filling bigger venues. Take an Encore to restart with permanent Fame, then build an even stronger show.

release_games.name: Lily or Horse
release_games.description: The easiest game in the world. Flip a coin and call it: lily or horse? Call it right 10 times in a row to win. Miss, and the coins you bet are thrown away. With a little luck, it only takes 10 flips.

release_games.name: Idle Gas Station Tycoon
release_games.description: Turn a tiny roadside pump into a thriving highway service empire. Serve cars, grow your station, hire staff, add a shop, car wash, garage, truck stop and EV chargers, then expand to new locations. A relaxing low-poly idle tycoon, no ads, fully offline.

release_games.name: Dawn Archive
release_games.description: Choose rooms. Rotate them. Connect your path. Shape a mysterious mansion in this exploration and puzzle adventure. With limited steps and keys, solve puzzles and follow clues in forgotten records to reach the archive deep within.

release_games.name: Slaskescape 2
release_games.description: 40 interconnected skills fuel your next upgrade in this single-player 3D idle RPG. Gather materials, craft better gear and automate your supplies with hired workers, summons and inventions. Choose your next unlock, then let your character get to work.

release_games.name: Pocket Sports
release_games.description: Grab a friend and split one handheld down the middle. Air hockey, bowling, sumo and Turf Wars for two: each player holds one side, or play online with a Steam friend.

release_games.name: Pikabuu: Home
release_games.description: Rian and Febi thought they found their dream home at a cheap price, unaware of its dark history. Experience their daily life from dual perspectives in this psychological horror game. Face relentless terror, make critical choices, and uncover the truth: are they truly the only ones inside?

release_games.name: 猫咪之家 CatHome
release_games.description: Run your stray cat shelter using a classic slot machine game format.

release_games.name: FUTA GIRLS
release_games.description: FUTA GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

release_games.name: Wild Draw
release_games.description: Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

release_games.name: V-Buddy UltraDeluxe
release_games.description: VBuddy is back, written from the ground up to be more featureful and better than ever! Feed sweets and tiny people to a cast of colourful characters and unlock new toys, skins and backgrounds for your V-Buddy UltraDeluxe!

release_games.name: Echo in the Lightless Deep
release_games.description: Echo in the Lightless Deep is a deep-sea survivor roguelite. Symbionts fight for you; you steer, dodge and build. The brighter your core, the farther you see and strike, and the more the deep sends at you. Five giants guard the way down. At the bottom, choose: return to the light, or stay dark.

release_games.name: 赛博拼豆
release_games.description: A free, offline bead-crafting game with 40 studio-original patterns, including 10 for Halloween, plus 6 starters. Turn photos into bead guides with background removal, then place beads and iron your work. No ads or in-app purchases. Simplified Chinese interface.

release_games.name: Shatterwing
release_games.description: Turn enemy fire into your greatest weapon. SHATTERWING is a pixel-art bullet hell shooter where you dash to create mirrors, reflect deadly volleys, and build your ship across five stages. Master six ships or switch colors and absorb bullets in Polarity mode.

release_games.name: SHAME
release_games.description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

release_games.name: Catch The Ducks
release_games.description: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

release_games.name: ChessGuardians
release_games.description: Play on boards that challenge the imagination — from a classic office to holographic, post-apocalyptic and more. Face different engines, variants, import your games, and play against millions of players. The chess you know. The excitement you never imagined.

release_games.name: Puzzle Penguins
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Lakes
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Money Burner
release_games.description: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

release_games.name: GomokuSoccer
release_games.description: Place or Flick? In Gomoku Soccer, you can place your stones just to build a line of five, or flick them off the board and watch your opponent crashing out. Test your strategy and your aim!

release_games.name: DRIFTIT
release_games.description: Top-down drift racing with deep arcade physics. Throw one car sideways through 20 hand-built tracks in five low-poly worlds, chain slides for points, chase your own ghost and set the fastest three-lap time on Steam leaderboards checked against every run's replay.

release_games.name: 模拟穿越-三国
release_games.description: 穿越到群雄并起的汉末，你不是开局便号令天下的主公，而是从小卒、文吏或斥候起步的无名之人。结识会记住承诺、恩情与背叛的历史人物，完成上官任务，献上计策，积累军功与治绩，在复杂的人脉和官场中争取升迁。你可以招募亲随、经营私人部曲、组建攻城军团、治理城池、发展势力科技，也能求亲成婚、经营家庭，或在时机成熟时举旗自立。每推进一个月，战争、调任、疾病、背叛和天下大势都会继续演变；你的选择不仅决定自己的仕途，也可能让熟悉的三国历史走向另一条道路。

release_games.name: Cellwright - A FreeCell Roguelike
release_games.description: This is FreeCell, re-imagined as a roguelike. Chain cards to the foundations to build Mult, collect relics that multiply each other, and beat every deal's quota. Win the eight-ante run, then push into true Endless. Renown, feats and eight Grades carry over between runs.

release_games.name: Coffee Keeper
release_games.description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

release_games.name: QuestAway
release_games.description: A tiny idle RPG that lives next to your taskbar. Build a party of heroes, send them off to fight and get back to work. There's loot waiting when you come back. Twelve times a day, everyone takes on a giant Colossus together.

release_games.name: My Goth Waifu: Hentai Puzzle
release_games.description: Solve seven types of puzzles across 100 increasingly challenging levels and unlock ever more revealing images of a bold goth beauty. Earn up to three stars, beat your best times, and fill your private gallery in My Goth Waifu: Hentai Puzzle.

release_games.name: DODGE GAME
release_games.description: Dodge relentless enemy swarms, build score-multiplying combos, and unleash devastating powers in a fast-paced arcade survival game. Conquer evolving arenas, defeat intense bosses, and climb the leaderboards.

release_games.name: Puzzle Nuts
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Touwers: Defend the Realm
release_games.description: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

release_games.name: Console Space
release_games.description: You are the captain aboard a starship. Make decisions in the terminal's text logs: from repairing the reactor to moral dilemmas that irreversibly change the fate of the crew.

release_games.name: 爱在触及之处 Love Where Touches
release_games.description: "Love Where Touches" is a supernatural high school doujin VN. A third extra lunchbox made daily, an invisible girl in the classroom, and magical truths hidden behind forgotten memories... To protect the one you cherish, would you sacrifice your memories to reach true happiness?

release_games.name: LastAlive
release_games.description: LastAlive is a hardcore psychological survival simulator set in a world created by your own mind. To survive, explore a dead city, gather resources, craft tools, fortify your position, and make fateful decisions. Complete all the objectives, preserve your sanity, and wake up.

release_games.name: Puzzle Mollusks
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Marine Fish
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Wild Cats
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Moostache Farm
release_games.description: An idle farming game about Moostache, a farmer with one small field and a big mustache. Grow wheat, eggs, milk, apples and carrots, then trade the harvest for chef hats. Big Food Inc. buys your farms each season. Spend the profit on its shares until you own the company.

release_games.name: EinStein
release_games.description: An alchemy roguelike where you spin your wheel and watch items devour, merge, and upgrade one another. Collect relics, trigger chain reactions, and snowball your Magic—every run carves out a unique alchemical path.

release_games.name: You'll Never Find My Cash!
release_games.description: 🆓 Free demo available! Your roommate is broke. Hide your cash so they can't see where, then find your broke roommate's last cash. Most cash wins. A 1–4 player party game.

release_games.name: Hubble Bubble
release_games.description: Online co-op chaos for 1 to 4 players in a space station hookah lounge. The gravity cuts out mid-shift, customers throw up, hot coals set people on fire and the shopping cart goes wherever it wants. Every dollar you make turns the dump into a two-floor lounge.

release_games.name: A Northern Evil: Tape One
release_games.description: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

release_games.name: RuinBlade
release_games.description: This is a small personal work. Please manage your expectations

release_games.name: 7 Millimeters
release_games.description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

release_games.name: Wandering The Corridors
release_games.description: Walk through an endless corridor and look for anomalies. Observe every detail, remember what you see, and discover what has changed before moving forward.

release_games.name: Companion Baduk
release_games.description: Learn and master Go (Baduk/Weiqi) with unique AI companions, custom game analysis with move explanations, ranked puzzles, joseki training, and a rich proverb database. Play, practice, and improve your skills at your own pace!

release_games.name: Banana Life Sim
release_games.description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

release_games.name: Riskline
release_games.description: Riskline is a multiplayer game about risk, greed, and outplaying your rivals. Spin slots, bet on roulette, challenge other players to duels, grab limited items, and decide when to cash out. Whoever hides the most money in the bank by the end of the match wins.

release_games.name: BurgerJoint: Fast Food Simulator
release_games.description: A fast food simulator game focused on physics-based mechanics and satisfying cooking experience. Flip, stack, grill and assemble burgers however you like, manage your restaurant’s stock, take orders, and enjoy the running of your own virtual kitchen.

release_games.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
release_games.description: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

release_games.name: Slime Slasher
release_games.description: You take on the role of a slime fighting alongside the rebels against Brain 738 and a spacefaring race of penguins. Become a warrior, archer, or mage and play through your own story to a unique ending!

release_games.name: Kitchen Traitor
release_games.description: A last-second slap. Dinner on the floor. Kitchen Traitor is a first-person cooking and social deduction game for 4–8 players online. Run three restaurants while hidden traitors sabotage the shift. Also includes 2–3-player co-op without traitors and solo practice.

release_games.name: Bohnice: Within The Mind
release_games.description: Explore Prague's abandoned Bohnice Asylum as an investigative journalist. Uncover dark secrets, detect paranormal activity with your radio, and capture photographic evidence of the hospital's terrifying past.

release_games.name: Tensei Brave
release_games.description: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

release_games.name: Who Invited You?
release_games.description: Some of your party guests were never invited. They look like your friends, answer to their names, and behave exactly the same. Photos, messages and phone calls are the only proof. Find them before the night ends — alone or with up to three friends.

release_games.name: Super Clown Save Santa
release_games.description: 2.5d Platformer where you control Super Clown. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and enemy bee and Save Santa Claus and Save Christmas

release_games.name: Neighbor Duel
release_games.description: Here, they’ll snatch items right out of your hands, knock your loot loose with a club to the back, and freeze you for five seconds so they can calmly make off with your grapes. Fight, use cunning, and haul ten items back to your base before your opponent does.

release_games.name: Aim Tracer
release_games.description: A first-person shooter tracking game that leaving a trail that draws a design. Track it through circles, roses, stars, and Lissajous loops across 40 levels, and finish each drawing before the timer runs out.

release_games.name: Rêverie: Audio Stories
release_games.description: Close your eyes, listen, choose: illustrated audio stories where your choices change the ending. Two free stories, a king's messenger in a storm and a fairy tale in songs, and three as DLC: a mystery in the snow, the last morning of Pompeii and the king's flight to Varennes.

release_games.name: Just One More Fly
release_games.description: Hunt pesky flies in this first-person swatting game. Clear rooms, earn upgrades, and tackle bigger infestations with swatters, electric rackets, a hand vacuum, and a flamethrower. Place traps, beat your best time, and catch that one last fly.

release_games.name: Halloweenies Candy Run
release_games.description: Trick-or-treat with up to 4 players. Loot the houses on procedurally generated streets. Find rare physics based candy and bank it before the Candy KPI catches up with you. Buy weapons and abilities to help your odds against the horde. Your friends can hear proximity chat, but so can the hunters.

release_games.name: Dealer's Choice
release_games.description: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

release_games.name: CloudBurst
release_games.description: Pilot a heavy airship through a sea of clouds, pull alongside your rivals and fire broadsides. Drift out of the storm and you sink. Up to ten captains over LAN or Steam, six modes and three kinds of terrain.

release_games.name: Galactic Rummi LAN Party
release_games.description: Multiplayer Rummi board game ideal for LAN parties, family game night, long flights, camping trips and areas where an Internet connection is not available. All playing devices are required to be connected over the same LAN (Local Area Network), or the Wi-Fi network or Hotspot.

release_games.name: TaskBar VendingMachine
release_games.description: A tiny pixel-art vending machine that lives on your Windows taskbar. Customers line up while you work or play. Stock the shelves, set your prices, read the daily news to catch the next trend, and meet quirky regulars, all without leaving your desktop.

release_games.name: Deckbound
release_games.description: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

release_games.name: Dungtilian
release_games.description: Run a burger stand on the surface to feed a starving underground world. Take orders, assemble burgers, and collect human Dung. Face the truth creeping into everyday life.

release_games.name: Fliegeralarm
release_games.description: Launch from a US Navy carrier deck into the Pacific War, 1943–45. Fliegeralarm is cinematic arcade air combat: dogfights, bombing runs and torpedo attacks in legendary aircraft like the F6F Hellcat – 21 story missions, boss duels against the Yamato and the wave-survival mode Hell Run.

release_games.name: Magehold Fairwinds
release_games.description: Crew a leaking airship across five acts of painted sky. Route Flow, raise wind shields, cast from the Casting Room and board your enemies in real-time-with-pause battles, then pay off the debt, if you can. An airship roguelite set in the world of Magehold.

release_games.name: Sex Novel - Cuckold and Hotwife
release_games.description: An erotic VISUAL NOVEL with stunning HD visuals and steamy ANIMATIONS. A devoted husband finally reveals his deepest fantasy: sharing his hot wife with other men. Will Bella embrace Devon’s desires?

release_games.name: Masterpiece Malpractice
release_games.description: Ruin art. Precisely. Inflate, twist and smudge famous paintings to match their distorted doubles. A playful visual puzzle with 70 art challenges, 13 distortion tools and three stars to chase on every canvas.

release_games.name: Swat Mosquito: Sleepless Nights
release_games.description: Swat mosquitoes, earn coins, and build up your pest-control arsenal in this 2D incremental game. Unlock permanent upgrades, combine automatic devices, and take on the Mosquito King.

release_games.name: Sketch Defense
release_games.description: Draw your towers. Defend your doodled castle. Try not to panic. A playful tower defense with 20 campaign pages, drawings that affect your defenses, and online 1v1 Doodle Duels where you sketch an army and send it at a friend.

release_games.name: Library Police Simulator
release_games.description: Books overdue? Find their secrets. Search loan records, emails, social media, and the school itself. Use what you uncover to force returns, recruit allies, and automate your work. Grow the Library Police, then decide what its control has done to the school in this first-person dark comedy job sim.

release_games.name: Moon Sweepers
release_games.description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

release_games.name: A Sweet Date With : Freesia
release_games.description: Embark on a sensual honeybee-hunting adventure with Freesia, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Freesia's enticing layers.

release_games.name: らくがきスマッシュ / Doodle Smash
release_games.description: Your doodle is your fighter! Draw a character and watch it brawl in a knockout-style party fighter. Its size, shape and colours decide its stats and one of 30 elemental skills. Play up to 4 on one screen, battle the CPU, or climb the online ranked Colosseum against doodles from around the world.

release_games.name: Restore the Luminous
release_games.description: A free-to-play 1v1 card game. Every player uses the same card pool, but each leader has its own ability, opening hand size, and number of board slots. All cards are available from the start. Note: the game is in Japanese only.

release_games.name: Blockmania
release_games.description: A block-puzzle roguelike. Place pieces on an 8×8 board, clear lines and score Chips × Mult. Upgrade your own bag of blocks, collect 92 rule-bending Jokers and beat 12 rounds of bosses, then push into Overtime and try to break the machine.

release_games.name: Last Light: Chalk Creek
release_games.description: Three strangers are stranded in a rural town overrun by the infected and things that crawl out of the ground. Fight through an illustrated three-chapter story or hold out for three days in an isometric shooter with nine weapons, destructible scenery, dynamic weather and a day–night cycle.

release_games.name: Watershed
release_games.description: Make it rain anywhere on Earth: a desert, a forest, a mountain range. Watch real terrain fill with rain, rivers find their way to the sea, lakes form in valleys and flash floods rush down dry canyons. A rain and flood simulation sandbox built on real elevation data.

release_games.name: Zombie Last Stand
release_games.description: Take your last stand against an evolving zombie swarm. Fight ten enemy types and two deadly bosses, collect special bullets, armor and permanent upgrades, survive extreme weather events, unlock SWAT skins, complete achievements, and chase a higher score with every run.

release_games.name: A Secret Stay With : Isabella
release_games.description: Step inside an exclusive private residence with Isabella, your captivating host. This adults-only "spot the differences" game challenges your keen eye while rewarding your success with intimate, seductive reveals.

release_games.name: SUSPENCIL
release_games.description: An online drawing and social deduction game for up to 8 players. Draw your prompt and discuss the drawings to find the Werewolf—the only one with a different prompt. The Madman scribbles on others’ drawings to help the Werewolf. Even if caught, the Werewolf can win by guessing the Citizens’ prompt.

release_games.name: Empty The Lake!
release_games.description: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

release_games.name: Spot the Difference Fighter
release_games.description: Fighting games meet spot-the-difference! Find the differences and KO your opponent! No complicated controls—just sharp eyes and quick reflexes! Chain combos and compete against players from around the world!

release_games.name: Bungee Simulator: Freefall
release_games.description: An extreme bungee jumping simulation game that goes for real physics feedback. Leap from high up and feel the ultimate weightlessness of free fall and the adrenaline rush when the rope snaps back.

release_games.name: Fish Wrangler
release_games.description: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.

release_games.name: Rouge and Run
release_games.description: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

release_games.name: Furry Snow Leopard
release_games.description: Furry Snow Leopard is a seductive adult puzzle game featuring a charming snow leopard heroine. Uncover her boldest looks, unlock steamy illustrations, and step by step discover what lies behind her cold yet alluring gaze.

release_games.name: 101 Cats: Frankfurt
release_games.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Frankfurt landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

release_games.name: 101 Cats: San Francisco

release_games.description: Build a gem factory, one card at a time. Combine factory automation with deckbuilding as you mine, refine, transport and ship precious gems. Work with an eccentric crew in the abyss and meet the demands of Lilitryon, your gold-loving supervisor.

release_games.name: Smithereens
release_games.description: Smithereens — the destructible platform shooter for 2–5 players. Blast holes in the arena, launch your friends into acid, and turn respawns into comebacks with upgrade cards. Brawl on one couch or online, or practice against bots.

release_games.name: Want a Bomb?
release_games.description: Explore an island in search of the Sun Gem, solo or with up to 4 players online. Blast through mountains, sell ore, research and upgrade your gear, and take on monsters. From chain reactions to launchers that send friends flying, carve your own path!

release_games.name: Licensed to Love: Airi
release_games.description: Licensed to Love: Airi is a short adult retro-style visual novel about joining a relationship training agency and learning what happens when practice starts to feel real.

release_games.name: Hentai Puzzle: Cassandra
release_games.description: Solve puzzles with Cassandra, a very naughty witch, and unlock seductive anime images and scenes as you progress in Hentai Puzzle: Cassandra.

release_games.description: 30 DAYS. FOUR WOMEN. ONE ISLAND. Thirty days on a deserted island. Four women. A storm, ruins, and desires that cannot all be satisfied at once. 200+ illustrations and animated explicit scenes.

release_games.name: The Grave Abyss
release_games.description: Grab your sword and descend to the deepest depths of a corrupted cave to find and destroy the source of evil that plagues the small town of Oakhaven. The Grave Abyss is an old school single player, 3d dungeon crawler RPG with turn based combat.

release_games.name: Strip Bubbles: A night in the City
release_games.description: Match, pop, and reveal! Unwind with this seductive anime bubble shooter beneath the neon glow of the Midnight District. Meet 4 gorgeous girls in their private spots, collect their wardrobe, and choose your path through interactive reward trees and hot endings.

release_games.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
release_games.description: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

release_games.name: Hentai Tales: Humanoid Doll
release_games.description: After years of saving, I finally bring home a budget-class companion android, Mianmian. My routine life is upended by a malfunction that leads me to a secret compensation: Viola, a top-tier, "wild" prototype with a faulty connection.

release_games.name: ShapeBreaker
release_games.description: ShapeBreaker is a survival clicker: click shapes to break them, preventing sanity lost, survive increasingly difficult waves. Earn coins, buy upgrades, and push further on your next run.

release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Beyond Dawn
release_games.description: Scavenge a dying city before sunrise in a first-person world rendered in 3D ASCII. Follow hidden routes, build a home beneath the streets, and descend toward Liminal Corp. Explore a possible future in Wasteland, where repairs made in the past can change what survives.

release_games.name: Halloween Trick or Treat: Mega Bundle 1
release_games.description: THREE Fabulous Fun-Filled Halloween themed Hidden Object Games for all the Family and all Ages to enjoy.

release_games.name: Amazecards
release_games.description: Each card represents a movement. Choosing the correct sequence is essential to cross the board, avoid dangers, and reach the chest at the end of each stage. One wrong step can cause the player to fall into holes or be struck by spike traps that alternate between active and inactive every turn.

release_games.name: Falling
release_games.description: In Falling, guide your ball through obstacle courses in free fall. One touch is all it takes to start over. Easy to pick up, tough to master — and create your own levels.

release_games.name: FarmWings
release_games.description: A vertical idle shmup: your fighter flies, dodges and shoots on its own, and you command its evolution. Beat adaptive AI bosses across 5 biomes and 3 difficulty modes, forge gear up to +10 and trade items on the Steam Community Market. Always in a corner of your screen.

release_games.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
release_games.description: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

release_games.name: Sweet Camping 2
release_games.description: Sweet Camping 2 - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around camping. Spend a pleasant time at a campsite with five pretty and lovely girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.

release_games.name: BudMageddon
release_games.description: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

release_games.name: One Way Tickets
release_games.description: “One Way Tickets” is a roguelite incremental adventure game where you embark on a exciting journey in a fantasy world. Choose your vehicle, equip your device and face challenges from all kinds of enemies. Ram! Unload bullets! Swing with all your might! Keep growing and push forward!

release_games.name: Kurdistan Simulator
release_games.description: Kurdistan Simulator is an experimental walking simulation set in the empty landscapes of a nonexistent country where, in reality, there is nothing at all. As you wander through this void—which exists only in someone’s dreams or imagination—you’ll realize there’s nothing to do around you

release_games.name: 君临传奇之风起云涌
release_games.description: 江湖将乱，风云已动！经典复古高爆国战版传奇，专为兄弟情义与热血厮杀而生！不氪金照样封神，不将就才能称王。极品装备、绝世武学全凭实力爆出，BOSS越狠，爆得越疯，捡到你手软！ 战鼓擂响，屠龙在手，兄弟们整装待发——攻沙、夺城、君临天下！

release_games.name: Evercursed: Act I
release_games.description: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

release_games.name: Run.EXE
release_games.description: A fast-paced 3D platformer where you run, jump, and survive through 25 levels of shifting gravity, reversed controls, and intentional glitches that constantly break the rules.

release_games.name: Eric's Farm
release_games.description: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Toss ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry animals and smash through ten chaotic days in a slapstick 3D farm game. Take on bosses, five minigames and Endless Mode, then unlock The Back Forty: grow crops, drive tractors and build your own farm.

release_games.name: Retro Pond
release_games.description: Breed unique fish, discover rare mutations and grow your pond.

release_games.name: Ashen Knight
release_games.description: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

release_games.name: Cyan Soul
release_games.description: An arcade style, pixel art, boss-rush puzzle action game. Move your character up, down, right and left! Dash through enemy attacks and obstacles! Pick up objects and hurl them at the boss to cause damage! Gather enough points and unleash max damage with a powerful projectile or form!

release_games.name: It Wants You To Stay
release_games.description: The lights are on. Everyone is gone. Descend through eleven shifting liminal worlds in this first-person psychological horror game. Photograph the impossible, follow a missing woman’s VHS recordings, and save your light for what follows you. When the lights fail, stand still.

release_games.name: Mount Noire
release_games.description: Get cash, get meds, get home. Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

release_games.name: Desktop Taxi
release_games.description: A cozy idle taxi sim with Lofi beats. Grow your taxi business quietly in the corner of your screen while you work.

release_games.name: Saving Songburg™
release_games.description: Saving Songburg™ is a 3D third-person action-adventure platformer, set in a whimsical Steampunk world. Help the robot Automavoz save the town of Songburg from the interdimensional gang of art thieves known as the Dream Stealers!

release_games.name: Climb King
release_games.description: Climb. Fall. Repeat. A high-stakes pixel-art climbing game with grab-and-swing movement, harsh drops, and “safe points” that aren’t as safe as you’d like.

release_games.name: The Story of Noah
release_games.description: Welcome to the captivating world of "The Story of Noah" — a journey for you and your children into ancient times and one of the most inspiring stories of the Holy Scriptures! Step into the role of Noah — the man chosen to build an ark and save his family and all animals from the great flood.

release_games.name: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim
release_games.description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

release_games.name: Duckpool
release_games.description: A rubber duck. Lasers. Bathroom chaos. Duckpool is a challenging top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Blast bizarre enemies, dodge traps, defeat bosses, and escape with your soap. Build a flock of 150 ducks and uncover the mystery behind the bubbles.

release_games.name: Eyes On Me
release_games.description: Live a girls life while being stalked by a serial killer with an insteresting sexual fantasy. Can you reveal the story without completely shitting yourself?

release_games.name: Radical Zomboarding
release_games.description: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

release_games.name: Mimic Alert
release_games.description: A co-op horror game where anything can be a mimic. Memorize the building by day, hunt by night with a friend — or play PvP: one Mimic Queen against up to four humans.

release_games.name: Abandoned Hearts
release_games.description: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

release_games.name: ALYSSA
release_games.description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

release_games.name: Elevator Button Simulator
release_games.description: Step into an elevator, press the buttons, and travel between floors. A simulator built around a small part of everyday life. Enjoy watching the elevator respond to each press.

release_games.name: Chained Pirates Together
release_games.description: A cursed skull has chained your crew together, and only a lightning strike at the summit can break it. Climb 1000 meters in this physics-based co-op climbing game for 1–4 pirates, where one bad jump drags everyone down with you.

release_games.name: MAZZIOSI
release_games.description: MAZZIOSI is a single-player 3v3 card battler in a crooked city. Choose three of 63 heroes, combine their abilities and outsmart eccentric bosses. Follow a comic-book campaign or take on roguelite runs with branching routes and powerful boosts.

release_games.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
release_games.description: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid bosses. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

release_games.name: Fruitpocalypse
release_games.description: The veggies have risen. Only the fruits stand in their way. Survive 20 waves of evil vegetables, twisted bosses and cursed nights in this cartoon arena roguelite.

release_games.name: Grind Grid
release_games.description: A pixel-art incremental clicker-idler where 96 monsters and 32 idle blocks each level up independently. Hover your mouse — damage fires on its own. Prestige, evolutions, perks, tiers, and hundreds of upgrades. How far can you push the numbers?

release_games.name: Song Bao's Adventure
release_games.description: Adapted from real lives. Song Bao leaves Shengdu on a scholarship to Lion City, where he learns the language, the rules, and the overtime — until lightning turns him into a chicken. A fully-voiced ink-wash interactive film: 40 scenes, 4 endings, told with a smile.

release_games.name: A Hoard in Order
release_games.description: After a storm made a mess on The Salty Scallop, it is up to you, the Quartermaster, to put everything back in its place in this cozy sorting game.

release_games.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
release_games.description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

release_games.name: Chaos Chess Definitive Edition
release_games.description: Chess, reimagined! Draft powerful Champions with unique abilities, outsmart your opponent, and adapt to board-altering Chaos events. Master classic chess, dominate online PvP, or conquer the epic single-player campaign. All 34 launch Champions and 7 scenarios are included in one purchase.

release_games.name: STOREBOT: Tidy Up PC Parts
release_games.description: Organize thousands of PC parts, complete shelves, unlock powerful upgrades, and work together with friends to tidy up a chaotic computer store. Carry, throw, and sort boxes across two unique maps while building your perfect store.

release_games.name: Simply A Button
release_games.description: 48 rooms. 48 challenges. No pressure. A first-person, puzzle, platformer where every room is something different and there's nothing to prove. Solve the puzzles at your leisure. If need be there is a hint and answer sign for you in every room. No one will know. But you will know. You will know.

release_games.name: Sidetrack — Tiny Trains for Your Desktop
release_games.description: A cozy idle railway game that lives along the edge of your desktop while you work. Buy engines and wagons, deliver cargo, fill contracts and blow the whistle for coins as five districts grow along one long line: vans stop at shop doors, windows light up at dusk and boats drift down the river.

release_games.name: PALJA Survivors
release_games.description: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

release_games.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
release_games.description: Leave it running and ★ loot keeps pouring in. Push deeper with weapon skills and 72 allies who each bring a trait — and time your Burst to parry a boss's big hit.

release_games.name: TSUKIMI PLANET -CLASSIC REMASTER-
release_games.description: A mysterious girl named Tsukimi appears beside a terminally ill young man, claiming to be an alien from the Moon. She offers to grant his final wish. His answer is simple: “I want to talk with you again tomorrow.” A short visual novel reborn as a CLASSIC REMASTER.

release_games.name: Gems & Palace
release_games.description: Dig through layered mines, uncover 60 unique gems, master an arsenal of mining tools, and complete your collection. Display every discovery in the Gem Museum and use your treasures to illuminate the Myriad Crystal Palace.

release_games.name: Ashnar's Lair
release_games.description: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

release_games.name: Chat is Cooked
release_games.description: Turn your Twitch chat into part of the show. Grab and throw chatters, drop them into the pot, and let messages, channel points, Bits, and subscriptions trigger chaotic effects in this customizable streamer overlay game.

release_games.name: Little Pot, Big Seasons
release_games.description: A tiny potted plant in a soft, healing animated style, living in the corner of your desktop. Transparent, always-on-top, truly zero UI. Water it, feed it, weed it, and walk with it from sprout through all four seasons. Rain, snow and light drift by; little chalkboards tell you what it needs.

release_games.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke
release_games.description: Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all! Take on task after task all by yourself!

release_games.name: Trivia Mania
release_games.description: Welcome to Trivia Mania! Test your knowledge about the most common trivia questions, and improve your own performance. Trivia Mania has over 4,700 questions across eight genres. Game modes such as the Gauntlet, Ladder, Survival and Custom allow you to play in different fun and interactive ways.

release_games.name: Bullet Breakfast
release_games.description: Bullet Breakfast is a fast-paced 3D third-person arena shooter. Choose from five unique heroes, master their weapons and abilities, collect powerful upgrades, survive endless waves of undead, and defeat the Demon King before sunrise!

release_games.name: Memory Moth
release_games.description: Memory Moth blends roguelike, tower defense, farming, and resource management. Grow crops, build defenses, team up with animal companions, fight waves of pests, create unique builds, and recover fading memories.

release_games.name: Flamebound Tactics
release_games.description: Flamebound Tactics is a pixel-art strategy puzzle. Place units on suitable terrain, combine their unique coverage patterns, and light every brazier without exceeding the budget. Solve 30 handcrafted stages across islands of varied shapes and terrain.

release_games.name: Rescuing My Wife
release_games.description: Your wife, Amanda, has been kidnapped by a family of demonic creatures. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, defeat the demonic family members, and find Amanda.

release_games.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
release_games.description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

release_games.name: NOVA
release_games.description: Every world you own grows forces. Fling them at the next one. Nova is real-time strategy stripped to one move and one mouse: 144 hand built levels, seven rival factions, worlds that orbit out from under your plans, and a galaxy of black holes and burning stars standing in your way.

release_games.name: Polandball: The Sixth Day - Destroy
release_games.description: Endless waves of infected are closing in! A single-player, top-down endless survival shooter starring countryballs. Survive through your own choices and builds, create a character of your own, and fight through a living day-night cycle as the world gradually falls apart.

release_games.name: The 31st Student
release_games.description: Thirty names. Thirty-one desks. Explore a deserted Japanese high school, cross-check altered records, and restore damaged audio recordings. A first-person psychological horror mystery where the evidence you preserve shapes three unique endings.

release_games.name: Skyts
release_games.description: Two hundred and sixteen km/h and nothing to hold on to. Beat your own ghost, take the same line as five other runners, or fight them for a lit bomb that slows down whoever carries it. Six tracks, a daily challenge, a map editor, skins to earn.

release_games.name: Second Source
release_games.description: You are the OSINT analyst. One report on your desk is a plant, and it lies in exactly one place. Find it before the clock runs out. And when they breach the building, get the commander out on foot, unseen.

release_games.name: Hentai Femboy Housekeeper
release_games.description: Hentai Femboy Housekeeper brings cozy home vibes, charming femboys, and playful surprises. Complete relaxing puzzles, reveal exclusive artwork, and make every room feel special.

release_games.name: Axiom of Stars
release_games.description: Resurrect a fallen sky, one constellation at a time. Axiom of Stars is a calm, luminous logic puzzle game: 2048 puzzles across multiple constellations, each a new way to think, and new mechanics to figure out.

release_games.name: THERMAL RUNAWAY
release_games.description: A top-down roguelite inside one sealed chamber. Ten levels, one hundred waves, and upgrades that compound into something the facility was not built to contain. The run ends when you break — or when the reaction does.

release_games.name: AFTER CLOSING - 闭店之后
release_games.description: After closing, only two people are left in the office. She's your manager, six years older, and she never takes off that silver watch. She says this doesn't count - she's said it four times. A short adult visual novel about order coming apart: four stat-driven endings, seven H scenes.

release_games.name: Dub House
release_games.description: One to eight players, a party game where you only use your voice, Take a character each, record your lines, then watch it back with your takes where the actors used to be. Four modes: Dub, Telephone, Rap Booth. Plus a clip editor

release_games.name: Idle Plinko
release_games.description: Build the ultimate Plinko machine in this incremental idle game. Level up to discover unique boards, buy powerful upgrades, unlock special balls, gamble to transform your pegs, and prestige for permanent perks. Compete with players worldwide and climb the leaderboards.

release_games.name: Play and Learn: German
release_games.description: First we get you speaking, then we make you better. A story RPG where the microphone is the controller: a full A1 to B2 German course, 15 role-play rooms, 6,100 spoken sentences, every meaning in your own language. Fully offline, one-time purchase.

release_games.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1: Lost Friend
release_games.description: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

release_games.name: Biblioclash Digital
release_games.description: Biblioclash Digital is the official digital version of Biblioclash for Windows and macOS. In this deck-building game players bring their own custom set of cards to play and try to defeat their opponent in a magical duel.

release_games.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
release_games.description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

release_games.name: Orbital Madness
release_games.description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

release_games.name: Please Advise
release_games.description: You've been sent to a private clinic to audit the books. You're really here to find out who killed your uncle. You cannot speak, so you answer by gesture or on a tablet. Balance the clinic's money, patient trust, staff loyalty, and your own conscience.

release_games.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
release_games.description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

release_games.name: DaoNoKa hide
release_games.description: Don't fear to speak e lusive words. The only certainty is that all things present shall fade away in time. Friends from overseas have recommended consulting relevant reference books during your playthrough of the work.

release_games.name: Overlap
release_games.description: Fast-paced 2D wave shooter built around the parry. Two weapons, a coin shop, nine planets of story, and a style meter that punishes the timid. Reach SSS rank, clear the campaign, or die trying.

release_games.name: SAKIMORI
release_games.description: Explore cursed locations, locate cursed objects, and purify them. Alongside the guardian Saku Tsukino, confront the curse within an anomalous space, purify the cursed objects, and survive. A first-person horror Roguelite set in abandoned Japanese locations.

release_games.name: Battle Nap
release_games.description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

release_games.name: Wartide
release_games.description: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.

release_games.name: TitleIt!
release_games.description: Turn a photo into the funniest caption. Write, vote and compete in quick online rounds with friends on Steam, Android and the web. Play for free, join with a room code and collect your winning moments. Optional purchases available.

release_games.name: Risk it Little Biscuit
release_games.description: Risk it, little biscuit! Crunch through endless hordes of sugar-crazed sweets in this bite-sized bullet-heaven roguelite. Pick a hero from the pantry, stack absurd snack weapons, evolve them into pure kitchen chaos and topple crowned bosses, one crumbly run at a time.

release_games.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
release_games.description: 🐱 Discover 200 hidden cats across 2 artistic hand-drawn scenes 🖌️. Relax with color-by-numbers 🎨 and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op 👯‍♂️, while Meow FM 🎶 sets the perfect creative mood.

release_games.name: Lost Jelly
release_games.description: A cute puzzle arcade game where your robot can't stop moving! Guide Nimble across colorful farm levels, collect every runaway Jelly, and reach the exit. With broken brakes and a growing trail of boxes behind him, every move matters!

release_games.name: Tow Game
release_games.description: Tow Game is a physics-based action game where you control a car being towed by a tow truck. Swing around the environment using the tow cable and earn points by causing chaos and destruction.

release_games.name: Terror In The Shadowrealms
release_games.description: Explore unsettling environments, search for anomalies, and survive unexpected encounters in this short indie horror game.

release_games.name: Sakura Hime 7
release_games.description: In a paradise of blooming cherry blossoms, catgirls, witches, and elves gather around you. Share sweet everyday moments with them and build a lavish harem all your own.

release_games.name: King of Jewelry
release_games.description: Run a vintage jewelry business: hunt for bargains, haggle, appraise and sell to the right customer. Build your collection from thousands of pieces, balance stock against the bills, and solve 500 jewelry puzzles to earn new treasures.

release_games.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced [Episode 1]
release_games.description: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

release_games.name: Atrion Project
release_games.description: A hybrid with no memories. A planet out to kill you. A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics. Fight. Die. Learn. Retry. Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

release_games.name: Moadra
release_games.description: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

release_games.name: Lighthouse of Madness
release_games.description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you on this island. Explore the island, solve challenging puzzles, and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity.

release_games.name: Monsters, Inn Order!
release_games.description: Check in for cute monsters and deliciously tangled logic puzzles. Arrange a line of peculiar guests, connect their clues, and chase that glorious “aha!” across 100+ puzzles. Make unlikely friends, uncover a little mystery, and find a place for everyone.

release_games.name: Robot Fisher
release_games.description: Third person fishing simulation game, where player controls lonely robot who are just fishing

release_games.name: BOOMSWEEPER
release_games.description: An incremental twist on classic Minesweeper. Sweep, earn, upgrade, hire a crew, dig up Finds and go deeper into boards inside boards. One wrong click... BOOM.

release_games.name: Oval Office Tidy Up
release_games.description: Some people will finish it in one sitting. Some will start by recognizing a few flags and leave knowing exactly where Benin is. Read the flag on each folder, figure out where that country is and file it on the right continent shelf. Tidy up fast and beat your best time.

release_games.name: Farkle: Tavern Dice
release_games.description: Farkle: Tavern Dice brings the classic push-your-luck dice game to a cozy medieval tavern. Roll for points, decide when to bank your score, and risk another throw for a bigger payoff—or lose the round.

release_games.name: My Own Roguelike: RPG
release_games.description: An auto-attack roguelite RPG. Pick level-up cards every run, farm gear with random options and grow a 331-node passive tree to craft a build that is all your own — across 9 worlds, Hell difficulty and an endless boss tower.

release_games.name: Taskbar Cat
release_games.description: A little company for your Windows desktop. Adopt cats with unique coats, eyes and personalities. Watch them wander, nap and play along your taskbar, then take a break to pet them, share treats and care for your growing cat family.

release_games.name: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
release_games.description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king’s ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

release_games.name: O'BLOCK
release_games.description: You start with $300 and a shoebox. You end up selling sneakers to billionaires, if you can read who's lying. Every buyer hides their number and some lie about it. Free to play: name your price, win the deal, climb from the block to a billion.

release_games.name: Fzzy Bzzy's The Beautiful Ones
release_games.description: A straight forward action rpg where you play as Shell, a mouse destined to lead sinking mice out of the dark! Based around the Universe 25 experiment, a dying society of rats and mice fight to survive in a post-apocalyptic world!

release_games.name: Sudoku Unlimited
release_games.description: Settle into a cozy garden of Sudoku. Solve classic grids and clever variants, learn with step-by-step hints, and unlock new scenery as you play. Share a board in online co-op or keep a small puzzle beside your other apps.

release_games.name: TPS Tickman: Castle Defense
release_games.description: Hold the canyon wall against 30 waves of stickmen in a laid-back third-person shooter. Arm your castle with auto turrets, missiles, drones and cavalry, hijack enemy tanks, fly a gunship, and bring down six giant bosses. No grind, no difficulty levels — just shoot.

release_games.name: Farthest
release_games.description: Start with nothing. Get as far as you can. Explore an endless, procedurally generated maze, crack open chests, unlock portals, and when the clock runs out, outrun the Void. How far will you get?

release_games.name: STAR CIPHER
release_games.description: Turn English vocabulary practice into a sci-fi typing battle. Type answers to stop falling enemies, build combos, and tackle faster waves. Explore 100 chapters with comic dialogues, pronunciation audio, and a practice mode you can play at your own pace.

release_games.name: ROTORORA Drone Racing
release_games.description: Race through five colorful worlds in 8-drone battles. Fly up and down, choose boost detours, and compete with missiles, rapid fire and shields. Play solo with CPU rivals or join online rooms, with arcade controls and optional quad physics.

release_games.name: Kaiju Climber
release_games.description: Kaiju Climber is a surreal action-platformer where the goal is simple; Get to the next checkpoint!
